It proposes VEDet, a query-based transformer framework that augments features with 3D positional encodings and uses view-conditioned queries to enforce multi-view consistency. This method achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 该论文通过视角等变性提升了3D检测性能，方法新颖且实验充分，值得关注。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出了利用视角等变性的VEDet框架，提升多视角3D检测精度。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 创新性地在输入和损失层面注入多视角几何信息。
2303.14548|v2.result: 在nuScenes基准上取得了最先进性能。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR和Radar数据融合中Radar数据稀疏且缺乏高度信息的问题，该论文提出了双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion。方法上，首先从LiDAR分支学习重要细节以丰富Radar局部特征，然后在统一的鸟瞰图表示中融合增强后的Radar特征与LiDAR特征。相比已有工作，该方法通过双向融合有效解决了Radar数据稀疏和高度缺失的挑战。效果上，在nuScenes和ORR数据集上取得了动态物体检测的最先进性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of fusing sparse Radar data lacking height information with LiDAR in 3D detection. It proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional fusion framework that enriches Radar features from LiDAR and combines them in a unified BEV representation. This method achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes and ORR datasets.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 该论文提出的双向融合策略有效解决了多传感器融合中的关键问题，实验充分，值得关注。
2306.01438|v2.contribution: 提出了双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架，提升动态物体3D检测性能。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 创新性地通过双向融合增强Radar特征并统一表示。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上取得了最先进性能。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: 针对现有3D检测方法依赖密集特征或后处理导致效率低下的问题，该论文提出了VoxelNeXt，一种全稀疏的VoxelNet用于3D检测和跟踪。方法上，通过全稀疏卷积和稀疏体素表示，直接预测物体框，避免了密集特征图的计算。相比已有工作，该方法在保持高精度的同时显著提升了推理效率。效果上，在多个基准上展示了优异的性能。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of dense features in 3D detection. It proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet that directly predicts boxes from sparse voxel representations. This method achieves high accuracy with improved efficiency on multiple benchmarks.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 该论文提出的全稀疏架构对提升3D检测效率具有重要意义，值得关注。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出了全稀疏VoxelNet架构，实现高效3D检测和跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 创新性地采用全稀疏卷积和直接预测策略。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 在多个基准上展示了优异的性能。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有掩码自编码器在多模态设置中交互不足的问题，该论文提出了PiMAE，一个促进点云和图像交互的自监督预训练框架。方法上，通过投影模块对齐掩码和可见令牌，利用双分支MAE管道和共享解码器促进跨模态交互，并设计跨模态重建模块增强表示学习。相比已有工作，该方法在掩码策略、解码器和重建模块三方面实现了深度交互。效果上，在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2基准上取得了显著改进。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient cross-modal interaction in masked autoencoders for point cloud and image data. It proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised framework with aligned masking, a shared decoder, and cross-modal reconstruction. This method achieves significant improvements on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 benchmarks.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 该论文在多模态自监督学习方面提出了有效交互机制，实验充分，值得关注。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出了PiMAE框架，增强点云和图像的自监督交互学习。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 创新性地设计了掩码对齐、共享解码器和跨模态重建模块。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2基准上取得了显著改进。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 针对BEV 3D检测中现有方法将BEV空间沿高度维度展平，未能充分利用不同高度层特征信息的问题，提出BEV-SAN方法。该方法沿高度维度采样构建全局和局部BEV切片，从相机特征聚合切片特征并通过注意力机制融合，最后用transformer融合局部和全局BEV特征。相比现有展平方法，能更好地保留高度维度的语义信息，提升检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing BEV 3D detection methods flatten the BEV space along the height dimension, neglecting informative features at different heights. It proposes BEV-SAN, which samples along height to build global and local BEV slices, aggregates camera features into slices, merges them via attention, and fuses with a transformer. This improves detection accuracy by preserving height-specific information.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 该工作针对BEV特征构建中的高度信息丢失问题提出了新颖的切片注意力机制，对多相机3D检测有重要参考价值。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出BEV切片注意力网络，通过高度维度的切片采样和注意力融合提升BEV特征质量。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 首次在BEV特征构建中显式建模高度维度的全局和局部信息。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes等数据集上验证了有效性，显著优于基线方法。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测模型计算量大、难以部署的问题，提出基于交换传递的知识蒸馏方法itKD。该方法采用自编码器框架，通过通道压缩和解压缩，利用压缩表示损失绑定师生网络的通道知识，并将解压缩特征反向传递以减少重构差距，同时引入头注意力损失匹配检测信息。实验表明能训练出与3D检测任务对齐的轻量模型。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the computational inefficiency of point-cloud 3D detectors by proposing interchange transfer-based knowledge distillation (itKD). It uses an autoencoder with channel-wise compression, a compressed representation loss, and head attention loss to transfer knowledge from teacher to student. Experiments show the method trains lightweight models aligned with 3D detection tasks.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 该工作为3D检测的模型压缩提供了新思路，但创新性和实验规模相对有限。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出交换传递知识蒸馏框架，实现3D检测模型的高效压缩。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 利用共享自编码器和双向特征传递实现通道级知识蒸馏。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上验证了轻量模型的性能提升。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测器在真实世界恶劣天气和传感器噪声下鲁棒性不足的问题，设计了27种针对LiDAR和相机输入的常见损坏类型，并在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上建立了三个鲁棒性基准。大规模评估了24种3D检测模型，发现运动级损坏威胁最大，LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好，相机-only模型对图像损坏极其脆弱。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness in 3D detectors to real-world corruptions by designing 27 types of corruptions for LiDAR and camera inputs. It establishes benchmarks KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, and Waymo-C, and evaluates 24 models, finding motion-level corruptions are most threatening, fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are vulnerable.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地建立了3D检测鲁棒性基准，对自动驾驶安全评估具有重要价值。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 首次建立全面的3D检测鲁棒性基准并揭示关键发现。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 设计了涵盖多传感器和真实场景的27种损坏类型。
2303.11040|v2.result: 评估了24种模型，提供了鲁棒性排名和洞察。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 针对LSS-based多视图3D检测中卷积忽略BEV特征径向对称性、增加优化难度的问题，提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）和方位角等变锚框。AeConv的采样网格始终沿径向，学习方位角不变的BEV特征；锚框使检测头预测方位角无关目标。还引入相机解耦虚拟深度统一不同相机内参的深度预测。在nuScenes上NDS达62.0%，大幅超越PETRv2和BEVDepth。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that standard convolution ignores the radial symmetry of BEV features in multi-view 3D detection. It proposes azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) and anchors to learn azimuth-invariant features, plus camera-decoupled virtual depth. AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth by a large margin.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 该工作从几何对称性角度创新设计卷积和锚框，显著提升检测精度，是BEV检测的重要进展。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积和锚框，实现方位角不变的BEV特征学习。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用径向对称性设计等变卷积，减少优化难度。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，超越多个SOTA方法。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 针对多帧点云检测中Detect-and-Fuse框架计算冗余的问题，提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF。该方法利用物体运动连续性，在当前帧生成3D proposals并基于速度传播到前序帧，池化感兴趣点并编码为proposal特征，通过双向特征聚合模块促进跨帧交互，并用体素采样优化池化速度。在保证精度的同时显著提升效率。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundant computation in multi-frame point cloud detection by proposing Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF). It generates 3D proposals in the current frame, propagates them to previous frames based on velocities, pools points-of-interest, and uses a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation module. This improves efficiency while maintaining accuracy.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多帧检测的效率瓶颈提出了运动引导的融合策略，实用性强。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导的序列融合方法，减少冗余计算并提升检测效率。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 利用运动连续性传播proposals，避免逐帧全量特征提取。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在多个数据集上实现了精度与效率的更好平衡。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 针对NeRF场景中直接进行物体检测的问题，提出NeRF-RPN框架，直接在预训练NeRF上操作，利用多尺度3D神经体素特征回归3D边界框，无需渲染任何视角。该框架通用，可检测无类别标签的物体，并提供了包含合成和真实数据的基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses object detection in NeRF scenes by proposing NeRF-RPN, which directly operates on pre-trained NeRF models. It uses multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features to regress 3D bounding boxes without rendering, and is applicable to class-agnostic detection. A benchmark dataset is also provided.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了NeRF中检测的新方向，但与应用领域相关性较低。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 首次提出直接在NeRF上进行物体检测的通用框架。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 利用体素特征表示实现无需渲染的3D检测。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了有效性，并公开了基准。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: ①针对3D目标检测中无监督域适应在点云密度差异大时性能下降的问题。②提出了一种密度不敏感的域适应方法，通过设计密度感知的特征对齐和样本重加权策略来缓解源域与目标域密度分布不一致的影响。③相比现有域适应方法，该方法显式建模密度差异，并在特征和实例层面进行自适应调整。④在多个基准数据集上验证了有效性，显著提升了跨域检测精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of unsupervised domain adaptation in 3D object detection under large point cloud density discrepancies. It proposes a density-insensitive method with density-aware feature alignment and sample reweighting to mitigate distribution shifts. Compared to existing methods, it explicitly models density differences and adapts at both feature and instance levels. Experiments on benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements in cross-domain detection accuracy.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该论文针对实际应用中常见的点云密度差异问题，提出了实用的域适应策略，对提升模型泛化能力有参考价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的3D目标检测域适应方法，缓解密度分布差异。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 引入密度感知的特征对齐与样本重加权机制。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在跨域基准上显著提升检测精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: ①针对激光雷达与相机融合中深度信息利用不足和跨模态交互粒度不够的问题。②提出了MSMDFusion框架，包含多深度反投影（MDU）方法，利用深度感知设计将2D语义提升到3D空间，并在体素空间实现细粒度跨模态交互。③相比现有方法，MDU更好地利用深度信息，融合策略从简单拼接或注意力改进为多尺度、多深度种子融合。④在nuScenes和Waymo等基准上取得了领先的3D检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth exploitation and coarse cross-modal interaction in LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D detection. It proposes MSMDFusion with a Multi-Depth Unprojection method that leverages depth-aware designs to lift 2D semantics into 3D, enabling fine-grained interactions in voxel space. Compared to prior work, it improves depth utilization and fusion granularity. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes and Waymo benchmarks.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该论文在融合深度信息方面有创新，多尺度设计提升了检测精度，对多模态感知研究有较强启发。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出多深度种子融合框架，增强LiDAR-相机跨模态3D检测。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 多深度反投影与细粒度体素交互机制。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在主要基准上达到领先性能。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D检测中跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段知识迁移不足的问题。②提出了X3KD框架，通过知识蒸馏在模态（LiDAR到相机）、任务（检测到分割等）和训练阶段间传递信息，增强相机模型的感知能力。③相比单模态或单任务蒸馏，该方法系统性地整合多维度知识，提升训练效率。④在nuScenes等数据集上验证了性能提升，尤其在远距离和小物体检测上。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient knowledge transfer across modalities, tasks, and stages in multi-camera 3D detection. It proposes X3KD, a distillation framework that transfers knowledge from LiDAR to cameras, across tasks, and between training stages. Compared to single-dimension distillation, it systematically integrates multi-dimensional knowledge. Experiments on nuScenes show improved performance, especially for distant and small objects.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该论文提出全面的蒸馏框架，对多相机感知和知识蒸馏研究有重要参考意义。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出跨模态、任务和阶段的统一知识蒸馏方法。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 多维度知识蒸馏的协同设计。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 显著提升多相机3D检测精度。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: ①针对3D目标检测中局部与全局跨模态融合不充分的问题。②提出了LoGoNet，设计局部到全局的融合模块，先提取局部细粒度特征，再通过全局上下文建模增强语义一致性。③相比仅局部或全局融合的方法，LoGoNet兼顾细节与全局信息，提升复杂场景下的鲁棒性。④在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得了优越的检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient local and global cross-modal fusion in 3D detection. It proposes LoGoNet with local-to-global fusion modules, first extracting fine-grained local features then enhancing semantic consistency via global context. Compared to local-only or global-only methods, it balances detail and global information. The method achieves superior performance on KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该论文的局部-全局融合设计具有创新性，对多模态3D检测有实际贡献。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出局部到全局的跨模态融合网络。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 分层融合策略结合局部细节与全局语义。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在多个基准上取得领先结果。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云3D检测中复杂局部聚合器设计是否必要的问题。②重新审视了基于柱状（pillar）的模型，通过借鉴2D检测的成功经验（如扩大感受野）和现代化训练策略，简化网络设计。③相比依赖精细几何建模的方法，该工作证明简单pillar模型在精度和速度上均具竞争力。④在Waymo和nuScenes上实现了最先进性能，挑战了传统直觉。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper questions the necessity of complex local aggregators in LiDAR-based 3D detection. It revisits pillar-based models, incorporating minimal adaptations from 2D detection like enlarged receptive fields and modern training strategies. Compared to geometry-heavy methods, it shows simple pillar models are competitive in accuracy and latency. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on Waymo and nuScenes, challenging common intuitions.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了对网络设计的深刻反思，简化模型同时提升性能，对高效3D检测有重要指导意义。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 证明简化pillar模型可达到最先进性能。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 从计算资源分配角度重新设计网络架构。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云序列中遮挡和远距离物体检测困难的问题。②提出了MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为虚拟模态，将时序上下文中的物体信息传播到目标帧，生成虚拟点云增强输入。③相比传统时序聚合方法，MoDAR能高效利用超长序列（如18秒）信息，且计算开销低。④在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器性能，达到新的最先进水平。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses detection of occluded and long-range objects in point cloud sequences. It proposes MoDAR, using motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to propagate object information from temporal contexts to the target frame via virtual points. Compared to traditional temporal aggregation, it efficiently leverages extra-long sequences with low overhead. The method significantly improves prior detectors on Waymo Open Dataset, achieving new state-of-the-art results.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将运动预测与检测结合，有效解决遮挡和远距离问题，具有很高的实用价值。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出运动预测驱动的虚拟模态增强3D检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将时序运动信息转化为虚拟点云。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo上大幅提升检测性能并刷新SOTA。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督与梯度优化不匹配的问题，即传统IoU损失在优化过程中可能产生不准确的梯度，影响检测精度。②提出了梯度校正的IoU监督方法，通过分析损失函数的梯度特性，设计校正机制以改善优化方向。③相比已有工作，创新性地从梯度层面修正IoU损失，而非仅调整损失形式，更直接地提升训练效果。④实验表明该方法在标准3D检测基准上提升了性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between IoU supervision and gradient optimization in 3D object detection, where traditional IoU losses may yield inaccurate gradients. It proposes a gradient-corrected IoU supervision method that adjusts the optimization direction by analyzing gradient properties. Compared to existing approaches, it innovatively corrects gradients rather than merely altering loss formulations. Experiments show improved performance on standard 3D detection benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该论文从优化理论角度切入3D检测，具有学术价值，但摘要信息有限，需全文验证效果。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督策略，改善3D检测中的优化过程。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 首次从梯度层面修正IoU损失，而非仅调整损失函数形式。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 在3D检测基准上取得性能提升，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D目标检测依赖3D点云标注、训练与推理不一致且数据成本高的问题。②提出了仅需2D标签的弱监督方法，利用投影一致性、多视角一致性和方向一致性构建训练架构，并设计了新的2D方向标注方法以指导旋转预测。③相比已有工作，该方法消除了训练阶段对LiDAR标注的依赖，降低了数据收集成本，并支持大规模反馈数据利用。④实验表明，该方法性能与部分全监督方法相当，且作为预训练方法时显著优于对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that monocular 3D object detection relies on LiDAR point cloud annotations for training, causing inconsistency with inference and high data costs. It proposes a weakly supervised method using only 2D labels, leveraging projection, multi-view, and direction consistency, along with a novel 2D direction labeling scheme. Compared to prior work, it removes the need for 3D annotations during training, reducing expenses. Experiments show comparable performance to some fully supervised methods and, when used for pretraining, significantly outperforms the fully supervised baseline.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了实际部署中的数据标注瓶颈，弱监督设计具有高应用价值，实验验证充分。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测框架，降低标注成本并提升预训练效果。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 结合三种一致性约束和新型2D方向标注，实现无需3D数据的训练。
2303.08686|v2.result: 性能与部分全监督方法相当，预训练时显著超越全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车）因截断和遮挡导致定位精度差的问题。②提出SeaBird方法，在鸟瞰图（BEV）分割任务中使用Dice损失，并设计专门的网络结构来增强BEV特征。③相比传统基于中心点或L1损失的方法，Dice损失直接优化BEV分割的IoU，更适应大型物体的稀疏分布。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，大型物体的3D检测精度显著提升，尤其mAP提升明显（具体数值未提供）。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of monocular 3D detection for large objects like trucks, which suffer from truncation and occlusion. It proposes SeaBird, which employs Dice loss for BEV segmentation to improve localization, outperforming prior methods on nuScenes and Waymo, especially for large objects.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 针对大型物体检测的特定痛点，方法简洁有效，对BEV-based单目检测有重要参考价值。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出将Dice损失用于BEV分割以改进单目3D大型物体检测。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 利用Dice损失对BEV稀疏目标的鲁棒性替代传统回归损失。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上大型物体检测精度显著提升。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: ①针对时序3D检测中计算开销大和点云运动建模复杂的问题。②提出PTT（Point-Trajectory Transformer），通过点轨迹在时间维度上聚合特征，实现高效时序建模。③相比基于体素或BEV的时序融合，点轨迹方法直接关联对应点，减少冗余计算。④在nuScenes数据集上，以较低延迟取得与SOTA相当的检测精度，尤其在运动物体上表现优异（具体数值未提供）。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost and complex motion modeling in temporal 3D detection. It proposes PTT, a point-trajectory transformer that aggregates features along point trajectories, achieving efficient and accurate detection on nuScenes with reduced latency.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 为时序点云检测提供新思路，兼顾效率与精度，适合实时自动驾驶场景。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出点轨迹Transformer用于高效时序3D物体检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 以点轨迹替代体素或BEV进行时序特征聚合。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上实现低延迟且精度与SOTA相当。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR和相机融合中模态对齐和特征选择不充分的问题。②提出GAFusion，利用多种引导信息（如深度、语义）自适应融合LiDAR和相机特征。③相比简单拼接或注意力融合，多引导机制能更精准地利用跨模态互补信息。④在nuScenes和Waymo上，3D检测精度超过现有融合方法，尤其在远距离和小物体上提升明显（具体数值未提供）。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient modality alignment and feature selection in LiDAR-camera fusion. It proposes GAFusion, which uses multiple guidance cues for adaptive fusion, achieving superior 3D detection accuracy on nuScenes and Waymo, especially for distant and small objects.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 融合策略设计精细，多引导机制具有普适性，对多模态感知研究有较强启发。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多引导自适应融合框架GAFusion用于LiDAR-相机3D检测。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 利用深度和语义等引导信息动态调整跨模态特征融合权重。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上精度超越现有融合方法。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: ①针对当前稀疏查询BEV框架在复杂场景下性能瓶颈，以及密集BEV框架被忽视的问题。②提出BEVNeXt，重新设计密集BEV框架，包括增强的编码器、时序融合和任务头。③相比稀疏方法，密集BEV保留完整空间信息，更利于小物体和长尾场景。④在nuScenes和Waymo上，BEVNeXt以更高效率取得SOTA 3D检测精度，证明密集BEV框架的潜力（具体数值未提供）。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: This paper challenges the dominance of sparse-query BEV frameworks by reviving dense BEV designs. BEVNeXt enhances dense BEV with improved encoders and temporal fusion, achieving SOTA 3D detection on nuScenes and Waymo with higher efficiency, highlighting the untapped potential of dense representations.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 重新审视密集BEV框架的价值，实验充分，对BEV感知方向具有里程碑意义。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出BEVNeXt，复兴并优化密集BEV框架用于3D检测。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 系统性地改进密集BEV的编码、时序融合和任务头设计。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上取得SOTA精度且效率更高。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中不同物体尺度差异大、统一框架难以兼顾的问题。②提出UniMODE，采用统一的多尺度架构，结合鸟瞰图和透视图特征进行联合推理。③相比单一BEV或透视方法，UniMODE能自适应处理近处和远处物体。④在nuScenes和KITTI上，UniMODE在单目3D检测中取得领先精度，尤其提升远距离小物体性能（具体数值未提供）。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of scale variation in monocular 3D detection. It proposes UniMODE, a unified architecture combining BEV and perspective features, achieving leading accuracy on nuScenes and KITTI, particularly for distant small objects.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 统一多尺度框架设计合理，对单目检测的尺度鲁棒性有显著贡献。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出UniMODE统一框架，融合BEV和透视特征进行单目3D检测。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 通过多尺度特征融合自适应处理不同距离的物体。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: ①针对雷达-相机融合中雷达点稀疏和噪声大导致BEV特征质量低的问题。②提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间设计雷达特征编码和融合模块，并引入深度引导。③相比早期融合或后期融合，BEV级融合更利于统一特征表达。④在nuScenes上，RCBEVDet在雷达-相机融合3D检测中取得SOTA精度，尤其在恶劣天气下鲁棒性更强（具体数值未提供）。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of sparse and noisy radar data in radar-camera fusion. It proposes RCBEVDet, which performs BEV-level fusion with depth guidance, achieving SOTA 3D detection on nuScenes and improved robustness in adverse weather.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 针对雷达融合的实用性问题，方法工程性强，对低成本自动驾驶方案有重要价值。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出RCBEVDet，实现BEV空间下的雷达-相机高效融合。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 在BEV中设计雷达专用编码和深度引导融合策略。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上取得SOTA精度并增强恶劣天气鲁棒性。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D检测中依赖昂贵3D标注的问题，提出VSRD方法，利用实例感知的体积轮廓渲染，仅需2D框和深度先验即可训练3D检测器。方法通过可微渲染将3D提案投影为体积轮廓，并与2D实例分割掩码对齐，从而提供监督信号。相比现有弱监督方法，VSRD无需精确的3D形状或运动信息，更通用且鲁棒。在KITTI等数据集上，该方法显著缩小了与全监督方法的差距，并优于现有弱监督基线。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: To address the heavy reliance on expensive 3D annotations in weakly supervised 3D detection, this paper proposes VSRD, which leverages instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering to train 3D detectors using only 2D boxes and depth priors. The method aligns rendered volumetric silhouettes with 2D instance masks to provide supervision, eliminating the need for precise 3D shapes or motion. It achieves notable performance gains over existing weakly supervised baselines on KITTI, narrowing the gap with fully supervised methods.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该工作为弱监督3D检测提供了新思路，利用渲染技术降低标注成本，对实际应用有较大价值。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出一种基于体积轮廓渲染的弱监督3D检测框架，仅需2D标注即可训练。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 将可微渲染与实例感知的体积轮廓结合，实现无需3D形状的弱监督学习。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI上显著优于现有弱监督方法，逼近全监督性能。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中跨视角信息融合不充分的问题，提出Multi-View Attentive Contextualization（MVAC）方法，通过注意力机制增强多视角特征间的上下文交互。方法在2D和3D特征层面分别引入自注意力与交叉注意力，有效聚合全局视角信息。相比现有基于Transformer的融合方法，MVAC更轻量且能捕获细粒度跨视角依赖。在nuScenes基准上，该方法在NDS和mAP指标上均取得显著提升，尤其在远距离和小目标场景。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: To improve cross-view information fusion in multi-view 3D detection, this paper introduces MVAC, which employs attention mechanisms to enhance contextual interactions among multi-view features. It applies self- and cross-attention at both 2D and 3D feature levels, enabling efficient global aggregation. Compared to Transformer-based fusion baselines, MVAC is more lightweight and captures fine-grained dependencies, achieving significant gains in NDS and mAP on nuScenes, especially for distant and small objects.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 该工作系统性地设计了多级注意力融合策略，对多相机感知任务具有较强参考价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出一种多视角注意力上下文融合模块，提升3D检测的跨视角一致性。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 在2D和3D特征上联合使用自注意力与交叉注意力，实现高效全局交互。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度歧义导致定位不准的问题，提出将3D检测与占用预测联合学习的方法，通过显式建模场景占用来辅助目标定位。方法引入占用分支，与检测头共享特征，并设计占用-检测一致性损失以增强几何约束。相比纯检测方法，该联合框架能利用稠密占用信息改善深度估计和边界框回归。在KITTI和nuScenes上，该方法在BEV和3D指标上均优于现有单目检测器，尤其在中远距离目标上提升明显。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: To mitigate depth ambiguity in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes jointly learning 3D detection with occupancy prediction, explicitly modeling scene occupancy to assist object localization. The method shares features between occupancy and detection heads and introduces consistency losses to enforce geometric constraints. Compared to detection-only approaches, it leverages dense occupancy to improve depth estimation and box regression, achieving superior BEV and 3D metrics on KITTI and nuScenes, particularly for mid-to-far objects.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 该工作将占用预测与检测结合，为单目3D感知提供了新范式，具有较高研究价值。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出一种占用辅助的单目3D检测框架，通过联合学习提升定位精度。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 设计占用-检测一致性损失，利用稠密占用信息约束目标几何。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上显著优于现有单目检测器。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测和位姿估计中不确定性建模不足的问题，提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型生成3D边界框和位姿参数。方法将检测任务建模为条件生成过程，通过去噪网络逐步细化预测，并引入几何约束以提升稳定性。相比传统回归方法，扩散模型能更好地捕获多模态分布，处理遮挡和模糊场景。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，MonoDiff在3D AP和位姿误差指标上优于现有单目方法，尤其在挑战性场景下。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: To address insufficient uncertainty modeling in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation, this paper proposes MonoDiff, which employs diffusion models to generate 3D boxes and pose parameters. The method formulates detection as a conditional generation process, refining predictions via denoising with geometric constraints. Compared to regression-based methods, diffusion models better capture multimodal distributions, handling occlusion and ambiguity. MonoDiff outperforms existing monocular methods on KITTI and Waymo in 3D AP and pose error metrics, especially in challenging scenes.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 该工作将扩散模型引入单目3D检测，探索了生成式感知的新方向，具有启发性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D检测与位姿估计框架。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 利用条件扩散过程建模检测不确定性，并引入几何约束。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上优于现有单目方法。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视角3D检测中BEV特征构建效率低和精度不足的问题，提出BEVSpread，通过扩展体素池化策略优化BEV表示生成。方法在体素池化时引入空间传播机制，增强特征在垂直和水平方向的分布，减少信息丢失。相比传统体素池化，BEVSpread能更有效地利用稀疏点云特征，提升远距离目标检测能力。在DAIR-V2X和Rope3D数据集上，该方法在3D AP上显著优于现有路侧检测方法，且推理速度更快。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of BEV representation for roadside 3D detection, this paper proposes BEVSpread, which enhances voxel pooling with a spatial propagation mechanism. The method distributes features more effectively along vertical and horizontal directions, reducing information loss during pooling. Compared to standard voxel pooling, BEVSpread better utilizes sparse point features, improving distant object detection. It achieves significant gains in 3D AP on DAIR-V2X and Rope3D with faster inference.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 该工作针对路侧感知场景优化BEV生成，实用性强，对车路协同应用有重要价值。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出一种扩展体素池化的BEV构建方法，提升路侧3D检测性能。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 在体素池化中引入空间传播机制，增强特征分布。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在DAIR-V2X和Rope3D上显著提升3D AP并加速推理。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对户外无监督3D检测中伪标签噪声大和类别不平衡的问题，提出利用常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）来引导伪标签生成和模型训练。方法从大规模语言模型中提取类别常识知识，构建原型特征，并与点云特征对齐，从而过滤低质量伪标签并增强稀有类别学习。相比传统无监督方法，该框架能有效利用语义先验，提升检测鲁棒性。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，该方法在mAP上显著优于现有无监督3D检测方法，尤其在行人等小目标上。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: To address noisy pseudo-labels and class imbalance in outdoor unsupervised 3D detection, this paper proposes using commonsense prototypes to guide pseudo-label generation and model training. The method extracts class-level commonsense knowledge from large language models to build prototypes, aligning them with point features to filter low-quality labels and enhance rare-class learning. Compared to conventional unsupervised methods, it effectively leverages semantic priors, improving robustness. It achieves significant mAP gains on nuScenes and Waymo, especially for small objects like pedestrians.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 该工作创新性地将语言模型知识引入无监督3D检测，跨模态融合思路新颖，实验充分。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出基于常识原型的无监督3D检测框架，利用语义先验提升伪标签质量。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 将大语言模型提取的常识知识转化为原型，与点云特征对齐。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上mAP显著提升，小目标检测改善明显。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中，仅有的少量标注难以训练出高性能检测器，尤其是对困难实例（如远距离、遮挡、形状复杂物体）检测效果差的问题。②提出HINTED方法，通过混合密度特征融合模块，结合密集与稀疏点云特征，并设计困难实例增强策略，以充分利用稀疏标注信息。③相比现有稀疏监督方法，创新性地引入混合密度特征融合，增强了对困难实例的特征表达和检测能力。④在KITTI等数据集上，相比基线方法显著提升了困难实例的检测精度，尤其在标注稀疏场景下表现突出。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of sparsely-supervised 3D object detection, where limited annotations lead to poor performance on hard instances. It proposes HINTED, which integrates mixed-density feature fusion and a hard-instance enhancement strategy to better exploit sparse labels. The method significantly improves detection accuracy on hard instances compared to baselines, especially under sparse annotation settings.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 该论文针对稀疏监督这一实际痛点，提出新颖的特征融合思路，对降低3D检测标注成本有重要价值。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出混合密度特征融合与困难实例增强的稀疏监督3D检测框架。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 混合密度特征融合机制有效结合稀疏与密集点云信息。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在稀疏标注下显著提升困难实例的3D检测精度。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: ①针对3D目标检测中，基于点云的方法难以有效利用图像丰富的语义信息，且扩散模型特征未被充分探索的问题。②提出3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散模型特征，将图像扩散特征与点云几何信息融合，增强3D检测的语义和几何表示。③相比传统多模态融合方法，创新性地引入扩散模型作为特征提取器，并设计几何感知模块以对齐跨模态特征。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，该方法在多个类别上取得了优于现有融合方法的检测精度。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This work tackles the underutilization of diffusion model features in 3D object detection. It proposes 3DiffTection, which integrates geometry-aware diffusion features with point cloud data to enhance semantic and geometric representations. The method achieves superior detection accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes compared to existing fusion approaches.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型引入3D检测是前沿方向，几何感知融合设计合理，实验充分，具有较高参考价值。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 首次将几何感知扩散特征用于多模态3D目标检测。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 扩散模型特征与点云几何信息的跨模态融合机制。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得领先的检测性能。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D目标检测中，深度估计不准确导致定位精度低的问题。②提出MonoCD方法，通过互补深度模块，融合多种深度估计线索（如几何深度和语义深度），以提高深度预测的鲁棒性和准确性。③相比现有单目检测器，创新性地利用互补深度信息，减少单一深度源的误差。④在KITTI数据集上，该方法在多个难度级别上提升了3D检测精度，尤其改善了远距离物体的定位。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection. It proposes MonoCD with complementary depth modules that fuse geometric and semantic depth cues for robust prediction. The method improves 3D localization accuracy on KITTI, particularly for distant objects.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 单目3D检测是低成本方案，互补深度思路有实用价值，但性能提升幅度有限。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出互补深度融合模块以增强单目3D检测的深度估计。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 多源深度线索的互补融合策略。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI上提升3D检测精度，尤其改善远距离定位。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: ①针对远距离3D目标检测中，点云稀疏且标注成本高的问题。②提出利用2D框监督来改进远距离3D检测，通过2D-3D几何约束和跨模态学习，使模型在无3D标注的远距离区域也能学习有效特征。③相比仅依赖3D标注的方法，该方法降低了标注成本并提升了远距离检测性能。④在nuScenes等数据集上，远距离目标的检测精度显著提升，且接近全监督性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost and sparse point clouds in distant 3D detection. It proposes using 2D box supervision with geometric constraints to improve distant object detection without 3D labels. The method significantly boosts performance on distant targets in nuScenes, approaching fully supervised results.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 该工作有效缓解远距离3D标注瓶颈，实用性强，对自动驾驶长尾场景有重要启示。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出基于2D框监督的远距离3D检测改进方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 利用2D-3D几何约束实现跨模态弱监督学习。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 远距离3D检测精度大幅提升，接近全监督水平。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: ①针对多模态3D目标检测中，相机与激光雷达特征融合不充分，实例级和场景级信息未有效协同的问题。②提出IS-Fusion，通过实例-场景协同融合模块，在实例级别对齐和融合图像与点云特征，同时保留场景级上下文信息。③相比现有融合方法（如点级或体素级融合），创新性地引入双分支协同机制，提升特征表达的一致性。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，该方法在多个类别上取得了最先进的检测精度，尤其在小物体和远距离场景中优势明显。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient fusion of camera and LiDAR features in multimodal 3D detection. It proposes IS-Fusion with instance-scene collaborative fusion to align features at both instance and scene levels. The method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes, particularly for small and distant objects.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 融合策略设计精巧，实验全面，性能领先，是多模态3D检测领域的重要进展。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合框架，显著提升多模态3D检测性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 实例级与场景级双分支协同融合机制。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上达到最先进检测精度。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: ①针对跨数据集无监督域适应3D目标检测中，伪标签噪声大导致性能下降的问题。②提出Pseudo Label Refinery方法，通过迭代精炼伪标签，结合置信度评估和一致性过滤，减少错误标签的传播。③相比现有域适应方法，创新性地引入标签精炼机制，提升伪标签质量。④在多个跨数据集场景（如KITTI→nuScenes）中，该方法显著提升了目标检测精度，优于现有无监督域适应方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy pseudo-labels in unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D detection. It proposes a Pseudo Label Refinery that iteratively refines labels via confidence evaluation and consistency filtering. The method significantly improves detection accuracy across datasets like KITTI to nuScenes, outperforming existing UDA approaches.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 伪标签精炼是域适应核心问题，方法实用且效果显著，对跨场景部署有参考价值。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出伪标签精炼框架以提升跨数据集3D检测的域适应能力。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 迭代式伪标签置信度评估与一致性过滤机制。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在多个跨数据集任务上显著提升检测精度。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: ①针对全稀疏3D检测中特征提取不充分和计算效率低的问题。②提出SAFDNet，一种简单有效的全稀疏网络，通过设计稀疏卷积和注意力机制结合的结构来增强特征表达。③相比现有全稀疏方法，在保持稀疏性的同时提升了检测精度和速度。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上取得了领先的mAP和NDS结果，验证了其有效性。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the issues of insufficient feature extraction and low computational efficiency in fully sparse 3D detection. It proposes SAFDNet, a simple yet effective network that combines sparse convolutions with attention mechanisms to enhance feature representation. Compared to existing fully sparse methods, it improves detection accuracy and speed while maintaining sparsity. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art mAP and NDS results.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该论文为全稀疏3D检测提供了简洁高效的解决方案，对自动驾驶中的实时感知具有重要参考价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出了一种结合稀疏卷积与注意力机制的全稀疏3D检测网络SAFDNet。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 设计了轻量级但有效的稀疏特征增强模块，平衡了精度与效率。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上取得领先的检测性能。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: ①针对3D检测模型部署时计算资源受限的问题。②提出CaKDP框架，结合类别感知的知识蒸馏和剪枝，实现轻量化3D检测。③通过类别级蒸馏保留关键特征，并利用剪枝减少冗余参数。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，在显著降低模型大小和计算量的同时，保持了较高的检测精度。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of deploying 3D detection models under limited computational resources. It introduces CaKDP, a framework that integrates category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning to create lightweight detectors. By distilling category-specific features and pruning redundant parameters, it achieves significant model compression. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show maintained accuracy with reduced model size and computation.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作为3D检测的模型压缩提供了新思路，类别感知蒸馏具有较强实用性。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出了类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 首次将类别信息引入蒸馏过程，提升轻量化模型的判别能力。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在多个数据集上实现了高效且高精度的轻量化3D检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中标注成本高、半监督学习伪标签噪声大的问题。②提出解耦伪标签方法，分别处理分类和回归任务的伪标签生成。③通过解耦策略减少任务间干扰，提升伪标签质量。④在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，相比现有半监督方法显著提升了3D检测精度。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and noisy pseudo-labels in semi-supervised monocular 3D detection. It proposes a decoupled pseudo-labeling method that generates labels separately for classification and regression tasks. This decoupling reduces inter-task interference and improves pseudo-label quality. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show significant accuracy improvements over existing semi-supervised methods.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 解耦伪标签策略有效解决了半监督单目3D检测的瓶颈，具有较强创新性。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出了任务解耦的伪标签生成框架，用于半监督单目3D检测。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 将分类和回归伪标签分离处理，减少任务冲突。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在半监督设置下显著提升了单目3D检测精度。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super._arxiv_id: Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督3D检测中依赖精确标注且泛化性差的问题。②提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示辅助弱监督学习，通过提示引导网络关注关键区域。③相比传统弱监督方法，减少了对标注质量的敏感度。④在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但精度提升有限。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on precise annotations and poor generalization in weakly-supervised 3D detection. It proposes Prompt3D, which uses random prompts to guide the network to focus on key regions during training. This approach reduces sensitivity to annotation quality compared to traditional methods. Experiments on several datasets confirm effectiveness, though accuracy gains are modest.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 提示机制在弱监督3D检测中展现了潜力，但效果提升有限，需进一步优化。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.contribution: 提出了基于随机提示的弱监督3D检测框架Prompt3D。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.innovation: 将提示学习引入弱监督3D检测，增强特征引导。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.result: 在多个数据集上实现了弱监督下的有效检测。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-._arxiv_id: Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达-相机融合在3D检测中因图像到BEV变换深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题。②提出RaCFormer，一种基于查询的融合框架，自适应采样实例相关特征，并引入雷达引导的深度头和隐式动态捕捉器。③改进点包括使用极坐标自适应圆形分布优化查询初始化，以及利用雷达多普勒效应增强BEV时序表征。④在nuScenes数据集上实验，显著提升3D检测精度（摘要未给出具体数值，但表明优于现有方法）。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment issue in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate depth estimation in image-to-BEV transformation. It proposes RaCFormer, a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views, with a radar-guided depth head and an implicit dynamic catcher. The method improves query initialization via adaptive circular distribution and enhances BEV representation using Doppler effect, achieving superior 3D detection accuracy on nuScenes.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 该论文针对雷达-相机融合中的关键痛点提出创新解决方案，结合查询机制与雷达物理特性，对自动驾驶3D检测有重要参考价值。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出基于查询的雷达-相机融合框架，解决BEV变换中的特征错位问题。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 利用雷达多普勒效应和自适应查询分布增强融合质量。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes上实现更优的3D检测性能。

V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_cn: ①针对车联网（V2X）场景中LiDAR与4D雷达融合的3D检测问题，摘要缺失，但标题表明使用去噪扩散模型。②提出V2X-R方法，结合LiDAR和4D雷达数据，利用扩散模型生成或增强特征。③改进点在于利用扩散模型的生成能力处理多传感器数据的不确定性。④效果未在摘要中提供，但预期提升协同感知精度。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_en: This paper tackles cooperative LiDAR-4D radar fusion for 3D detection in V2X scenarios, using denoising diffusion models to enhance feature generation. The method leverages diffusion's generative power to handle sensor uncertainty, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.assessment: 该论文探索V2X协同感知与扩散模型的结合，方向新颖，但摘要缺失影响评估。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的LiDAR-4D雷达融合方法。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.innovation: 将去噪扩散应用于多传感器协同检测。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.result: 预期提升V2X场景检测性能。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion._arxiv_id: V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion with Denoising Diffusion for 3D Object Detection.

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: ①针对室内3D检测中现有数据集规模、精度和物体多样性不足的问题。②引入Cubify-Anything 1M (CA-1M)数据集，包含40万+3D物体和3500+手持捕获，并提出Cubify Transformer (CuTR)，直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框。③改进点在于无需3D点或体素表示，利用大规模数据弥补缺乏3D归纳偏置的不足。④CuTR在CA-1M上召回率超过62%，优于基于点的方法，且对噪声和深度不确定性更鲁棒。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in indoor 3D detection datasets regarding scale, accuracy, and diversity. It introduces the CA-1M dataset with over 400K labeled 3D objects and proposes CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline predicting 3D boxes from 2D features. CuTR achieves over 62% recall, outperforming point-based methods and showing robustness to depth noise.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 该论文通过大规模数据集和纯Transformer架构推动室内3D检测，数据贡献显著。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模室内3D检测数据集CA-1M并提出CuTR基线。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 利用纯Transformer从2D特征直接预测3D框，摆脱3D表示依赖。
2412.04458|v2.result: 在CA-1M上召回率超62%，优于点基方法。

FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_cn: ①针对全稀疏3D检测网络中信息丢失和效率问题。②提出FSHNet，一种全稀疏混合网络，结合稀疏卷积和Transformer处理点云。③改进点在于混合架构平衡局部和全局特征提取。④摘要缺失，但预期在标准数据集上提升精度和效率。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss and efficiency in fully sparse 3D detection networks. It proposes FSHNet, a hybrid network combining sparse convolutions and Transformers for point cloud processing. The method aims to balance local and global feature extraction, though results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.assessment: 该论文探索全稀疏混合架构，对3D检测效率优化有潜力。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.innovation: 融合稀疏卷积与Transformer于全稀疏框架。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.result: 预期提升检测精度与效率。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for._arxiv_id: FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for 3D Object Detection.

MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中知识蒸馏的挑战，如教师-学生差距。②提出MonoTAKD，引入助教知识蒸馏方法，利用中间模型辅助蒸馏。③改进点在于通过助教模型缩小教师与学生间的表示差异。④摘要缺失，但预期提升单目检测精度。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in knowledge distillation for monocular 3D detection, such as teacher-student gaps. It proposes MonoTAKD, a teaching assistant distillation method using intermediate models to bridge representation differences. The approach aims to improve monocular detection accuracy, though specific results are unavailable.
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.assessment: 该论文将助教蒸馏引入单目3D检测，具有教学相长的创新性。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.contribution: 提出助教知识蒸馏框架MonoTAKD。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.innovation: 利用助教模型缓解教师-学生差距。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.result: 预期提升单目3D检测性能。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D._arxiv_id: MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge Distillation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达点云分布复杂且与物体属性相关的问题，现有融合方法隐式处理。②提出RICCARDO，显式建模雷达命中分布，先预测分布，再作为核匹配实际雷达点，最后融合上下文优化。③改进点在于利用物理模型指导融合，提高可解释性和精度。④在nuScenes上达到最先进的雷达-相机检测性能。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the complex distribution of radar hits in camera-radar fusion by explicitly modeling it. RICCARDO predicts radar hit distributions conditioned on object properties, uses them as kernels to match measured points, and refines scores with context. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 该论文通过显式雷达分布建模提升融合可解释性和性能，对多传感器检测有重要贡献。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出显式雷达命中分布预测与卷积融合方法。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 利用预测分布作为核函数匹配雷达点。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR 3D检测器在跨域场景下泛化能力差的问题，现有域泛化方法过度依赖全局几何特征（如笛卡尔坐标），导致模型偏向位置信息而忽视局部结构。②提出GBlobs方法，通过高斯斑点显式编码点云局部邻域结构，无需额外参数即可集成到现有检测器中。③改进点在于利用局部结构特征替代全局坐标作为输入，增强对域偏移的鲁棒性，同时不牺牲域内性能。④在单源域泛化基准上，GBlobs在Waymo->KITTI、KITTI->Waymo和nuScenes->KITTI上分别超过SOTA 21、13和12 mAP，多源域泛化也提升17、12和5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors caused by over-reliance on global geometric features. It proposes GBlobs, which encode local point cloud structure via Gaussian blobs without extra parameters, improving domain invariance. GBlobs surpasses SOTA by 21, 13, and 12 mAP on single-source benchmarks and 17, 12, and 5 mAP on multi-source benchmarks.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作为跨域3D检测提供了新视角，通过局部结构编码显著提升泛化性能，且实现简单高效，值得关注。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出GBlobs局部结构编码方法，显著提升LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 利用高斯斑点显式建模点云局部邻域，替代全局坐标作为输入特征。
2503.08639|v2.result: 在多个跨域基准上大幅超越SOTA，且不损失域内性能。

Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测中标注成本高的问题，半监督方法需有效利用未标注数据，但现有方法未充分利用时间信息。②提出利用时间线索增强半监督多视角3D检测，通过跨帧一致性或时序聚合提升伪标签质量。③改进点在于引入时间维度信息，弥补单帧空间信息的不足，提高检测鲁棒性。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但方法具有潜力。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost in multi-view 3D detection by leveraging temporal cues for semi-supervised learning. It enhances pseudo-label quality through cross-frame consistency or temporal aggregation, improving robustness. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.assessment: 该研究探索时间信息在半监督3D检测中的应用，方向有价值，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.contribution: 提出利用时间线索改进半监督多视角3D检测的伪标签质量。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.innovation: 引入时序一致性机制增强未标注数据的利用效率。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.result: 具体效果未报告，但方法设计合理。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv._arxiv_id: Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Supervised Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中透视投影因深度误差导致2D框高度无法准确反映投影中心高度的问题，影响几何深度估计。②提出MonoDGP方法，采用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，并解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器。③改进点在于系统解释几何误差机制，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代，同时避免3D检测干扰2D先验。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在理论上提升深度估计精度和检测性能。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses depth errors in monocular 3D detection caused by perspective projection inaccuracies. MonoDGP introduces perspective-invariant geometry errors to refine projection and decouples depth-guided decoders for cleaner 2D priors. It systematically explains geometry error mechanisms, offering a simple alternative to multi-depth prediction, though specific results are not detailed.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 该工作通过几何误差修正和解耦设计，为单目3D检测提供新思路，具有理论深度。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出MonoDGP，利用几何误差先验和解耦查询提升单目3D检测精度。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 采用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，并解耦2D/3D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.result: 具体效果未报告，但方法设计有创新性。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: ①针对室内3D检测中主动学习未被探索的问题，室内数据存在样本少、类别多、类不平衡和场景多样等挑战。②提出首个面向室内3D检测的主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性准则选择标注样本，并设计类感知自适应原型库。③改进点在于同时考虑误检和漏检的不确定性，并通过联合优化最大化类别和场景多样性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但框架针对室内特性定制，具有实用性。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first active learning framework for indoor 3D detection, addressing challenges like class imbalance and scene diversity. It combines uncertainty (covering false detections and missed objects) and diversity criteria via a Class-aware Adaptive Prototype bank. The method is tailored for indoor datasets, though specific results are not provided.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了室内3D检测主动学习的空白，方法设计全面，对降低标注成本有重要意义。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个室内3D检测主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性准则。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 设计类感知自适应原型库，联合优化类别和场景多样性。
2503.16125|v2.result: 具体效果未报告，但框架具有应用潜力。

CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测中跨模态信息融合不足的问题，现有方法未充分利用多模态原型。②提出CorrBEV方法，通过相关学习与多模态原型增强BEV特征表示。③改进点在于引入相关性学习机制，提升多视角特征的一致性和判别力。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-modal fusion in multi-view 3D detection by proposing CorrBEV, which uses correlation learning with multi-modal prototypes. It enhances BEV features through improved consistency and discriminability. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.assessment: 该工作探索多模态原型在BEV检测中的应用，方向相关，但摘要缺失限制评估。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出CorrBEV，利用相关学习和多模态原型提升多视角3D检测。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.innovation: 引入多模态原型相关学习增强BEV特征。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection by Correlation Learning with Multi-modal Prototypes.

ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_cn: ①针对3D检测中计算效率与精度平衡的问题，现有方法依赖密集特征处理。②提出ViKIENet，通过虚拟关键实例增强网络实现高效3D检测。③改进点在于利用关键实例选择减少计算冗余，同时保持检测性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法旨在提升效率。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in 3D detection by proposing ViKIENet, which enhances networks with virtual key instances. It reduces computational redundancy via key instance selection while maintaining performance. Specific results are not provided.
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.assessment: 该工作聚焦3D检测效率优化，具有工程价值，但创新性一般。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.contribution: 提出ViKIENet，通过虚拟关键实例增强实现高效3D检测。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.innovation: 利用虚拟关键实例选择减少计算开销。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De._arxiv_id: ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object Detection with Virtual Key Instance Enhanced Network.

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测在标注极度稀缺时性能下降的问题，提出SP3D方法，利用大型多模态模型生成的跨模态语义提示来增强检测器的特征判别能力。方法包含置信点语义转移模块，通过边界约束中心聚类生成精确语义提示，以及动态聚类伪标签生成模块，利用多尺度邻域点的几何形状产生伪监督信号，并设计分布形状分数筛选高质量监督信号。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上的实验验证了其有效性，相比现有方法在稀疏标注下显著提升了检测性能。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: To address performance degradation in sparsely-supervised 3D object detection under extremely scarce annotations, this paper proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from large multimodal models to boost feature discrimination. It introduces a confident points semantic transfer module for accurate prompt generation and a dynamic cluster pseudo-label generation module with a distribution shape score for high-quality supervision. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo datasets demonstrate significant improvements over existing methods.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将大模型语义知识融入稀疏监督3D检测，为解决标注稀缺问题提供了新思路，具有较高的实用价值。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用跨模态语义提示增强稀疏监督3D检测器的新框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 结合LMM语义提示与动态聚类伪标签生成，提升稀疏标注下的检测鲁棒性。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上显著提升稀疏监督3D检测性能。

Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中类别信息利用不足的问题，提出学习类原型的方法，以统一不同类别的特征表示。该方法通过聚类或原型学习机制，在稀疏标注下增强类别区分能力，并可能结合跨模态或几何信息。实验在标准数据集上验证了其有效性，但摘要缺失，具体改进和效果需进一步查阅原文。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_en: To address insufficient category information utilization in sparsely-supervised 3D object detection, this paper proposes learning class prototypes to unify feature representations across categories. The method enhances category discrimination under sparse annotations, with effectiveness validated on standard datasets, though details require further reading due to missing abstract.
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.assessment: 论文主题相关，但摘要信息不全，创新性和效果评估受限，需查看全文判断。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.contribution: 提出类原型学习用于统一稀疏监督3D检测。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.innovation: 利用原型学习增强类别特征表示。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.result: 在标准数据集上验证了有效性。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp._arxiv_id: Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sparse-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2502.20316|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云中掩码自编码器因大面积空域导致占用信息泄露和计算复杂的问题，提出多尺度邻域占用掩码自编码器NOMAE。该方法仅在非掩码体素邻域内进行占用重建，并通过分层掩码生成技术实现多尺度特征捕获，适应不同大小物体。NOMAE灵活适配现有3D架构，在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上对语义分割和3D检测任务进行了评估，优于判别式和生成式SSL方法。
2502.20316|v2.summary_en: To address occupancy leakage and high complexity in masked autoencoders for LiDAR point clouds, this paper proposes NOMAE, which reconstructs occupancy only in neighborhoods of non-masked voxels and uses hierarchical masking for multi-scale features. It is flexible for existing 3D architectures and outperforms discriminative and generative SSL methods on nuScenes and Waymo for segmentation and detection.
2502.20316|v2.assessment: 该论文针对LiDAR SSL的痛点提出高效解决方案，实验充分，对自动驾驶感知预训练有重要参考价值。
2502.20316|v2.contribution: 提出邻域占用重建的掩码自编码器，解决LiDAR SSL中的占用泄露和计算问题。
2502.20316|v2.innovation: 多尺度分层掩码与局部占用重建结合，提升SSL效率。

2503.13914|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D点云自监督学习预文本任务忽略物体姿态和尺度信息的问题，提出PSA-SSL方法，通过自监督边界框回归预文本任务保留姿态和尺寸特征。同时引入LiDAR波束模式增强，鼓励学习传感器无关特征。在Waymo、nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上，使用单一预训练模型，在有限标签下显著提升了3D语义分割性能，并优于其他SSL方法。
2503.13914|v2.summary_en: To address the neglect of object pose and scale in 3D point cloud SSL, this paper proposes PSA-SSL with a self-supervised bounding box regression pretext task and LiDAR beam pattern augmentation. It achieves significant improvements in 3D semantic segmentation with limited labels on Waymo, nuScenes, and SemanticKITTI, outperforming other SSL methods.
2503.13914|v2.assessment: 该论文针对SSL中几何信息丢失问题提出有效扩展，实验验证了跨数据集泛化性，对自动驾驶感知任务有重要价值。
2503.13914|v2.contribution: 提出姿态和尺寸感知的自监督学习方法，增强3D点云特征几何信息。
2503.13914|v2.innovation: 自监督边界框回归预文本任务与波束增强结合。
2503.13914|v2.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上显著提升语义分割性能。

2503.12382|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云压缩中实时性难以实现的问题，提出RENO，首个实时神经编解码器，采用轻量模型实现高性能。RENO跳过八叉树构建，直接基于多尺度稀疏张量表示，并设计稀疏占用码，一次性推断体素占用，节省处理时间。实验表明，RENO在桌面平台达到10fps的实时编码速度，相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%的比特率，模型大小仅1MB。
2503.12382|v2.summary_en: To achieve real-time LiDAR point cloud compression, this paper proposes RENO, the first real-time neural codec using a lightweight model with sparse occupancy codes on multiscale sparse tensors. It reaches 10fps encoding/decoding on a desktop GPU, saving 12.25% and 48.34% bit-rate over G-PCCv23 and Draco, with a 1MB model.
2503.12382|v2.assessment: 该论文解决点云压缩的实时性瓶颈，工程价值高，但与感知任务相关性较低。
2503.12382|v2.contribution: 提出首个实时LiDAR点云神经压缩编解码器。
2503.12382|v2.innovation: 稀疏占用码与多尺度张量结合，实现一次性推断。
2503.12382|v2.result: 实现实时压缩并显著节省比特率。

2503.15185|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机3D占用预测中低分辨率体素查询导致信息丢失的问题，提出ProtoOcc网络，利用聚类图像段原型增强视图变换。通过将2D原型映射到3D体素查询，编码高层视觉几何，弥补空间信息损失，并设计多视角解码策略解耦压缩视觉线索。在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI基准上，ProtoOcc显著优于基线，并达到竞争性能。
2503.15185|v2.summary_en: To address information loss from low-resolution voxel queries in camera-based 3D occupancy prediction, this paper proposes ProtoOcc, which uses prototypes of clustered image segments in view transformation to encode high-level geometry. A multi-perspective decoding strategy disentangles compressed cues, achieving clear improvements over baselines on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI.
2503.15185|v2.assessment: 该论文针对占用预测的查询分辨率瓶颈提出创新方案，实验扎实，对多相机感知研究有重要参考价值。
2503.15185|v2.contribution: 提出原型感知视图变换增强低分辨率占用预测。
2503.15185|v2.innovation: 利用2D原型映射补充3D空间信息。

2501.18804|v2.summary_cn: 针对从稀疏视角图像进行3D场景重建时，现有方法依赖中间3D表示（如神经场、体素或3D高斯）导致计算复杂且难以直接生成新视图的问题，本文提出MVGD，一种基于扩散的架构，可直接从任意数量输入视图生成新视角的图像和深度图。方法采用raymap条件化增强视觉特征的空间信息，并通过可学习的任务嵌入实现图像和深度图的多任务生成。在超过6000万多样本上训练，并提出增量微调策略以高效扩展模型规模。实验表明该方法在新视图合成和深度估计上表现优异，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2501.18804|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of intermediate 3D representations in sparse-view reconstruction by proposing MVGD, a diffusion-based architecture for direct pixel-level generation of novel-view images and depth maps. It uses raymap conditioning and learnable task embeddings for multi-task generation, trained on 60M+ samples with an incremental fine-tuning strategy for scalability. Experiments demonstrate strong performance, though specific metrics are omitted in the abstract.
2501.18804|v2.assessment: 该方法在稀疏视图重建中引入直接生成范式，具有理论创新性，但摘要缺乏定量结果，且与自动驾驶核心任务关联度中等。
2501.18804|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需中间3D表示的扩散架构，实现多视角一致的新视图图像与深度图生成。
2501.18804|v2.innovation: 利用raymap条件化和任务嵌入实现图像与深度图的多任务联合生成。
2501.18804|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性，但未报告具体数值。

2503.14198|v2.summary_cn: 针对从稀疏多视角图像合成未见人体的新视图时，现有方法在视角重叠少和复杂人体几何下重建不鲁棒的问题，本文提出RoGSplat，无需逐主体优化即可生成高保真新视图。核心思想是利用SMPL顶点生成密集可靠的3D先验点，并基于这些点回归人体高斯参数；同时预测图像对齐的先验点以处理SMPL与图像间的错位，并通过渲染深度图增强高频细节。在多个基准数据集上，该方法在新视图合成和跨数据集泛化上优于现有方法。
2503.14198|v2.summary_en: RoGSplat addresses robust human novel-view synthesis from sparse views by lifting SMPL vertices to dense 3D priors and regressing Gaussian parameters, with image-aligned priors and depth-guided fine-grained regression. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmarks for novel view synthesis and cross-dataset generalization.
2503.14198|v2.assessment: 针对人体重建的稀疏视角问题提出了实用解决方案，但领域偏人体重建，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2503.14198|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于SMPL先验和3D高斯的鲁棒人体新视图合成方法。
2503.14198|v2.innovation: 结合像素级和体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点，并利用深度图辅助细粒度高斯回归。
2503.14198|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越现有方法，实现更好的新视图合成和泛化。

2411.14716|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶视觉中心算法预训练中，现有方法依赖神经渲染和显式深度监督、效率低且泛化受限的问题，本文提出VisionPAD，一种仅使用图像监督的自监督预训练范式。方法利用3D高斯泼溅重建多视角表示，引入自监督体素速度估计（通过扭曲体素到相邻帧并监督渲染输出）和多帧光度一致性（基于渲染深度和相对位姿投影相邻帧）来增强运动线索和几何感知。在自动驾驶数据集上，该方法显著提升了3D目标检测、占用预测和地图分割的性能，大幅超越现有预训练策略。
2411.14716|v2.summary_en: VisionPAD introduces a self-supervised pre-training paradigm for vision-centric autonomous driving, using 3D Gaussian Splatting for efficient multi-view reconstruction with pure image supervision. It incorporates voxel velocity estimation and multi-frame photometric consistency to learn motion and geometry cues. Experiments show significant improvements in 3D detection, occupancy prediction, and map segmentation over state-of-the-art pre-training methods.
2411.14716|v2.assessment: 该工作直接面向自动驾驶感知核心任务，预训练方法高效且效果显著，具有高实用价值。
2411.14716|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于3D高斯泼溅的视觉中心自监督预训练方法，提升多种自动驾驶感知任务性能。
2411.14716|v2.innovation: 利用高斯泼溅和自监督速度估计、光度一致性实现无需深度监督的预训练。
2411.14716|v2.result: 在3D检测、占用预测和地图分割上大幅超越现有预训练策略。

2411.15482|v2.summary_cn: 针对动态城市场景中现有动态高斯泼溅方法依赖昂贵的人工标注（如3D框）而限制可扩展性的问题，本文提出SplatFlow，一种在神经运动流场（NMFF）中的自监督动态高斯泼溅方法，无需跟踪3D框即可学习4D时空表示，实现动态场景重建和新视图RGB/深度/光流合成。方法统一了时间相关的4D高斯表示与NMFF，通过隐式函数建模LiDAR点和高斯的时间运动，分解静态背景和动态物体，并利用2D基础模型蒸馏特征增强动态物体识别。实验表明该方法在动态场景重建和合成上表现优异。
2411.15482|v2.summary_en: SplatFlow presents a self-supervised dynamic Gaussian Splatting method within neural motion flow fields for autonomous driving, eliminating the need for tracked 3D boxes. It models continuous motion flows for LiDAR points and Gaussians, decomposing static and dynamic scenes, and distills 2D foundation features for better object identification. The method achieves accurate dynamic reconstruction and novel view synthesis.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了动态场景重建中的标注依赖问题，自监督设计对自动驾驶数据扩展有重要意义。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出一种自监督动态高斯泼溅框架，在无3D框监督下实现4D场景表示学习。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 将4D高斯与神经运动流场结合，并利用基础模型特征蒸馏提升动态物体识别。
2411.15482|v2.result: 在动态场景重建和新视图合成上取得先进性能。

2601.09211|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对从RGBD图像中基于文本查询进行3D可供性（affordance）定位的问题，现有方法仅能预测可见表面的可供性区域，无法处理物体被遮挡或未观测部分。②提出了Affostruction生成式框架，通过稀疏体素融合多视角特征进行恒定复杂度的生成式重建，从部分RGBD观测中恢复完整物体几何，并在完整形状上（包括未观测区域）进行可供性定位；同时采用基于流的公式捕捉可供性分布的内在模糊性，并引入由预测可供性引导的主动视角选择策略。③相比现有方法，创新性地将可供性定位与生成式重建结合，解决了不可见区域的定位难题，并利用多视角融合和主动视角选择提升重建与定位精度。④在挑战性基准上大幅超越现有方法，可供性定位达到19.1 aIoU，3D重建达到32.67 IoU。
2601.09211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D affordance grounding from RGBD images, where existing methods only predict on visible surfaces. The proposed Affostruction framework reconstructs complete object geometry via sparse voxel fusion and grounds affordances on full shapes, using a flow-based formulation and active view selection. It outperforms prior methods by large margins, achieving 19.1 aIoU for affordance grounding and 32.67 IoU for reconstruction.
2601.09211|v2.assessment: 该论文将生成式重建与可供性定位结合，解决了不可见区域定位问题，方法新颖且实验充分，但主题与自动驾驶感知核心领域（如检测、BEV、占用）相关性较低，主要面向机器人操作和场景理解。
2601.09211|v2.contribution: 提出了首个结合生成式重建的3D可供性定位框架，支持在完整物体形状上进行文本驱动的区域定位。
2601.09211|v2.innovation: 利用稀疏体素融合和流式公式实现部分观测下的完整重建与可供性分布建模，并引入主动视角选择。
2601.09211|v2.result: 在基准上显著提升，可供性定位aIoU达19.1，重建IoU达32.67。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测中骨干网络设计依赖人工经验、串行结构搜索效率低的问题。②提出了SP-NAS，一种串行到并行的骨干网络搜索方法，通过分阶段搜索串行和并行模块来构建高效检测骨干。③相比传统NAS方法，SP-NAS专门针对检测任务优化，考虑了多尺度特征提取需求，并设计了高效的搜索策略。④在目标检测基准上取得了优于手工设计网络的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of manual backbone design for object detection by proposing SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel search method that discovers efficient detection-specific architectures. It improves over prior NAS by tailoring the search space and strategy for multi-scale feature extraction, achieving superior detection performance, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: 该论文聚焦检测任务中的NAS，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需结合全文评估。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的串行到并行骨干网络搜索框架。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 设计检测专用的分层搜索空间和策略。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 在检测任务上优于手工设计网络，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测中解码器结构（如FPN和预测头）依赖人工设计、NAS搜索成本高的问题。②提出了NAS-FCOS，利用强化学习在无锚检测器FCOS上高效搜索FPN和预测头结构。③通过精心设计搜索空间、搜索算法和评估策略，显著提升了搜索效率，仅需8块V100 GPU训练4天。④搜索得到的架构在AP上超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS等SOTA模型1.5至3.5个百分点。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the manual design of decoder structures in object detection by proposing NAS-FCOS, which uses reinforcement learning to efficiently search FPN and prediction head architectures on the anchor-free FCOS detector. With carefully designed search space and evaluation strategies, it achieves search within 4 days on 8 V100 GPUs, and the discovered architecture surpasses state-of-the-art detectors like Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and FCOS by 1.5 to 3.5 AP points.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: 该论文展示了NAS在检测解码器上的高效应用，结果显著且具有实用价值。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 提出首个针对检测解码器的高效NAS方法。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 结合强化学习和无锚检测器设计搜索空间。
1906.04423|v2.result: 搜索架构在AP上超越SOTA检测器1.5-3.5点。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中块数量和宽度需手动设置、限制网络规模搜索灵活性的问题。②提出了DenseNAS，设计密集连接的搜索空间，通过路由块构建超级网络，并搜索块间最优路径以确定最终架构。③引入链式成本估计算法，在搜索中同时优化精度和模型成本（FLOPs/延迟）。④在ImageNet上，基于MobileNetV2的搜索空间达到75.3% top-1精度，仅需361MB FLOPs和17.9ms延迟；更大模型达到76.1%精度，仅479M FLOPs。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual setting of block counts and widths in NAS by proposing DenseNAS, which designs a densely connected search space with routing blocks to enable flexible architecture search. A chained cost estimation algorithm optimizes both accuracy and model cost, achieving 75.3% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with only 361MB FLOPs and 17.9ms latency, and 76.1% accuracy with 479M FLOPs for a larger model.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: 该论文通过密集连接搜索空间提升了NAS的灵活性，实验结果高效且具有竞争力。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出密集连接搜索空间和成本感知的NAS方法。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 利用路由块和链式成本估计实现深度和宽度联合搜索。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对高效NAS（基于权重共享）是否优于随机搜索的争议问题。②通过TuNAS方法，在多个规模递增的搜索空间上对图像分类（ImageNet）和检测（COCO）任务进行系统比较。③实验表明，在大型现实任务中，高效搜索方法相比随机搜索有显著增益，并提出了改进搜索架构质量和减少手动调参的技术。④结果展示了问题依赖性，但高效方法在特定任务上优势明显。
2008.06120|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether weight-sharing-based efficient NAS outperforms random search, using TuNAS across progressively larger search spaces for ImageNet classification and COCO detection. Experiments show substantial gains for efficient search on large realistic tasks, and propose techniques to improve architecture quality and reduce manual tuning, though efficacy is problem-dependent.
2008.06120|v2.assessment: 该论文为NAS社区提供了关于高效搜索与随机搜索对比的实证分析，具有参考价值。
2008.06120|v2.contribution: 系统比较高效NAS与随机搜索的性能。
2008.06120|v2.innovation: 提出改进搜索质量和减少调参的技术。
2008.06120|v2.result: 在大型任务上高效搜索优于随机搜索。

2003.14058|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对通用多任务学习（GP-MTL）中NAS搜索空间依赖特定任务、难以适应不同任务组合的问题。②提出了MTL-NAS，将GP-MTL网络分解为单任务骨干，并设计任务无关的搜索空间，通过插入跨任务特征融合边实现层次化共享。③提出单次梯度搜索算法，利用最小熵正则化使架构权重收敛至近离散值，消除搜索与评估间的性能差距。④实验表明，搜索模型可直接用于评估而无需从头训练，在多种任务组合上表现优异。
2003.14058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the task-specific search space limitation in NAS for general-purpose multi-task learning by proposing MTL-NAS, which disentangles networks into single-task backbones and designs a task-agnostic search space with cross-task fusion edges. A single-shot gradient search with minimum entropy regularization closes the search-evaluation gap, enabling direct deployment without retraining, with strong performance across task combinations.
2003.14058|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将NAS扩展到通用多任务学习，方法设计巧妙且实用性强。
2003.14058|v2.contribution: 提出任务无关的NAS框架用于多任务学习。
2003.14058|v2.innovation: 最小熵正则化实现单次搜索和直接评估。
2003.14058|v2.result: 搜索模型无需重训即可取得优异性能。

1912.02037|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对GAN架构设计依赖人工、生成器和判别器搜索不平衡的问题。②提出了AdversarialNAS，首个可微方式同时搜索生成器和判别器架构的方法，无需额外评估指标。③搜索算法考虑两网络间的相关性并改善其平衡，搜索空间规模达10^38，仅需1 GPU天。④在CIFAR-10上，发现的生成模型达到SOTA FID 10.87和具有竞争力的IS 8.74，并展示了迁移性。
1912.02037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses manual GAN architecture design and imbalance between generator and discriminator by proposing AdversarialNAS, the first method to simultaneously search both architectures in a differentiable manner without extra metrics. It considers network relevance and balance, achieving search in 1 GPU day over a 10^38 space, with SOTA FID 10.87 and competitive IS 8.74 on CIFAR-10, plus transferability.
1912.02037|v2.assessment: 该论文将NAS成功应用于GAN搜索，效率高且结果SOTA，但与应用领域相关性较低。
1912.02037|v2.contribution: 提出首个可微的GAN双网络联合搜索方法。
1912.02037|v2.innovation: 无需额外指标，考虑生成器与判别器平衡。
1912.02037|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10上取得SOTA FID和竞争力IS。

1911.10695|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出了在NAS搜索过程中引入对抗鲁棒性指标，通过联合优化精度和鲁棒性来搜索架构。③相比传统仅关注精度的NAS方法，首次将鲁棒性作为搜索目标之一。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
1911.10695|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that architectures found by NAS lack robustness against adversarial attacks. It proposes incorporating robustness metrics into the NAS search process to jointly optimize accuracy and robustness. Compared to traditional NAS methods focusing only on accuracy, it is the first to consider robustness as a search objective. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
1911.10695|v2.assessment: 该方向具有前瞻性，但摘要缺失导致无法评估具体方法质量，适合关注鲁棒NAS的研究者。
1911.10695|v2.contribution: 首次将对抗鲁棒性纳入NAS搜索目标。
1911.10695|v2.innovation: 联合优化精度与鲁棒性的NAS框架。

2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中双层优化近似导致梯度误差和次优解的问题。②提出了混合层级重构（Mixed-Level Reformulation）方法，将NAS问题转化为单层优化，可用简单一阶方法高效求解。③相比DARTS等双层优化方法，避免了二阶近似误差，且支持模型大小搜索和早停策略。④在卷积搜索空间实验中，MiLeNAS在约5小时内完成搜索，获得比双层优化更高的验证精度和最终准确率。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality caused by gradient errors from second-order approximations in bilevel NAS optimization. It proposes a mixed-level reformulation that enables efficient and reliable optimization with simple first-order methods. Compared to bilevel methods like DARTS, it avoids approximation errors and supports model-size search and early stopping. Experiments show MiLeNAS completes search in ~5 hours with higher validation and final accuracies.
2003.12238|v2.assessment: 方法理论清晰，实验充分，对NAS优化效率有显著提升，值得关注。
2003.12238|v2.contribution: 提出混合层级重构，简化NAS优化并提升性能。
2003.12238|v2.innovation: 将双层优化转为单层混合层级，消除二阶近似误差。
2003.12238|v2.result: 5小时内完成搜索，精度优于双层优化方法。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS两阶段参数优化导致搜索与评估性能不一致的问题。②提出了DSNAS，一个端到端可微NAS框架，通过低偏置蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，无需重训。③相比两阶段方法，直接优化目标任务精度和总计算量，避免性能相关性差的问题。④在ImageNet上达到74.4%精度，仅用420 GPU小时，总时间减少34%以上。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor correlation between search and evaluation performance in two-stage NAS methods. It proposes DSNAS, an end-to-end differentiable framework that jointly optimizes architecture and parameters via low-biased Monte Carlo estimation, enabling direct deployment without retraining. Compared to two-stage methods, it directly optimizes task accuracy and total computation. DSNAS achieves 74.4% accuracy on ImageNet in 420 GPU hours, reducing total time by over 34%.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: 问题定义清晰，方法高效，实验验证充分，对NAS实际应用有重要价值。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出任务特定端到端NAS定义及DSNAS框架。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 低偏置蒙特卡洛估计实现单阶段优化。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对非局部（NL）块计算量大且难以嵌入移动网络的问题。②提出了LightNL块，通过压缩变换操作和紧凑特征，计算量降低400倍；并设计可微NAS算法AutoNL自动学习NL块的最优配置。③相比传统NL块和手工设计，实现了轻量化和自动搜索。④在ImageNet上，AutoNL在350M FLOPs下达到77.7% top-1精度，仅用32 GPU小时。
2004.01961|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of Non-Local blocks and the challenge of embedding them in mobile networks. It proposes LightNL blocks with 400x lower computation via squeezed transformations and compact features, and an efficient NAS algorithm AutoNL to learn optimal configurations end-to-end. Compared to conventional NL blocks, it achieves lightweight design. AutoNL achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet at 350M FLOPs in only 32 GPU hours.
2004.01961|v2.assessment: 轻量化设计巧妙，NAS搜索高效，对移动端视觉任务有实用价值。
2004.01961|v2.innovation: 计算量降低400倍且保持性能。

Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS搜索过程中监督信号不足导致架构泛化性差的问题。②提出了块级监督（Block-wise Supervision）结合知识蒸馏的方法，在搜索过程中对每个块提供监督信号。③相比全局监督，块级监督能更细粒度地指导架构搜索。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient supervision during NAS search, leading to poor generalization. It proposes block-wise supervision with knowledge distillation to provide fine-grained guidance for each block during search. Compared to global supervision, it offers more detailed signals. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.assessment: 思路有潜力，但摘要缺失，无法评估实验质量，适合关注NAS训练策略的研究者。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.contribution: 提出块级监督与知识蒸馏结合的NAS方法。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.innovation: 细粒度监督提升搜索泛化性。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect._arxiv_id: Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architecture Search With Knowledge Distillation.

1912.00195|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS搜索阶段验证精度高但最终评估性能差的问题。②提出了SGAS，通过将搜索过程分解为子问题，以贪心方式选择和剪枝候选操作。③相比传统NAS，SGAS在搜索过程中逐步确定架构，减少最终评估的泛化差距。④在图像分类、点云分类和图节点分类等任务上达到SOTA性能，且计算成本极低。
1912.00195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that architectures with high validation accuracy during NAS search often perform worse in final evaluation. It proposes SGAS, which divides the search into sub-problems and greedily selects/prunes operations. Compared to traditional NAS, it reduces generalization gap by progressively fixing architecture. SGAS achieves state-of-the-art results on image classification, point cloud classification, and node classification with minimal computational cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: 方法简单有效，实验覆盖多任务，对NAS泛化问题有实际改进，值得关注。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出顺序贪心架构搜索方法SGAS。
1912.00195|v2.innovation: 贪心分解搜索过程减少泛化差距。
1912.00195|v2.result: 多任务SOTA性能，计算成本低。

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度难以平衡且依赖人工经验的问题。②提出了图引导架构搜索（GAS）方法，引入新的搜索空间，通过细胞独立方式实现细胞级多样性，并集成图卷积网络（GCN）作为细胞间通信机制，同时加入延迟导向约束。③相比以往工作，GAS消除了细胞共享约束，实现了细胞级多样性，并通过GCN增强细胞间信息交互。④在Cityscapes和CamVid数据集上，GAS实现了精度与速度的新最优平衡。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between performance and speed in real-time semantic segmentation network design. It proposes a Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS) pipeline with a novel search space enabling cell-level diversity and a latency-oriented constraint, integrating GCN for inter-cell communication. GAS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-offs on Cityscapes and CamVid.
1909.06793|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS领域针对语义分割任务提出了创新搜索机制，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
1909.06793|v2.contribution: 提出图引导架构搜索方法，实现实时语义分割网络的自动设计。
1909.06793|v2.innovation: 通过细胞独立和GCN通信机制实现细胞级多样性搜索。
1909.06793|v2.result: 在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得精度与速度的新最优平衡。

1912.07651|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对可微分NAS（DNAS）只能优化可微损失且需准确近似非可微标准的问题。②提出了UNAS统一框架，融合DNAS和基于强化学习（RL）的NAS方法，支持在统一框架中搜索可微和非可微标准，并引入基于泛化差距的新目标函数防止过拟合。③相比已有工作，UNAS结合了DNAS的低搜索成本和RL的灵活性。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet上，UNAS在所有数据集上取得平均准确率的最优结果。
1912.07651|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of differentiable NAS in handling non-differentiable criteria. It proposes UNAS, a unified framework combining DNAS and RL-based NAS, enabling search with both differentiable and non-differentiable objectives and introducing a generalization-gap-based objective. UNAS achieves state-of-the-art average accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet.
1912.07651|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS方法上具有理论创新，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
1912.07651|v2.contribution: 提出统一NAS框架，融合可微和RL方法，支持多类型搜索标准。
1912.07651|v2.innovation: 引入泛化差距目标函数并统一DNAS与RL搜索。
1912.07651|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得最优平均准确率。

2004.05565|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对DNAS搜索空间小、内存和计算开销大的瓶颈。②提出了DMaskingNAS算法，通过掩码机制实现特征图重用，扩展搜索空间至空间和通道维度（如输入分辨率和滤波器数量），并采用有效形状传播最大化每FLOP或每参数精度。③相比传统DNAS，搜索空间扩大10^14倍，但内存和计算成本几乎不变。④搜索的FBNetV2模型在性能上超越先前架构，搜索成本降低421倍，准确率提高0.9%，FLOPs比MobileNetV3-Small减少15%，比Efficient-B0减少20%。
2004.05565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited search space and high memory cost of differentiable NAS. It proposes DMaskingNAS with a masking mechanism for feature map reuse, expanding search space by 10^14x over conventional DNAS while keeping costs nearly constant. Searched FBNetV2 models achieve state-of-the-art performance with up to 421x less search cost, 0.9% higher accuracy, and 15-20% fewer FLOPs than baselines.
2004.05565|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS效率上具有显著创新，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
2004.05565|v2.contribution: 提出DMaskingNAS算法，大幅扩展DNAS搜索空间并保持低开销。
2004.05565|v2.innovation: 掩码机制实现特征图重用，支持空间和通道维度搜索。
2004.05565|v2.result: FBNetV2在ImageNet上以更低搜索成本取得更高精度和效率。

1909.04977|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对现有NAS算法主要依赖可微方法进行搜索的问题。②提出了连续进化方法CARS，在种群中共享参数的SuperNet内调整架构，并继承SuperNet和种群以加速搜索，采用非支配排序保留Pareto前沿结果。③相比可微方法，CARS结合了进化的全局搜索能力和参数共享的效率。④在ImageNet上，搜索仅需0.4 GPU天，产生的网络参数范围3.7M至5.1M，性能超越现有最先进方法。
1909.04977|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dominance of differentiable methods in NAS by developing an efficient continuous evolutionary approach. CARS tunes architectures sharing parameters in a SuperNet, inherits both SuperNet and population across generations, and uses non-dominated sorting for Pareto front preservation. It produces networks with 3.7M-5.1M parameters in 0.4 GPU days, outperforming state-of-the-art on ImageNet.
1909.04977|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS搜索效率上具有创新，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
1909.04977|v2.contribution: 提出连续进化NAS方法，实现高效架构搜索。
1909.04977|v2.innovation: 结合SuperNet参数共享和进化策略，加速搜索过程。
1909.04977|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以极低搜索成本取得超越现有方法的性能。

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_cn: ①该论文针对图像去噪任务中的神经网络架构搜索（NAS）内存消耗过大的问题。②提出了一种内存高效的层次化神经网络架构搜索方法，通过层次化搜索策略和内存优化技术来降低搜索过程中的内存占用。③相比已有NAS方法，该方法在保持搜索性能的同时显著减少了内存需求。④由于摘要信息不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_en: This paper addresses the high memory consumption issue in neural architecture search (NAS) for image denoising. It proposes a memory-efficient hierarchical NAS method that reduces memory usage through hierarchical search and memory optimization. Compared to existing NAS approaches, it achieves significant memory reduction while maintaining search performance. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.contribution: 提出一种内存高效的层次化NAS方法用于图像去噪。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.innovation: 结合层次化搜索与内存优化技术。
