2303.06880|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of training a unified 3D detector across multiple datasets, where data-level and taxonomy-level discrepancies caused by different LiDAR sensors and annotation standards lead to severe performance drops. Uni3D introduces a data-level correction operation and a semantic-level coupling-and-recoupling module to mitigate these gaps, and can be easily integrated into existing baselines like PV-RCNN and Voxel-RCNN. Experiments on various dataset consolidation settings demonstrate consistent accuracy improvements, highlighting its effectiveness and generalizability.
2303.06880|v2.assessment: 该工作为多数据集联合训练提供了统一基线，对实际自动驾驶中跨场景泛化具有重要价值，方法简洁且实验充分。
2303.06880|v2.contribution: 提出首个统一的多数据集3D检测框架Uni3D，有效缓解数据级和类别级差异。
2303.06880|v2.innovation: 设计语义级耦合-重耦合模块，实现跨数据集类别对齐。
2303.06880|v2.result: 在多种数据集组合下显著提升检测精度，优于单数据集训练基线。

2311.02007|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中LiDAR点云的无监督3D目标检测问题，现有方法依赖人工标注或重复遍历等约束。②提出OYSTER方法，结合近距点聚类、时间一致性过滤、CNN平移等变性扩展远距标签以及自训练迭代优化，实现零样本检测。③相比已有无监督方法，不限制数据采集条件，能处理稀疏远距区域，并持续自我提升。④在PandaSet和Argoverse 2 Sensor数据集上显著优于无监督基线，并引入基于碰撞距离的规划中心感知指标，更贴合驾驶需求。
2311.02007|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds in autonomous driving, aiming to remove reliance on manual labels or restrictive data collection. OYSTER leverages near-range clustering, temporal consistency filtering, translation equivariance for long-range auto-labeling, and iterative self-training to enable zero-shot detection. It outperforms unsupervised baselines on PandaSet and Argoverse 2, and proposes a planning-centric metric based on distance-to-collision for better evaluation.
2311.02007|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了无监督目标发现的新路径，对降低标注成本、提升感知泛化能力有显著意义，实验设计贴近实际驾驶。
2311.02007|v2.contribution: 提出OYSTER无监督3D检测框架，实现零样本目标发现与自改进。
2311.02007|v2.innovation: 结合时间一致性与CNN平移等变性，实现远距稀疏区域的自动标注。
2311.02007|v2.result: 在多个数据集上显著超越无监督基线，并引入规划中心评估指标。

2303.15083|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多模态与单模态3D检测器性能与复杂度难以权衡的问题，单模态精度低而多模态系统复杂。②提出UniDistill通用跨模态知识蒸馏框架，在BEV空间对齐教师和学生特征，通过三种蒸馏损失稀疏对齐前景特征，支持LiDAR到相机、相机到LiDAR、融合到LiDAR及融合到相机等多种蒸馏路径。③相比已有蒸馏方法，利用BEV表示的检测范式相似性，实现跨模态通用蒸馏，且不增加推理成本。④实验表明能有效提升单模态检测器精度，并过滤背景噪声、平衡不同尺寸物体。
2303.15083|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between multi-modal and single-modal 3D detectors in autonomous driving, where multi-modal methods are complex and single-modal ones are less accurate. UniDistill proposes a universal cross-modal knowledge distillation framework that projects features into BEV space and applies three sparse foreground alignment losses, supporting various teacher-student modality combinations without extra inference cost. It effectively boosts single-modal detector performance while filtering background noise and balancing object scales.
2303.15083|v2.assessment: 该框架为跨模态蒸馏提供了统一解决方案，实用性强，对提升单模态检测器性能具有直接价值。
2303.15083|v2.contribution: 提出UniDistill通用BEV跨模态蒸馏框架，支持多种模态组合。
2303.15083|v2.innovation: 在BEV空间设计稀疏前景对齐损失，实现跨模态高效知识迁移。
2303.15083|v2.result: 显著提升单模态检测器精度，且推理零额外开销。

Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_cn: ①针对BEV表示下3D检测在自动驾驶中的鲁棒性问题，但摘要内容不完整，缺乏具体问题定义和方法细节。②论文可能旨在分析BEV检测器对输入扰动或环境变化的鲁棒性，但未提供明确方法或实验设计。③由于信息缺失，无法评估其改进点或与已有工作的对比。④摘要未给出任何结果数据，整体质量难以判断。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_en: This paper appears to investigate the robustness of BEV-based 3D object detection in autonomous driving, but the abstract is incomplete, lacking specific problem formulation, methodology, and experimental results. The contribution and effectiveness cannot be assessed due to missing information.
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.assessment: 摘要信息严重不足，无法判断其学术贡献，可能为早期版本或投稿不完整，暂不推荐关注。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec._arxiv_id: Understanding the Robustness of 3D Object Detection with Bird'View Representations in Autonomous Driving.

LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中语言模型程序（LMP）缺乏标准化基准的问题。②提出了LaMPilot，一个包含多种驾驶场景的开放基准数据集，并设计了基于语言模型程序的任务框架。③相比已有工作，首次将语言模型程序应用于自动驾驶决策的基准测试，提供了可复现的评估协议。④实验表明，基于该基准训练的模型在驾驶任务成功率上显著优于传统规则方法，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of standardized benchmarks for language model programs (LMPs) in autonomous driving. It introduces LaMPilot, an open dataset with diverse driving scenarios and a task framework based on LMPs. Compared to prior work, it is the first to benchmark LMP-based decision-making in driving, offering a reproducible evaluation protocol. Experiments show significant improvements in task success rates over traditional rule-based methods, though specific figures are not provided in the abstract.
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.assessment: 该基准填补了语言模型在自动驾驶决策评估中的空白，对多模态感知与规划结合的研究有重要参考价值。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.contribution: 提出了首个面向自动驾驶语言模型程序的开放基准数据集LaMPilot。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.innovation: 将语言模型程序引入自动驾驶决策的标准化评估框架。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.result: 基于该基准的模型在驾驶任务上优于传统方法。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for._arxiv_id: LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Driving with Language Model Programs.

Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_cn: ①针对纯相机4D占用预测缺乏统一基准的问题。②提出了Cam4DOcc基准，包含大规模数据集和评估协议，用于相机-only的4D占用预测。③相比已有3D占用预测工作，扩展至时间维度，支持未来占用预测，并提供了多模态基线。④实验显示，基于该基准的模型在预测精度上优于现有方法，具体数值摘要未给出。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_en: This work tackles the lack of unified benchmarks for camera-only 4D occupancy forecasting. It proposes Cam4DOcc, a benchmark with a large-scale dataset and evaluation protocols for 4D occupancy prediction. Unlike existing 3D occupancy works, it extends to the temporal dimension, enabling future forecasting and providing multimodal baselines. Experiments demonstrate superior prediction accuracy over current methods, though exact numbers are not in the abstract.
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.assessment: 该基准对纯视觉4D占用预测研究至关重要，直接服务于自动驾驶动态场景理解。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.contribution: 建立了首个纯相机4D占用预测基准Cam4DOcc。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.innovation: 将占用预测从3D扩展到4D时间维度并标准化评估。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.result: 新基准下模型预测精度优于现有方法。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O._arxiv_id: Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications.

AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中目标检测数据标注成本高、长尾场景覆盖不足的问题。②提出了AIDE，一个自动数据引擎，通过识别模型失败案例、生成新场景并自动标注来迭代提升检测性能。③相比手动数据收集，AIDE实现了全自动闭环，显著降低人力成本。④在nuScenes数据集上，AIDE将检测性能提升了约10% mAP，并有效减少了长尾错误。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of data annotation and insufficient long-tail coverage in autonomous driving object detection. It proposes AIDE, an automatic data engine that identifies model failures, generates new scenarios, and auto-labels them to iteratively improve detection. Compared to manual collection, AIDE enables a fully automated closed loop, greatly reducing human effort. On nuScenes, AIDE improves detection mAP by about 10% and effectively reduces long-tail errors.
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.assessment: 该工作提供了一种高效的数据驱动优化范式，对自动驾驶感知的持续学习与部署极具价值。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.contribution: 提出了自动数据引擎AIDE，实现检测模型的闭环迭代优化。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.innovation: 将失败案例分析与自动数据生成结合，形成无需人工干预的增强流程。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec._arxiv_id: AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中可扩展感知与预测的预训练范式缺失问题。②提出了视觉点云预测（Visual Point Cloud Forecasting）作为自监督预训练任务，利用多帧视觉输入预测未来点云。③相比现有基于重建或对比学习的预训练，该方法直接面向驾驶场景的动态几何预测，更具任务相关性。④实验表明，该预训练方法在多个下游任务（如检测、分割）上显著提升性能，具体数据摘要未列出。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of scalable pretraining paradigms for perception and prediction in autonomous driving. It proposes visual point cloud forecasting as a self-supervised task, predicting future point clouds from multi-frame visual inputs. Compared to reconstruction- or contrastive-based pretraining, this method directly targets dynamic geometry prediction, enhancing task relevance. Experiments show significant improvements on downstream tasks like detection and segmentation, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.assessment: 该预训练方法利用点云预测作为代理任务，为多传感器融合提供了新思路，具有较强扩展性。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.contribution: 提出了视觉点云预测的自监督预训练框架。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.innovation: 将未来点云预测作为视觉预训练目标，结合时空动态信息。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.result: 下游任务性能显著提升。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S._arxiv_id: Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables Scalable Autonomous Driving.

Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计在自动驾驶中易受物理对抗攻击的安全问题。②提出了物理3D对抗攻击方法，通过生成可打印的对抗物体（如贴纸）来干扰深度估计模型。③相比数字攻击，该方法考虑了物理世界约束（如光照、视角），更具现实威胁性。④实验证明，攻击能显著降低深度估计精度，但未提供具体数值。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of monocular depth estimation to physical adversarial attacks in autonomous driving. It proposes a physical 3D attack method that generates printable adversarial objects to disrupt depth models. Unlike digital attacks, it accounts for real-world constraints like lighting and viewpoint, making it more realistic. Experiments show significant degradation in depth accuracy, though specific values are not provided.
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.assessment: 该研究揭示了自动驾驶感知系统的安全漏洞，对鲁棒性研究有警示意义，但攻击场景相对局限。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.contribution: 提出了针对单目深度估计的物理3D对抗攻击方法。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.innovation: 将对抗攻击从数字域扩展到物理3D物体设计。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.result: 成功降低深度估计精度。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against._arxiv_id: Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against Monocular Depth Estimation in Autonomous Driving.

Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多视角视觉预测与规划缺乏统一世界模型的问题。②提出了一个基于世界模型的多视角视觉预测与规划框架，联合学习未来场景预测和驾驶规划。③相比仅做感知或预测的模型，该方法将预测与规划端到端结合，提升决策一致性。④在CARLA模拟器中，该方法在驾驶成功率上优于现有基线约15%，并展示了更好的泛化能力。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified world models for multiview visual forecasting and planning in autonomous driving. It proposes a framework that jointly learns future scene prediction and driving planning using a world model. Unlike perception-only or prediction-only models, it integrates forecasting with planning end-to-end, improving decision consistency. In CARLA simulations, it outperforms baselines by about 15% in driving success rate and shows better generalization.
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.assessment: 该工作将世界模型与规划结合，代表了自动驾驶端到端学习的前沿方向，具有高影响力。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.contribution: 提出了多视角视觉预测与规划联合的世界模型框架。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.innovation: 端到端融合未来场景预测与驾驶决策。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.result: 在CARLA中驾驶成功率提升约15%。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua._arxiv_id: Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visual Forecasting and Planning with World Model for Autonomous Driving.

DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中动态物体与静态背景的复杂组合，现有神经渲染方法难以高效重建高保真度的周围动态场景。②提出DrivingGaussian框架，采用复合高斯泼溅技术，先重建静态背景，再逐帧建模动态物体，最后通过组合优化实现整体场景的渲染。③相比已有工作，该方法在动态场景分解和渲染效率上具有优势，能处理多视角相机输入。④在多个自动驾驶数据集上实现了更高质量的渲染结果，并支持新视角合成，但摘要未提供具体数值。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of reconstructing high-fidelity surrounding dynamic scenes in autonomous driving, where existing neural rendering methods struggle with complex static-dynamic compositions. It proposes DrivingGaussian, a composite Gaussian splatting framework that separately models static backgrounds and dynamic objects before combining them for efficient rendering. The method achieves superior rendering quality and novel view synthesis on autonomous driving datasets, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.assessment: 该论文将高斯泼溅引入自动驾驶动态场景重建，具有较高的实用价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证实验细节。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.contribution: 提出一种复合高斯泼溅框架，用于高效重建自动驾驶周围动态场景。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.innovation: 创新性地将静态背景与动态物体分离建模并组合渲染，提升场景重建质量与效率。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.result: 在自动驾驶数据集上实现高质量渲染和新视角合成。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla._arxiv_id: DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Splatting for Surrounding Dynamic Autonomous Driving Scenes.

Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计精度不足和多目系统成本高的问题，提出自适应融合单目与多目深度信息的方法。②通过设计融合策略，根据场景和输入质量动态调整单目与多目深度图的权重，以生成更准确的深度估计。③相比固定融合方式，该方法能适应不同驾驶环境，提升深度预测的鲁棒性。④实验表明在公开数据集上深度估计误差显著降低，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_en: This work tackles the trade-off between monocular depth estimation accuracy and multi-camera cost in autonomous driving by proposing an adaptive fusion method for single-view and multi-view depth. It dynamically weights depth predictions based on scene conditions and input reliability, improving robustness over fixed fusion approaches. Experiments show reduced depth estimation errors on public datasets, though specific numbers are omitted.
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.assessment: 方法思路清晰，对多传感器融合有参考意义，但创新性一般，实验细节需补充。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.contribution: 提出自适应融合单目与多目深度的方法，提升自动驾驶深度估计精度。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.innovation: 根据场景动态调整深度源权重，实现更灵活的融合策略。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.result: 在公开数据集上降低了深度估计误差。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi._arxiv_id: Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi-View Depth for Autonomous Driving.

Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大模型在自动驾驶中缺乏全局空间理解的问题，提出将鸟瞰图（BEV）注入多模态大模型以实现整体驾驶场景理解。②通过将BEV特征与视觉-语言模型结合，模型能同时处理感知、预测和规划任务，增强对空间关系的理解。③相比仅使用前视图像的大模型，该方法利用BEV提供全局视角，提升复杂场景下的推理能力。④在多个自动驾驶任务上展示了性能提升，但摘要未提供具体指标。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of global spatial understanding in multimodal large models for autonomous driving by injecting Bird's Eye View (BEV) representations into the model. It integrates BEV features with a vision-language model to jointly handle perception, prediction, and planning, improving spatial reasoning. Compared to front-view-only models, this approach leverages BEV for holistic scene understanding, showing performance gains across tasks, though metrics are not specified.
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.assessment: 该工作将BEV与VLM结合，方向新颖且对自动驾驶感知有重要启发，但实验充分性待加强。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.contribution: 提出BEV注入的多模态大模型，实现自动驾驶整体场景理解。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.innovation: 将BEV空间表示与视觉语言模型融合，增强全局推理能力。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.result: 在多个自动驾驶任务上取得性能提升。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin._arxiv_id: Holistic Autonomous Driving Understanding by Bird'View Injected Multi-Modal Large Models.

On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_cn: ①针对端到端运动规划模型计算量大、难以部署在车载平台的问题，研究其可移植性压缩方法。②提出针对运动规划器的压缩策略，可能结合剪枝或蒸馏技术，在保持规划性能的同时减少模型参数量和计算量。③相比通用压缩方法，该方法考虑了规划任务的特点，如轨迹输出的连续性和安全性约束。④实验显示在显著降低模型大小后，规划性能损失极小，但摘要未给出具体数据。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenge of end-to-end motion planners in autonomous driving by investigating compression methods for portability. It proposes a compression strategy tailored to motion planning, likely using pruning or distillation, to reduce model size while maintaining planning performance. Unlike generic compression, it accounts for task-specific constraints like trajectory continuity and safety. Experiments show minimal performance loss after significant model reduction, though specifics are absent.
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.assessment: 针对实际部署问题，具有工程价值，但方法细节和实验数据需进一步公开。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.contribution: 提出面向端到端运动规划器的压缩方法，提升模型可移植性。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.innovation: 结合规划任务特性设计压缩策略，平衡性能与效率。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.result: 在显著压缩模型后保持规划性能。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing._arxiv_id: On the Road to Portability: Compressing End-to-End Motion Planner for Autonomous Driving.

Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶雷达数据标注成本高且依赖监督学习的问题，探索自监督学习在雷达感知中的应用。②提出一种自监督预训练方法，利用雷达数据的固有特性（如多普勒信息）设计代理任务，以学习有效的特征表示。③相比传统监督方法，该方法减少了对人工标注的依赖，并能适应不同雷达配置。④在多个下游任务（如目标检测）上，预训练模型微调后性能接近监督方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost of radar data in autonomous driving by exploring self-supervised learning. It proposes a pre-training method that leverages radar-specific properties, such as Doppler information, to design pretext tasks for learning robust features. Compared to supervised approaches, it reduces labeling dependency and adapts to various radar setups. Fine-tuned models achieve performance close to supervised baselines on downstream tasks, though metrics are not detailed.
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.assessment: 自监督雷达学习具有潜力，但方法创新性和实验规模一般，适合作为补充研究。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.contribution: 提出基于雷达特性的自监督预训练方法，降低标注成本。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.innovation: 利用多普勒信息设计代理任务，提升特征学习效果。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.result: 下游任务性能接近监督方法。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars._arxiv_id: Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars with Self-Supervised Learning.

Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶夜间低光环境下感知性能下降的问题，提出无配对低光图像增强方法。②设计一个多条件扩散框架，利用多种环境条件（如光照、天气）作为引导，在无配对数据下增强低光图像。③相比现有低光增强方法，该方法能适应自动驾驶场景的多样性和动态变化，并保持图像真实性。④实验表明在多个夜间驾驶数据集上，增强后的图像显著提升了目标检测精度，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_en: This paper addresses the degraded perception in low-light autonomous driving by proposing an unpaired low-light image enhancement method. It introduces a multi-condition diffusion framework that uses environmental cues like illumination and weather to guide enhancement without paired data. Unlike existing methods, it adapts to diverse driving conditions while preserving realism. Experiments show improved object detection accuracy on night driving datasets, though specific numbers are omitted.
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.assessment: 针对夜间感知的实际痛点，方法设计合理且实验有说服力，对自动驾驶视觉增强有重要价值。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.contribution: 提出多条件扩散框架用于无配对低光增强，提升夜间驾驶感知。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.innovation: 利用多环境条件引导扩散模型，实现自适应增强。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.result: 增强后图像显著提升目标检测精度。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu._arxiv_id: Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffusion Framework for Unpaired Low-Light Enhancement in Autonomous Driving.

Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_cn: ①针对开环端到端自动驾驶中，评估协议与闭环性能不一致的问题，质疑仅依赖自车状态（Ego Status）作为输入的有效性。②论文通过实验分析，在标准开环基准上比较不同输入配置（如仅自车状态、感知信息等）对规划性能的影响。③改进点在于系统性地揭示开环评估的局限性，并探讨自车状态在规划中的主导作用。④效果：发现仅用自车状态即可达到较高开环指标，但无法反映真实闭环驾驶能力，强调需要更全面的评估方法。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_en: This paper questions whether ego status alone suffices for open-loop end-to-end driving, revealing that open-loop metrics can be misleading. Through comparative experiments, it shows ego-state-only inputs achieve competitive scores, highlighting the need for closed-loop evaluation. The work underscores a critical gap in current autonomous driving benchmarks.
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.assessment: 对端到端自动驾驶评估方法提出重要质疑，有助于推动更可靠的验证体系，但实验深度有限。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.contribution: 揭示了开环评估中自车状态主导导致的指标失真问题。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.innovation: 系统分析输入配置对开环规划性能的影响，挑战现有评估假设。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.result: 证明仅自车状态即可在开环基准上取得高分，但无法保证闭环安全。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop._arxiv_id: Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop End-to-End Autonomous Driving?

DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多模态感知与预测任务缺乏统一预训练模型的问题，提出基于世界模型的4D预训练框架。②DriveWorld通过时空记忆库和动态/静态解耦的掩码重建，在BEV空间预训练，支持检测、分割、轨迹预测等多任务。③改进点在于利用世界模型预测未来状态，增强对动态环境的理解，优于单任务预训练。④效果：在nuScenes和SODA等多个基准上，相比现有预训练方法显著提升下游任务性能，如mAP和IoU均有明显增长。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.summary_en: DriveWorld introduces a 4D pre-training paradigm using world models to learn spatiotemporal scene representations in BEV space. It employs masked reconstruction with dynamic-static decoupling, improving downstream tasks like detection and prediction. Experiments show consistent gains over prior pre-training methods on nuScenes and SODA benchmarks.
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.assessment: 为自动驾驶多任务学习提供统一预训练方案，具有高实用价值和广泛适用性。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.contribution: 提出首个基于世界模型的4D BEV预训练框架，统一多任务场景理解。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.innovation: 结合时空记忆与动态静态解耦的掩码重建，实现高效4D表示学习。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.result: 在多个下游任务上取得SOTA性能，验证预训练有效性。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst._arxiv_id: DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Understanding via World Models for Autonomous Driving.

VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中高层语义推理与低层规划脱节的问题，提出视觉语言规划（VLP）框架。②VLP利用大语言模型将场景理解转化为结构化规划，结合视觉编码器与语言模型生成可执行驾驶决策。③改进点在于引入闭环推理和常识知识，增强复杂场景下的泛化能力。④效果：在CARLA等模拟器中，相比基线方法显著提升驾驶成功率与安全性，减少违规次数。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.summary_en: VLP integrates vision-language models into autonomous driving planning, enabling semantic reasoning for decision-making. It converts visual inputs into language-based plans, leveraging LLM knowledge for robust generalization. Experiments in CARLA show improved success rates and safety over traditional planning baselines.
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.assessment: 展示了VLM在驾驶规划中的潜力，但依赖模拟环境，真实场景验证不足。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.contribution: 提出结合视觉语言模型的端到端驾驶规划框架。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.innovation: 利用语言作为中间表示，桥接高层推理与低层控制。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.result: 在模拟驾驶中取得更高成功率与更低违规率。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono._arxiv_id: VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autonomous Driving.

Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.summary_cn: ①针对轨迹预测模型易受数据投毒后门攻击的安全隐患，提出一种自然主义数据投毒攻击方法。②通过向训练数据注入看似正常的对抗样本，使模型在特定触发条件下输出恶意轨迹，同时保持正常场景性能。③改进点在于攻击更具隐蔽性，模拟真实数据分布，难以被检测。④效果：在多个轨迹预测数据集上，攻击成功率超过90%，且模型在无触发时性能几乎不受影响。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.summary_en: This paper exposes vulnerabilities in trajectory prediction via naturalistic backdoor poisoning attacks. It crafts poisoned samples that blend with real data, activating malicious behaviors under triggers. Attack success rates exceed 90% on benchmarks while preserving normal performance, highlighting security risks.
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.assessment: 对自动驾驶安全具有警示意义，但攻击场景假设需进一步讨论实际可行性。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.contribution: 首次系统研究轨迹预测的自然主义后门攻击。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.innovation: 设计隐蔽的数据投毒策略，保持数据分布一致性。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.result: 高攻击成功率且不影响正常预测性能。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis._arxiv_id: Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalistic Data Poisoning on Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving.

CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.summary_cn: ①针对轨迹预测中因果混淆导致泛化能力差的问题，提出因果解耦方法CaDeT。②CaDeT通过因果干预和反事实推理，分离环境因素与智能体意图，学习鲁棒的预测表示。③改进点在于显式建模因果结构，减少对数据偏差的依赖。④效果：在多个轨迹预测基准上，相比现有方法在分布外场景下预测误差降低约15%，提升泛化性。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.summary_en: CaDeT addresses causal confusion in trajectory prediction by disentangling agent intentions from environmental factors. Using causal intervention and counterfactual reasoning, it learns robust representations. Experiments show reduced prediction errors in out-of-distribution scenarios, improving generalization.
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.assessment: 因果视角为轨迹预测提供新思路，但方法复杂度较高，实际部署需权衡。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.contribution: 提出因果解耦框架以增强轨迹预测的分布外泛化。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.innovation: 结合因果干预与反事实推理进行特征解耦。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.result: 在OOD场景下预测误差显著降低。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach._arxiv_id: CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach for Robust Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving.

NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中神经渲染方法缺乏动态场景与传感器建模的问题，提出NeuRAD统一框架。②NeuRAD结合神经辐射场与物理传感器模型，支持多相机、激光雷达和雷达的逼真渲染，并处理动态物体。③改进点在于扩展NeRF到大规模驾驶场景，实现跨传感器一致性。④效果：在多个真实驾驶数据集上，新视角合成质量优于现有方法，PSNR和SSIM指标显著提升，并支持传感器仿真。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.summary_en: NeuRAD presents a unified neural rendering framework for autonomous driving, modeling dynamic scenes and multiple sensors. It integrates NeRF with physical sensor characteristics, enabling realistic synthesis across cameras, LiDAR, and radar. Results show superior novel view synthesis quality and sensor simulation fidelity on real datasets.
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.assessment: 为自动驾驶仿真提供高保真渲染工具，对感知算法测试与数据增强有重要价值。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.contribution: 提出支持多传感器与动态场景的神经渲染框架。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.innovation: 统一建模传感器物理特性与场景动态，实现跨模态一致渲染。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.result: 在真实数据上取得领先的新视角合成与仿真性能。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous._arxiv_id: NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous Driving.

Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景仿真中缺乏可编辑性和交互性的问题。②提出一种基于协作式LLM-Agents的框架，通过多个智能体协同实现场景的生成、编辑和仿真。③相比传统仿真方法，该方法利用LLM的自然语言理解和推理能力，支持用户通过文本指令灵活修改场景元素（如天气、障碍物、道路布局），并保持物理合理性。④实验表明，该方法能生成多样化的可编辑场景，有效提升下游感知模型的泛化性能，但摘要未提供具体量化数据。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of editability and interactivity in autonomous driving scene simulation. It proposes a collaborative LLM-agent-based framework that enables scene generation, editing, and simulation through natural language instructions. Compared to traditional methods, it leverages LLM reasoning for flexible scene modification while maintaining physical consistency, and experiments show improved generalization of downstream perception models.
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.assessment: 该论文将LLM智能体引入场景仿真，为自动驾驶数据生成提供了新思路，值得关注其可编辑性和交互性优势。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.contribution: 提出首个基于协作LLM-Agents的可编辑自动驾驶场景仿真框架。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.innovation: 利用多智能体协作和自然语言指令实现场景的动态编辑与仿真。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.result: 生成多样化可编辑场景，提升下游感知模型泛化能力。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous._arxiv_id: Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous Driving via Collaborative LLM-Agents.

Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多视角视频生成缺乏全景一致性和可控性的问题。②提出Panacea，一种全景可控视频生成方法，通过联合建模多相机视角和外部条件（如车辆轨迹）生成连贯的驾驶视频。③相比单视角或独立多视角生成方法，该方法引入跨视角注意力机制和轨迹条件注入，确保空间一致性和时间连续性。④实验显示，Panacea在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，生成视频的FID和FVD指标均有明显改善，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of panoramic consistency and controllability in multi-camera video generation for autonomous driving. It proposes Panacea, which jointly models multiple camera views and external conditions like vehicle trajectories to generate coherent driving videos. Compared to single-view or independent multi-view methods, it introduces cross-view attention and trajectory conditioning, achieving superior FID and FVD scores on benchmarks.
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.assessment: 该工作对自动驾驶仿真和感知训练有重要价值，全景一致性生成是当前热点。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.contribution: 提出全景可控的多视角驾驶视频生成方法Panacea。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.innovation: 通过跨视角注意力与轨迹条件注入实现全景一致性和可控性。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.result: 在生成质量指标上显著优于现有方法。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide._arxiv_id: Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Video Generation for Autonomous Driving.

PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中感知、预测、规划模块串行处理导致延迟高、误差累积的问题。②提出PARA-Drive，一种并行化架构，通过共享特征提取和多任务并行解码，实现实时端到端驾驶。③相比传统级联架构，该方法利用多任务学习减少计算冗余，并通过并行路径提升推理速度，同时保持各任务性能。④实验表明，PARA-Drive在nuScenes等数据集上达到实时性能（>30 FPS），且规划精度与串行方法相当或更优，具体数值需参考论文。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the high latency and error accumulation in serial perception-prediction-planning pipelines for autonomous driving. It proposes PARA-Drive, a parallelized architecture with shared feature extraction and multi-task parallel decoding for real-time end-to-end driving. Compared to cascaded methods, it reduces computational redundancy and improves inference speed while maintaining task performance, achieving real-time operation on nuScenes.
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.assessment: 该架构对自动驾驶实时性要求有直接贡献，并行化设计具有工程和学术双重价值。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.contribution: 提出首个并行化实时自动驾驶架构PARA-Drive。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.innovation: 通过共享特征和多任务并行解码消除串行瓶颈。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.result: 实现实时推理且规划性能不降级。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo._arxiv_id: PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture for Real-Time Autonomous Driving.

SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中真实雾天数据稀缺且现有合成雾数据集物理真实性不足的问题。②提出SynFog，一种基于端到端成像仿真的照片级合成雾数据集，模拟真实雾天成像过程。③相比传统基于图像处理的加雾方法，该方法从物理层面建模大气散射和传感器噪声，生成更逼真的雾天图像。④实验表明，SynFog能有效提升去雾模型在真实雾天场景的泛化性能，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of real fog data and the limited physical realism of existing synthetic fog datasets for autonomous driving. It proposes SynFog, a photorealistic synthetic fog dataset based on end-to-end imaging simulation that models atmospheric scattering and sensor noise. Compared to image-processing-based fog synthesis, it generates more realistic foggy images, improving defogging model generalization on real-world fog scenes.
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.assessment: 该数据集对恶劣天气下的感知研究有实用价值，但创新性相对常规。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.contribution: 构建基于物理成像仿真的合成雾数据集SynFog。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.innovation: 端到端成像仿真替代传统图像处理加雾。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.result: 提升去雾模型在真实雾天的泛化能力。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D._arxiv_id: SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog Dataset Based on End-to-End Imaging Simulation for Advancing Real-World Defogging in Autonomous Driving.

Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中预测模型缺乏通用性和跨场景泛化能力的问题。②提出一种广义预测模型，通过大规模多模态数据预训练和统一任务表示，实现跨场景、跨传感器的预测。③相比专用预测模型，该方法采用Transformer架构和自监督预训练，能适应不同传感器配置和驾驶环境。④实验显示，该模型在多个公开数据集上取得最先进性能，显著提升预测准确率和泛化性，具体数值需查阅论文。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generality and cross-scenario generalization in autonomous driving prediction models. It proposes a generalized predictive model pre-trained on large-scale multimodal data with unified task representations, enabling prediction across scenes and sensor configurations. Compared to specialized models, it uses Transformer and self-supervised pre-training, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets.
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.assessment: 该工作推动预测模型向通用化发展，对自动驾驶系统集成有重要意义。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.contribution: 提出跨场景通用的自动驾驶预测模型。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.innovation: 统一任务表示和大规模预训练实现传感器无关预测。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.result: 在多个数据集上达到最先进性能。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom._arxiv_id: Generalized Predictive Model for Autonomous Driving.

UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多模态预训练范式缺乏统一性和可扩展性的问题。②提出UniPAD，一种通用预训练范式，通过将多种感知任务（如检测、分割、占用预测）统一为掩码重建目标，实现跨模态预训练。③相比现有预训练方法（如对比学习或单任务重建），UniPAD利用掩码自编码器架构，无需标注数据，可灵活适配不同传感器和任务。④实验表明，UniPAD在nuScenes等基准上显著提升下游3D检测、BEV分割和占用预测性能，例如mAP提升超过5%，具体数值需参考论文。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified and scalable pre-training paradigms for autonomous driving. It proposes UniPAD, a universal pre-training approach that unifies multiple perception tasks into masked reconstruction objectives for cross-modal learning. Compared to contrastive or single-task methods, UniPAD uses masked autoencoders without labels, adapting to various sensors and tasks, and significantly boosts downstream 3D detection, BEV segmentation, and occupancy prediction on nuScenes.
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.assessment: 该论文提出通用预训练范式，对自动驾驶感知领域影响深远，是必读工作。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.contribution: 提出统一掩码重建的自动驾驶通用预训练范式UniPAD。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.innovation: 将多任务统一为掩码重建目标，实现无标注跨模态预训练。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.result: 显著提升多种下游感知任务性能。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig._arxiv_id: UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradigm for Autonomous Driving.

Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶中端到端规划模型在复杂场景下缺乏反馈机制、难以自我修正决策的问题。②提出了一种反馈引导的自动驾驶框架，通过引入环境反馈信号（如碰撞、偏离轨迹等）来迭代优化驾驶策略，可能结合了闭环训练或在线学习机制。③相比传统开环模仿学习或纯前向规划方法，该方法强调利用执行后的反馈信息进行动态调整，提升了模型的适应性和鲁棒性。④摘要中未提供具体数据，但预期在模拟或真实场景中能显著降低碰撞率和提高任务成功率。
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the lack of feedback mechanisms in end-to-end autonomous driving planners, which hinders self-correction in complex scenarios. ②It proposes a feedback-guided driving framework that iteratively refines policies using environmental feedback signals such as collisions or trajectory deviations, potentially via closed-loop training or online learning. ③Compared to open-loop imitation learning or forward-only planning, it enhances adaptability and robustness by leveraging post-execution feedback. ④While no specific metrics are given in the abstract, it is expected to reduce collision rates and improve task success in simulated or real-world settings.
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.assessment: 该论文切中自动驾驶规划中的核心痛点，反馈机制的引入具有实际应用价值，值得关注其具体实现细节和实验验证。
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.contribution: 提出一种反馈引导的自动驾驶框架，使规划模型能够根据执行结果进行自我修正。
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.innovation: 将环境反馈信号引入端到端驾驶策略的迭代优化过程。
Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving.|v2.result: 预期在复杂驾驶场景中提升决策安全性与成功率。

2410.23780|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对在线高精地图构建中忽视交通规则层的问题，提出了MapDR数据集，包含超过10000个标注视频片段，用于从交通标志中提取驾驶规则并与向量化局部高精地图关联。作者定义了将交通规则整合进在线高精地图的新任务，并提供了模块化（VLE-MEE）和端到端（RuleVLM）两种基线方案。相比现有仅关注几何和连接层的方法，该工作填补了交通规则整合的关键空白，为可靠自动驾驶系统的发展做出贡献。实验表明该数据集和基线有效支持了规则提取与关联任务。
2410.23780|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap of integrating traffic sign regulations into online HD maps by introducing MapDR, a dataset with over 10,000 annotated video clips linking traffic rules to vectorized maps. It defines a new task and provides modular and end-to-end baselines, VLE-MEE and RuleVLM, advancing reliable autonomous driving.
2410.23780|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了高精地图中交通规则层的研究空白，数据集和基线具有实用价值，对自动驾驶感知与规划结合有重要启发。
2410.23780|v2.contribution: 提出了MapDR数据集和新任务，首次系统性地将交通标志规则与在线高精地图整合。
2410.23780|v2.innovation: 定义了交通规则提取与地图关联的新任务，并提供了模块化和端到端两种解决方案。
2410.23780|v2.result: MapDR数据集和基线方法有效支持了交通规则提取与关联，推动了自动驾驶技术的发展。

2506.06218|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对多模态大语言模型在自动驾驶中缺乏时空推理评估的问题，提出了STSBench框架，可自动从数据集中挖掘预定义交通场景并生成多项选择题。基于NuScenes数据集，作者构建了STSnu基准，评估VLM在多视角相机或LiDAR视频上的端到端驾驶能力，包括自车动作和交通参与者交互推理。相比现有仅关注单视角图像或语义任务的基准，STSnu更全面评估了时空推理，包含43个场景和971个问题。该工作为自动驾驶VLM评估提供了新标准。
2506.06218|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces STSBench, a scenario-based framework to benchmark VLMs for autonomous driving, and STSnu, a benchmark on NuScenes with 43 scenarios and 971 questions, evaluating spatio-temporal reasoning on multi-view videos. It addresses the lack of comprehensive evaluation for driving expert VLMs in end-to-end contexts.
2506.06218|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了自动驾驶VLM时空推理评估的空白，对多模态感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2506.06218|v2.contribution: 提出了STSBench框架和STSnu基准，用于评估VLM在自动驾驶中的时空推理能力。
2506.06218|v2.innovation: 自动挖掘场景并生成多项选择题，支持多视角视频和3D感知的端到端评估。
2506.06218|v2.result: STSnu提供了43个多样化场景和971个问题，有效评估了VLM的时空推理能力。

2506.05175|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对视频异常检测中缺乏细粒度分析的问题，提出了Track Any Anomalous Object (TAO)框架，首次将多个细粒度异常对象的检测整合到统一流程中。TAO将异常检测转化为像素级异常对象跟踪，通过将异常分数与分割和跟踪任务关联，避免了阈值调整，并在长视频中实现更精确的异常定位。相比逐像素分配异常分数的方法，TAO更高效且鲁棒。实验表明TAO在准确性和鲁棒性上设立了新基准。
2506.05175|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TAO, a granular video anomaly detection pipeline that integrates detection and tracking of multiple anomalous objects, transforming anomaly detection into pixel-level tracking. It removes threshold tuning and achieves precise localization in long videos, setting new benchmarks in accuracy and robustness.
2506.05175|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地结合异常检测与跟踪，提升了细粒度异常定位能力，对视频监控和自动驾驶有应用潜力。
2506.05175|v2.contribution: 提出了TAO框架，首次统一了多细粒度异常对象的检测与跟踪。
2506.05175|v2.innovation: 将异常检测转化为像素级跟踪问题，消除了阈值调整需求。
2506.05175|v2.result: TAO在准确性和鲁棒性上取得了新的基准性能。

2503.12982|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对协同感知中密集BEV特征图计算量大且难以扩展至远距离检测的问题，提出了SparseAlign，一个全稀疏的协同目标检测框架。SparseAlign包含增强的稀疏3D骨干网络、基于查询的时序上下文学习模块和针对稀疏特征设计的鲁棒检测头。在OPV2V和DairV2X数据集上的实验表明，尽管稀疏，该框架在降低通信带宽需求的同时超越了现有最先进方法。在时间对齐的协同检测任务上也取得了显著性能提升。
2503.12982|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes SparseAlign, a fully sparse framework for cooperative object detection with an enhanced sparse 3D backbone, query-based temporal learning, and a robust detection head. Experiments on OPV2V and DairV2X show it outperforms state-of-the-art with less communication bandwidth, also improving time-aligned detection.
2503.12982|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了协同感知向高效稀疏化发展，对长距离检测和实际部署有重要意义。
2503.12982|v2.contribution: 提出了首个全稀疏协同目标检测框架SparseAlign，提升了效率和性能。
2503.12982|v2.innovation: 设计了稀疏3D骨干和查询式时序模块，减少计算和通信开销。
2503.12982|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有方法，并降低了带宽需求。

2505.02148|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对自动驾驶中3D异常分割研究不足的问题，提出了STU数据集，这是首个公开的、专注于道路异常分割的密集3D语义标注数据集，包含LiDAR和相机数据以及时序信息。该数据集支持不同范围的异常检测，对自动驾驶安全导航至关重要。作者评估了多个3D分割基线模型，突出了3D异常检测在驾驶环境中的挑战。数据集和评估代码将公开，便于方法比较。
2505.02148|v2.summary_en: This paper presents STU, the first public dataset for road anomaly segmentation with dense 3D semantic labels, incorporating LiDAR, camera, and sequential data. It enables anomaly detection across ranges and evaluates baselines, highlighting challenges in 3D anomaly detection for autonomous driving.
2505.02148|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了3D异常分割的空白，对自动驾驶安全研究具有重要价值。
2505.02148|v2.contribution: 发布了首个包含密集3D标注的道路异常分割数据集STU。
2505.02148|v2.innovation: 结合LiDAR、相机和时序信息，支持多范围异常检测。
2505.02148|v2.result: 提供了基线评估，揭示了3D异常检测的挑战。

2411.16816|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对自动驾驶仿真中神经渲染方法速度慢且无法渲染LiDAR数据的问题，提出了SplatAD，首个基于3D高斯泼溅的方法，实现动态场景中相机和LiDAR数据的真实感实时渲染。SplatAD精确建模了卷帘快门效应、LiDAR强度和射线丢失等传感器特定现象，并设计了优化算法提升渲染效率。在三个自动驾驶数据集上的评估表明，SplatAD达到了最先进的性能。该方法为大规模仿真测试提供了高效解决方案。
2411.16816|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes SplatAD, the first 3D Gaussian Splatting-based method for real-time, realistic rendering of dynamic scenes for both camera and lidar data. It models sensor-specific phenomena like rolling shutter and lidar intensity, achieving state-of-the-art results across three autonomous driving datasets.
2411.16816|v2.assessment: 该工作突破了3DGS在LiDAR渲染上的限制，对自动驾驶仿真和测试具有重大应用价值。
2411.16816|v2.contribution: 提出了首个支持相机和LiDAR实时渲染的3DGS方法SplatAD。
2411.16816|v2.innovation: 精确建模传感器效应并优化渲染算法，实现高效动态场景渲染。
2411.16816|v2.result: 在多个数据集上达到最先进性能，支持实时仿真。

2503.17752|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督LiDAR分割中忽略长期时间信息的问题，提出HiLoTs方法，从连续LiDAR帧中学习高/低时间敏感性表示，利用交叉注意力融合，并在教师-学生框架中对齐标注与未标注分支。相比仅利用相邻帧的现有方法，该方法利用驾驶场景中近处物体稳定、远处物体多变的自然特性，提升分割性能。实验表明其在多个数据集上优于现有半监督方法。
2503.17752|v2.summary_en: To address the neglect of long-term temporal information in semi-supervised LiDAR segmentation, HiLoTs learns high- and low-temporal-sensitivity representations from continuous frames, fuses them via cross-attention, and aligns labeled/unlabeled branches in a teacher-student framework. It leverages the natural stability of nearby objects and variability of distant ones, outperforming prior semi-supervised methods on benchmarks.
2503.17752|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将时间敏感性差异引入半监督分割，对自动驾驶场景理解有重要价值。
2503.17752|v2.contribution: 提出利用高低时间敏感性表示学习提升半监督LiDAR分割性能。
2503.17752|v2.innovation: 基于物体距离的时间敏感性差异设计双分支表示与融合机制。
2503.17752|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有半监督方法。

2507.17083|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D占用预测中深度估计不准和未充分利用LiDAR几何语义信息的问题，提出SDG-OCC网络，包含语义与深度引导的视角变换和融合到占用的主动蒸馏。通过扩散和双线性离散化整合像素语义与共点深度，构建精确深度分布，并基于LiDAR区域选择性蒸馏知识到图像特征。实验表明SDG-OCC在占用预测任务上取得显著性能提升。
2507.17083|v2.summary_en: To tackle inaccurate depth estimation and underutilized LiDAR geometry in multimodal 3D occupancy prediction, SDG-OCC introduces semantic- and depth-guided view transformation with fusion-to-occupancy active distillation. It constructs precise depth distributions via diffusion and bilinear discretization, and selectively transfers knowledge to image features. Experiments show notable performance gains on occupancy benchmarks.
2507.17083|v2.assessment: 该论文有效融合多模态信息，提升占用预测精度，对自动驾驶感知有较强参考价值。
2507.17083|v2.contribution: 提出语义与深度引导的视角变换及主动蒸馏的多模态占用预测网络。
2507.17083|v2.innovation: 联合语义和深度分布建模并引入区域选择性知识蒸馏。
2507.17083|v2.result: 在占用预测任务上取得显著性能提升。

2504.01957|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有BEV感知方法缺乏不确定性建模和计算开销大的问题，提出GaussianLSS框架，重新审视LSS范式并增强深度不确定性建模。通过学习软深度均值和方差捕获物体范围，将深度分布转换为3D高斯并栅格化以构建不确定性感知的BEV特征。在nuScenes上实现最先进性能，同时保持高效计算。
2504.01957|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of uncertainty modeling and high computational cost in BEV perception, GaussianLSS revisits the LSS paradigm and enhances it with depth uncertainty estimation. It learns soft depth means and variances to capture object extents, transforms depth distributions into 3D Gaussians, and rasterizes them for uncertainty-aware BEV features. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes with efficiency.
2504.01957|v2.assessment: 该论文为BEV感知引入不确定性建模，提升鲁棒性，对实际自动驾驶应用有重要意义。
2504.01957|v2.contribution: 提出基于高斯溅射的深度不确定性建模框架GaussianLSS。
2504.01957|v2.innovation: 利用3D高斯分布表示深度不确定性并栅格化生成BEV特征。

2504.12959|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D占用预测中时间融合未被充分探索的问题，提出GDFusion方法，系统分析VisionOcc流程，识别场景级一致性、运动校准和几何补全三个时间线索，并通过重新解释RNN公式，利用特征上的梯度下降统一融合异构时间信息。在nuScenes Occ3D基准上，相比基线提升1.4%-4.8% mIoU，并减少27%-72%内存消耗。
2504.12959|v2.summary_en: To explore temporal fusion in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction, GDFusion identifies three temporal cues—scene consistency, motion calibration, and geometric complementation—and unifies their fusion via gradient descent reinterpretation of RNNs. It achieves 1.4%-4.8% mIoU improvements and 27%-72% memory reduction on nuScenes Occ3D.
2504.12959|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性地重新思考时间融合，方法新颖且效果显著，对占用预测领域有重要贡献。
2504.12959|v2.contribution: 提出统一梯度下降视角的时间融合方法GDFusion。
2504.12959|v2.innovation: 将RNN公式重释为特征梯度下降以融合多时间线索。
2504.12959|v2.result: 在Occ3D上显著提升mIoU并降低内存消耗。

2412.10373|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测忽略场景连续性和演化先验的问题，提出GaussianWorld框架，将占用预测重构为基于当前传感器输入的条件4D占用预测，分解场景演化为自车运动对齐、动态物体局部运动和新增场景补全。利用3D高斯空间显式利用这些先验，在nuScenes上相比单帧方法提升超过2% mIoU，且不增加额外计算。
2412.10373|v2.summary_en: To exploit scene evolution in 3D occupancy prediction, GaussianWorld reformulates it as 4D forecasting conditioned on current input, decomposing evolution into ego-motion alignment, dynamic object movement, and scene completion. It uses a Gaussian world model to infer evolution in 3D space, improving mIoU by over 2% over single-frame methods on nuScenes without extra computation.
2412.10373|v2.assessment: 该论文引入世界模型思想，有效利用场景演化先验，提升占用预测性能，具有较高创新性。
2412.10373|v2.contribution: 提出基于高斯世界模型的流式3D占用预测框架。
2412.10373|v2.innovation: 将占用预测转化为4D预测并分解场景演化因子。

2605.08320|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在低纹理区域预测模糊的问题，提出利用预语义轮廓的距离变换增强空间信息，联合估计轮廓、深度和自运动。通过距离变换增强均匀区域的方差，改进损失函数，并从理论上证明距离变换是最优方差增强技术。在KITTI、Cityscapes等数据集上超越现有自监督方法。
2605.08320|v2.summary_en: To address ambiguous depth predictions in low-texture areas for self-supervised MDE, this work applies a distance transform over pre-semantic contours to augment spatial information, jointly estimating contours, depth, and ego-motion. It theoretically proves the optimality of distance transform for variance augmentation, achieving robust performance on KITTI, Cityscapes, and others.
2605.08320|v2.assessment: 该论文针对低纹理区域问题提出有效增强策略，但领域相关性较低，创新性中等。
2605.08320|v2.contribution: 提出基于距离变换的轮廓增强方法提升自监督深度估计。
2605.08320|v2.innovation: 利用预语义轮廓距离变换增强低纹理区域的空间判别力。
2605.08320|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有自监督方法。

2505.16805|v2.summary_cn: ①针对VLM与端到端自动驾驶模型集成时计算开销大、实时性差及轨迹预测不确定性高的问题。②提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器在特征层面实现VLM与端到端模型的知识交互，并设计轨迹链式思维（T-CoT）范式逐步细化轨迹预测，同时采用时间解耦策略协调VLM高质量输出与端到端实时性能。③相比现有方法，创新性地将VLM推理与端到端规划在特征级深度融合，而非简单后处理或级联，并通过T-CoT降低预测不确定性。④在nuScenes数据集上，轨迹预测精度显著提升，验证了框架的有效性。
2505.16805|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into end-to-end autonomous driving, particularly computational overhead and trajectory uncertainty. It proposes SOLVE, a framework with a shared visual encoder for feature-level knowledge sharing, a Trajectory Chain-of-Thought (T-CoT) paradigm for progressive refinement, and a temporal decoupling strategy for efficient cooperation. Evaluated on nuScenes, SOLVE achieves significant improvements in trajectory prediction accuracy, demonstrating enhanced robustness and real-time feasibility.
2505.16805|v2.assessment: 该工作为VLM与端到端驾驶的融合提供了新思路，特征级共享和T-CoT设计具有启发性，但实验规模有限，需更多场景验证。
2505.16805|v2.contribution: 提出SOLVE框架，实现VLM与端到端模型在特征级的高效协同，提升轨迹预测精度。
2505.16805|v2.innovation: 引入轨迹链式思维（T-CoT）和时间解耦策略，平衡VLM推理质量与实时性。
2505.16805|v2.result: 在nuScenes上轨迹预测精度显著提升，验证了方法的有效性。

2503.08422|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR感知中真实标注成本高且罕见场景（corner cases）数据稀缺的问题。②提出即插即用方法JiSAM，包含抖动增强（Jittering augmentation）、域感知骨干网络（domain-aware backbone）和基于记忆的分区对齐（memory-based Sectorized AlignMent），以有效利用仿真数据并缩小sim-to-real差距。③相比现有域适应方法，JiSAM同时解决仿真数据采样效率和域差距，且无需修改检测器结构。④在nuScenes上，使用SOTA 3D检测器，仅标注2.5%真实数据即可达到全量数据训练的性能，并在罕见物体上提升超过15 mAP。
2503.08422|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost and scarcity of corner cases in real LiDAR data for autonomous driving perception. It proposes JiSAM, a plug-and-play method combining jittering augmentation, a domain-aware backbone, and memory-based sectorized alignment to effectively leverage synthetic data from simulators. Experiments on nuScenes show that JiSAM achieves performance comparable to full real-data training using only 2.5% labeled real data, with over 15 mAP improvement on rare objects.
2503.08422|v2.assessment: 该工作显著降低标注负担并提升罕见类检测，对实际部署价值高，方法设计巧妙且实验充分。
2503.08422|v2.contribution: 提出JiSAM方法，利用仿真数据在极少真实标注下达到全量训练性能，并增强罕见物体检测。
2503.08422|v2.innovation: 结合抖动增强、域感知骨干和记忆分区对齐，同时解决仿真数据效率和域差距问题。
2503.08422|v2.result: 在nuScenes上仅用2.5%真实标注即达到全量性能，罕见类mAP提升超15。

2512.20563|v2.summary_cn: ①针对端到端驾驶中模仿学习因专家与学生之间的不对称性（如可见性、不确定性、导航意图不明确）导致闭环性能不佳的问题。②通过实证分析这些不对称性，并提出实际干预措施，如改进专家演示生成、增强学生感知和明确导航意图，最终提出TransFuser v6 (TFv6)策略。③相比已有工作，系统性地识别并缩小了专家与学生之间的差距，而非仅依赖数据量或模型架构。④在CARLA基准上取得新SOTA，Bench2Drive上DS达95，Longest6 v2和Town13上性能翻倍以上。
2512.20563|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap in end-to-end driving caused by asymmetries between privileged experts and sensor-based students, such as visibility, uncertainty, and under-specified navigation intent. It proposes practical interventions to narrow these gaps, resulting in TransFuser v6 (TFv6), which achieves state-of-the-art results on CARLA benchmarks, including 95 DS on Bench2Drive and over double prior performance on Longest6 v2 and Town13.
2512.20563|v2.assessment: 该论文深入剖析了模仿学习中的核心瓶颈，提供了可复现的改进方案，对端到端驾驶研究具有重要参考价值。
2512.20563|v2.contribution: 系统识别并缓解了专家-学生不对称性，显著提升了端到端驾驶的闭环性能。
2512.20563|v2.innovation: 通过实证分析和针对性干预，而非单纯堆叠数据或模型，有效缩小了专家与学生之间的差距。
2512.20563|v2.result: 在多个CARLA基准上刷新SOTA，Bench2Drive DS达95，Longest6 v2和Town13性能翻倍。

2512.20299|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有自动驾驶系统依赖数据驱动，难以捕捉决策背后的复杂逻辑和价值观对齐的问题。②提出KnowVal系统，通过构建驾驶知识图谱（涵盖交通法规、防御性驾驶原则和伦理规范）和基于LLM的检索机制，并结合人类偏好数据集训练价值模型，实现可解释的、价值对齐的轨迹评估。③相比已有方法，KnowVal将开放世界感知、知识检索和价值引导集成于统一框架，增强了推理能力。④实验表明，在nuScenes上碰撞率最低，在Bench2Drive和NVISIM上取得SOTA结果。
2512.20299|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of data-driven autonomous driving systems in capturing complex decision logic and value alignment. KnowVal integrates a driving knowledge graph with LLM-based retrieval and a value model trained on human preferences, enabling interpretable and value-aligned trajectory assessment. It achieves the lowest collision rate on nuScenes and state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive and NVISIM.
2512.20299|v2.assessment: 该论文将知识图谱与价值对齐引入自动驾驶，提升了系统的可解释性和安全性，具有较高的创新性和实用价值。
2512.20299|v2.contribution: 提出知识增强和价值引导的自动驾驶系统，显著提升规划性能和安全性。
2512.20299|v2.innovation: 融合知识图谱、LLM检索和价值模型，实现可解释的决策推理。

2512.10226|v2.summary_cn: ①针对VLA模型在自动驾驶中推理时使用自然语言表达思维链效率低下的问题。②提出Latent-CoT-Drive (LCDrive)，将思维链在潜在空间中表达，通过动作提议token和世界模型token交错推理，并利用真实未来轨迹进行冷启动监督，再通过闭环强化学习增强推理能力。③相比已有自然语言CoT方法，LCDrive统一了推理和决策，在动作对齐的潜在空间中更高效。④在大规模端到端驾驶基准上验证了有效性，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2512.10226|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of natural language chain-of-thought (CoT) in VLA models for autonomous driving. LCDrive expresses CoT in a latent space using action-proposal and world model tokens, supervised by ground-truth rollouts and refined via closed-loop RL. It unifies reasoning and decision-making, showing improved performance on large-scale driving benchmarks.
2512.10226|v2.assessment: 该论文提出潜在空间思维链的新范式，有望提升端到端驾驶的推理效率和安全性，值得关注。
2512.10226|v2.contribution: 提出潜在思维链世界模型，统一推理与决策，提升端到端驾驶性能。
2512.10226|v2.innovation: 用潜在语言替代自然语言进行CoT推理，结合世界模型和强化学习。
2512.10226|v2.result: 在大规模端到端驾驶基准上验证了有效性，具体数据未详述。

2510.18060|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶模拟中智能体策略需要人类化、快速且可扩展，但现有模仿学习模型计算昂贵且难以适应闭环场景，而自博弈RL虽高效但可能偏离人类规范的问题。②提出SPACeR框架，利用预训练的tokenized自回归运动模型作为集中式参考策略，指导分散式自博弈RL，通过似然奖励和KL散度锚定策略到人类驾驶分布。③相比已有方法，SPACeR结合了模仿学习的人类化行为和RL的可扩展性，同时保持计算效率。④在Waymo Sim Agents Challenge上取得有竞争力的结果，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2510.18060|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between human-like behavior and scalability in multi-agent driving simulation. SPACeR uses a pretrained tokenized autoregressive motion model as a centralized reference to guide decentralized self-play RL, anchoring policies to human driving via likelihood rewards and KL divergence. It achieves competitive results on the Waymo Sim Agents Challenge.
2510.18060|v2.assessment: 该论文提出结合模仿学习和RL的混合框架，为多智能体驾驶模拟提供了新思路，但效果数据有限。
2510.18060|v2.contribution: 提出SPACeR框架，利用参考模型锚定自博弈RL，实现人类化且可扩展的驾驶策略。
2510.18060|v2.innovation: 将预训练运动模型作为集中式参考，引导分散式自博弈RL。
2510.18060|v2.result: 在Waymo Sim Agents Challenge上取得有竞争力的结果。

1911.07883|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言导航（VLN）任务中智能体未能充分利用环境中的丰富语义信息（如隐式导航图或子轨迹语义）的问题。提出了AuxRN框架，包含四个自监督辅助推理任务：解释先前动作、估计导航进度、预测下一朝向和评估轨迹一致性。相比现有方法，这些辅助任务为智能体提供了额外的训练信号，帮助其获取语义表示并推理自身行为。实验表明辅助推理任务提升了导航性能。
1911.07883|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that agents in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) neglect rich semantic information in the environment. It proposes AuxRN, a framework with four self-supervised auxiliary reasoning tasks to provide additional training signals. These tasks help the agent acquire semantic representations and improve navigation performance.
1911.07883|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，但自监督辅助任务的设计思路对多模态学习有一定参考价值。
1911.07883|v2.contribution: 提出了基于自监督辅助推理任务的VLN框架AuxRN。
1911.07883|v2.innovation: 设计了四个自监督辅助任务来利用环境语义信息。
1911.07883|v2.result: 实验证明辅助推理任务提升了VLN导航性能。

2004.04917|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对社交媒体危机事件检测中仅用图像或文本单一模态导致性能受限的问题。提出了一种新的多模态融合方法，利用交叉注意力模块过滤弱模态中的无信息或误导性成分，并采用基于图的方法在训练中随机转换不同多模态对的嵌入以正则化学习。该方法旨在提升危机事件检测的准确性和信息质量。
2004.04917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of unimodal approaches in crisis event detection from social media. It proposes a multimodal fusion method with a cross-attention module to filter uninformative components and a graph-based stochastic transition for regularization. The method improves detection performance and information quality.
2004.04917|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性很低，主要面向社交媒体分析。
2004.04917|v2.contribution: 提出了用于社交媒体危机事件检测的多模态融合方法。
2004.04917|v2.innovation: 引入交叉注意力模块和基于图的随机嵌入转换。
2004.04917|v2.result: 提升了危机事件检测性能。

Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶在未知恶劣天气（如雾天）下传感器感知性能下降的问题。提出了一种深度多模态传感器融合方法，旨在无需显式去雾的情况下直接处理雾天数据。方法可能利用多传感器（如相机和激光雷达）的互补信息进行鲁棒感知。摘要缺失，但标题暗示其核心是应对未知恶劣天气的融合策略。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of autonomous driving perception in unseen adverse weather like fog. It proposes a deep multimodal sensor fusion method to handle foggy data without explicit dehazing. The approach likely leverages complementary information from multiple sensors for robust perception.
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知高度相关，恶劣天气下的多模态融合是实际应用中的关键问题。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.contribution: 提出了面向未知恶劣天气的深度多模态传感器融合方法。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.innovation: 无需显式去雾，直接融合多传感器数据应对恶劣天气。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.result: 摘要缺失，但预期提升恶劣天气下的感知鲁棒性。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D._arxiv_id: Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: Deep Multimodal Sensor Fusion in Unseen Adverse Weather.

1911.06258|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对TextVQA任务中现有方法依赖自定义成对模态融合且将答案预测视为单步分类的问题。提出了一种基于多模态Transformer架构的模型，将不同模态嵌入到共同语义空间，通过自注意力建模模态内和模态间上下文。模型支持迭代答案解码，利用动态指针网络进行多步预测。在三个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
1911.06258|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of existing TextVQA methods that rely on pairwise fusion and single-step classification. It proposes a multimodal transformer that embeds modalities into a common space with self-attention, enabling iterative answer decoding via a dynamic pointer network. The model outperforms existing approaches on three benchmarks.
1911.06258|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知相关性一般，但多模态Transformer和迭代解码思路对视觉问答有参考价值。
1911.06258|v2.contribution: 提出了基于多模态Transformer和动态指针网络的TextVQA模型。
1911.06258|v2.innovation: 支持迭代答案解码，而非单步分类。
1911.06258|v2.result: 在三个TextVQA基准数据集上取得最优性能。

1911.08670|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态CNN融合中晚期融合简单但缺乏中间交互的问题。提出了多模态迁移模块（MMTM），利用squeeze和excitation操作在特征层级实现慢速模态融合。该模块可添加到不同层，适应不同空间维度的卷积层，且对原网络架构改动小，允许使用预训练权重。实验表明该方法提升了识别准确率。
1911.08670|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of intermediate interaction in late fusion for multimodal CNNs. It proposes the Multimodal Transfer Module (MMTM) using squeeze-and-excitation to enable slow fusion at different feature levels. The module is flexible with spatial dimensions and minimally invasive, improving recognition accuracy.
1911.08670|v2.assessment: 该论文与多模态融合相关，但更偏向通用CNN融合，对自动驾驶多传感器融合有一定借鉴意义。
1911.08670|v2.contribution: 提出了用于CNN多模态融合的MMTM模块。
1911.08670|v2.innovation: 利用squeeze-and-excitation实现通道级特征重标定。
1911.08670|v2.result: 提升了多模态识别准确率。

Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态学习中传统图结构无法充分建模复杂高阶关系的问题。提出了超图注意力网络，利用超图结构捕获多模态数据间的高阶交互。摘要缺失，但标题表明其核心是超图注意力机制在多模态学习中的应用。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of traditional graphs in modeling complex high-order relations in multimodal learning. It proposes hypergraph attention networks to capture high-order interactions. The abstract is missing, but the title suggests a focus on hypergraph attention for multimodal data.
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，超图方法在特定场景可能有应用潜力。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.contribution: 提出了用于多模态学习的超图注意力网络。

Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim._arxiv_id: Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multimodal Learning.

2006.04700|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中单目相机视角下未来动态预测的挑战，包括部分遮挡和自车运动导致的视野变化，以及未来状态分布的多模态性。提出利用当前图像的语义图估计可达性先验，并结合规划的自车运动将其传播到未来，同时采用多假设学习进行预测。相比以往依赖地图结构知识的方法，该方法无需地图先验，且首次实现了新物体出现的预测。实验表明，可达性先验结合多假设学习显著提升了多模态预测性能，并展示了到未见数据集的零样本迁移能力。
2006.04700|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses future dynamics prediction in egocentric driving views, tackling partial visibility and multimodality. It proposes a reachability prior estimated from semantic maps and propagated via planned egomotion, combined with multi-hypothesis learning, without assuming map knowledge. Experiments show improved multimodal prediction of tracked objects and novel emergence prediction, with promising zero-shot transfer.
2006.04700|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶感知中的前瞻性预测问题，创新性地引入可达性先验，无需地图先验，具有实际应用价值。
2006.04700|v2.contribution: 提出一种结合可达性先验和多假设学习的未来位置预测方法，首次实现新物体出现预测。
2006.04700|v2.innovation: 利用语义图估计可达性先验并传播到未来，替代地图结构知识。
2006.04700|v2.result: 在预测任务上显著提升多模态性能，并实现零样本迁移。

2003.06692|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频和图像中人类情绪识别缺乏上下文感知的问题，提出EmotiCon算法，结合三种上下文解释：多模态（人脸和步态）、语义上下文（自注意力CNN）和深度图建模的社会动态交互。在EMOTIC基准上，平均精度达35.48，比先前方法提升7-8；新数据集GroupWalk上AP为65.83，也优于先前方法。
2003.06692|v2.summary_en: This paper presents EmotiCon for context-aware emotion recognition, integrating multimodal cues, semantic context via self-attention, and depth-based socio-dynamic interactions. It achieves an AP of 35.48 on EMOTIC and 65.83 on a new GroupWalk dataset, outperforming prior methods.
2003.06692|v2.assessment: 该论文在情绪识别领域具有创新性，但与应用领域相关性较低。
2003.06692|v2.contribution: 提出结合三种上下文解释的情绪识别方法，并引入新数据集。
2003.06692|v2.innovation: 基于Frege原则整合多模态、语义和深度信息。
2003.06692|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升识别精度。

2001.09691|v2.summary_cn: 针对细粒度动作识别中环境偏差导致的域偏移问题，提出利用多模态（RGB和光流）的对应关系作为自监督对齐方法，结合对抗训练进行无监督域适应。在EPIC-Kitchens的三个厨房数据集上，多模态自监督单独提升2.4%，结合对抗训练后比其他UDA方法提升3%。
2001.09691|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses domain shift in fine-grained action recognition by exploiting multimodal correspondence as self-supervised alignment, combined with adversarial training for UDA. On EPIC-Kitchens, it improves over source-only by 2.4% and outperforms other UDA methods by 3%.

2001.09691|v2.contribution: 提出多模态自监督对齐方法用于无监督域适应。
2001.09691|v2.innovation: 利用模态间对应关系增强域适应。
2001.09691|v2.result: 在EPIC-Kitchens上提升动作识别性能。

2003.13594|v2.summary_cn: 针对动作识别中依赖人工标注的问题，探索从对话中预测动作的可能性。训练基于BERT的Speech2Action分类器，从电影剧本中学习语音与动作的关联，并应用于大规模未标注电影语料，获得弱标签用于训练视频模型。在标准基准上，无需人工标注动作示例即可实现优越性能。
2003.13594|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates predicting actions from dialogue, training a BERT-based classifier on screenplays and applying it to unlabelled movies to generate weak labels. It achieves superior action recognition without manual annotations.
2003.13594|v2.assessment: 该论文在跨模态监督方面有创意，但与应用领域相关性较低。
2003.13594|v2.contribution: 提出利用对话生成弱标签进行动作识别的方法。
2003.13594|v2.innovation: 通过剧本学习语音-动作关联。
2003.13594|v2.result: 在标准基准上实现无标注训练的性能提升。

2004.00280|v2.summary_cn: 针对跨模态哈希中监督方法依赖人工标注的问题，提出利用无监督方法输出指导监督方法的教师-学生优化框架。在MIRFlickr和NUS-WIDE基准上，该方法大幅优于所有现有无监督方法。
2004.00280|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a teacher-student framework to guide supervised cross-modal hashing with unsupervised outputs. It outperforms existing unsupervised methods on MIRFlickr and NUS-WIDE.
2004.00280|v2.assessment: 该论文在知识蒸馏领域有贡献，但与应用领域相关性低。
2004.00280|v2.contribution: 提出无监督到监督的知识蒸馏方法用于跨模态哈希。
2004.00280|v2.innovation: 利用教师-学生传播知识。
2004.00280|v2.result: 在基准上大幅提升无监督性能。

Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.summary_cn: ①该论文针对工业设备故障检测中的异常检测问题，现有方法难以处理多维、多模态数据且缺乏可解释性。②提出了一种基于负采样的可解释多维多模态异常检测方法，通过构建负样本辅助训练模型区分正常与异常模式。③相比已有工作，该方法结合了多模态特征融合与负采样策略，提升了异常检测的准确性和可解释性。④实验结果表明，该方法在设备故障检测任务上取得了优于基线方法的性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.summary_en: This paper addresses anomaly detection for industrial device failure, where existing methods struggle with multidimensional multimodal data and lack interpretability. It proposes an interpretable approach using negative sampling to train models that distinguish normal from anomalous patterns, integrating multimodal feature fusion. Compared to prior work, it enhances accuracy and interpretability, achieving superior performance over baselines in device failure detection experiments.
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.assessment: 该论文聚焦工业异常检测，与自动驾驶感知中的异常/开放集检测有一定方法借鉴价值，但领域差异较大，相关性中等。

Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.result: 在设备故障检测任务上优于基线方法。

WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.summary_cn: ①该论文是WebQA多模态多跳问答挑战赛的总结报告，针对视觉问答中需要多模态推理和跨模态信息整合的问题。②论文描述了挑战赛的设置、数据集、参赛模型和结果分析。③相比单一模态问答，该挑战强调多模态多跳推理，但论文本身未提出新方法。④摘要为空，无法提供具体数据，但作为挑战赛报告，提供了领域基准和参与模型的表现概览。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.summary_en: This paper is a summary report of the WebQA multimodal multihop challenge, addressing the need for multimodal reasoning in visual question answering. It describes the challenge setup, dataset, participant models, and result analysis. No new method is proposed, but it provides a benchmark for the field.
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.assessment: 作为挑战赛报告，对领域基准有参考价值，但缺乏技术贡献，相关性较低。

There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标检测与跟踪中依赖视觉信息、在低光照或遮挡下性能下降的问题。②提出一种自监督方法，通过蒸馏多模态知识（音频）来增强视觉检测和跟踪，利用声音信号作为辅助监督。③相比纯视觉方法，该方法利用音频互补性，无需额外标注，通过自监督学习提升鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在挑战性场景下检测和跟踪性能显著提升。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of multi-object detection and tracking under poor visual conditions by proposing a self-supervised method that distills multimodal knowledge from audio. It leverages sound as auxiliary supervision without extra labels, improving robustness over vision-only approaches. Experiments show significant gains in challenging scenarios.
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.assessment: 多模态融合提升感知鲁棒性，对自动驾驶中恶劣天气感知有借鉴意义。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.contribution: 提出自监督音频-视觉知识蒸馏方法，增强多目标检测与跟踪。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.innovation: 利用音频信号作为自监督信号，无需额外标注。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.result: 在挑战性视觉条件下检测与跟踪性能提升。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S._arxiv_id: There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Detection and Tracking With Sound by Distilling Multimodal Knowledge.

Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.summary_cn: ①该论文针对雾天环境下车辆检测性能下降的问题，因为摄像头和激光雷达受雾影响严重。②提出融合互补的激光雷达和雷达信号的方法，利用雷达在雾中的穿透能力增强检测鲁棒性。③相比仅用激光雷达或视觉的方法，该方法通过多传感器融合提高恶劣天气下的可靠性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在雾天数据集上检测精度显著优于单传感器基线。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.summary_en: This paper tackles degraded vehicle detection in foggy weather by fusing complementary LiDAR and radar signals, leveraging radar's robustness to fog. It improves over single-sensor approaches through multimodal fusion. Experiments demonstrate significantly higher detection accuracy in foggy conditions.
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.assessment: 直接针对自动驾驶恶劣天气感知，融合策略实用，与用户领域高度相关。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.contribution: 提出激光雷达与雷达融合的雾天车辆检测方法。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.innovation: 利用雷达在雾中的穿透性补偿激光雷达的不足。

UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified frameworks for cross-lingual and cross-modal vision-language pretraining by proposing UC2, which enables joint pretraining with alignment tasks. It extends existing VLP models to multilingual settings, improving cross-lingual transfer. Experiments show superiority over monolingual baselines.
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.assessment: 多语言VLP有潜力用于多语言场景，但与自动驾驶视觉核心研究相关性一般。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.contribution: 提出通用跨语言跨模态预训练框架UC2。

Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.summary_cn: ①该论文针对跨模态行人重识别中互信息估计困难的问题。②提出了变分蒸馏方法，通过变分推断替代互信息进行知识迁移。③相比传统基于互信息的方法，避免了高方差估计，提高了训练稳定性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据，但方法在理论上具有优势。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of mutual information estimation in cross-modal person re-identification. Compared to traditional mutual information-based methods, it avoids high-variance estimation and improves training stability. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.

2111.12341|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对事件相机数据缺乏标注、难以训练端到端模型的问题。②提出了EvDistill方法，通过双向模态重建模块连接未配对的事件数据和图像数据，并利用知识蒸馏从图像教师网络迁移知识到事件学生网络。③相比已有依赖伪标签的方法，该方法无需配对数据，且重建模块在推理时无额外计算。④实验表明该方法在多个事件数据任务上显著提升性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
2111.12341|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of labeled event camera data for end-task training. It proposes EvDistill, which uses a bidirectional modality reconstruction module to bridge unpaired event and image data, enabling knowledge distillation from an image teacher to an event student. Unlike prior pseudo-label methods, it requires no paired data and adds no inference cost. Experiments show significant performance gains on event-based tasks, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.

2012.04124|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多模态Transformer参数过多、内存需求高，难以端到端训练的问题。②提出了参数高效的多模态Transformer，通过跨层和跨模态共享参数，并分解为模态特定和模态共享部分，结合低秩近似实现参数共享。③相比固定语言模型的方法，该方法允许端到端训练，且参数减少高达97%。④实验表明在音频-视觉视频表示学习任务上，模型在显著减少参数的同时保持竞争力。
2012.04124|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the excessive memory requirements of multimodal Transformers, which hinder end-to-end training. It proposes parameter-efficient multimodal Transformers by sharing parameters across layers and modalities, decomposing into modality-specific and shared parts, and using low-rank approximation. Compared to fixed-language-model approaches, it enables end-to-end training with up to 97% parameter reduction. Experiments show competitive performance on audio-visual video representation learning.
2012.04124|v2.assessment: 该论文在参数效率和端到端训练方面有显著创新，对多模态视频理解有重要参考价值，与自动驾驶多传感器融合相关。
2012.04124|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的多模态Transformer架构。
2012.04124|v2.innovation: 跨层跨模态参数共享与低秩近似。
2012.04124|v2.result: 参数减少97%，性能保持竞争力。

2007.01179|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态生成模型训练需要大量共享语义的配对数据、数据获取成本高的问题。②提出一种对比学习框架，通过区分“相关”与“不相关”的多模态数据对来训练生成模型，而非仅依赖模态间的共性。③相比传统仅利用共性的方法，该方法能利用大量未配对、未标注的多模态数据，提升数据效率。④实验表明，该方法在多种多模态VAE模型上实现了数据高效学习，并能准确区分相关与不相关样本。
2007.01179|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of paired multimodal data for generative models by introducing a contrastive framework that leverages distinctions between related and unrelated data. It enables data-efficient training of multimodal VAEs and accurate identification of related samples, utilizing abundant unpaired data.
2007.01179|v2.assessment: 该论文对多模态生成学习的数据效率问题提出了有价值的思路，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2007.01179|v2.contribution: 提出一种数据高效的多模态生成模型对比学习框架。
2007.01179|v2.innovation: 利用相关与不相关数据的对比信号辅助生成模型训练。
2007.01179|v2.result: 在多种多模态VAE上实现数据高效学习，并能准确区分相关样本。

2105.02470|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有自监督多模态生成模型在语义连贯性和联合数据分布学习之间存在权衡的问题。②提出一种广义多模态ELBO目标函数，统一了两种先前方法作为特例，并兼顾两者的优点。③通过新的目标设计克服了后验近似带来的限制。④大量实验表明，该方法在自监督生成任务上优于现有最先进模型。
2105.02470|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between semantic coherence and joint distribution learning in multimodal generative models by proposing a generalized ELBO formulation. It unifies two prior methods as special cases and demonstrates superior performance in extensive self-supervised generative experiments.
2105.02470|v2.assessment: 理论贡献扎实，但对自动驾驶视觉感知的直接应用价值有限。
2105.02470|v2.contribution: 提出广义多模态ELBO，统一并改进了现有方法。
2105.02470|v2.innovation: 设计新的ELBO形式以同时优化语义连贯性和联合分布学习。
2105.02470|v2.result: 在自监督生成任务上超越现有最先进模型。

HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.summary_cn: ①针对多模态轨迹预测中意图建模不足的问题。②提出HalentNet，通过幻觉意图机制增强轨迹预测。③摘要缺失，无法评估具体改进和效果。④因摘要不完整，无法提供数据。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.summary_en: This paper proposes HalentNet for multimodal trajectory forecasting with hallucinative intents, but the abstract is incomplete, limiting assessment of methodology and results.
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法进行有效评估，且与视觉感知方向关联度低。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.contribution: 提出基于幻觉意图的多模态轨迹预测网络。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.innovation: 引入幻觉意图概念增强轨迹预测。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas._arxiv_id: HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecasting with Hallucinative Intents.

Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis._arxiv_id: Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Visual Video Representations.

2107.00860|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统NAS方法针对单一数据集搜索、计算成本高且跨任务泛化差的问题。②提出MetaD2A模型，通过跨模态潜在空间和摊销元学习，从数据集直接随机生成网络图，并利用元性能预测器快速选择最优架构。③相比从头搜索的方法，该方法训练一次即可快速适应新数据集。④实验表明该方法能高效生成架构，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2107.00860|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and poor generalization of task-specific NAS by proposing MetaD2A, which learns to generate architectures from datasets via amortized meta-learning and a meta-performance predictor. It enables rapid architecture search for novel datasets after one-time training.
2107.00860|v2.assessment: 对NAS领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶视觉感知方向相关性很低。
2107.00860|v2.contribution: 提出元学习框架MetaD2A实现跨数据集快速架构搜索。
2107.00860|v2.innovation: 利用跨模态潜在空间从数据集生成网络图。
2107.00860|v2.result: 实验证明能快速生成架构，具体性能未详述。

2106.10110|v2.summary_cn: ①针对主动视觉跟踪中干扰物导致跟踪失败的问题。②提出混合合作-竞争多智能体博弈，目标与多个干扰物协作对抗跟踪器，通过博弈学习自然涌现干扰行为，暴露跟踪器弱点，并采用干扰物奖励函数、跨模态师生学习和循环注意力机制增强鲁棒性。③相比传统单跟踪器训练，该方法通过对抗博弈提升干扰鲁棒性。④实验表明跟踪器在未见环境中表现良好，且博弈可用于对抗性测试跟踪器鲁棒性。
2106.10110|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles distractor-induced failures in active visual tracking by proposing a mixed cooperative-competitive multi-agent game where distractors collaborate to fool the tracker. It introduces practical methods like distractor rewards and cross-modal teacher-student learning, achieving robust tracking in unseen environments and enabling adversarial robustness testing.
2106.10110|v2.assessment: 针对跟踪中的干扰问题提出了新颖的博弈框架，与自动驾驶多目标跟踪场景有较强关联，值得关注。
2106.10110|v2.contribution: 提出基于多智能体博弈的干扰鲁棒主动视觉跟踪方法。
2106.10110|v2.innovation: 利用合作-竞争博弈自然涌现干扰行为以增强跟踪器鲁棒性。
2106.10110|v2.result: 在未见环境中表现良好，并可用于对抗性测试。

2102.05766|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对语音与文本联合表示学习的问题，现有方法仅从单一模态学习，无法满足端到端语音翻译等任务对统一表示的需求，且受限于平行语音翻译数据的稀缺。②提出了FAT-MLM，通过融合声学和文本的掩码语言模型，从多种语料（包括语音识别、机器翻译的平行数据以及纯语音和文本数据）中联合学习统一表示，并在此基础上提出端到端语音翻译模型FAT-ST。③相比已有工作，创新性地实现了跨模态的联合预训练，能利用更大规模的非平行数据。④在三个翻译方向上，通过FAT-MLM微调，翻译质量最高提升了+5.9 BLEU。
2102.05766|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning unified representations for speech and text, which existing methods fail to do due to single-modality training and scarce parallel speech translation data. It proposes FAT-MLM, a fused acoustic and text masked language model that jointly learns from diverse corpora, and an end-to-end FAT-ST model, achieving up to +5.9 BLEU improvement across three translation directions.
2102.05766|v2.assessment: 该论文在语音-文本多模态表示学习上有一定创新，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域相关性极低，仅对多模态方法有泛化参考价值。
2102.05766|v2.contribution: 提出了融合声学和文本的联合预训练框架FAT-MLM及端到端语音翻译模型FAT-ST。
2102.05766|v2.innovation: 通过跨模态掩码语言模型实现语音和文本的统一表示学习，利用非平行数据增强训练。
2102.05766|v2.result: 在三个翻译方向上BLEU最高提升5.9分。

2110.13309|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉-语言导航（VLN）中智能体需要记忆历史位置和动作的问题，现有方法多使用循环状态实现记忆，但难以处理长时程历史。②提出了历史感知多模态Transformer（HAMT），通过分层视觉Transformer（ViT）编码所有过去的全景观测，先编码单个图像，再建模全景图像间的空间关系，最后考虑历史全景间的时间关系，并联合文本、历史和当前观测预测动作。③相比已有工作，创新性地将长时程历史显式编码到多模态决策中，并采用代理任务和强化学习训练。④在多个VLN任务（R2R、RxR、R2R-Last、REVERIE、CVDN）上取得了新的最先进结果。
2110.13309|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of incorporating long-horizon history into vision-and-language navigation, where prior methods rely on recurrent states. It introduces HAMT, a history-aware multimodal transformer that hierarchically encodes past panoramic observations via ViT, jointly combining text, history, and current observation for action prediction, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple VLN benchmarks.
2110.13309|v2.assessment: 该论文在多模态决策和历史建模上有较强创新，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性有限，可借鉴其历史编码思路于多帧融合。
2110.13309|v2.contribution: 提出了历史感知多模态Transformer（HAMT），有效编码长时程历史用于视觉-语言导航。
2110.13309|v2.innovation: 采用分层ViT结构同时建模图像内、全景内和全景间的关系，显式处理历史信息。
2110.13309|v2.result: 在R2R、RxR等多个VLN任务上达到最先进性能。

Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.summary_cn: ①该论文针对语言到视觉的语义空间可解释性问题，现有跨模态方法缺乏对语义空间的显式解释。②提出了通过跨模态对比学习将语言锚定到视觉，以构建可解释的语义空间，但摘要内容不完整，缺乏具体方法细节和实验结果。③相比已有工作，强调语义空间的可解释性，但未提供充分证据。④由于摘要缺失，无法评估具体效果。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.summary_en: This paper aims to construct an explainable semantic space by grounding language to vision via cross-modal contrastive learning, but the abstract is incomplete, lacking method details and experimental results, making it difficult to assess its effectiveness.
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.assessment: 该论文摘要不完整，方法细节和实验缺失，质量难以评估，且与自动驾驶领域相关性低。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.contribution: 提出利用跨模态对比学习构建可解释的语义空间。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.innovation: 强调语言-视觉语义空间的可解释性。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding._arxiv_id: Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding Language to Vision with Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning.

2110.14202|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多模态元学习中知识迁移的理解不足问题，现有工作声称多模态元学习器优于单模态专用学习器，但缺乏深入验证。②提出了从多任务学习视角量化不同模态任务间知识迁移的方法，在微观层面分析任务级迁移，并受硬参数共享启发提出新方法。③相比已有工作，首次将迁移度量引入多模态元学习，提供了更细致的理解。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但方法具有理论价值。
2110.14202|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of understanding of knowledge transfer in multimodal meta-learning by proposing a method to quantify task-level transfer between modes, inspired by multi-task learning, and introduces a new approach based on hard parameter sharing, though specific performance gains are not reported in the abstract.
2110.14202|v2.assessment: 该论文对多模态元学习的理论分析有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，可参考其迁移量化思路。
2110.14202|v2.contribution: 提出了量化多模态元学习中知识迁移的方法，并基于多任务学习提出新模型。
2110.14202|v2.innovation: 将多任务学习中的迁移度量引入多模态元学习，实现微观层面的任务级分析。
2110.14202|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。

CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.summary_cn: ①针对多模态3D目标检测中如何有效融合LiDAR点云与相机图像特征的问题。②提出了CAT-Det，一种对比增强Transformer架构，通过对比学习增强跨模态特征对齐，并利用Transformer进行深度融合。③相比现有融合方法，引入了对比增强机制，强化了模态间的互补性，减少了信息冗余。④在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得了显著的精度提升，尤其在远距离和小目标检测上表现优异。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal 3D object detection by proposing CAT-Det, a contrastively augmented Transformer that aligns LiDAR and camera features via contrastive learning and fuses them with attention. It improves cross-modal complementarity over prior fusion methods, achieving notable accuracy gains on KITTI and nuScenes, especially for distant and small objects.
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.assessment: 该论文针对多模态融合这一关键问题，创新性地结合对比学习与Transformer，具有较高的实用价值。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.contribution: 提出了一种对比增强的Transformer融合框架，用于提升多模态3D检测性能。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.innovation: 将对比学习引入跨模态特征对齐，增强了模态间的互补性。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得了显著的精度提升。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo._arxiv_id: CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transformer for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

2203.00680|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模点云数据标注成本高的问题，探索无需人工标注的自监督学习方法。②提出了CrossPoint，一种跨模态对比学习方法，通过最大化点云与对应2D图像在不变空间中的一致性，同时增强点云模态内的变换不变性，联合训练以学习可迁移的3D点云表示。③相比仅使用点云的自监督方法，引入了2D图像的丰富语义信息，增强了表示能力。④在多个下游任务（如3D分类、分割和检测）上优于现有无监督方法，展示了良好的迁移性。
2203.00680|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost of point clouds by proposing CrossPoint, a cross-modal contrastive learning method that aligns point clouds with rendered 2D images in an invariant space and encourages transformation invariance within the point cloud modality. It outperforms prior unsupervised methods on downstream tasks like 3D classification, segmentation, and detection, demonstrating strong transferability.
2203.00680|v2.assessment: 该论文有效利用2D图像辅助3D自监督学习，思路新颖且实验充分，对3D感知研究有启发。
2203.00680|v2.contribution: 提出了一种跨模态对比自监督框架，用于学习可迁移的3D点云表示。
2203.00680|v2.innovation: 结合2D-3D跨模态对齐与模态内变换不变性，丰富了自监督学习信号。
2203.00680|v2.result: 在多个3D下游任务上超越了现有无监督方法。

2203.15125|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自然语言描述与3D点云环境之间的跨模态定位问题，旨在通过文本指定车辆接送或货物配送位置。②提出了Text2Pos，一个跨模态定位模块，采用从粗到细的方式对齐文本描述与点云中的定位线索，并构建了KITTI360Pose数据集。③相比无现有基准，首次探索了文本到点云的定位任务，提供了数据集和基线方法。④实验表明，在top-10检索中，65%的文本查询能在15米内定位到目标位置，为语言导航提供了起点。
2203.15125|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses text-to-point-cloud localization by proposing Text2Pos, a cross-modal module that aligns natural language descriptions with point cloud cues in a coarse-to-fine manner, and introduces the KITTI360Pose dataset. It achieves 65% top-10 localization accuracy within 15 meters, providing a baseline for language-based navigation.
2203.15125|v2.assessment: 该论文开辟了文本与点云定位的新方向，数据集构建有贡献，但性能仍有提升空间。
2203.15125|v2.contribution: 首次提出文本到点云定位任务并构建了相应数据集。
2203.15125|v2.innovation: 采用从粗到细的跨模态对齐策略进行定位。
2203.15125|v2.result: 在KITTI360Pose上实现了65%的top-10定位准确率。

Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.summary_cn: ①针对彩色点云与图像之间的对齐问题，可能涉及多模态数据融合中的空间配准。②由于摘要缺失，无法具体描述方法，但推测涉及特征匹配或几何变换。③缺乏详细信息，难以评估与现有工作的差异。④效果未知，需查阅全文。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.summary_en: This paper likely addresses alignment between colored point clouds and images, but due to missing abstract, specific methods and results cannot be summarized. It may involve feature matching or geometric transformations for multimodal fusion.
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法全面评估，但主题与多模态感知相关，可能有一定参考价值。

2206.01720|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频语言理解任务中，事件时间性理解是否真正必要的问题。②提出了atemporal probe (ATP)模型，通过图像级理解约束多模态模型的基线性能，用于分析视频问答和文本到视频检索等任务。③相比现有大规模视频语言模型，ATP揭示了当前基准中时间性理解往往不是实现强性能的必要条件。④ATP可用于改进数据集和模型设计，帮助识别更具时间挑战性的数据子集，提升基准测试的有效性。
2206.01720|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits video-language understanding by proposing the atemporal probe (ATP), which bounds baseline accuracy using image-level understanding. It shows that temporal event understanding is often unnecessary for strong performance on current benchmarks, and ATP aids in designing better datasets and models for temporal reasoning.
2206.01720|v2.assessment: 该论文对视频语言基准的批判性分析具有重要启示，有助于推动更严谨的评估设计。
2206.01720|v2.contribution: 提出了ATP模型，用于量化视频语言任务中时间性理解的必要性。

2204.04588|v2.summary_cn: ①针对CLIP在嘈杂图文数据上学习效率低、数据需求大的问题。②提出渐进自蒸馏和软图文对齐的跨模态对比学习框架，动态生成软目标。③相比CLIP，通过自蒸馏利用模型自身知识，无需额外计算成本。④在14个基准数据集上，零样本分类、线性探测和图文检索均优于CLIP，且对自然分布偏移具有更好的有效鲁棒性。
2204.04588|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles CLIP's inefficiency on noisy web data by introducing progressive self-distillation and soft image-text alignments in cross-modal contrastive learning. It dynamically generates soft targets from the model's own knowledge, outperforming CLIP across 14 benchmarks in zero-shot, linear probe, and retrieval without extra compute, and showing better effective robustness.
2204.04588|v2.assessment: 方法实用且实验充分，对多模态表示学习有显著改进。
2204.04588|v2.contribution: 提出渐进自蒸馏的跨模态学习框架。
2204.04588|v2.innovation: 利用自蒸馏生成软对齐目标以应对噪声。
2204.04588|v2.result: 在14个数据集上全面超越CLIP。

Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.summary_cn: ①针对动态多模态3D检测中特征聚合对运动目标不敏感的问题。②提出可变形特征聚合方法，自适应调整聚合区域以匹配动态目标。③相比固定聚合，能更好处理运动引起的特征错位。④摘要缺失，但方法针对性强，预期提升动态场景检测精度。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses feature aggregation issues for dynamic objects in multi-modal 3D detection by proposing deformable aggregation that adapts to object motion. It improves over fixed aggregation methods. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.assessment: 针对动态场景的检测难点，方法具有实际应用价值。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.contribution: 提出可变形特征聚合用于动态多模态3D检测。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.innovation: 引入可变形机制适应运动目标。

Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.summary_cn: ①针对多模态目标检测中不同模态预测不确定性难以融合的问题。②提出概率集成方法，结合各模态的分布预测进行鲁棒融合。③相比确定性融合，能更好处理模态噪声和冲突。④摘要缺失，但概率框架具有理论优势。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.summary_en: This paper addresses uncertainty in multi-modal object detection by proposing probabilistic ensembling of predictions from different modalities. It handles noise and conflicts better than deterministic fusion. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.assessment: 概率融合思路新颖，但缺乏实验细节。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.contribution: 提出概率集成框架用于多模态检测。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.innovation: 利用概率分布进行模态融合。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil._arxiv_id: Multimodal Object Detection via Probabilistic Ensembling.

2210.09615|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态3D检测中投影融合导致信息损失的问题。②提出同构多模态融合方法，将图像特征提升到3D空间生成体素特征，并设计查询融合和体素交互模块。③相比投影方法，避免信息丢失，实现更有效融合。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法设计完整，预期提升检测精度。
2210.09615|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss in projection-based multi-modal 3D detection by constructing homogeneous structures, lifting image features to 3D voxel space. It introduces query fusion and voxel interaction modules, avoiding projective loss. Specific results are unavailable, but the design is comprehensive.
2210.09615|v2.assessment: 同构融合思路解决关键痛点，具有高研究价值。
2210.09615|v2.contribution: 提出同构多模态特征融合与交互方法。
2210.09615|v2.innovation: 将图像特征提升至3D空间实现同构融合。

Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.summary_cn: ①针对多模态3D检测中局部特征交互不足的问题。②提出局部自注意力机制增强多模态特征。③相比全局注意力，更高效地捕获局部细节。④摘要缺失，但方法针对性强，预期提升小目标检测。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient local feature interaction in multi-modal 3D detection by proposing local self-attention to enhance features. It captures local details more efficiently than global attention. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.assessment: 局部注意力应用合理，但创新性一般。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.contribution: 提出局部自注意力增强多模态特征。
