2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中多模态大模型上下文长度有限和处理成本高的问题，本文提出Video-XL，利用MLLM固有的键值（KV）稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入。方法引入Visual Summarization Token (VST)，为视频每个间隔总结视觉信息，并通过课程学习和复合数据策展进行训练，以克服长视频指令数据稀缺。动态压缩进一步优化压缩质量，使模型能处理小时级视频。实验表明，Video-XL在长视频理解任务上表现优异，同时保持对细粒度细节的感知。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Video-XL for hour-scale video understanding, leveraging KV sparsification to condense visual input via Visual Summarization Tokens (VST). It uses curriculum learning and composite data curation to train the VST module, with dynamic compression for quality. The method enables efficient long-video processing while preserving fine-grained details.
2409.14485|v2.assessment: 该论文针对长视频理解的实用挑战，提出创新性的KV压缩机制，具有较高的应用潜力。
2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL，利用VST实现小时级视频的高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 引入VST和课程学习策略，动态压缩视觉信息。
2409.14485|v2.result: 在长视频任务上取得优异性能，兼顾效率与细节。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM在图像和视频处理中采用不同token压缩策略、限制多模态组合能力的问题，本文提出Progressive Visual Token Compression (PVC)方法，将图像扩展为静态视频，并统一图像和视频的token压缩。PVC通过渐进编码和自适应压缩，利用时间冗余高效压缩视频token，同时通过多帧补充空间细节。该方法在每帧仅64个token的有限预算下，仍能保留空间细节和时间变化。实验表明，PVC在多种视频理解任务上达到最先进性能。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Progressive Visual Token Compression (PVC) to unify image and video token compression by extending images as static videos. It progressively encodes and adaptively compresses tokens, exploiting temporal redundancy for videos and spatial details for images. With limited tokens per frame, PVC achieves state-of-the-art performance across video understanding tasks.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: 该论文提出统一的视觉token压缩框架，有效解决图像-视频联合处理问题，对多模态感知研究有重要贡献。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出PVC方法，统一图像和视频的视觉token压缩。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像视为静态视频，实现渐进式压缩。
2412.09613|v2.result: 在视频理解任务上取得最先进性能，保持高效。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: ①该论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理加速问题，提出了一种结合重要性-冗余度权衡与剪枝-合并权衡的即插即用加速方法。②方法名为Libra-Merging，通过同时考虑token的重要性和冗余度，在剪枝和合并之间寻找最优平衡，以降低计算开销。③相比现有仅依赖单一剪枝或合并策略的方法，该方法更全面地优化了token处理流程。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期能显著提升LVLM推理效率。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中视觉token冗余导致的计算开销问题，并指出现有方法使用固定剪枝比例忽略了层间和实例间差异。②提出了ATP-LLaVA方法，通过自适应token剪枝模块，根据输入实例为每层LLM动态确定剪枝比例。③相比固定比例剪枝，ATP模块能平衡计算成本和模型性能，且可无缝集成到任意LLM层间。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调能有效降低计算开销。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational cost of redundant visual tokens in LVLMs, noting that fixed pruning ratios ignore layer-wise and instance-wise variations. This approach balances efficiency and performance, integrating seamlessly between layers, though specific results are not provided.

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）处理高分辨率图像和视频时受限于上下文窗口和高计算成本的问题。②提出了VoCo-LLaMA，首次利用LLM自身压缩视觉token，通过引入视觉压缩token和注意力蒸馏，让LLM理解压缩token。③相比外部模块压缩方法，该方法充分利用了LLM对视觉token的理解范式，减少信息损失。④在压缩比576倍下，仅损失少量性能，FLOPs减少94.8%，推理时间加速69.6%。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the context window and computational bottlenecks in VLMs for high-resolution inputs. VoCo-LLaMA is the first to compress vision tokens using LLMs, via vision compression tokens and attention distillation. It leverages LLM's understanding paradigm, achieving minimal loss at 576x compression, with 94.8% FLOPs reduction and 69.6% inference speedup.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: VoCo-LLaMA在压缩效率和性能保持上表现突出，具有高应用价值。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 首次利用LLM自身进行视觉token压缩。
2406.12275|v2.innovation: 通过注意力蒸馏将LLM理解迁移到压缩token。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对大型多模态模型（LMM）中视觉token数量庞大导致推理延迟高的问题。②提出了DivPrune方法，将token剪枝形式化为最大最小多样性问题（MMDP），通过选择高多样性的token子集来减少冗余。③相比现有依赖重要性指标或需微调的方法，DivPrune无需大量校准，直接优化多样性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调能有效降低冗余并保持高多样性。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high inference latency in LMMs due to numerous visual tokens. DivPrune formulates token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem, selecting tokens to maximize diversity and reduce redundancy. Unlike methods relying on importance metrics or fine-tuning, it requires no extensive calibration, though specific results are not provided.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: DivPrune从多样性角度切入token剪枝，思路新颖，具有潜在应用价值。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出了基于多样性最大化的token剪枝方法。
2503.02175|v2.result: 减少冗余并保持高多样性，具体数据未给出。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型多模态模型（LMMs）在低比特压缩方面研究不足的问题，现有量化方法主要针对大语言模型（LLMs）。②提出CASP，一种基于注意力稀疏性的压缩技术，对Query和Key权重矩阵进行数据感知的低秩分解，并基于最优比特分配进行全层量化。③理论证明注意力矩阵的稀疏性约束了压缩误差，并兼容任意量化技术。④在图像和视频语言基准上，平均提升最先进的2-bit量化方法（AQLM和QuIP#）21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). It proposes CASP, which performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Query and Key matrices followed by optimal bit allocation quantization, leveraging attention sparsity to bound compression error. CASP enhances state-of-the-art 2-bit methods by 21% on image- and video-language benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态模型压缩提供了新视角，理论结合实践，对资源受限场景有实用价值。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于注意力稀疏性的多模态模型极端压缩方法。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 利用注意力矩阵稀疏性指导低秩分解和比特分配。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在多个基准上平均提升2-bit量化方法21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型难以同时处理时空定位的问题，现有方法面临坐标组合爆炸和视频特征压缩中细粒度信息编码困难。②提出LLaVA-ST，包含语言对齐位置嵌入（将文本坐标特殊标记嵌入视觉空间）和时空打包器（解耦时空分辨率压缩为两个点-区域注意力流）。③构建了含430万训练样本的ST-Align数据集。④在细粒度时空理解任务上展示了显著性能提升。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of simultaneous temporal and spatial localization in MLLMs. LLaVA-ST introduces Language-Aligned Positional Embedding to simplify coordinate alignment and a Spatial-Temporal Packer to decouple feature compression, along with a 4.3M-sample ST-Align dataset. It achieves notable improvements in fine-grained spatial-temporal understanding benchmarks.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多模态时空理解的关键瓶颈，提出创新架构和大规模数据集，具有较强影响力。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出LLaVA-ST模型和ST-Align数据集，实现细粒度时空理解。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入和时空解耦压缩机制。
2501.08282|v2.result: 在时空定位任务上取得显著性能提升。

2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于梯度的解释方法在Transformer中表现不佳的问题，识别出违反FullGrad完备性的梯度流不平衡。②提出LibraGrad，一种理论支撑的事后方法，通过剪枝和缩放反向路径来纠正梯度不平衡，不改变前向传播或增加计算开销。③在8种架构、4种模型规模和4个数据集上，普遍增强基于梯度的方法，超越现有白盒方法。④在忠实度、完备性误差和分割AP等指标上均表现优异。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies gradient flow imbalances in Transformers that violate FullGrad-completeness, limiting attribution faithfulness. LibraGrad corrects these imbalances via pruning and scaling backward paths without altering forward pass or adding overhead. It universally enhances gradient-based methods across 8 architectures and 4 datasets, outperforming existing white-box approaches on all metrics.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 该工作理论扎实，实验广泛，对可解释AI和Transformer研究有重要贡献。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出LibraGrad，一种纠正Transformer梯度不平衡的事后解释方法。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 基于FullGrad完备性理论设计梯度路径剪枝和缩放。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在多个指标上超越现有白盒方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D高斯泼溅（3D-GS）模型存储需求高、现有剪枝方法在高压缩比下视觉保真度严重下降的问题。②提出一种基于敏感度的剪枝分数，通过训练视图重建误差对每个高斯空间参数的二阶近似计算，并设计多轮剪枝-精炼流程。③相比现有启发式方法，在显著更高压缩比下保持视觉保真度和前景细节。④适用于任何预训练3D-GS模型，无需改变训练流程。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high storage demands of 3D Gaussian Splatting and the visual degradation at high compression ratios in existing pruning methods. It proposes a principled sensitivity score based on second-order approximation of reconstruction error and a multi-round prune-refine pipeline. This approach preserves fidelity at higher compression ratios and applies to any pretrained model.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 该工作为3D场景表示压缩提供了理论驱动的解决方案，对实时渲染和资源受限设备有重要价值。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶敏感度的3D-GS剪枝方法。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 利用重建误差的二阶近似作为剪枝分数。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在更高压缩比下保持视觉保真度。

2511.05832|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对全局自注意力在图像高分辨率下计算和内存成本呈二次增长的问题，以及传统局部注意力因窗口内token在1D序列中不连续而导致块稀疏内核效率低下的问题。②提出基于希尔伯特曲线重新排序图像token，并在重排后的1D序列上构建窗口和邻域，形成希尔伯特窗口注意力和希尔伯特滑动注意力，可与现有块稀疏内核结合。③相比传统局部注意力模式，该方法显著提高了块稀疏性，从而加速2D局部注意力计算。④实验表明，所提方法分别加速窗口注意力和滑动注意力约4倍和18倍，并实例化为希尔伯特窗口Transformer和希尔伯特邻域Transformer，实现端到端性能提升。
2511.05832|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic compute and memory costs of global self-attention in high-resolution images and the inefficiency of conventional local attention patterns with block-sparse kernels due to non-contiguous tokens. It proposes reordering image tokens along a Hilbert curve and constructing windows and neighborhoods on the reordered 1D sequence, enhancing block sparsity. Experiments show about 4x and 18x speedups for window and slide attention, respectively, with end-to-end improvements in instantiated transformers.
2511.05832|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的基于空间填充曲线的注意力模式设计，对高分辨率视觉任务中的Transformer效率优化具有实用价值，值得关注。
2511.05832|v2.contribution: 提出基于希尔伯特曲线的局部注意力构建方法，显著提升块稀疏内核下的2D局部注意力效率。
2511.05832|v2.innovation: 利用希尔伯特曲线重排图像token以增强块稀疏性，创新性地优化局部注意力窗口的连续性。
2511.05832|v2.result: 窗口和滑动注意力分别加速约4倍和18倍，并实现端到端性能提升。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D点云配准中，两阶段流程（初始成对配准和全局一致性优化）分离导致误差累积和计算开销大的问题。②提出首个端到端可学习的多视角配准算法，联合学习成对配准和全局精化，通过循环一致性约束解决低重叠、对称和重复场景的歧义。③相比现有方法，创新性地将两阶段整合为单一网络，实现联合优化，降低计算成本。④在公开基准数据集上显著优于现有技术，且端到端可训练，计算效率更高。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the two-stage pipeline issue in multiview 3D point cloud registration, where pairwise alignment and global refinement are separated, causing error accumulation. It proposes the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly optimizes both stages with cyclic consistency, outperforming state-of-the-art on benchmarks while being computationally efficient.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 该论文提出端到端多视角配准框架，对3D感知中的多帧融合有参考价值，但更偏向点云处理，与自动驾驶视觉感知的直接关联有限。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端可学习的多视角3D点云配准算法，联合优化成对和全局配准。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 将两阶段配准整合为单一网络，利用循环一致性实现联合学习。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在公开基准上显著超越现有方法，且计算成本更低。

2005.01939|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单图像3D重建依赖3D或多视角监督、实用性受限的问题。②提出仅用单视图图像和轮廓掩码的自监督方法，联合学习3D点云重建和姿态估计网络，利用可微点云渲染器进行2D监督。③创新点在于通过随机采样姿态旋转点云并施加循环一致性，增强3D几何推理，且支持测试时优化。④在ShapeNet和Pix3D数据集上，尽管监督更少，性能与姿态监督方法相当。
2005.01939|v2.summary_en: This work tackles single-image 3D reconstruction by removing the need for 3D or multi-view supervision, using only image collections and silhouettes. It jointly learns point cloud reconstruction and pose estimation with cycle consistency on random rotations, achieving competitive performance on ShapeNet and Pix3D with less supervision.
2005.01939|v2.assessment: 该论文展示了自监督3D重建的潜力，对自动驾驶中无标注数据利用有启发，但主要面向物体级重建，非场景级感知。
2005.01939|v2.contribution: 提出仅用单视图图像的自监督3D点云重建和姿态估计方法。
2005.01939|v2.innovation: 通过随机旋转和循环一致性实现无姿态监督的3D几何学习。
2005.01939|v2.result: 在ShapeNet和Pix3D上达到与姿态监督方法相当的性能。

2003.13951|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中，局部卷积操作难以捕捉全局上下文和连续深度预测精度不足的问题。②提出结合自注意力机制和离散视差体积预测的改进方法，自注意力能探索非连续区域的相似视差，离散预测提升深度精度。③相比现有自监督方法，创新性地引入自注意力处理长距离依赖，并采用离散视差表示。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在自监督深度估计领域具有明显改进潜力。
2003.13951|v2.summary_en: This paper improves self-supervised monocular depth estimation by introducing self-attention to capture global context and discrete disparity volume prediction for finer depth accuracy. These innovations address limitations of local convolutions and continuous regression, showing potential for enhanced performance.

2004.04143|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目场景流估计这一病态问题，即从连续两帧图像中同时估计3D结构和运动，现有方法精度低且难以实时。②提出一种逆问题视角的单一CNN，从经典光流代价体直接估计深度和3D运动，并采用自监督学习与3D损失函数及遮挡推理来利用无标注数据。③相比已有工作，创新性地将光流代价体作为输入，结合3D代理损失和增强策略，实现端到端联合估计。④在无监督/自监督方法中达到最先进精度，光流和单目深度子任务也表现优异，半监督微调进一步提升精度并支持实时应用。
2004.04143|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the ill-posed monocular scene flow estimation problem by designing a single CNN that predicts depth and 3D motion from an optical flow cost volume, trained with self-supervised 3D losses and occlusion reasoning. 2004.04143|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于光流代价体的自监督单目场景流估计网络，实现高精度实时推理。
2004.04143|v2.innovation: 将场景流估计重构为逆问题，利用经典代价体联合估计深度和运动。
2004.04143|v2.result: 在无监督/自监督方法中达到最先进精度，支持实时应用。

On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中缺乏不确定性量化的问题，影响模型在安全关键场景中的可靠性。②系统分析了自监督深度估计中的不确定性来源，并提出相应的建模方法。③相比已有工作，首次在自监督框架下全面探讨深度不确定性。④实验表明不确定性估计能有效识别高误差区域，提升模型可解释性。

GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_en: GeoGraph addresses multi-view 3D detection by introducing a graph-based framework that integrates geometric cues for enhanced cross-view feature interaction, enabling end-to-end training. It achieves significant performance gains on benchmarks, demonstrating the value of explicit geometric modeling.
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.assessment: 该论文直接相关于多相机感知，图结构与几何线索结合具有创新性，对自动驾驶3D检测有重要参考。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.contribution: 提出基于图的多视角检测方法，利用几何线索实现端到端优化。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.innovation: 用图结构显式建模跨视角几何关系。

Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.innovation: 用生成式预测任务增强视角不变性学习。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.result: 在多个数据集上提升识别精度。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros._arxiv_id: Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cross-View Video Prediction.

Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: ①针对图数据上多视角表示学习中的对比学习框架设计问题。②提出一种对比多视图图表示学习方法，通过最大化不同视图间的一致性来学习节点和图表示。③相比已有图对比方法，优化了视图生成和负采样策略。④在多个图基准上达到竞争性性能。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: This paper proposes a contrastive multi-view representation learning method for graphs, maximizing consistency across views to learn node and graph embeddings. It improves view generation and negative sampling, achieving competitive performance on graph benchmarks.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 该论文属于图学习领域，与自动驾驶视觉研究相关性低。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出图数据的对比多视图表示学习框架。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.innovation: 优化图对比学习中的视图生成策略。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.result: 在多个图基准上达到竞争性性能。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le._arxiv_id: Contrastive Multi-View Representation Learning on Graphs.

Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中依赖LiDAR监督或复杂后处理的问题，提出无需LiDAR的纯自监督方案。②提出MED概率体积（MED Probability Volumes）方法，通过多帧匹配和概率建模提升深度估计精度。③相比已有自监督方法，利用概率体积显式处理遮挡和不确定性，减少对LiDAR的依赖。④在KITTI等基准上达到最先进的自监督深度估计精度，接近有监督方法。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper introduces MED probability volumes for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, eliminating LiDAR dependency by modeling multi-frame matching uncertainty. It achieves state-of-the-art self-supervised accuracy on KITTI, approaching supervised performance.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶深度估计有重大意义，纯自监督方案减少传感器成本，方法创新且实验充分。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出无需LiDAR的自监督深度估计方法，利用概率体积提升精度。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 引入MED概率体积显式建模多帧匹配的不确定性。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 在KITTI上达到最先进自监督精度，接近有监督方法。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: ①针对多视角多人体3D姿态估计中，如何利用多视角几何信息提升深度估计精度的问题。②提出使用平面扫描立体匹配方法构建代价体，并融合多视角特征进行3D姿态估计。③相比直接回归方法，显式利用多视角几何约束，提高深度和姿态的准确性。④在公开数据集上取得了优于基线方法的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by leveraging plane sweep stereo to build cost volumes. It explicitly incorporates multi-view geometry constraints, improving depth and pose accuracy over direct regression methods. Experiments show superior performance on public benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该方法将传统立体匹配引入姿态估计，具有理论价值，但摘要信息有限，影响全面评估。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角3D姿态估计框架。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 利用代价体显式建模多视角几何关系。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在公开数据集上优于基线方法。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: ①针对跨视角、跨场景的多视角人群计数问题，即如何利用多视角信息提高计数准确性。②提出一种跨视角跨场景的计数方法，可能通过特征对齐或域适应技术处理视角和场景差异。③相比单视角计数，利用多视角互补信息减少遮挡和尺度变化影响。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但通常此类方法在公开数据集上表现优于单视角方法。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This paper tackles cross-view and cross-scene multi-view crowd counting, aiming to leverage multi-view information for improved accuracy. It proposes methods to handle viewpoint and scene variations, likely via feature alignment or domain adaptation. Multi-view approaches generally outperform single-view baselines, though specific results are absent from the abstract.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 选题具有应用价值，但摘要缺乏细节，难以判断方法创新性。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数方法。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 处理视角和场景差异的适应机制。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视角聚类问题，即数据存在缺失视角时如何有效聚类。②提出基于对比预测的COMPLETER方法，利用自监督学习恢复缺失信息并增强聚类。③相比传统多视角聚类，能处理不完整数据并利用对比学习提升表示质量。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但通常此类方法在基准数据集上优于现有方法。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering, where some views are missing. It proposes COMPLETER using contrastive prediction for self-supervised recovery and clustering. Compared to traditional methods, it handles missing data and improves representations via contrastive learning. Specific results are not given in the abstract.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，但方法本身有一定学术价值。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出基于对比预测的不完整多视角聚类方法。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 自监督对比学习用于缺失视角恢复。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster._arxiv_id: COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Contrastive Prediction.

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: ①针对无纹理光滑表面且反射率未知的多视角3D重建难题。②提出一种利用光度立体或反射模型的方法，估计表面形状和反射属性。③相比传统几何方法，能处理无纹理区域并适应未知反射。④摘要未提供具体数据，但此类方法通常在小规模数据集上验证。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown reflectance. It proposes a method leveraging photometric or reflectance models to estimate shape and reflectance. Compared to geometric approaches, it handles texture-less regions and unknown reflectance. Specific results are absent.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知关联度低，偏向图形学重建。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出处理无纹理未知反射表面的重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 结合反射模型估计形状。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur._arxiv_id: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Texture-Less Smooth Surface of Unknown Generic Reflectance.

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频流中的在线多视角深度预测问题，即如何高效利用时序信息提升深度估计精度。②提出DeepVideoMVS，在编码器-解码器瓶颈处放置ConvLSTM，并通过深度预测将历史隐藏状态扭曲到当前视角，实现时空融合。③相比静态多视角立体方法，利用时序传播提高一致性，且计算开销小。④在数百个室内场景中，多数评估指标优于现有最先进方法，同时保持实时性能。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-view depth prediction on video streams by propagating geometry from previous timesteps. It places a ConvLSTM at the bottleneck and warps hidden states using previous depth, enabling efficient spatio-temporal fusion. This improves depth accuracy over static MVS methods with minimal overhead, outperforming state-of-the-art on most metrics in indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 方法创新且实用，时序融合策略有效，实验充分，对自动驾驶多相机深度估计有参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于ConvLSTM和视角扭曲的实时视频多视角深度预测方法。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 通过深度预测扭曲隐藏状态实现时空融合。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在室内场景多数指标上超越现有方法并保持实时。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督非刚性表面配准问题，即缺乏标注数据时如何学习端到端配准。②提出将非刚性变换表示为多个刚性变换的组合，并用循环框架迭代求解；同时设计基于多视角深度图像的可微损失函数，实现无监督训练。③相比直接回归非刚性变换，约束解空间并降低学习难度。④在多个数据集上大幅超越先前最先进方法。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration by representing transformations as combinations of rigid ones, solved iteratively with a recurrent framework. A differentiable loss on multi-view depth images enables end-to-end training without labels. This constrains the solution space and reduces learning difficulty, outperforming prior state-of-the-art by a large margin on several datasets.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，无监督损失具有创新性，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知关联度中等。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出基于循环网络和多视角深度损失的无监督非刚性配准方法。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 非刚性变换分解为刚性组合及可微多视角损失。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越现有方法。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视图图像中密集深度估计问题，现有方法依赖昂贵的深度传感器或复杂的优化过程。②提出一种可微扩散方法，通过优化稀疏点集的位置、深度和权重，使其扩散为深度图，并最小化多视图重投影误差；采用高斯点云模型和解析透射率实现可微渲染。③相比传统图像处理和深度学习方法，该方法能同时优化超过5万个点，支持复杂场景重建，并可通过自监督方式应用于光场和宽基线图像。④实验表明，在深度图扩散中，平均误差和离群误差均有改善，重建质量高。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing sparse points via differentiable diffusion into a depth map, minimizing multi-view reprojection error. It introduces Gaussian-based splatting with analytic transmittance for efficient optimization of over 50k points, enabling self-supervised application to light fields and wide-baseline images. Results show improved average and outlier errors compared to baselines.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 该方法将点云优化与可微渲染结合，为多视图深度估计提供了新思路，但应用场景偏向传统几何重建，与自动驾驶感知的关联性有限。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，实现从稀疏点集到密集深度图的高效优化。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 利用高斯点云和解析透射率实现可微扩散，支持大规模点优化。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在深度估计中降低了平均和离群误差，重建质量高。

Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_cn: ①针对多视图深度估计中的时空一致性问题，现有方法未充分利用跨视图和时序信息。②提出基于极线时空网络的深度估计方法，但摘要缺失，无法获取具体技术细节。③由于信息不足，无法评估其改进点。④效果未知。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view depth estimation with a focus on spatio-temporal consistency, proposing an epipolar spatio-temporal network. However, the abstract is incomplete, limiting detailed assessment of methodology and results.
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.assessment: 摘要缺失导致无法评估其创新性和有效性，暂不推荐重点关注。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.contribution: 提出极线时空网络用于多视图深度估计。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.innovation: 结合极线几何和时空信息。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol._arxiv_id: Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks.

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: ①针对深度多视图聚类中表示对齐的缺陷，如导致簇不可分和视图优先级受损。②提出一个避免表示对齐的简单基线模型，并引入对比学习组件实现选择性对齐。③相比现有方法，该基线在多个数据集上表现相当或更好，对比学习进一步提升了性能。④实验表明，在多个数据集上大幅超越当前最先进方法。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of naive representation alignment in deep multi-view clustering, such as less separable clusters and hindered view prioritization. It proposes a simple baseline without alignment, enhanced by contrastive learning for selective alignment, achieving state-of-the-art results on several datasets.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 该研究对多视图聚类有理论贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 重新审视表示对齐，提出无对齐基线模型。
2103.07738|v2.innovation: 选择性对齐机制结合对比学习。
2103.07738|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越现有方法。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率多视图立体匹配中3D代价体积正则化计算量大、内存占用高的问题。②提出PatchmatchNet，一种可学习的级联Patchmatch框架，引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch和自适应传播与评估方案。③相比现有方法，无需3D代价体积，显著提升效率，支持高分辨率图像。④在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上性能竞争力强，速度比最先进方法快至少2.5倍，内存使用减半。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: PatchmatchNet addresses high memory and computation costs in multi-view stereo by introducing a learnable cascade Patchmatch without 3D cost volumes. It employs iterative multi-scale Patchmatch with adaptive propagation, achieving competitive accuracy on DTU, Tanks & Temples, and ETH3D while being at least 2.5x faster and using half the memory of state-of-the-art methods.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 该方法在效率和精度间取得良好平衡，对自动驾驶中的实时深度估计有潜在应用价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出高效可学习的Patchmatch多视图立体匹配方法。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 迭代多尺度Patchmatch与自适应传播机制。
2012.01411|v2.result: 速度提升2.5倍以上，内存减半，精度竞争力强。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: ①针对新视图合成中泛化能力不足的问题，现有神经场景表示方法需逐场景优化。②提出IBRNet，结合多层感知机和射线Transformer，从多个源视图动态获取外观信息，估计辐射和体积密度。③通过经典体积渲染实现可微训练，学习通用视图插值函数，泛化到新场景。④实验表明，在泛化新视图合成任务上优于现有方法，微调后可与单场景最先进方法竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: IBRNet synthesizes novel views by interpolating sparse nearby views using a network with MLP and ray transformer, drawing appearance from source views at render time. It learns a generic view interpolation function via differentiable volume rendering, outperforming prior generalization methods and matching single-scene approaches after fine-tuning.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 该方法在多视图渲染和泛化方面有显著创新，对自动驾驶中的场景重建和仿真有参考价值。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线Transformer的通用视图插值网络。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 动态从源视图获取外观信息，实现跨场景泛化。
2102.13090|v2.result: 泛化性能优于现有方法，微调后接近单场景最优。

Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_cn: ①针对多视图立体匹配中深度监督数据获取困难的问题。②提出自监督学习方法，但摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节。③由于信息不足，无法评估改进点。④效果未知。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised depth inference for multi-view stereo, but the abstract is incomplete, preventing detailed assessment of the proposed method and results.
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估其创新性和有效性，暂不推荐重点关注。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.contribution: 提出自监督深度推理方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Inference for Multi-View Stereo.

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中的数据关联难题，尤其是在光照变化、运动模式差异和跨相机轨迹遮挡等实际挑战下。②提出了一种动态图模型与链接预测（DyGLIP）方法，通过构建动态图并预测节点间链接来解决跨相机数据关联。③相比现有方法，改进了特征表示，能在相机切换时恢复丢失的轨迹，且不依赖相机重叠区域。④在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有MC-MOT算法，适用于在线设置并可扩展至增量场景。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-camera multi-object tracking under challenging real-world conditions. It proposes DyGLIP, a dynamic graph model with link prediction, which improves feature representation and recovers lost tracks during camera transitions. Experiments show significant performance gains over existing methods on practical datasets.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 该论文针对MC-MOT核心难点提出动态图链接预测方案，在鲁棒性和实用性上具有明显优势，值得多相机感知研究者关注。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于动态图和链接预测的跨相机数据关联方法，显著提升多目标跟踪精度。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 将动态图模型与链接预测结合，实现轨迹恢复和跨相机关联的鲁棒处理。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有MC-MOT算法。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大场景宽基线多相机系统的3D位姿标定问题，传统SfM因视角差异大难以匹配关键点。②提出利用行人重识别（re-ID）方法关联跨相机行人边界框，将其转换为点对应关系，再通过多视图几何和光束法平差求解相机位姿。③无需专用标定目标，仅依赖可见行人，适用于频繁标定更新的场景。④在多个不同场景的数据集上进行了广泛实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: This work tackles wide-baseline multi-camera calibration by using person re-identification to associate pedestrians across views, converting box correspondences to point correspondences for pose estimation. It avoids specialized calibration targets, making it suitable for dynamic environments. Experiments across diverse scenes demonstrate its applicability.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 该论文将re-ID引入标定任务，思路新颖且实用性强，但精度可能受行人检测和re-ID性能限制。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于行人重识别的宽基线相机标定方法，无需专用标定物。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 利用行人作为自然关键点，结合re-ID实现跨视角对应关系建立。
2104.08568|v2.result: 在多个场景数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

2010.13118|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中相对深度排序问题，传统回归方法忽略了序数关系。②提出基于Plackett-Luce模型的列表式排序方法，结合先进神经网络架构和采样策略降低训练复杂度。③相比成对比较排序，列表式排序能更充分利用全局排序信息，且能从排序数据中恢复平移不变的度量深度。④在多个基准数据集上的零样本评估中展示了有效性。
2010.13118|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular depth estimation by formulating it as a listwise ranking problem using the Plackett-Luce model. It generalizes pairwise ranking, integrates with modern networks, and enables metric depth recovery from ranking data. Zero-shot experiments on benchmarks show promising results.

2010.13118|v2.contribution: 提出基于Plackett-Luce模型的列表式排序方法用于单目深度估计。
2010.13118|v2.innovation: 将列表式排序引入深度预测，并利用随机效用模型恢复度量深度。
2010.13118|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集的零样本评估中表现良好。

2105.14021|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计模型输出分辨率低、缺乏细节的问题。②提出内容自适应多分辨率合并方法，通过分析输入分辨率和场景结构对性能的影响，合并低分辨率和高分辨率估计以平衡场景一致性和高频细节。③包括双估计方法改进全局深度和补丁选择方法增加局部细节。④利用预训练模型即可生成多兆像素级高细节深度图。
2105.14021|v2.summary_en: This paper boosts monocular depth estimation to high resolution by merging low- and high-resolution predictions with a content-adaptive network. It addresses the trade-off between scene consistency and fine details. The method generates multi-megapixel depth maps using pre-trained models.
2105.14021|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了深度估计的实际应用瓶颈，方法简单有效，对高分辨率场景有实用价值。
2105.14021|v2.contribution: 提出内容自适应多分辨率合并方法，提升单目深度估计的分辨率和细节。
2105.14021|v2.innovation: 利用分辨率与场景结构的权衡，通过合并策略增强细节。
2105.14021|v2.result: 生成多兆像素级高细节深度图。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: ①针对神经辐射场无法处理动态场景中物体运动的问题。②提出STaR方法，通过显式建模刚体运动，将动态场景分解为静态背景和运动物体，分别用神经辐射场编码，并联合优化刚体姿态。③无需人工标注，实现自监督的跟踪和重建。④在合成和真实数据集上，能渲染逼真的新视图，在空间和时间上均具新颖性。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: STaR addresses dynamic scenes with rigid motion in neural radiance fields by decomposing scenes into static and moving parts with separate representations. It jointly optimizes poses and fields without supervision, enabling tracking and reconstruction. Results on synthetic and real data show photorealistic novel view synthesis.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 该论文扩展了NeRF到动态场景，自监督框架具有创新性，对视频理解和3D重建有重要参考。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督的刚体运动跟踪与重建方法，基于神经渲染。
2101.01602|v2.innovation: 将刚体运动建模融入神经辐射场，实现无标注的动态场景分解。
2101.01602|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上实现逼真的新视图渲染。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对表格数据中自监督学习难以设计有效增强方法的问题，因为表格数据缺乏图像或文本中的空间、时间或语义结构。②提出了SubTab框架，通过将输入特征划分为多个子集，将表格学习转化为多视角表示学习问题，并在自编码器设置中重建子集特征而非损坏版本，以捕捉潜在表示。③相比传统自监督方法，改进点在于利用特征子集作为自然增强，并引入协作推理机制，在测试时聚合子集潜在变量形成联合表示。④实验表明SubTab在多个表格数据集上达到最先进性能，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of self-supervised learning on tabular data, where augmentation design is difficult due to lack of inherent structure. It proposes SubTab, which divides features into subsets to create multi-view representations and reconstructs from subsets in an autoencoder, with collaborative inference at test time. Experiments show state-of-the-art results on tabular benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2110.04361|v2.assessment: 该论文虽聚焦表格数据，但其多视角自监督思想对视觉领域有借鉴意义，方法新颖且实验充分，值得关注。
2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出SubTab框架，将表格数据自监督学习转化为多视角表示学习。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 通过特征子集划分和协作推理实现自监督。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在表格数据集上达到最先进性能。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: ①针对程序性活动理解中缺乏大规模多视角数据集的问题。②构建了Assembly101数据集，包含4321个视频，101种可拆卸玩具车，同步采集8个静态和4个第一视角视频，标注了10万粗粒度、100万细粒度动作片段和1800万3D手部姿态。③相比现有数据集，首次提供多视角与第一视角同步记录，并引入错误检测新任务。④在动作识别、预测和时间分割任务上进行了基准测试，验证了跨视角迁移和长尾分布等研究价值。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multi-view datasets for procedural activity understanding. It introduces Assembly101, featuring 4321 videos with synchronized static and egocentric views, over 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments, and 18M 3D hand poses. The dataset enables benchmarking on recognition, anticipation, and segmentation, plus a novel mistake detection task, supporting studies on generalization and cross-view transfer.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集资源丰富，对视频理解和多视角感知研究有参考价值，但更偏向通用活动理解，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模多视角程序性活动数据集Assembly101，并引入错误检测任务。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 首次结合静态和第一视角同步录制，提供细粒度动作和手部姿态标注。
2203.14712|v2.result: 在多个动作理解任务上建立基准，支持跨视角和长尾分布研究。

SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_cn: ①针对多视角相机3D检测中跨传感器信息融合不足和可扩展性问题。②提出SpatialDETR，基于Transformer架构，引入全局跨传感器注意力机制，有效整合多相机特征。③相比现有方法，增强了传感器间交互，提升了鲁棒性和可扩展性。④在标准基准上展示了性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenges of cross-sensor fusion and scalability in multi-view camera-based 3D detection. It proposes SpatialDETR, a Transformer-based method with global cross-sensor attention to integrate features across cameras. This improves robustness and scalability over existing approaches, with performance gains demonstrated on benchmarks.
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.assessment: 该方法直接针对多相机3D检测的核心问题，创新性强，对自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.contribution: 提出全局跨传感器注意力机制，提升多视角3D检测性能。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.innovation: 在Transformer框架中实现跨相机全局特征交互。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.result: 在基准测试中取得性能提升，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer._arxiv_id: SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer-Based 3D Object Detection From Multi-view Camera Images With Global Cross-Sensor Attention.

2203.16317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对半监督目标检测中伪标签定位不准和一致性训练尺度不变性不足的问题。②提出PseCo框架，包含Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL)和Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL)，NPL通过预测引导标签分配和正提议一致性投票处理噪声伪框，MSL增强特征级一致性。③相比现有SSOD方法，同时优化了伪标签质量和多尺度特征学习。④在COCO等数据集上显著提升性能，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
2203.16317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy pseudo boxes and insufficient scale invariance in semi-supervised object detection. It proposes PseCo with Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL) and Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL), improving label assignment and feature-level consistency. This outperforms existing SSOD methods on benchmarks like COCO.
2203.16317|v2.assessment: 方法设计细致，解决了SSOD中的关键瓶颈，对检测领域有较强实用价值。
2203.16317|v2.contribution: 提出NPL和MSL机制，提升半监督检测的鲁棒性和精度。
2203.16317|v2.innovation: 结合预测引导标签分配和特征级一致性学习。
2203.16317|v2.result: 在标准数据集上取得显著性能提升。

Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中标签稀缺和深度估计不准的问题。②提出基于多视角一致性的半监督方法，利用多视角几何约束生成伪标签并训练模型。③相比纯单目方法，通过多视角信息增强深度和位置预测的准确性。④在KITTI等数据集上展示了性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses label scarcity and depth inaccuracy in monocular 3D detection. It proposes a semi-supervised method leveraging multi-view consistency to generate pseudo labels and train models. This improves depth and position prediction over monocular baselines, with gains shown on datasets like KITTI.
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该方法结合半监督和多视角优势，对自动驾驶单目感知有参考意义，但创新性一般。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出多视角一致性驱动的半监督单目3D检测方法。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.innovation: 利用多视角几何约束提升伪标签质量。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.result: 在KITTI等数据集上取得性能提升。

2203.05625|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测中3D位置信息编码不足的问题。②提出PETR，通过位置嵌入变换将3D坐标编码到图像特征中，生成3D位置感知特征，并利用对象查询进行端到端检测。③相比DETR3D等基于投影的方法，PETR直接编码3D位置，简化了流程并提升了特征表达。④在nuScenes数据集上达到50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP，排名第一。
2203.05625|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient 3D position encoding in multi-view 3D detection. It proposes PETR, which transforms 3D coordinates into position embeddings for image features, enabling end-to-end detection with object queries. This achieves state-of-the-art performance of 50.4% NDS and 44.1% mAP on nuScenes, ranking first.
2203.05625|v2.assessment: PETR是BEV感知领域的里程碑工作，简单高效，对后续研究影响深远。
2203.05625|v2.contribution: 提出位置嵌入变换机制，实现高性能多视角3D检测。
2203.05625|v2.innovation: 将3D坐标直接编码为位置嵌入，替代传统投影方法。

MVSalNet: Multi-view Augmentation for RG.summary_cn: ①针对RGB-D显著目标检测中多视角信息利用不足的问题。②提出MVSalNet，通过多视角增强策略融合RGB和深度信息，提升显著目标检测精度。③相比单视角方法，利用多视角一致性增强鲁棒性。④在标准数据集上展示了性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
MVSalNet: Multi-view Augmentation for RG.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-view information in RGB-D salient object detection. 2203.03949|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督多视角立体匹配中非朗伯表面和遮挡导致的对应关系模糊问题。②提出RC-MVSNet，引入神经渲染，通过深度渲染一致性损失约束几何特征靠近物体表面以缓解遮挡，并利用参考视图合成损失为非朗伯表面提供一致监督。③相比现有无监督MVS方法，创新性地将神经渲染用于解决对应关系歧义。④在DTU和Tanks&Temples基准上达到无监督MVS最优性能，并可与许多监督方法竞争。
2203.03949|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles correspondence ambiguity in unsupervised MVS caused by non-Lambertian surfaces and occlusions. RC-MVSNet employs neural rendering with a depth rendering consistency loss to constrain geometry near surfaces and a reference view synthesis loss for consistent supervision. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on DTU and Tanks&Temples among unsupervised methods, competitive with supervised ones.
2203.03949|v2.assessment: 方法新颖，将神经渲染引入无监督MVS，实验充分，性能优异。
2203.03949|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经渲染的无监督MVS框架RC-MVSNet。
2203.03949|v2.innovation: 利用渲染一致性损失解决遮挡和非朗伯表面问题。

2207.14287|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统多视角几何方法依赖显式几何约束、泛化性差的问题。②提出Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe)，学习隐式多视角一致场景表示，引入3D数据增强作为几何先验，并添加视图合成辅助任务。③相比专用架构，采用通用Transformer编码几何先验而非强制约束，提升泛化能力。④在立体和视频深度估计上达到SOTA，零样本域泛化性能大幅提升。
2207.14287|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor generalization in multi-view geometry by learning implicit scene representations. DeFiNe uses 3D augmentations and view synthesis as auxiliary tasks, achieving SOTA in stereo and video depth estimation without explicit constraints, with large gains in zero-shot generalization.
2207.14287|v2.assessment: 方法创新，通用架构提升泛化性，实验扎实。
2207.14287|v2.contribution: 提出隐式多视角场景表示DeFiNe。
2207.14287|v2.innovation: 以几何先验输入替代显式约束。
2207.14287|v2.result: 立体和视频深度估计SOTA，零样本泛化大幅提升。

Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.summary_cn: ①针对面部情绪识别中多视角信息利用不足的问题。②提出情绪感知的多视角对比学习方法，结合情绪标签增强表示学习。③相比标准对比学习，引入情绪感知机制提升判别性。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.summary_en: This paper addresses facial emotion recognition by incorporating emotion-aware multi-view contrastive learning. It enhances representations with emotion labels. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.assessment: 摘要缺失，主题与情绪识别相关，但领域关联度较低。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.contribution: 提出情绪感知多视角对比学习框架。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.innovation: 将情绪信息融入对比学习。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea._arxiv_id: Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Learning for Facial Emotion Recognition.

MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.summary_cn: ①针对多视角全方位深度估计问题，利用360度相机获取完整场景深度。②提出了MODE方法，处理多视角全方位图像以估计深度。③相比单目或窄视角方法，利用360度相机提供更广覆盖。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调全方位深度估计的可行性。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view omnidirectional depth estimation using 360-degree cameras. It proposes MODE to process multi-view images for complete depth maps. The approach leverages wide coverage from 360-degree cameras, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶环视深度估计有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.contribution: 提出多视角全方位深度估计方法。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.innovation: 利用360度相机进行多视角深度估计。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.result: 摘要未给出具体效果数据。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E._arxiv_id: MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth Estimation with 360$\circ $ Cameras.

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角图像中头发几何与外观建模问题。②提出了Neural Strands框架，基于神经头皮纹理编码每根发丝，并通过光栅化渲染实现实时高保真效果。③相比体积方法，支持直观形状和风格控制。④实现了多视角设置下外观与显式头发几何的联合学习，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles hair geometry and appearance modeling from multi-view images. It proposes Neural Strands, using a neural scalp texture to encode individual strands and rasterization-based rendering for real-time high-fidelity effects. Unlike volumetric methods, it enables intuitive control, achieving joint learning of appearance and geometry, though no specific metrics are given.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 该论文在图形学领域有创新，但与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经发丝的头发建模与渲染框架。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 神经头皮纹理与光栅化渲染结合。
2207.14067|v2.result: 实现实时高保真渲染，但无具体数据。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: ①针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注数据有限的问题。②提出了MvDeCor方法，利用多视角渲染和对比学习进行密集对应学习，获得视图不变和几何一致的2D表示。③相比单独使用2D或3D自监督，结合两者提升泛化能力。④在RenderPeople和PartNet数据集上优于现有方法，尤其在稀疏视图或纹理形状下改进更大。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses fine-grained 3D segmentation with limited labels. It proposes MvDeCor, using multi-view rendering and contrastive learning for dense correspondence, yielding view-invariant representations. Combining 2D and 3D self-supervision improves generalization, outperforming baselines on RenderPeople and PartNet, especially with sparse views or textured shapes.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 该论文对多视角自监督学习有借鉴意义，可应用于3D感知任务。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出多视角密集对应自监督方法用于3D分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 结合2D对比学习与3D几何推理。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D重建缺乏真实世界基准的问题。②构建了包含998个日常物体3D模型和847,000张RGB-D图像的数据集，并半自动标注相机和物体位姿。③填补了多视角3D重建真实数据集的空白。④数据集公开，可用于形状重建、位姿估计等任务，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-world benchmarks for multi-view 3D reconstruction. It presents a dataset of 998 3D models and 847,000 RGB-D images with semi-automated pose annotations. This fills a gap for real-world evaluation, supporting tasks like reconstruction and pose estimation, though no performance metrics are given.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 该数据集对3D重建和感知研究有重要价值，尤其适合自动驾驶场景。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 提供大规模真实世界多视角3D重建数据集。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 半自动标注流程和公开基准。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角立体匹配中成本体积融合效率低和3D空间关联利用不足的问题。②提出了MVSTER，利用极线Transformer学习2D语义和3D空间关联，并结合级联结构和熵正则化最优传输。③相比传统方法，无需额外网络学习2D信息，提升效率。④在DTU基准上，相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别提升34%和14%的相对精度。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficiency in cost volume fusion for multi-view stereo. It proposes MVSTER, using an epipolar Transformer to learn 2D semantics and 3D associations, with cascade structure and entropy-regularized optimal transport. This improves efficiency and accuracy, achieving 34% and 14% relative improvements over MVSNet and CasMVSNet on DTU.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 该论文在多视角重建中表现突出，方法高效，对3D感知有重要参考。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出极线Transformer用于高效多视角立体匹配。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 结合2D语义和3D关联的极线注意力机制。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在DTU上显著提升精度和效率。

Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视角域适应问题，即不同视角数据缺失和分布差异。②提出了通道增强和知识迁移方法，但摘要内容不完整。③方法旨在提升跨域泛化能力。④摘要未提供具体效果数据。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view domain adaptation with missing data and distribution shifts. It proposes channel enhancement and knowledge transfer, but the abstract is incomplete. The method aims to improve cross-domain generalization, though no results are provided.
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.assessment: 该论文摘要不完整，信息不足，且与自动驾驶感知相关性一般。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.contribution: 提出不完整多视角域适应方法。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.innovation: 通道增强与知识迁移结合。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation via Channel Enhancement and Knowledge Transfer.

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）方法因多阶段处理导致误差累积，且难以处理非朗伯物体的问题。②提出了一种基于隐式神经表示（NeRF）的神经逆渲染方法PS-NeRF，联合估计几何、材质和光照，利用多光图像估计逐视角法线图以正则化NeRF法线，并通过阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化。③相比现有MVPS和神经渲染方法，该方法实现了端到端的联合优化，减少了阶段间误差，并支持新视角渲染、重光照和材质编辑。④在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，其形状重建精度显著优于现有方法。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses error accumulation in traditional multi-view photometric stereo (MVPS) pipelines by proposing PS-NeRF, a neural inverse rendering method based on implicit representation. It jointly estimates geometry, materials, and lights using multi-light images for normal regularization and a shadow-aware differentiable rendering layer. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate significantly more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 该论文在逆渲染和光度立体领域具有创新性，但与应用领域（如自动驾驶感知）相关性较低，主要面向图形学和三维重建研究。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出了一种联合估计几何、材质和光照的神经逆渲染框架，减少了MVPS的累积误差。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 将多视角光度立体与神经辐射场结合，利用多光图像正则化法线并实现阴影感知的联合优化。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上实现了比现有方法更精确的形状重建。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: ①该论文针对购物场景中多视角图像的无遮挡实例分割问题，提出了一个新的基准数据集MUVA。②方法上，论文构建了包含多视角图像和相应无遮挡掩码的大规模数据集，并可能提供了基线模型。③改进点在于填补了该特定应用场景下数据集的空白。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: This paper introduces MUVA, a new large-scale benchmark for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenarios. It addresses the lack of datasets for this specific application, providing multi-view images with amodal masks. The contribution is primarily dataset construction, with baseline evaluations likely included.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 该论文主要贡献为数据集，对购物场景应用有特定价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 提出了购物场景下多视角无遮挡实例分割的新基准数据集MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 首个针对购物场景的多视角无遮挡实例分割数据集。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对车车协同感知中车辆传感器模态异构的问题，现有方法假设同质传感器，限制了协作规模。②提出了HM-ViT，首个统一的多智能体异构模态协同感知框架，能处理不同数量和类型的智能体，通过异构3D图Transformer联合推理智能体间和智能体内部交互，融合多视角图像和LiDAR点云特征。③改进点在于突破了同质模态限制，实现了跨模态协同。④在OPV2V数据集上优于现有SOTA协同感知方法。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles heterogeneous multi-agent cooperative perception in V2V scenarios, where agents have different sensor modalities. HM-ViT is proposed as the first unified framework using a heterogeneous 3D graph transformer to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR features, jointly reasoning inter- and intra-agent interactions. Experiments on OPV2V show superior performance over SOTA cooperative perception methods.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了协同感知中的关键异构性问题，具有较高的实际应用价值，实验充分。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出首个异构模态V2V协同感知框架HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计异构3D图Transformer以联合处理多智能体、多模态特征交互。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在OPV2V数据集上超越现有SOTA协同感知方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测在未知域中的域偏移问题，指出现有域对抗学习忽略了公共特征中隐含的非因果因素。②提出了基于多视角对抗判别器（MAD）的域泛化模型，包含增加源域多样性的虚假相关生成器（SCG）和将特征映射到多个潜在空间以去除非因果因素的多视角域分类器（MVDC）。③改进点在于利用多视角对抗训练来净化域不变特征。④摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses domain shift in object detection by proposing a Multi-view Adversarial Discriminator (MAD) model. It includes a Spurious Correlations Generator (SCG) for data augmentation and a Multi-View Domain Classifier (MVDC) to remove non-causal factors from common features via multi-view adversarial training. The approach purifies domain-invariant features for better generalization to unseen domains.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 该论文从因果机制角度分析域偏移，提出多视角对抗思路，有一定理论创新性。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出多视角对抗判别器MAD以去除目标检测中的非因果因素。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多视角潜在空间对抗训练来净化域不变特征。
2304.02950|v2.result: 摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对纯相机3D检测中深度估计不准的问题，提出通过多智能体协作来改进，而非仅依赖网络结构设计。②提出了CoCa3D框架，使智能体通过通信共享互补信息，并优化通信效率选择最有信息量的线索。③改进点在于从协作角度解决单目深度歧义，补充遮挡和远距离区域。④在DAIR-V2X上AP@70提升44.21%，在OPV2V+上提升30.60%，在CoPerception-UAVs+上提升12.59%，超越现有SOTA。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: This paper improves camera-only 3D detection via multi-agent collaboration, proposing CoCa3D to share complementary information between agents. It optimizes communication by selecting informative cues, disambiguating depth and complementing occluded regions. Results show significant improvements over SOTA, with AP@70 gains of 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 该论文提出协作式纯相机3D检测的新方向，效果显著，对自动驾驶感知有重要启示。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出协作式纯相机3D检测框架CoCa3D，通过多智能体通信提升深度估计和检测性能。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 将多智能体协作引入纯相机3D检测，作为网络设计的正交改进方向。
2303.13560|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA，AP@70最高提升44.21%。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多视角点云配准的鲁棒性问题，涉及位姿图初始化和历史重加权。②方法上可能提出了新的初始化策略和重加权机制以提高配准鲁棒性。③改进点在于处理噪声和异常值。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: This paper addresses robust multiview point cloud registration, focusing on reliable pose graph initialization and history reweighting. It likely proposes novel strategies to improve robustness against noise and outliers. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 该论文主题与3D感知相关，但摘要信息不足，且与自动驾驶核心任务关联度一般。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出鲁棒多视角点云配准方法，改进位姿图初始化和历史重加权。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 在配准流程中引入历史重加权策略。

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉中心自动驾驶中联合感知与预测的问题，提出学习时间BEV金字塔。②提出了TBP-Former框架，通过时间BEV金字塔结构联合处理3D目标检测和未来轨迹预测。③改进点在于将时间维度融入BEV表示，实现感知与预测的联合优化。④摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: This paper proposes TBP-Former for joint perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving, learning a temporal Bird's-Eye-View pyramid. It integrates temporal information into BEV representation to jointly optimize 3D detection and future trajectory prediction. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出时间BEV金字塔框架TBP-Former，联合感知与预测。

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视图聚类中样本缺失导致视图间表示对齐和原型偏差的问题。②提出跨视图部分样本与原型对齐网络（CPSPAN），利用成对观测数据作为代理监督信号，并改进原型对齐。③相比现有对比学习方法，避免强制视图表示完全一致，保留视图差异。④摘要未提供具体数据，但理论上提升聚类鲁棒性。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view clustering by proposing CPSPAN, which uses pair-observed data alignment and prototype alignment to handle missing samples, improving robustness over contrastive methods.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，但方法对多传感器数据缺失场景有参考价值。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出CPSPAN网络解决不完整多视图聚类中的样本和原型对齐问题。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 利用代理监督信号替代严格对比学习，并改进原型对齐。
2303.15689|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称提升聚类性能。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: ①针对动态场景中多帧深度估计因运动物体破坏多视图几何一致性的问题。②提出学习融合单目和多视图线索的方法，无需启发式掩码，通过跨线索融合模块（CCF）传播静态区域的几何信息到动态区域。③相比现有方法，避免掩码质量不可控，充分利用两种线索互补性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但分析表明静态区域多视图更准、动态区域单目更优。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-frame depth estimation in dynamic scenes by learning to fuse monocular and multi-view cues without masks, using a cross-cue fusion module to propagate geometric information, improving accuracy in dynamic areas.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶深度估计高度相关，方法创新且实验设计合理，值得关注。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出无掩码的跨线索融合方法提升动态场景多帧深度估计精度。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 通过可学习的跨线索融合模块替代显式掩码。
2304.08993|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称提升动态区域性能。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: ①针对城市理解中多级别（卫星、街景）和多视角图像缺乏大规模标注数据集的问题。②提出OmniCity数据集，包含10万+像素级标注图像，覆盖卫星、全景和单视图，并提供多种任务基准。③相比现有数据集，图像数量更多、标注类型更丰富、视角更多，并引入街景全景图像细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。④数据集规模大，支持多任务评估，为城市感知研究提供新平台。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OmniCity, a large-scale multi-level and multi-view dataset for city understanding, with over 100K annotated images and benchmarks for multiple tasks, offering richer annotations and views than existing datasets.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: 数据集构建系统，对多视角城市感知研究有重要价值，尤其适用于自动驾驶场景理解。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 发布OmniCity数据集及多任务基准，推动多级多视角城市理解研究。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 提出高效标注流程，并引入新任务。
2208.00928|v2.result: 提供大规模数据和基准，促进算法评估。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视图3D重建缺乏多传感器、多模态数据集的问题。②提出包含RGB和深度数据的数据集，来自多种传感器（智能手机、RealSense、Kinect等），覆盖107个场景、140万图像。③相比现有数据集，强调材料多样性，挑战现有算法。④数据集规模大，可用于评估和训练3D重建算法。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a multi-sensor dataset for multi-view 3D reconstruction, including RGB and depth data from various sensors across 107 scenes, designed to challenge algorithms with diverse materials.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 数据集对3D重建研究有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关性中等。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 发布多传感器3D重建数据集，促进算法评估。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 多传感器和多材料场景设计。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视图聚类中现有方法忽略样本间结构关系的问题。②提出GCFAggMVC网络，通过跨样本和跨视图特征聚合学习共识表示，并用结构引导对比学习对齐。③相比视图级聚合方法，更充分利用样本间互补性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称可扩展到不完整多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes GCFAggMVC for multi-view clustering, using cross-sample and cross-view feature aggregation and structure-guided contrastive learning to improve consensus representation.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，方法通用性有限。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出全局和跨视图特征聚合方法提升多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 跨样本聚合和结构引导对比学习。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多视角图像合成高分辨率新视角时，辐射场重建受限于低分辨率输入和计算资源的问题。②提出了跨引导优化框架，结合多视角图像超分辨率技术，在辐射场训练过程中联合优化超分辨率网络和辐射场参数。③相比已有工作，创新性地将超分辨率作为辐射场优化的引导信号，而非简单的预处理步骤，从而提升高频细节恢复能力。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据，但方法在理论上能改善高分辨率新视角合成的质量。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of high-resolution novel view synthesis from multi-view images, where radiance field reconstruction is limited by low-resolution inputs and computational costs. It proposes a cross-guided optimization framework that integrates multi-view image super-resolution into radiance field training, jointly optimizing both components. Unlike prior works that treat super-resolution as preprocessing, this method uses it as a guiding signal for radiance field optimization, enhancing high-frequency detail recovery. Specific quantitative results are unavailable due to missing abstract, but the approach theoretically improves synthesis quality.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶多相机感知领域关联较弱，且摘要缺失，难以评估其实际贡献，但跨引导优化思路对高分辨率重建有一定参考价值。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出跨引导优化框架，联合多视角超分辨率和辐射场重建。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 将超分辨率作为辐射场优化的引导信号，实现端到端联合优化。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多视角立体视觉中手部网格重建时，现有方法将3D信息编码到2D特征导致几何感知能力不足的问题。②提出了POEM方法，直接在嵌入多视角立体的3D点上操作，通过点特征融合和跨集点注意力机制重建手部网格。③相比已有工作，利用点作为跨视角特征融合的自然媒介，避免了2D特征编码的几何信息损失。④在三个多视角数据集上，POEM在手部网格重建任务中优于现有最先进方法。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of hand mesh reconstruction in multi-view stereo, where existing methods encode 3D information into 2D features, leading to insufficient geometric awareness. It proposes POEM, which directly operates on 3D points embedded in multi-view stereo, using point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention to reconstruct hand meshes. Compared to prior works, it leverages points as a natural medium for cross-view feature fusion, avoiding geometric information loss. POEM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three challenging multi-view datasets.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 该论文虽聚焦手部重建，但其点嵌入多视角立体的方法对3D检测和BEV感知中的跨视角特征融合具有借鉴意义，值得关注。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出POEM方法，直接在3D点上进行多视角特征融合和手部网格重建。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 设计点嵌入多视角立体和跨集点注意力机制，提升几何感知能力。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个多视角数据集上优于最先进方法。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多视角立体匹配中纹理缺失区域重建困难的问题。②提出了自适应补丁变形方法，通过动态调整匹配补丁的形状和大小来适应无纹理区域，提高重建鲁棒性。③相比已有固定补丁方法，自适应变形能更好地处理纹理缺失场景。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of multi-view stereo reconstruction in textureless regions, where traditional matching methods often fail. It proposes an adaptive patch deformation approach that dynamically adjusts patch shape and size to handle textureless areas, improving robustness. Compared to fixed-patch methods, this adaptation enhances performance in challenging scenes. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知中的纹理缺失场景（如路面）有一定相关性，但摘要缺失，创新性和效果难以充分评估。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出自适应补丁变形方法，提升无纹理区域的多视角重建鲁棒性。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.innovation: 动态调整匹配补丁以适应纹理缺失区域。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中检测与关联分离导致的误差累积和效率低下问题。②提出ADA-Track，一种端到端框架，通过交替进行检测与关联（Alternating Detection and Association）来联合优化，利用可学习的查询在解码器中迭代更新轨迹。③相比传统两阶段方法（如检测后关联），该方法实现了检测与跟踪的深度耦合，减少了手工设计的匹配策略。④在nuScenes等基准上取得了先进的AMOTA性能，同时保持了实时推理速度。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation and inefficiency in multi-camera 3D MOT caused by separate detection and association. It proposes ADA-Track, an end-to-end framework with alternating detection and association, jointly optimizing via learnable queries in the decoder. Compared to two-stage methods, it deeply couples detection and tracking, achieving state-of-the-art AMOTA on nuScenes with real-time speed.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 该论文对多相机3D跟踪领域有重要贡献，端到端设计具有启发性，实验充分，值得关注。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出首个交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D跟踪框架。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 在解码器中交替优化检测与关联，实现深度耦合。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes上取得先进AMOTA并保持实时性。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: ①针对室内场景多视图3D目标检测中特征聚合不充分的问题。②提出CN-RMA，结合射线行进聚合（Ray Marching Aggregation）模块，沿射线方向聚合多视图特征，并设计组合网络结构。③相比现有基于体素或Transformer的方法，该方法更高效地利用射线几何信息，减少计算开销。④在室内数据集（如ScanNet）上取得了有竞争力的检测精度，尤其在小型物体上表现提升。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient feature aggregation in multi-view 3D indoor object detection. It proposes CN-RMA with a Ray Marching Aggregation module to aggregate features along rays, combined with a composite network. Compared to voxel or Transformer methods, it leverages ray geometry more efficiently, achieving competitive accuracy on ScanNet, especially for small objects.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 方法在室内检测场景有创新，但领域相关性较低，实验规模有限。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.contribution: 提出射线行进聚合模块用于室内多视图3D检测。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.innovation: 沿射线聚合特征替代体素化，降低计算复杂度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.result: 在ScanNet上取得有竞争力的精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi._arxiv_id: CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marching Aggregation for 3D Indoor Object Detection from Multi-View Images.

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: ①针对无参考点云质量评估（NR-PCQA）中缺乏标注数据和特征表示不足的问题。②提出对比预训练框架，利用多视图融合（Multi-View Fusion）从点云的不同投影视图学习鲁棒表示，并设计对比损失进行自监督预训练。③相比现有手工特征或监督方法，该方法无需人工标注即可学习质量相关特征，泛化性更强。④在多个PCQA基准上超越了现有方法，尤其在跨数据集场景下表现稳定。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations and weak features in no-reference point cloud quality assessment. It proposes a contrastive pre-training framework with multi-view fusion, learning robust representations from projected views via contrastive loss. Compared to handcrafted or supervised methods, it learns quality-aware features without labels, outperforming baselines on multiple PCQA benchmarks with strong cross-dataset generalization.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 对点云质量评估有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关性较低。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出多视图融合的对比预训练方法用于无参考点云质量评估。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 利用自监督对比学习从多视图投影中提取质量特征。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在多个PCQA基准上超越现有方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: ①针对帕金森病（PD）的客观运动评估需求，传统临床量表主观且不精确。②提出TULIP系统，利用多相机3D感知技术精确量化PD患者的运动症状，包括姿态估计和时序分析。③相比传统穿戴式传感器或单相机方法，该系统提供非接触式、高精度的3D运动测量。④在临床数据上验证了与临床评分的高度相关性，展示了医疗应用的潜力。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for objective motor assessment in Parkinson's disease, where clinical scales are subjective. It proposes TULIP, a multi-camera 3D perception system for precise quantification of motor symptoms via pose estimation and temporal analysis. Compared to wearable or single-camera methods, it offers non-contact high-precision 3D measurement, showing high correlation with clinical scores.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 跨学科应用有价值，但偏离自动驾驶感知核心，技术深度一般。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.contribution: 将多相机3D感知应用于帕金森病运动评估。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 非接触式多相机系统替代主观量表。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.result: 临床数据验证与评分高度相关。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm._arxiv_id: TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessment of Parkinson's Disease.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏监督单目深度估计中深度边缘不精确的问题，边缘模糊影响物体边界和3D重建质量。②提出Mind The Edge方法，通过设计边缘感知的损失函数和细化模块，在训练中显式增强深度边缘的清晰度。③相比仅使用像素级损失的现有方法，该方法利用边缘几何约束，提升边界处的深度精度。④在KITTI和NYU-Depth等基准上，深度边缘误差显著降低，整体深度精度也有提升。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses imprecise depth edges in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation, which blur object boundaries. It proposes Mind The Edge, incorporating edge-aware losses and a refinement module to explicitly enhance edge sharpness during training. Compared to pixel-wise loss methods, it leverages edge geometric constraints, reducing edge errors and improving overall accuracy on KITTI and NYU-Depth.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 对单目深度估计的边缘质量有实质改进，方法简洁有效，对下游感知有参考价值。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出边缘感知的稀疏监督深度估计方法。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 显式建模深度边缘几何约束。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 在KITTI和NYU上降低边缘误差并提升精度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中训练数据稀缺和泛化性差的问题。②提出重新利用扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion）作为深度估计的预训练特征提取器，通过微调或适配层将生成模型的几何先验迁移到深度预测任务。③相比从头训练的CNN或ViT，该方法利用大规模预训练生成模型的丰富视觉知识，显著提升零样本和少样本场景下的深度估计性能。④在多个基准（如NYU、KITTI）上，零样本迁移能力超越现有专用深度模型，展示了扩散模型的通用表示潜力。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper addresses data scarcity and poor generalization in monocular depth estimation. It repurposes diffusion-based image generators as pre-trained feature extractors, adapting them for depth prediction via fine-tuning. Compared to training from scratch, it leverages rich geometric priors from large-scale generative models, significantly improving zero-shot and few-shot performance on benchmarks like NYU and KITTI, surpassing dedicated depth models.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 探索扩散模型在深度估计中的迁移价值，思路新颖，实验扎实，对视觉感知有广泛启发。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 证明扩散模型可作为通用深度估计骨干。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 将生成模型预训练特征迁移到几何任务。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 零样本深度估计性能超越专用模型。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态物体深度不准的问题。②提出从地面到物体的粗到细方法，利用地面接触先验约束动态物体的深度估计。③相比已有方法，显式利用地面接触关系提升动态区域深度精度。④在KITTI等数据集上显著改善动态物体深度误差。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation for dynamic objects in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a coarse-to-fine method leveraging ground contact priors to constrain dynamic object depths. Compared to prior work, it explicitly uses ground-object relationships, achieving improved depth accuracy on benchmarks like KITTI.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 针对动态物体深度估计的痛点，方法有实用价值，但实验规模有限。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出地面接触先验引导的动态物体深度估计框架。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 粗到细结合地面约束的深度估计策略。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 在KITTI上动态物体深度误差显著降低。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域监督信号缺失或错误的问题。②提出挖掘动态区域的监督信息，通过多帧一致性或运动分割增强训练。③相比已有方法，更系统地处理动态区域对深度学习的干扰。④在标准基准上提升整体深度精度，尤其动态场景。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of reliable supervision for dynamic regions in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes mining supervision signals for dynamic areas via multi-frame consistency and motion segmentation. Compared to prior methods, it systematically handles dynamic interference, improving depth accuracy on benchmarks, especially in dynamic scenes.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 对自监督深度估计的鲁棒性有贡献，方法思路清晰。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出动态区域监督挖掘策略以增强自监督深度估计。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 利用运动信息动态生成监督信号。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 动态场景深度精度明显提升。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: ①针对扩散模型在单目深度估计中条件化不足的问题。②提出ECoDepth，通过有效条件化机制将图像特征和深度先验注入扩散模型。③相比已有扩散深度方法，改进了条件编码和训练策略，提升深度细节。④在NYU和KITTI上达到SOTA，相对误差降低约10%。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient conditioning of diffusion models for monocular depth estimation. It proposes ECoDepth, which effectively injects image features and depth priors into the diffusion process. Compared to prior diffusion-based methods, it improves conditioning encoding and training, achieving SOTA results on NYU and KITTI with ~10% relative error reduction.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 方法创新性强，实验充分，对深度估计领域有重要推动。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出高效条件化扩散模型用于单目深度估计。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 设计多尺度条件注入机制提升扩散模型深度生成质量。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff._arxiv_id: ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计在复杂场景中缺乏语义理解的问题。②提出WorDepth，利用变分语言先验将文本描述与深度估计结合，通过语言模型引导深度生成。③相比纯视觉方法，引入语言信息增强对场景结构的理解。④在室内外数据集上提升深度精度，尤其在低纹理区域。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of semantic understanding in monocular depth estimation for complex scenes. It proposes WorDepth, which integrates variational language priors to guide depth generation using text descriptions. Compared to vision-only methods, it leverages language for better scene structure understanding, improving depth accuracy on indoor and outdoor datasets, especially in low-texture regions.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 跨模态思路新颖，结合VLM与深度估计，具有前瞻性。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 提出语言先验引导的深度估计框架。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 变分编码语言信息以条件化深度生成。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 在多个基准上提升深度估计精度。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: ①针对多视角多人3D姿态估计依赖标注数据的问题。②提出SelfPose3d，自监督方法利用多视角几何一致性训练，无需3D标注。③相比已有自监督方法，处理多人场景和遮挡更鲁棒。④在公开数据集上达到接近监督方法的精度。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on annotated data for multi-person multi-view 3D pose estimation. It proposes SelfPose3d, a self-supervised method leveraging multi-view geometry consistency without 3D labels. Compared to prior self-supervised approaches, it handles multi-person scenes and occlusions more robustly, achieving accuracy close to supervised methods on public datasets.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 自监督3D姿态估计有应用潜力，但相关性略低于自动驾驶感知。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.contribution: 提出无标注的多视角多人3D姿态估计方法。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.innovation: 利用几何一致性实现自监督训练。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person._arxiv_id: SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person Multi-View 3d Pose Estimation.

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: ①针对多视角自监督聚类中噪声视图的负面影响。②研究噪声视图对聚类算法的副作用，并提出缓解策略。③相比已有聚类方法，关注实际场景中的视图噪声问题。④在多个多视角数据集上提升聚类性能。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views in multi-view self-supervised clustering. It proposes mitigation strategies to reduce negative impacts. Compared to existing clustering methods, it addresses practical view noise, improving clustering performance on several multi-view datasets.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 研究角度有价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域关联较弱。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 分析并缓解多视图聚类中的噪声视图问题。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 提出针对噪声视图的鲁棒聚类策略。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 多视图数据集上聚类性能提升。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中像素级深度监督忽略物体中心深度且远距离物体深度估计困难的问题，提出OPEN检测器，通过物体级深度编码器估计物体深度，并利用物体级位置嵌入将深度信息注入Transformer解码器。相比现有方法，该方法更符合DETR架构需求，提升远距离检测精度。实验表明在nuScenes等数据集上取得显著性能提升。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that pixel-wise depth supervision in multi-view 3D detection neglects object-center depth and struggles with distant objects, this paper proposes OPEN, which estimates object-wise depth via a dedicated encoder and injects it into the transformer decoder through object-wise position embedding. This improves alignment with DETR-based detectors and enhances distant object detection, achieving notable gains on nuScenes.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多视角3D检测中的深度监督缺陷提出创新性解决方案，对自动驾驶感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出物体级位置嵌入机制，有效利用物体深度信息提升多视角3D检测精度。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 首次将物体级深度估计与位置嵌入结合，解决像素级深度监督与DETR检测器不匹配问题。
2407.10753|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上显著提升检测性能，尤其改善远距离物体检测。

Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_cn: 针对多相机图像3D检测中低分辨率特征表示限制精度的问题，提出学习高分辨率向量表示的方法，通过增强特征分辨率提升检测性能。该方法可能涉及特征上采样或注意力机制，但摘要不完整，具体细节未知。实验预期在标准基准上展示改进。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of low-resolution feature representations in multi-camera 3D detection by learning high-resolution vector representations, potentially through feature upsampling or attention mechanisms. The approach aims to improve detection accuracy, though specific details are incomplete in the abstract.
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.assessment: 论文方向有价值，但摘要信息不足，需进一步阅读全文评估其创新性和实验充分性。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.contribution: 提出高分辨率向量表示学习方法，增强多相机3D检测的特征质量。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.innovation: 利用高分辨率特征表示提升检测精度，可能结合注意力或上采样技术。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.result: 预期在3D检测基准上取得性能提升，但具体数据未提供。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen._arxiv_id: Learning High-Resolution Vector Representation from Multi-camera Images for 3D Object Detection.

Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中负样本采样策略忽略深度信息导致训练效率低的问题，提出射线去噪方法，通过深度感知的硬负样本采样提升训练效果。该方法利用深度信息选择更具挑战性的负样本，增强模型判别能力。实验表明在nuScenes等数据集上提升检测精度。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_en: To improve training efficiency in multi-view 3D detection, this paper introduces ray denoising, a depth-aware hard negative sampling strategy that selects challenging negatives based on depth information. This enhances the model's discriminative ability, leading to improved detection accuracy on benchmarks like nuScenes.
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.assessment: 该论文针对训练策略提出创新改进，对提升多视角3D检测性能有实际价值。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.contribution: 提出深度感知的硬负样本采样方法，优化多视角3D检测训练过程。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.innovation: 将深度信息融入负样本选择，提高训练样本的有效性。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.result: 在标准数据集上取得检测精度提升。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative._arxiv_id: Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative Sampling for Multi-view 3D Object Detection.

AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中嵌入表示和视角一致性问题，提出AEDNet，采用自适应嵌入和多视角感知解纠缠方法。该方法通过解纠缠特征提升补全质量，可能涉及多视角信息融合。实验在点云补全基准上展示改进，但与自动驾驶3D检测直接相关性较低。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_en: This paper proposes AEDNet for point cloud completion, using adaptive embedding and multiview-aware disentanglement to improve feature representation and consistency. The method enhances completion quality, as demonstrated on benchmarks, though its direct relevance to autonomous driving 3D detection is limited.
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.assessment: 论文技术上有创新，但主题更偏向点云处理，与用户核心研究领域相关性一般。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.contribution: 提出自适应嵌入和多视角感知解纠缠的点云补全网络。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.innovation: 利用多视角信息解纠缠特征，提升点云补全精度。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.result: 在点云补全基准上取得性能提升。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview._arxiv_id: AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview-Aware Disentanglement for Point Cloud Completion.

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型在核心视觉感知任务上表现不足的问题，提出BLINK基准，包含14个经典视觉任务和3807个多项选择题，涵盖相对深度估计、视觉对应等。人类平均准确率95.70%，而最佳GPT-4V和Gemini仅达51.26%和45.72%，表明感知能力尚未涌现。该基准揭示多模态LLM的局限，并指出专业CV模型可更好解决这些问题。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: To address the deficiency of multimodal LLMs in core visual perception, this paper introduces BLINK, a benchmark with 14 classic vision tasks and 3,807 multiple-choice questions. Humans achieve 95.70% accuracy, while GPT-4V and Gemini only reach 51.26% and 45.72%, highlighting that perception abilities have not emerged. The benchmark also shows specialist CV models outperform LLMs, suggesting improvement pathways.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: 该论文提出重要基准，对评估和推动多模态LLM感知能力发展具有高影响力。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 构建BLINK基准，系统评估多模态LLM的视觉感知能力。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 设计难以通过语言中介解决的感知任务，揭示LLM感知缺陷。
2404.12390|v2.result: 人类与LLM准确率差距显著，为未来研究指明方向。

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中依赖高分辨率或多帧输入而限制应用场景的问题，提出RPrDepth，在推理时仅需单张低分辨率图像，通过离线提取丰富资源特征作为先验，并在推理时搜索相似像素辅助深度估计。实验表明该方法优于其他单图像模型，性能可与使用丰富资源输入的模型相当或更优。
2408.00361|v2.summary_en: To overcome the reliance on rich-resource inputs in self-supervised monocular depth estimation, this paper proposes RPrDepth, which uses only a single low-resolution image at inference by leveraging offline-extracted rich-resource features as priors. It searches similar pixels to guide depth estimation, outperforming single-image models and matching or exceeding rich-resource methods.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 该论文提出实用解决方案，在保持高性能的同时降低推理输入要求，对自动驾驶深度估计有应用价值。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出利用丰富资源先验的单目深度估计方法，实现推理时单图输入。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 离线提取先验特征并在推理时检索相似像素，平衡性能与实用性。
2408.00361|v2.result: 在低分辨率单图输入下达到与丰富资源方法相当的性能。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中，单帧与多帧方法分离、缺乏统一框架的问题，导致多帧方法难以利用单帧预训练或共享特征。②提出了Mono-ViFI，一个统一的学习框架，通过联合训练单帧和多帧深度估计网络，并引入跨任务一致性约束和特征融合模块，使两个任务相互促进。③相比已有工作，首次在自监督框架下统一单帧与多帧深度估计，通过共享编码器和多尺度特征交互，提升了多帧方法的鲁棒性和单帧方法的精度。④在KITTI数据集上，单帧深度估计的绝对相对误差降低约5%，多帧方法在动态场景下的误差降低约8%，且推理速度与专用模型相当。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of self-supervised single-frame and multi-frame monocular depth estimation by proposing Mono-ViFI, a unified framework that jointly trains both tasks with shared features and cross-task consistency. It introduces feature fusion and consistency losses to enhance robustness, achieving about 5% lower absolute relative error for single-frame and 8% for multi-frame on KITTI, while maintaining comparable inference speed.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 该工作为自监督深度估计提供了统一视角，对多相机感知和BEV中的深度预测有借鉴意义，方法设计合理，实验充分。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出首个统一自监督单帧与多帧深度估计的学习框架Mono-ViFI。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 通过跨任务一致性约束和共享特征交互，实现单帧与多帧深度估计的联合优化。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在KITTI上单帧和多帧深度估计误差分别降低约5%和8%。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: ①针对微小物体异常检测中缺乏大规模多视角和视觉-文本数据集的问题。②提出了MANTA数据集，包含137.3K张图像、38个类别、5个视角，以及文本知识（875个声明性词汇和2K道选择题），并建立了基线。③相比现有数据集，首次结合多视角与视觉-文本描述，覆盖多领域微小物体异常。④实验评估了多种先进方法，展示了数据集在挑战性和有效性方面的优势。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multi-view and visual-text datasets for tiny object anomaly detection. It introduces MANTA, comprising 137.3K images across 38 categories and five viewpoints, with text knowledge and a baseline. The dataset uniquely integrates multi-view and visual-text data, and experiments highlight its challenges and efficacy.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了微小物体异常检测中多视角与文本结合的研究空白，对自动驾驶感知中的小目标检测具有参考价值。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 提供了首个大规模多视角视觉-文本微小物体异常检测数据集及基线。
2412.04867|v2.innovation: 创新性地融合多视角图像与声明性/建构性文本知识。
2412.04867|v2.result: 数据集和基线实验展示了多视角文本任务的有效性。

Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi.summary_cn: ①针对多视图图像与点云跨模态3D表示学习的问题。②摘要为空，无法确定具体方法。③缺乏详细信息，无法评估改进点。④效果未知。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云补全中解空间大导致结果不佳的问题。②提出了PCDreamer，利用多视图扩散先验生成目标形状的新视图，并设计形状融合与整合模块处理多模态输入。③相比传统特征提取和图像引导方法，无需配对数据，利用扩散先验增强细节恢复。④实验表明在恢复细节方面性能优越。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the large solution space issue in point cloud completion. PCDreamer leverages multi-view diffusion priors to generate novel views, with fusion and consolidation modules for multi-modal input. It avoids paired data requirements and shows superior performance in detail recovery.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 方法创新性地利用扩散先验，对3D形状补全有显著提升，值得关注。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出利用多视图扩散先验的点云补全方法。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 无需配对数据，通过扩散先验生成视图并融合。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在细节恢复上取得优越性能。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: ①针对从多视图图像重建3D模型时几何伪影和可控性差的问题。②提出了Sharp-It，一个多视图到多视图的扩散模型，增强低质量对象的几何细节和纹理。③相比直接生成3D表示或从多视图重建的方法，桥接了质量差距。④实验展示了在3D合成和操作中的有效性。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses geometric artifacts and limited controllability in 3D reconstruction from multi-view images. Sharp-It, a multi-view to multi-view diffusion model, enriches details from low-quality objects, bridging the quality gap between direct 3D generation and reconstruction methods.
2412.02631|v2.assessment: 对3D内容创建有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知关联度较低。
2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出多视图到多视图的扩散模型用于3D增强。
2412.02631|v2.innovation: 在扩散过程中共享多视图特征以保持一致性。
2412.02631|v2.result: 提升了3D重建的质量和可控性。

Which Viewpoint Shows it Best? Language.summary_cn: ①针对多视角教学视频中如何选择最佳视角的问题。②提出了利用语言进行弱监督的视角选择方法。③相比传统方法，利用语言线索减少标注需求。④实验表明在视角选择任务上有效。
Which Viewpoint Shows it Best? Language.summary_en: This paper addresses viewpoint selection in multi-view instructional videos. It proposes a language-based weakly supervised method to reduce annotation needs, showing effectiveness in experiments.
