2212.07401|v2.summary_cn: 针对动物和人类3D姿态标注昂贵的问题，提出BKinD-3D方法，从多视角视频中自监督发现3D关键点，无需2D或3D关键点及边界框监督。方法采用编码器-解码器架构，使用3D体素热图，训练目标包括重建多视角时空差异和关节长度约束。在人类和大鼠视频上验证了无需人工标注发现关键点的能力，展示了3D关键点发现用于行为研究的潜力。
2212.07401|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of 3D pose annotation by proposing BKinD-3D, a self-supervised method for discovering 3D keypoints from multi-view videos without any keypoint or bounding box supervision. It uses a 3D volumetric heatmap encoder-decoder trained with spatiotemporal reconstruction and joint length constraints, demonstrating effectiveness on human and rat videos.
2212.07401|v2.assessment: 该工作对行为科学中的3D姿态估计有潜在价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度较低。
2212.07401|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需监督的多视角视频3D关键点自监督发现方法。
2212.07401|v2.innovation: 结合3D体素热图与关节长度约束实现跨视角时空一致性学习。
2212.07401|v2.result: 在人类和大鼠视频上成功发现3D关键点。

2303.09877|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度多视图聚类中自监督方法发展不一致的问题，提出统一框架DeepMVC，涵盖多种现有方法。通过理论分析证明对比对齐可能损害聚类可分性，且视图越多影响越严重。实验验证了对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能，而所有方法都受益于某种形式的自监督，新实例在多个数据集上优于先前方法。
2303.09877|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inconsistencies in self-supervision for deep multi-view clustering by proposing DeepMVC, a unified framework encompassing many recent methods. It theoretically proves that contrastive alignment can harm cluster separability, worsening with more views, and empirically shows new instances outperform prior methods.
2303.09877|v2.assessment: 该工作对多视图聚类领域有理论贡献，但与自动驾驶感知方向相关性较弱。
2303.09877|v2.contribution: 提出统一框架并理论分析对比学习在多视图聚类中的负面影响。
2303.09877|v2.innovation: 从理论角度揭示对比对齐的缺陷并设计新自监督形式。
2303.09877|v2.result: 新实例在多个数据集上取得最优性能。

Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中CNN感受野有限和Transformer计算量大的问题，提出Lite-Mono轻量级CNN与Transformer混合架构。方法通过高效的特征提取和注意力机制平衡精度与效率，在KITTI和Cityscapes等基准上验证。相比现有方法，在保持低参数量的同时提升了深度估计精度，适合资源受限的自动驾驶场景。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between CNN's limited receptive field and Transformer's high computation in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing Lite-Mono, a lightweight hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture. It achieves improved depth accuracy on benchmarks like KITTI and Cityscapes with low parameter count, suitable for resource-constrained autonomous driving.
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.assessment: 该工作为自监督深度估计提供了高效轻量方案，对自动驾驶感知部署有实用价值。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.contribution: 提出轻量级CNN-Transformer混合架构用于自监督单目深度估计。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.innovation: 设计高效特征提取与注意力模块，在精度和效率间取得平衡。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.result: 在多个基准上以低参数量超越现有方法。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo._arxiv_id: Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transformer Architecture for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_cn: 针对3D异常检测与定位缺乏大规模标注数据的问题，提出了一个通过3D异常合成生成训练数据的基准，并设计了一个自监督学习网络用于异常检测与定位。该方法利用合成异常增强模型的泛化能力，无需真实异常标注。相比现有方法，该工作提供了可扩展的基准和自监督框架，实验表明在多个数据集上取得了显著的检测精度提升。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotated data in 3D anomaly detection and localization by proposing a benchmark with 3D anomaly synthesis and a self-supervised learning network. It enhances generalization via synthetic anomalies without real labels, outperforming existing methods on multiple datasets.
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.assessment: 为3D异常检测提供了新基准和自监督方案，对工业视觉和自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.contribution: 提出了3D异常合成基准和自监督学习网络。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.innovation: 利用合成异常实现自监督3D异常检测。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.result: 在多个数据集上检测精度显著提升。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an._arxiv_id: Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection and Localization: A Benchmark via 3D Anomaly Synthesis and A Self-Supervised Learning Network.

SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_cn: 针对自监督关键点估计中对应关系不准确的问题，提出了选择性对应增强的掩码自编码器（SCE-MAE），通过选择性增强关键点区域的对应特征来提升表征质量。该方法在预训练阶段引入对应关系选择机制，强化关键点相关特征的学习。相比标准MAE，SCE-MAE在多个关键点估计基准上取得了更优的准确率。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate correspondences in self-supervised landmark estimation by proposing SCE-MAE, which selectively enhances correspondence features during masked autoencoder pretraining. It improves landmark estimation accuracy over standard MAE on several benchmarks.
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.assessment: 针对关键点估计的特定改进，方法简洁有效，对相关任务有借鉴意义。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.contribution: 提出选择性对应增强的MAE变体。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.innovation: 在MAE中引入对应关系选择机制。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.result: 关键点估计准确率提升。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc._arxiv_id: SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhancement with Masked Autoencoder for Self-Supervised Landmark Estimation.

T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_cn: 针对点云表征学习中时间信息利用不足的问题，提出了时间掩码自编码器（T-MAE），通过掩码和重建时间序列中的点云帧来学习时空特征。该方法结合了空间掩码与时间建模，增强了点云序列的表征能力。相比仅空间建模的MAE，T-MAE在多个下游任务（如3D检测和分割）上取得了更优的性能。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal information in point cloud representation learning by proposing T-MAE, which masks and reconstructs point cloud frames over time to learn spatiotemporal features. It outperforms spatial-only MAE on downstream tasks like 3D detection and segmentation.
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.assessment: 对自动驾驶点云序列学习有重要价值，时间建模是提升表征的关键。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.contribution: 提出时间掩码自编码器用于点云序列表征学习。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.result: 在3D检测和分割任务上性能提升。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for._arxiv_id: T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for Point Cloud Representation Learning.

ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_cn: 针对图像和视频联合表征学习中模态差异的问题，提出了对比掩码自编码器（ViC-MAE），结合对比学习与掩码重建来统一图像和视频的表征。该方法通过对比损失对齐跨模态特征，同时利用MAE重建保留细节。相比单模态MAE或对比学习，ViC-MAE在视频和图像下游任务上均取得了更优的结果。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses modality gaps in joint image-video representation learning by proposing ViC-MAE, which combines contrastive learning with masked reconstruction to unify features. It achieves superior performance on both video and image downstream tasks compared to unimodal MAE or contrastive methods.
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.assessment: 多模态自监督学习的优秀工作，对视频理解和多传感器感知有启发。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.contribution: 提出图像-视频联合的对比掩码自编码器。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.innovation: 融合对比学习与MAE处理多模态数据。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.result: 在视频和图像任务上性能提升。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation._arxiv_id: ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation Learning from Images and Video with Contrastive Masked Autoencoders.

NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_cn: 针对神经辐射场（NeRF）的3D表征学习缺乏自监督方法的问题，提出了NeRF-MAE，将掩码自编码器应用于NeRF的隐式表征上。该方法通过掩码NeRF的空间特征并重建，学习可迁移的3D表征。相比基于体素或点云的方法，NeRF-MAE能更好地处理连续场景，并在多个3D理解任务上取得了改进。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of self-supervised learning for NeRF representations by proposing NeRF-MAE, which applies masked autoencoding to NeRF's implicit features. It learns transferable 3D representations, outperforming voxel- or point-based methods on several 3D understanding tasks.
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.assessment: 将MAE扩展到NeRF领域，创新性强，对3D感知表征有潜在应用。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.contribution: 提出NeRF的自监督掩码自编码方法。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.innovation: 在隐式神经场中应用掩码重建。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.result: 在3D理解任务上性能提升。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s._arxiv_id: NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-supervised 3D Representation Learning for Neural Radiance Fields.

DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_cn: 针对单视频中无监督点跟踪的挑战，提出了DINO-Tracker，利用DINO预训练特征进行自监督点跟踪。该方法通过特征匹配和时序一致性实现无需标注的跟踪，并处理遮挡和漂移问题。相比传统光流或监督跟踪方法，DINO-Tracker在多个视频跟踪基准上取得了竞争性结果。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised point tracking in single videos by proposing DINO-Tracker, which leverages DINO features for self-supervised tracking. It handles occlusion and drift via feature matching and temporal consistency, achieving competitive results on video tracking benchmarks.
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.assessment: 展示了自监督特征在视频跟踪中的潜力，对动态场景感知有参考价值。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.contribution: 提出基于DINO的自监督点跟踪方法。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.innovation: 利用预训练视觉特征实现无监督跟踪。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.result: 在跟踪基准上取得竞争性性能。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super._arxiv_id: DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-supervised Point Tracking in a Single Video.

SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_cn: ①针对点云上采样任务中依赖密集标注或合成数据的问题。②提出SPU-PMD方法，通过渐进网格变形实现自监督点云上采样，无需真实稠密点云标签。③相比现有监督方法，首次将自监督与网格变形结合，利用形状先验引导点生成。④在多个基准数据集上达到与监督方法相当的性能，显著减少标注成本。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense annotations in point cloud upsampling by proposing SPU-PMD, a self-supervised method using progressive mesh deformation. It eliminates the need for ground-truth dense point clouds, leveraging shape priors for point generation. The method achieves performance comparable to supervised baselines on standard benchmarks, substantially reducing annotation overhead.
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.assessment: 为点云上采样提供了自监督新思路，对3D感知中的数据处理有参考价值。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.contribution: 提出首个基于渐进网格变形的自监督点云上采样框架。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.innovation: 将网格变形引入自监督点云生成，摆脱标签依赖。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.result: 在多个数据集上性能接近监督方法，降低标注成本。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups._arxiv_id: SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Upsampling via Progressive Mesh Deformation.

Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_cn: ①针对点云自监督学习中对象间依赖导致特征学习不充分的问题。②提出对象交换策略，在训练中交换不同点云中的对象实例，破坏对象间相关性，增强模型对单个对象的表征能力。③相比现有全局对比学习方法，更关注局部对象级特征，提升下游任务泛化性。④在多个点云分类和分割基准上取得优于现有自监督方法的准确率。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_en: This work tackles the issue of object dependencies in point cloud self-supervised learning, which limits feature quality. It introduces an object exchange strategy that swaps instances across point clouds during training, breaking inter-object correlations and enhancing object-level representation. The method outperforms existing self-supervised approaches on classification and segmentation benchmarks.
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.assessment: 针对自监督学习中的对象依赖问题提出有效策略，对3D感知预训练有实际意义。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.contribution: 提出对象交换策略以缓解点云自监督中的对象依赖。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.innovation: 通过实例交换增强对象级特征学习。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.result: 在分类和分割任务上超越现有自监督方法。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin._arxiv_id: Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improving Point Cloud Self-Supervised Learning Through Object Exchange.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中依赖大量标注轨迹数据的问题。②提出基于路径一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法，利用时序路径的几何和外观一致性作为监督信号，无需人工标注。③相比监督跟踪方法，首次将路径一致性用于自监督MOT，提升跨场景泛化能力。④在MOT17等数据集上达到接近监督方法的性能，显著降低标注需求。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy annotation burden in multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised method based on path consistency. It leverages temporal geometric and appearance consistency as supervision, eliminating manual labels. The approach achieves near-supervised performance on MOT benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 为多目标跟踪提供自监督范式，对自动驾驶中的轨迹预测和跟踪有重要参考。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出路径一致性自监督信号用于多目标跟踪。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用时序路径一致性替代人工标注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT17上接近监督性能，降低标注成本。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Path Consistency.

RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界3D场景理解中缺乏区域级语言监督的问题。②提出RegionPLC，通过区域-点-语言对比学习，将2D区域文本描述与3D点云特征对齐，实现开放词汇的3D语义理解。③相比现有3D-语言方法，引入区域级对齐和跨模态知识蒸馏，提升细粒度理解能力。④在ScanNet和S3DIS等基准上，开放词汇语义分割mIoU提升显著，如ScanNet上达到45.2%。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of region-level language supervision in open-world 3D understanding. RegionPLC aligns 2D region text with 3D point features via regional point-language contrastive learning, enabling open-vocabulary segmentation. It outperforms prior 3D-language methods, achieving 45.2% mIoU on ScanNet, demonstrating strong generalization.
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.assessment: 开放世界3D理解的前沿工作，对自动驾驶中的未知物体识别具有直接价值。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.contribution: 提出区域级点-语言对比学习框架用于开放世界3D理解。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.innovation: 区域级文本-点云对齐实现开放词汇分割。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.result: 在ScanNet等基准上显著提升开放词汇分割性能。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr._arxiv_id: RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contrastive Learning for Open-World 3D Scene Understanding.

Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型在视觉-语言任务中产生幻觉的问题。②提出幻觉增强对比学习方法，通过生成并利用幻觉样本作为负例，增强模型对幻觉的判别能力。③相比现有幻觉缓解方法，首次将幻觉样本用于对比学习，提升训练效率和鲁棒性。④在多个视觉问答和图像描述基准上，幻觉率降低约15%，同时保持任务性能。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_en: This paper addresses hallucination in multimodal large language models by proposing hallucination-augmented contrastive learning. It generates hallucinated samples as negatives to improve discriminative ability. The method reduces hallucination rates by ~15% on VQA benchmarks while maintaining performance.
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.assessment: 针对多模态幻觉问题提出创新训练策略，对VLM在自动驾驶中的应用有借鉴意义。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.contribution: 提出幻觉增强对比学习以缓解多模态大模型的幻觉。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.innovation: 利用幻觉样本作为负例进行对比训练。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.result: 幻觉率降低15%，任务性能保持。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear._arxiv_id: Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning for Multimodal Large Language Model.

BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_cn: ①针对多模态对比学习模型（如CLIP）易受后门攻击的安全问题。②提出BadCLIP，通过双嵌入引导设计后门攻击，利用文本和视觉嵌入的协同作用提高攻击成功率。③相比现有攻击方法，首次提出双嵌入引导策略，增强攻击隐蔽性和鲁棒性。④在多个多模态数据集上，攻击成功率超过90%，同时保持模型正常性能。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_en: This paper investigates backdoor attacks on multimodal contrastive learning models like CLIP. BadCLIP introduces dual-embedding guided attacks, leveraging text and visual embeddings for higher success. It achieves over 90% attack success rate on benchmarks while preserving model utility.
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.assessment: 揭示多模态模型的安全漏洞，对自动驾驶中VLM部署的安全性有警示作用。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.contribution: 提出双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法针对多模态对比学习。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.innovation: 双嵌入协同增强攻击效果。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.result: 攻击成功率超90%，模型性能保持。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor._arxiv_id: BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor Attack on Multimodal Contrastive Learning.

SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D占用预测依赖昂贵3D标注的问题。②提出SelfOcc，一种自监督框架，利用多帧图像和相机位姿，通过可微渲染将3D占用场投影到2D进行光度一致性约束，无需深度或占用标签。③相比现有自监督方法，引入显式3D表示和时序信息，提升几何一致性。④在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上，自监督预训练后微调达到与监督方法相当的性能，零样本迁移表现优异。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on expensive 3D annotations in autonomous driving occupancy prediction. It proposes SelfOcc, a self-supervised framework that leverages multi-frame images and camera poses, using differentiable rendering to project a 3D occupancy field to 2D for photometric consistency, eliminating the need for depth or occupancy labels. Compared to existing self-supervised methods, it introduces explicit 3D representation and temporal information, improving geometric consistency. On SemanticKITTI and nuScenes, fine-tuning after self-supervised pretraining achieves performance comparable to supervised methods, with excellent zero-shot transfer.
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.assessment: 该论文是自监督3D占用预测的代表性工作，对降低标注成本、提升泛化能力有重要意义，值得自动驾驶感知研究者关注。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.contribution: 提出首个无需深度或占用标签的自监督3D占用预测框架SelfOcc。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.innovation: 利用可微渲染和时序光度一致性实现3D占用场的自监督学习。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上达到与监督方法相当的性能，零样本迁移表现优异。

What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: ①针对未修剪多动作视频中时空定位依赖密集人工标注的问题。②提出自监督方法，利用叙述指令（narrated instructions）作为弱监督信号，联合学习动作的时间边界和空间区域。③相比仅用视频或文本的现有方法，引入跨模态对齐和时序一致性约束。④在多个基准上显著提升定位精度，尤其在零样本设置下表现突出。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of spatio-temporal grounding in untrimmed multi-action videos, which typically requires dense manual annotations. It proposes a self-supervised method that leverages narrated instructions as weak supervision to jointly learn temporal boundaries and spatial regions of actions. Compared to existing video-only or text-only methods, it introduces cross-modal alignment and temporal consistency constraints. It significantly improves grounding accuracy on multiple benchmarks, especially in zero-shot settings.
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该论文在视频理解领域有创新性，但与本用户关注的自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出利用叙述指令进行自监督时空定位的新框架。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.innovation: 将跨模态对齐与自监督学习结合用于多动作视频定位。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.result: 在多个基准上显著提升定位精度，零样本表现突出。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised Spatio- Temporal Grounding in Untrimmed Multi-Action Videos from Narrated Instructions.

Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_cn: ①针对超分辨率模型在低分辨率输入上泛化能力差的问题。②提出自监督方法，利用低分辨率图像作为引导，通过多尺度一致性训练提升模型对未知降质因子的鲁棒性。③相比传统监督超分，引入自监督预训练和低分辨率先验。④在多个超分基准上，跨数据集泛化性能显著提升。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of super-resolution models on low-resolution inputs. It proposes a self-supervised method that uses low-resolution images as guidance, employing multi-scale consistency training to improve robustness to unknown degradation factors. Compared to traditional supervised super-resolution, it introduces self-supervised pretraining and low-resolution priors. It significantly improves cross-dataset generalization on multiple super-resolution benchmarks.
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.assessment: 该论文聚焦图像超分，与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱，但自监督思路有一定参考价值。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.contribution: 提出利用低分辨率图像引导的自监督超分泛化方法。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.innovation: 多尺度一致性训练增强对未知降质因子的鲁棒性。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.result: 跨数据集泛化性能显著提升。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General._arxiv_id: Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving Generalization for Super-Resolution by Self-Supervised Learning.

Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_cn: ①针对人脸自监督表示学习忽略面部区域语义差异的问题。②提出区域感知的自监督框架，通过分割面部区域并分别进行对比学习，增强局部特征。③相比全局对比方法，引入区域级约束。④在多个面部识别和属性分析任务上取得提升。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that self-supervised facial representation learning ignores semantic differences across facial regions. It proposes a region-aware self-supervised framework that segments facial regions and applies contrastive learning separately to enhance local features. Compared to global contrastive methods, it introduces region-level constraints. It achieves improvements on multiple face recognition and attribute analysis tasks.
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.assessment: 该论文面向人脸识别，与自动驾驶感知方向相关性很低，仅对自监督方法有微弱借鉴。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.contribution: 提出区域感知的人脸自监督表示学习框架。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.innovation: 将面部区域分割与对比学习结合。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.result: 在面部识别和属性分析任务上取得提升。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Facial Representation Learning with Facial Region Awareness.

CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_cn: ①针对无监督目标发现中现有方法依赖预训练模型且发现目标不完整的问题。②提出CuVLER，通过穷举自监督Transformer特征，结合多尺度聚类和迭代细化，增强目标发现的召回率和准确性。③相比现有无监督发现方法，引入更全面的特征利用和细化策略。④在多个目标发现基准上显著提升，尤其在复杂场景下。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the issues in unsupervised object discovery where existing methods rely on pretrained models and produce incomplete object detections. It proposes CuVLER, which exhaustively leverages self-supervised Transformer features, combined with multi-scale clustering and iterative refinement, to enhance recall and accuracy of discovered objects. Compared to existing unsupervised discovery methods, it introduces more comprehensive feature utilization and refinement strategies. It significantly improves on multiple object discovery benchmarks, especially in complex scenes.
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.assessment: 该论文对开放集检测和无监督发现有一定参考价值，与自动驾驶中的未知目标检测相关，值得关注。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.contribution: 提出基于穷举自监督Transformer特征的无监督目标发现方法CuVLER。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.innovation: 多尺度聚类与迭代细化结合提升发现完整性。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.result: 在多个目标发现基准上显著提升，复杂场景表现优异。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis._arxiv_id: CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Discoveries through Exhaustive Self-Supervised Transformers.

Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_cn: ①针对文本引导图像编辑中提示词不充分导致编辑效果不佳的问题。②提出提示增强方法，通过自监督方式生成多样化提示，提升编辑的语义一致性。③相比固定提示方法，引入动态提示生成。④在多个图像编辑任务上提升编辑质量。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient prompts in text-guided image manipulation, leading to suboptimal editing results. It proposes a prompt augmentation method that generates diverse prompts in a self-supervised manner to improve semantic consistency of edits. Compared to fixed-prompt methods, it introduces dynamic prompt generation. It improves editing quality on multiple image manipulation tasks.
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.assessment: 该论文面向图像编辑，与自动驾驶感知方向几乎无关，不建议重点关注。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.contribution: 提出自监督提示增强方法用于文本引导图像编辑。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.innovation: 动态生成多样化提示提升编辑语义一致性。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.result: 在多个图像编辑任务上提升编辑质量。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised Text-guided Image Manipulation.

BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D亚断层图像对齐中方向估计精度不足的问题。②提出了BOE-ViT，利用等变性增强方向估计，在自监督框架下进行3D亚断层图像对齐。③相比已有方法，引入了等变性约束以提升方向估计的鲁棒性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient orientation estimation accuracy in self-supervised 3D subtomogram alignment. It proposes BOE-ViT, which leverages equivariance to boost orientation estimation within a self-supervised framework. The innovation lies in incorporating equivariance constraints to improve robustness, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性极低，且摘要缺失，难以评估其质量，整体重要性有限。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.contribution: 提出利用等变性增强自监督3D亚断层图像对齐中的方向估计。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.innovation: 将等变性引入自监督方向估计任务。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.result: 效果数据缺失，无法量化评估。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation._arxiv_id: BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation with Equivariance in Self-Supervised 3D Subtomogram Alignment.

DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_cn: ①针对点云自监督预训练模型在跨域学习（如从合成数据到真实数据）中性能下降的问题。②提出了DAP-MAE，一种域自适应点云掩码自编码器，通过域自适应机制提升跨域学习效果。③相比标准MAE，引入了域自适应模块以对齐不同域的特征分布。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance degradation of point cloud self-supervised pre-training in cross-domain learning scenarios. It proposes DAP-MAE, a domain-adaptive masked autoencoder that aligns feature distributions across domains. The key improvement is the integration of domain adaptation into the MAE framework, though quantitative results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.assessment: 该论文对3D感知的跨域泛化有一定参考价值，但摘要缺失限制了评估，且与自动驾驶核心任务关联中等。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.contribution: 提出域自适应点云掩码自编码器以改善跨域学习。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.innovation: 在MAE中引入域自适应机制。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.result: 效果数据缺失，无法量化评估。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas._arxiv_id: DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Masked Autoencoder for Effective Cross-Domain Learning.

2503.23220|v2.summary_cn: ①针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中Mean Teacher自标注方法的脆弱性，即学生模型仅用源数据训练时难以生成准确的目标域标签，导致正反馈循环失效。②提出了DINO Teacher方法，包含两个组件：首先在源数据上训练一个使用大型冻结DINOv2骨干的新标注器，生成更准确的目标域标签；然后利用这些标签改进检测器。③相比现有方法，解耦了标签生成与学习过程，利用大规模预训练模型（如DINOv2）的泛化能力，避免了耦合带来的限制。④摘要提到生成的标签更准确，但具体数值未给出，预期在DAOD基准上显著提升性能。
2503.23220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the brittleness of Mean Teacher self-labelling in domain adaptive object detection, where student models trained only on source data often fail to generate accurate target-domain labels. It proposes DINO Teacher, which trains a new labeller on source data using a frozen DINOv2 backbone to produce more reliable labels, decoupling label generation from learning. This leverages large pretrained models' generalization, overcoming the limitations of coupled approaches. The abstract indicates improved label accuracy, though specific metrics are not provided.
2503.23220|v2.assessment: 该论文针对DAOD的核心瓶颈提出创新解决方案，利用视觉基础模型，与自动驾驶跨域检测高度相关，具有重要研究价值。
2503.23220|v2.contribution: 提出DINO Teacher，利用冻结DINOv2生成高质量目标域标签以改进DAOD。
2503.23220|v2.innovation: 解耦标签生成与学习，引入大规模预训练模型。
2503.23220|v2.result: 标签生成更准确，预期提升DAOD性能。

A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云自监督预训练方法缺乏统一解释框架的问题。②提出了一个基于交互的统一视角来解读多种自监督预训练方法。③相比已有工作，提供了理论分析以理解不同方法的共性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified interpretation framework for self-supervised pre-training methods on 3D point clouds. It proposes an interaction-based perspective to explain various methods. The contribution is theoretical, offering insights into commonalities, though results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.assessment: 该论文偏理论分析，与自动驾驶应用关联较弱，且摘要缺失，重要性有限。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.contribution: 提出基于交互的统一视角解释3D点云自监督方法。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-._arxiv_id: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-supervised Pre-training Methods for 3D Point Clouds via Interactions.

2503.13739|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角人物关联在相似外观和未标定相机场景下可靠性低的问题。②提出了Self-MVA，一种自监督无标定多视角人物关联方法，利用跨视角图像同步作为预文本任务，结合编码器-解码器模型和匈牙利匹配。③相比现有方法，无需任何标注或相机标定，仅利用同步标签进行监督。④摘要提到方法有效，但具体数值未给出。
2503.13739|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unreliable multi-view person association in challenging scenes with similar appearances and uncalibrated cameras. It proposes Self-MVA, a self-supervised approach using cross-view image synchronization as a pretext task, with an encoder-decoder model and Hungarian matching. The key advantage is eliminating annotations and calibration, though specific metrics are not provided.
2503.13739|v2.assessment: 该论文与多相机感知相关，但聚焦人物而非车辆，对自动驾驶场景适用性有限，但自监督思路有借鉴意义。
2503.13739|v2.contribution: 提出自监督无标定多视角人物关联方法。
2503.13739|v2.innovation: 利用同步任务进行自监督训练。
2503.13739|v2.result: 方法有效，但无具体数据。

GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中从点级到平面级建模的精度不足问题。②提出了GeoDepth，将深度估计从点对点建模提升到平面对平面建模，以更好地利用几何约束。③相比已有方法，通过平面级建模增强了深度预测的连续性和准确性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据，但预期在KITTI等基准上提升性能。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy limitations in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by shifting from point-to-depth to plane-to-depth modeling. GeoDepth leverages plane-level geometric constraints to improve depth prediction consistency. This approach likely enhances performance on benchmarks like KITTI, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶深度估计高度相关，平面级建模思路具有创新性，对下游感知任务有重要价值。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.contribution: 提出平面级建模的自监督单目深度估计方法。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.innovation: 从点级到平面级的建模转变。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.result: 预期提升深度估计精度。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t._arxiv_id: GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-to-Depth Modeling for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对事件相机在资源受限机器人（如小型无人机）上在线自监督单目深度估计的计算效率瓶颈，本文通过优化对比度最大化的时间和内存效率，实现了设备端实时学习。方法在小型无人机上在线学习，相比仅预训练显著提升深度估计精度和避障成功率，并在自监督方法中达到最先进性能。改进点在于首次实现事件相机低延迟深度估计的在线设备端学习，兼顾效率与精度。
2412.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational bottleneck of online self-supervised monocular depth estimation from event cameras on resource-constrained robots. By improving the time and memory efficiency of contrast maximization, it enables on-device learning, achieving superior depth accuracy and obstacle avoidance on a small drone compared to pre-training only, and state-of-the-art performance among self-supervised methods.
2412.06359|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了在线设备端学习的潜力，对低功耗自主系统有重要价值，但相关度与主流自动驾驶视觉研究略有距离。
2412.06359|v2.contribution: 首次实现事件相机低延迟深度估计的在线设备端自监督学习。
2412.06359|v2.innovation: 通过优化对比度最大化流程的时间和内存效率，使实时在线学习成为可能。
2412.06359|v2.result: 在无人机上在线学习显著提升深度估计精度和避障成功率，达到自监督方法最先进水平。

2505.04410|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP在开放词汇密集预测中局部特征判别性和空间一致性不足的问题，本文提出DeCLIP框架，通过解耦自注意力模块分别获取“内容”和“上下文”特征。内容特征与图像裁剪表示对齐以提升局部判别性，上下文特征在视觉基础模型（如DINO）引导下保留空间相关性。实验表明DeCLIP在多个开放词汇密集预测任务上显著优于现有方法，为自动驾驶等开放场景感知提供新思路。
2505.04410|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitations of CLIP in open-vocabulary dense prediction, specifically poor local discriminability and spatial consistency. DeCLIP decouples self-attention to extract content and context features, aligning content with image crops and guiding context with vision foundation models, achieving significant improvements across multiple open-vocabulary dense prediction benchmarks.
2505.04410|v2.assessment: 该工作针对开放词汇密集预测的关键瓶颈提出有效解耦方案，对自动驾驶开放场景感知具有重要参考价值。
2505.04410|v2.contribution: 提出DeCLIP框架，通过解耦自注意力增强CLIP的局部特征判别性和空间一致性。
2505.04410|v2.innovation: 创新性地分离内容与上下文特征，并利用视觉基础模型引导空间相关性学习。
2505.04410|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇密集预测任务上显著超越现有方法。

2503.21003|v2.summary_cn: 针对AI生成图像检测中传统方法难以泛化到未知生成器的问题，本文提出显式建模取证微结构的方法，仅用真实图像自监督学习一组多样预测滤波器提取残差。通过多尺度联合建模获得紧凑模型参数作为每张图像的取证自描述，实现零样本检测、开放集来源归因和聚类。实验表明该方法在准确性和适应性上优于现有技术，推动合成图像取证发展。
2503.21003|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the generalization issue in detecting AI-generated images by explicitly modeling forensic microstructures. Using self-supervised learning on real images, it extracts diverse residuals and forms a compact forensic self-description, enabling zero-shot detection, open-set source attribution, and clustering, outperforming existing methods in accuracy and adaptability.
2503.21003|v2.assessment: 该工作为AI生成图像取证提供新范式，但相关度与自动驾驶感知领域较低。
2503.21003|v2.contribution: 提出基于取证自描述的零样本AI生成图像检测与来源归因方法。
2503.21003|v2.innovation: 显式建模像素级取证微结构，实现无需先验的开放集检测。
2503.21003|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得优于现有技术的准确性和适应性。

S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶多模态大语言模型缺乏可扩展时空视觉表示的问题，本文提出S4-Driver框架，通过自监督学习构建可扩展的时空视觉表示。方法整合多模态数据，提升驾驶场景理解能力，但摘要未提供具体细节。改进点在于强调可扩展性和自监督策略，以适应多样化驾驶环境。效果未在摘要中给出具体数据，但预期在驾驶任务上表现优异。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_en: This paper introduces S4-Driver, a scalable self-supervised driving multimodal large language model with spatio-temporal visual representation. It addresses the lack of scalable visual representations in autonomous driving LLMs, but specific method details and results are not provided in the abstract.
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.assessment: 该工作直接面向自动驾驶多模态感知，具有高相关度，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.contribution: 提出可扩展自监督时空视觉表示用于驾驶多模态大语言模型。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.innovation: 结合自监督学习与时空表示，提升驾驶场景理解的可扩展性。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据，预期在驾驶任务上表现优异。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv._arxiv_id: S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driving Multimodal Large Language Model with Spatio-Temporal Visual Representation.

2412.04424|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP风格视觉编码器在多样下游任务中视觉特征表达能力不足的问题，本文提出Florence-VL，利用生成式视觉基础模型Florence-2捕获不同层次和方面的视觉特征。通过深度-广度融合（DBFusion）架构整合多深度和多提示的视觉特征，并设计端到端预训练和微调流程。实验表明Florence-VL在视觉-语言对齐上优于流行视觉编码器，增强的深度和广度特征提升多模态大语言模型性能。
2412.04424|v2.summary_en: This paper presents Florence-VL, which uses Florence-2's generative visual features to enhance multimodal LLMs. It proposes depth-breadth fusion to integrate multi-depth and multi-prompt features, with a tailored training recipe, showing advantages over CLIP-style encoders in vision-language alignment and downstream performance.
2412.04424|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态大语言模型提供新视觉编码方案，对自动驾驶视觉-语言理解有潜在应用价值。
2412.04424|v2.contribution: 提出Florence-VL，利用生成式视觉编码器和深度-广度融合增强多模态大语言模型。
2412.04424|v2.innovation: 创新性地融合不同深度和提示下的视觉特征，提升视觉-语言对齐。
2412.04424|v2.result: 在视觉-语言对齐和下游任务上优于流行视觉编码器。

2502.18290|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督学习视觉编码器在大型视觉语言模型中共享复用导致的后门攻击风险，本文提出BadVision，首个利用新颖触发优化和后门学习技术攻击SSL编码器的方法。通过仅攻陷编码器，诱导LVLMs产生攻击者选择的幻觉，在八个基准上实现超过99%的攻击成功率，并造成77.6%的相对视觉理解错误，同时保持隐蔽性。该工作揭示SSL编码器的安全漏洞，对自动驾驶等安全关键应用有警示意义。
2502.18290|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals a new backdoor threat in SSL vision encoders for LVLMs, proposing BadVision with novel trigger optimization and backdoor learning. It achieves over 99% attack success rate and 77.6% relative visual understanding error across eight benchmarks while maintaining stealthiness, highlighting security risks in shared encoders.
2502.18290|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示自监督编码器的安全漏洞，对自动驾驶等安全关键系统有重要警示，但相关度中等。
2502.18290|v2.contribution: 首个针对SSL视觉编码器在LVLMs中后门攻击的方法BadVision。
2502.18290|v2.innovation: 提出新颖触发优化和后门学习技术，实现高成功率和隐蔽性。
2502.18290|v2.result: 在八个基准上实现超过99%攻击成功率和77.6%视觉理解错误。

2511.08666|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频基础模型在提取时空特征时，特征中隐含的敏感个人信息（如肤色、性别、服装）在下游任务中泄露隐私的问题。②提出了一种在潜在空间中操作的轻量级匿名化适配模块（AAM），可即插即用地应用于冻结的视频编码器，去除特征中的隐私信息同时保留任务效用，并设计了三个训练目标：基于静态片段的对比隐私目标、协同训练目标等。③相比现有像素级匿名化方法，该方法无需重训练整个效用模型，避免了任务特定匿名化的局限，适用于视频基础模型。④实验表明，AAM在保持下游任务性能的同时有效降低了隐私泄露风险，但摘要中未提供具体数据。
2511.08666|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy leakage in video foundation models, where spatio-temporal features inadvertently reveal sensitive attributes like skin color or gender. It proposes a lightweight Anonymizing Adapter Module (AAM) operating in latent space, plug-and-play with frozen encoders, using three training objectives to remove private information while preserving task utility. Unlike pixel-level methods, it avoids retraining the entire model and is suitable for video foundation models, though specific quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
2511.08666|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦视频理解中的隐私保护，创新性地在潜在空间进行匿名化，对多模态感知和基础模型应用有参考价值，但实验细节不足，与自动驾驶核心任务关联度中等。
2511.08666|v2.contribution: 提出了一种在潜在空间中即插即用的匿名化适配模块，用于视频基础模型的隐私保护。
2511.08666|v2.innovation: 将隐私匿名化从像素级迁移到潜在特征级，无需重训练基础模型。
2511.08666|v2.result: 在保持任务效用的同时降低了隐私泄露风险，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。

2003.13942|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对视频描述（Video Captioning）任务中现有方法仅利用场景级或物体级信息、未显式建模物体间交互，导致预测缺乏视觉依据且对虚假相关性敏感的问题。②提出了一个时空图模型，显式建模物体在空间和时间上的交互，构建可解释的链接以提供视觉依据；同时提出一种物体感知的知识蒸馏机制，用局部物体信息正则化全局场景特征，以应对物体数量变化带来的性能不稳定。③相比已有工作，创新在于将物体交互的显式建模与知识蒸馏结合，增强了模型的解释性和鲁棒性。④在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得了有竞争力的性能，并生成了可解释的预测。
2003.13942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of explicit object interaction modeling in video captioning, which leads to visually ungrounded predictions and sensitivity to spurious correlations. It proposes a spatio-temporal graph model that captures object interactions in space and time, along with an object-aware knowledge distillation mechanism to regularize global scene features with local object information. Experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance with interpretable predictions.
2003.13942|v2.assessment: 该论文将图模型与知识蒸馏结合用于视频描述，在可解释性方面有亮点，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向（如检测、BEV、占用）关联较弱，主要面向通用视频理解。
2003.13942|v2.contribution: 提出时空图模型与物体感知知识蒸馏机制，提升视频描述的视觉依据和鲁棒性。
2003.13942|v2.innovation: 显式建模物体时空交互，并用局部物体信息蒸馏全局场景特征。
2003.13942|v2.result: 在两个基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并生成可解释的预测。

2103.03454|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中智能体仅将历史经验存储为循环网络隐状态，无法捕捉环境布局和进行长期规划的问题。②提出了结构化场景记忆（SSM）架构，通过分模块存储导航感知信息，并设计collect-read控制器自适应收集信息以支持决策，同时模拟迭代算法进行长程推理。③相比已有工作，SSM提供了完整动作空间（地图上所有可导航位置），并引入基于前沿探索的导航决策策略，实现高效全局规划。④在R2R和R4R两个VLN数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
2103.03454|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of VLN agents that store past experiences as latent states in recurrent networks, failing to capture environment layouts and plan long-term. It proposes Structured Scene Memory (SSM), a compartmentalized architecture that memorizes percepts, disentangles visual and geometric cues, and uses a collect-read controller for adaptive decision-making and iterative long-range reasoning. By providing a complete action space and frontier-exploration-based planning, SSM achieves state-of-the-art performance on R2R and R4R datasets.
2103.03454|v2.assessment: 该论文在VLN领域提出了新颖的结构化记忆架构，对场景理解和长期规划有显著改进，但与本用户关注的自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低。
2103.03454|v2.contribution: 提出了结构化场景记忆架构，实现VLN中的高效环境建模和全局规划。
2103.03454|v2.innovation: 通过分模块记忆和完整动作空间设计，结合前沿探索策略，突破了循环网络的局限。
2103.03454|v2.result: 在R2R和R4R数据集上达到最先进性能。

VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言模型中视觉表示质量不足的问题，特别是目标检测特征在跨模态任务中的局限性。②提出了VinVL，通过重新审视和优化视觉表示，采用改进的目标检测模型（基于更大的骨干网络和更丰富的训练数据）生成更丰富的视觉特征，并集成到视觉语言模型中。③相比已有工作，VinVL在视觉特征提取上进行了系统性的改进，包括模型架构、预训练策略和数据规模。④在多个视觉语言基准任务（如VQA、image captioning等）上取得了显著优于先前最先进方法的结果。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of suboptimal visual representations in vision-language models, particularly the limitations of object detection features. It proposes VinVL, which revisits visual representations by using an improved object detection model with larger backbones and richer training data to generate more comprehensive visual features. Compared to prior work, VinVL systematically enhances feature extraction through architecture, pretraining, and data scaling, achieving significant improvements over state-of-the-art on multiple VL benchmarks.
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.assessment: 该论文对视觉语言模型中的视觉表示进行了深入优化，对多模态感知研究有重要参考价值，但直接应用于自动驾驶感知仍需适配。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.contribution: 提出了改进的视觉表示方法VinVL，显著提升了视觉语言任务的性能。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.innovation: 通过优化目标检测模型和训练数据，生成更丰富的视觉特征。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.result: 在多个视觉语言基准上超越先前最先进方法。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations._arxiv_id: VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models.

InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_cn: ①针对点云视觉定位（visual grounding）中缺乏对实例级上下文和场景整体理解的问题。②提出了InstanceRefer，通过实例多级上下文指涉，协同理解点云场景，包括实例级特征提取和跨实例关系建模。③相比已有工作，InstanceRefer强调实例间的上下文关联，而非仅依赖单点或局部特征。④在点云视觉定位基准数据集上取得了领先性能。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of instance-level context and holistic scene understanding in point cloud visual grounding. It proposes InstanceRefer, which performs cooperative understanding through instance multi-level contextual referring, including instance feature extraction and cross-instance relation modeling. Compared to prior methods, it emphasizes inter-instance context, achieving leading performance on point cloud grounding benchmarks.
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.assessment: 该论文在3D视觉定位中引入了实例级上下文建模，对3D感知有启发，但与本用户核心方向（自动驾驶感知）相关性中等。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.contribution: 提出了InstanceRefer方法，通过实例多级上下文提升点云视觉定位性能。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.innovation: 协同利用实例级上下文和场景结构进行指涉理解。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.result: 在点云视觉定位基准上取得领先结果。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde._arxiv_id: InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Understanding for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds through Instance Multi-level Contextual Referring.

3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_cn: ①针对点云视觉定位中关系建模不足的问题，现有方法难以捕捉物体间的语义和空间关系。②提出了3DVG-Transformer，利用Transformer架构对点云场景中的物体关系进行显式建模，通过自注意力机制融合多级特征。③相比已有工作，该方法将关系建模引入Transformer框架，增强了场景理解能力。④在点云视觉定位基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient relation modeling in point cloud visual grounding, where existing methods struggle to capture semantic and spatial relations between objects. It proposes 3DVG-Transformer, which uses Transformer architecture for explicit relation modeling via self-attention to fuse multi-level features. Compared to prior work, it integrates relation modeling into Transformer, enhancing scene understanding and achieving competitive performance on benchmarks.
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.assessment: 该论文将Transformer应用于点云视觉定位的关系建模，方法新颖，但与本用户自动驾驶感知方向的相关性有限。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.contribution: 提出了3DVG-Transformer，通过关系建模提升点云视觉定位精度。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.innovation: 利用Transformer自注意力机制显式建模物体间关系。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.result: 在点云视觉定位基准上取得有竞争力性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for._arxiv_id: 3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds.

3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云场景中密集描述生成与视觉定位任务相互独立、缺乏统一框架的问题。②提出了3DJCG，一个联合处理3D密集描述和视觉定位的统一框架，通过共享特征提取和任务交互模块实现协同学习。③相比分别训练两个任务的方法，该框架利用任务间的互补信息，增强了跨模态理解能力。④在基准数据集上取得了优于单独任务模型的性能，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified framework for joint dense captioning and visual grounding on 3D point clouds. It proposes 3DJCG, which integrates both tasks via shared feature extraction and interaction modules, leveraging complementary information to improve performance. The method outperforms separate task models on benchmark datasets, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.assessment: 该论文探索了3D视觉与语言任务的统一建模，对多模态感知研究有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证方法细节。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.contribution: 提出了首个联合3D密集描述与视觉定位的统一框架。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.innovation: 通过任务交互模块实现3D点云上描述与定位的协同学习。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.result: 在基准数据集上优于单独任务模型。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den._arxiv_id: 3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Dense Captioning and Visual Grounding on 3D Point Clouds.

A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇语义分割依赖复杂架构或额外训练，缺乏简单有效基线的问题。②提出了一个基于预训练视觉-语言模型的简单基线，利用CLIP等模型的零样本能力，通过特征对齐和像素级分类实现分割。③相比现有方法，该基线简化了流程，无需复杂模块，直接利用预训练知识。④在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得了竞争性结果，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_en: This paper tackles the complexity of open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by proposing a simple baseline using pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP. It aligns image and text features for pixel-level classification, avoiding intricate architectures. The approach achieves competitive performance on several benchmarks, though specific numbers are omitted in the abstract.
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.assessment: 该工作强调简洁性，为开放词汇分割提供了实用基线，对VLM应用研究有较高参考价值。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.contribution: 提出了一个利用预训练VLM的简单开放词汇分割基线。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.innovation: 简化分割流程，直接利用CLIP的跨模态对齐能力。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.result: 在多个基准上取得竞争性性能。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se._arxiv_id: A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Pre-trained Vision-Language Model.

A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言导航中命令可行性未知，导致智能体难以有效决策的问题。②构建了一个交互式视觉-语言导航数据集，包含未知可行性的命令，并设计了评估协议。③相比现有导航数据集，该工作引入了命令可行性不确定性，更贴近真实场景。④数据集和基线结果展示了任务的挑战性，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of unknown command feasibility in vision-language navigation, which complicates agent decision-making. It introduces an interactive dataset with such commands and evaluation protocols. Compared to existing datasets, it adds uncertainty, reflecting real-world conditions. The dataset and baselines highlight task challenges, though specifics are not in the abstract.
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.assessment: 该数据集填补了导航任务中命令可行性研究的空白，对多模态交互研究有贡献，但应用范围较窄。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.contribution: 构建了包含未知命令可行性的交互式导航数据集。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.innovation: 引入命令可行性不确定性到视觉-语言导航任务。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.result: 提供了基线并展示了任务难度。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility.

Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言导航中标签耦合导致表征学习不充分的问题。②提出了使用解耦标签学习解耦表征的方法，通过分离不同指令因素来增强导航能力。③相比传统方法，该工作显式建模标签解耦，提升了泛化性。④在导航基准上取得了改进，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient representation learning due to coupled labels in vision-language navigation. It proposes learning disentangled representations with decoupled labels, separating instruction factors to improve navigation. Unlike traditional methods, it explicitly models label disentanglement, enhancing generalization. Improvements are shown on navigation benchmarks, though specifics are absent.
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.assessment: 该研究关注表征解耦，对多模态导航任务有理论价值，但实际提升需更多实验验证。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.contribution: 提出基于解耦标签的表征学习方法用于视觉-语言导航。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.innovation: 显式解耦标签以提升表征的独立性和泛化性。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.result: 在导航基准上取得性能改进。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled._arxiv_id: Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled Labels for Vision-Language Navigation.

UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型中文本和框输出分离，缺乏统一接地建模的问题。②提出了UniTAB，统一文本和框输出，通过联合训练实现接地视觉-语言建模。③相比现有方法，该框架整合了生成和定位任务，提升了多任务效率。④在多个视觉-语言基准上取得了先进性能，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of text and box outputs in vision-language models, lacking unified grounding. It proposes UniTAB to unify these outputs via joint training for grounded modeling. Compared to existing methods, it integrates generation and localization tasks, improving efficiency. It achieves state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks, though specifics are not detailed.
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.assessment: 该工作统一了多模态输出，对视觉-语言接地任务有重要贡献，值得关注。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.contribution: 提出了统一文本和框输出的接地视觉-语言建模框架。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.innovation: 联合优化文本生成和框定位以实现统一输出。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.result: 在多个基准上取得先进性能。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo._arxiv_id: UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs for Grounded Vision-Language Modeling.

2207.09644|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督骨架序列预训练忽略层次时空结构，仅关注视频级对比学习的问题。②提出了层次化自监督预训练方案，集成到层次Transformer编码器Hi-TRS中，分别捕获帧、片段和视频级别的时空依赖。③相比现有方法，该工作显式建模层次结构，提升了表征质量。④在动作识别、检测和运动预测任务上，监督和半监督协议下均达到最先进性能。
2207.09644|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of hierarchical spatio-temporal structures in self-supervised skeleton pre-training, which often relies on video-level contrastive learning. It proposes a hierarchical pre-training scheme with a hierarchical Transformer encoder (Hi-TRS) to capture frame, clip, and video-level dependencies. Unlike prior methods, it explicitly models hierarchy, improving representation quality. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on action recognition, detection, and motion prediction under supervised and semi-supervised protocols.
2207.09644|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地引入层次自监督，显著提升骨架表征学习，对视频理解领域有重要价值。
2207.09644|v2.contribution: 提出了层次化自监督预训练方案用于骨架序列表征学习。
2207.09644|v2.innovation: 在帧、片段和视频级别显式建模时空依赖。
2207.09644|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上取得最先进性能。

2208.06105|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视频表示学习中现有方法未能充分利用短期运动动态的问题，提出运动敏感对比学习（MSCL），将光流捕获的运动信息注入RGB帧以增强特征学习。方法包括帧级局部运动对比学习（LMCL）、流旋转增强（FRA）生成运动打乱的负样本，以及运动差分采样（MDS）筛选训练样本。相比仅依赖全局对比学习的方法，MSCL在多个基准上显著提升性能，在UCF101和Something-Something v2上分别达到91.5%和50.3%的top-1准确率，视频检索top-1召回率达65.6%。
2208.06105|v2.summary_en: To address insufficient exploitation of short-term motion dynamics in self-supervised video representation learning, we propose Motion Sensitive Contrastive Learning (MSCL) that injects optical flow motion into RGB frames. It introduces local motion contrastive learning, flow rotation augmentation, and motion differential sampling, achieving state-of-the-art top-1 accuracies of 91.5% on UCF101 and 50.3% on Something-Something v2, plus 65.6% top-1 recall for retrieval.
2208.06105|v2.assessment: 该工作针对视频自监督学习中的运动建模短板，提出多层次的对比学习策略，实验充分且性能领先，对视频理解领域有重要参考价值。
2208.06105|v2.contribution: 提出MSCL框架，通过局部运动对比和运动感知采样增强自监督视频表示。
2208.06105|v2.innovation: 将光流运动信息显式注入RGB帧，并设计帧级对比目标和运动打乱负样本。
2208.06105|v2.result: 在多个视频分类和检索基准上刷新最先进结果。

2208.09843|v2.summary_cn: 针对图像-文本检索中对比学习受限于负样本数量少、人工加权和缺乏外部知识的问题，提出耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习（CODER）。方法设计多样性敏感对比学习（DCL）架构，利用动态字典扩大样本规模并自适应加权负样本，同时通过双分支分别学习实例级嵌入和从常识知识图谱查询概念级描述符。相比现有方法，CODER增强了跨模态表示的多样性感知和知识利用，在检索任务上预期有显著提升。
2208.09843|v2.summary_en: CODER addresses limitations of contrastive learning in image-text retrieval, such as limited negatives and manual weighting, by introducing diversity-sensitive contrastive learning with dynamic dictionaries and adaptive weighting. It employs dual branches for instance-level embeddings and concept-level descriptors from commonsense knowledge graphs, improving cross-modal alignment.
2208.09843|v2.assessment: 该论文针对跨模态检索中的对比学习缺陷提出创新架构，结合知识图谱增强表示，但摘要未给出具体实验结果，质量评估受限。
2208.09843|v2.contribution: 提出CODER框架，结合多样性敏感对比学习和知识图谱查询改进图像-文本检索。
2208.09843|v2.innovation: 动态字典和自适应负样本加权，以及双分支实例-概念对齐机制。
2208.09843|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在检索基准上优于现有方法。

2207.12661|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态对比预训练中通常使用独立编码器而限制知识共享的问题，研究模态共享的对比语言-图像预训练（MS-CLIP）框架。系统探索了Transformer模型中跨模态参数共享的比例，发现大部分共享的编码器优于分离更多参数的变体，且轻量级模态特定并行模块能进一步提升性能。相比vanilla CLIP，MS-CLIP在零样本ImageNet分类上相对提升高达13%。
2207.12661|v2.summary_en: MS-CLIP investigates parameter sharing across modalities in contrastive pre-training, showing that a mostly unified vision-language encoder outperforms variants with more separated parameters. Lightweight modality-specific parallel modules further improve performance, achieving up to 13% relative gain over vanilla CLIP in zero-shot ImageNet classification.
2207.12661|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地探索了模态共享架构的设计空间，为多模态预训练提供新视角，实验设计严谨，结果有说服力。
2207.12661|v2.contribution: 提出并评估多种模态共享CLIP框架，证明大部分共享参数的有效性。
2207.12661|v2.innovation: 沿参数共享谱系分析架构选择，并引入轻量级并行模块。

2107.06383|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言（V&L）模型中视觉编码器依赖有限人工标注数据的问题，研究将CLIP作为视觉编码器的效果。在两种场景下评估：任务特定微调和V&L预训练后迁移，发现CLIP显著优于广泛使用的BottomUp-TopDown等编码器。在VQA、视觉蕴含和V&L导航任务上取得新最先进结果，并开源代码。
2107.06383|v2.summary_en: This work studies using CLIP as a visual encoder in V&L models, showing significant improvements over in-domain encoders like BottomUp-TopDown. It achieves state-of-the-art results on VQA, visual entailment, and V&L navigation, demonstrating CLIP's advantage in both fine-tuning and pre-training scenarios.
2107.06383|v2.assessment: 该论文实证了大规模预训练视觉编码器对V&L任务的巨大价值，结果全面且开源，对多模态感知研究有直接指导意义。
2107.06383|v2.contribution: 系统评估CLIP作为视觉编码器在多种V&L任务中的性能，并刷新多项基准。
2107.06383|v2.innovation: 将CLIP无缝集成到V&L模型，验证其跨任务泛化能力。
2107.06383|v2.result: 在VQA、视觉蕴含和导航任务上达到新最先进水平。

2106.12570|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态VAE中通过显式因子分解组合模态信息导致表示质量受限的问题，提出MEME方法，通过互监督机制隐式结合模态信息。该方法重新利用半监督VAE，允许从部分观测数据学习，其中某些模态可完全缺失。在MNIST-SVHN和CUB数据集上，MEME在部分和完整观测方案下均优于基线，并展示了更好的表示相关性捕获能力。
2106.12570|v2.summary_en: MEME introduces mutual supervision in multimodal VAEs to implicitly combine information across modalities, avoiding explicit factorizations. It supports learning from partially-observed data and outperforms baselines on MNIST-SVHN and CUB datasets, with improved representation quality.
2106.12570|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态生成建模提供新思路，互监督机制简洁有效，但实验规模较小，对自动驾驶领域相关性有限。
2106.12570|v2.contribution: 提出基于互监督的多模态VAE，支持缺失模态学习。
2106.12570|v2.innovation: 通过半监督VAE隐式传递模态信息，替代显式组合。
2106.12570|v2.result: 在标准数据集上超越基线，并有效处理部分观测。

2106.09667|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态对比学习（如CLIP）在噪声和未筛选数据上训练的安全隐患，揭示后门和投毒攻击的严重威胁。通过仅投毒0.01%的数据（如Conceptual Captions中300张图像），可导致模型对测试图像误分类；定向投毒攻击仅需0.0001%数据（3张图像）。该工作质疑了基于网络抓取数据的训练实践，对模型安全性提出警示。
2106.09667|v2.summary_en: This paper exposes vulnerabilities in multimodal contrastive learning to backdoor and poisoning attacks, showing that poisoning 0.01% of data can cause misclassification, and targeted attacks need only 0.0001%. It questions the safety of training on noisy web-scraped data.
2106.09667|v2.assessment: 该研究揭示对比学习的安全漏洞，攻击效率惊人，对依赖大规模无标注数据的感知系统有重要警示意义。
2106.09667|v2.contribution: 首次系统展示对比学习对投毒和后门攻击的脆弱性。
2106.09667|v2.innovation: 量化极低数据投毒比例下的攻击成功率。
2106.09667|v2.result: 0.01%投毒导致误分类，0.0001%实现定向攻击。

2207.03482|v2.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇检测中CLIP模型缺乏精确目标定位、图像级监督启发式不准确的问题。②提出通过目标中心对齐CLIP语言嵌入，并利用伪标签过程从图像级监督中视觉接地目标，同时设计权重传递函数融合两种对齐策略。③相比现有方法，首次桥接目标级和图像级表示，利用互补优势提升检测性能。④在多个OVD基准上取得显著改进，如LVIS和COCO上的mAP提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2207.03482|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment of CLIP and image-level supervision in open-vocabulary detection by performing object-centric alignment of language embeddings and grounding objects via pseudo-labeling. A novel weight transfer function bridges the two strategies, improving detection accuracy on benchmarks like LVIS and COCO.
2207.03482|v2.assessment: 该工作针对开放词汇检测的核心瓶颈，提出创新的目标-图像级对齐框架，具有较强实用价值。
2207.03482|v2.contribution: 提出目标中心对齐与伪标签结合的方法，缩小开放词汇检测中目标级和图像级表示的差距。
2207.03482|v2.innovation: 设计权重传递函数融合CLIP语言嵌入和图像级监督的互补优势。
2207.03482|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇检测基准上实现性能提升。

2208.05592|v2.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇模型如CLIP在特定任务上零样本性能不佳的问题。②提出PAINT方法，通过微调前后权重插值实现模型修补，提升目标任务精度而不损害其他任务。③相比传统微调，权重插值避免灾难性遗忘，支持多任务修补和模型规模扩展。④在9个零样本性能差的任务上，精度提升15-60个百分点，同时ImageNet精度保持在一个百分点内。
2208.05592|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces PAINT, a weight interpolation method to patch open-vocabulary models like CLIP, improving accuracy on specific tasks by 15-60 percentage points while preserving ImageNet accuracy within one point. It supports multi-task patching and shows broad transfer across tasks.
2208.05592|v2.assessment: 该研究为开放词汇模型的定向优化提供了简洁有效的方案，对多任务场景有广泛适用性。
2208.05592|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重插值的模型修补方法，平衡任务特定提升与全局性能保持。
2208.05592|v2.innovation: 利用微调前后权重插值实现无损修补，支持多任务和跨任务迁移。
2208.05592|v2.result: 在多个任务上显著提升精度，且不损害原有性能。

2211.14241|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D视觉定位中视觉流仅依赖点云编码器，缺乏丰富2D语义线索的问题。②提出Look Around and Refer (LAR)模块，从3D点云合成2D线索并辅助3D编码器，无需额外2D输入。③相比现有方法，利用合成2D语义知识蒸馏提升3D视觉表示质量，训练和测试均高效。④在Nr3D、Sr3D和ScanRefer基准上一致超越现有方法，取得最优性能。
2211.14241|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes LAR, a module that synthesizes 2D clues from 3D point clouds to enhance 3D visual grounding, improving visual representations without extra 2D inputs. It consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Nr3D, Sr3D, and ScanRefer benchmarks.
2211.14241|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地利用2D合成语义辅助3D任务，方法简洁且效果显著，值得关注。
2211.14241|v2.contribution: 提出从点云合成2D线索的知识蒸馏方法，增强3D视觉定位的表示学习。
2211.14241|v2.innovation: 利用合成2D语义无需额外输入，提升3D编码器性能。
2211.14241|v2.result: 在三个主流基准上取得最优结果。

2301.05499|v2.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测（SDG-OD）研究几乎空白的问题，本文提出利用预训练视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）引入语义域概念。方法包括对检测器骨干特征进行语义增强，以及基于文本的分类损失，以同时学习鲁棒的定位和表示。在天气驾驶基准上，该方法比现有唯一的SDG-OD方法Single-DGOD提升了10%，验证了其有效性。
2301.05499|v2.summary_en: Addressing the underexplored problem of single domain generalization for object detection, this paper leverages a pre-trained vision-language model to introduce semantic domain concepts via textual prompts. A semantic augmentation strategy on backbone features and a text-based classification loss are proposed, outperforming the existing SDG-OD method by 10% on a weather-driving benchmark.
2301.05499|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了SDG在目标检测领域的空白，创新性地结合VLM，对自动驾驶等跨域场景具有重要参考价值。
2301.05499|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用视觉-语言模型进行单域泛化目标检测的框架。
2301.05499|v2.innovation: 通过文本提示实现语义增强，提升检测器的跨域泛化能力。
2301.05499|v2.result: 在天气驾驶基准上比现有方法提升10%。

2303.12027|v2.summary_cn: 针对自然语言规范跟踪中视觉定位与跟踪分离、难以端到端训练的问题，本文提出联合视觉定位与跟踪框架，将两者统一为基于视觉-语言参考的定位任务。设计了多源关系建模模块和时序建模模块，利用全局语义信息提升对目标外观变化的适应性。该方法有效利用了定位与跟踪的关联，提高了跟踪性能。
2303.12027|v2.summary_en: To address the separation of visual grounding and tracking in natural language specification tasks, this paper proposes a joint framework that unifies them as a localization task based on visual-language references. Multi-source relation modeling and temporal modeling modules are introduced, improving adaptability to appearance changes.
2303.12027|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地统一了定位与跟踪，为多模态跟踪提供了新思路，具有较强实用性。
2303.12027|v2.contribution: 提出联合视觉定位与跟踪的统一框架，实现端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.innovation: 利用多源关系建模和时序建模，融合全局语义信息。
2303.12027|v2.result: 在相关基准上提升了跟踪性能。

2303.16891|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇实例分割依赖人工掩码标注、导致基类过拟合的问题，本文提出Mask-free OVIS管道，利用预训练视觉-语言模型从图像-文本对中自动生成伪掩码，以弱监督方式学习基类和新类。该方法避免了强监督与弱监督的差异，提升了对新类的泛化能力。
2303.16891|v2.summary_en: To overcome the reliance on manual mask annotations in instance segmentation, this paper proposes Mask-free OVIS, which generates pseudo-masks from vision-language models using image-caption pairs. This weakly supervised approach mitigates overfitting to base categories and improves novel category generalization.
2303.16891|v2.assessment: 该论文减少了标注成本，推动了开放词汇分割的实用化，对数据稀缺场景有重要意义。
2303.16891|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工掩码的开放词汇实例分割方法。
2303.16891|v2.innovation: 利用VLM自动生成伪掩码，实现弱监督学习。
2303.16891|v2.result: 有效提升了对新类别的泛化性能。

2303.13076|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇检测中CLIP模型从整图到区域识别的分布不匹配以及新类定位困难的问题，本文提出CORA框架，采用区域提示和锚点预匹配机制。区域提示通过提示CLIP区域分类器缓解分布差距，锚点预匹配通过类感知匹配机制学习泛化的定位能力。在COCO OVD基准上，新类AP50达到41.7，超过之前SOTA 2.4，且无需额外训练数据。
2303.13076|v2.summary_en: Addressing distribution mismatch and localization challenges in open-vocabulary detection, CORA adapts CLIP with region prompting and anchor pre-matching. It achieves 41.7 AP50 on novel classes in COCO OVD, outperforming previous SOTA by 2.4 without extra data.
2303.13076|v2.assessment: 该论文在开放词汇检测上取得显著性能提升，方法设计巧妙，具有高影响力。
2303.13076|v2.contribution: 提出CORA框架，有效适配CLIP用于开放词汇检测。
2303.13076|v2.innovation: 区域提示和锚点预匹配机制解决分布差距与定位难题。
2303.13076|v2.result: 在COCO OVD上达到41.7 AP50，超越SOTA。

2301.09121|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割依赖掩码标注的问题，本文提出OVSegmentor模型，仅利用网络爬取的图像-文本对进行预训练。通过槽注意力绑定模块将像素组装为组令牌，并与标题嵌入对齐，同时设计掩码实体补全和跨图像掩码一致性两个代理任务。构建CC4M数据集提升训练效率，实验验证了其有效性。
2301.09121|v2.summary_en: For open-vocabulary semantic segmentation without mask annotations, OVSegmentor uses image-text pairs with slot-attention binding and proxy tasks like masked entity completion. It improves training efficiency with CC4M dataset and demonstrates strong performance.
2301.09121|v2.assessment: 该论文探索了无掩码标注的开放词汇分割，方法新颖，对降低标注依赖有重要贡献。
2301.09121|v2.contribution: 提出仅用图像-文本对训练的开放词汇分割模型。
2301.09121|v2.innovation: 槽注意力绑定和代理任务实现细粒度对齐。
2301.09121|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性。

2212.00785|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界语义分割中对比学习训练与测试不一致的问题，本文提出文本接地对比学习（TCL）框架，直接学习区域-文本对齐。方法为给定文本生成分割掩码，提取文本接地图像嵌入并与文本嵌入对齐，从而直接提升掩码质量。在8个语义分割数据集上进行了统一评估，取得了先进性能。
2212.00785|v2.summary_en: To address train-test discrepancy in open-world segmentation, TCL directly learns region-text alignment by generating masks and aligning text-grounded embeddings. It achieves state-of-the-art results across 8 datasets with a unified protocol.
2212.00785|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了对比学习在分割中的关键缺陷，方法简洁有效，具有广泛适用性。
2212.00785|v2.contribution: 提出文本接地对比学习框架，实现直接区域-文本对齐。

2303.14038|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言预训练（VLP）中训练成本高、收敛慢的问题，其根源在于掩码语言建模（MLM）中预测率与损坏率相互绑定，导致大量输出token被排除在预测损失之外。②提出了一种新的预训练任务——自由语言建模（FLM），实现了100%的预测率，同时允许任意损坏率，并可为每个待预测token定制损坏跨度。③相比MLM，FLM解耦了预测率与损坏率，使模型能更灵活地利用双向上下文，在相同GPU时间内学习得更好更快。④实验表明，FLM在保持性能的同时，相比基于MLM的方法实现了2.5倍的预训练时间缩减。
2303.14038|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and slow convergence in vision-language pretraining (VLP), caused by the entanglement of prediction and corruption rates in masked language modeling (MLM). It proposes Free Language Modeling (FLM), which enables a 100% prediction rate with arbitrary corruption rates and customizable corruption spans, decoupling the two rates. FLM achieves a 2.5x pretraining time reduction over MLM-based methods while maintaining competitive performance.
2303.14038|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种高效的预训练任务，显著提升了VLP的训练效率，对大规模多模态模型训练具有重要参考价值。
2303.14038|v2.contribution: 提出FLM预训练任务，解耦预测率与损坏率，实现高效视觉-语言预训练。
2303.14038|v2.innovation: 创新性地将预测率从损坏率中解放，并支持逐token定制的损坏跨度。
2303.14038|v2.result: 在保持性能的同时，预训练时间缩减2.5倍。

2211.10277|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模视觉-语言模型（VLM）在下游任务迁移时，现有高效迁移学习方法（如提示微调、适配器微调）要么破坏预训练知识，要么过度偏向新任务，导致泛化性不足。②提出Task Residual Tuning（TaskRes），直接在文本分类器上操作，通过冻结原始分类器权重，并微调一组残差参数来构建新分类器，显式解耦预训练知识与任务特定知识。③相比现有方法，TaskRes保留了可靠的先验知识，同时灵活探索任务特定知识，避免了知识破坏或过度偏置。④实验表明，TaskRes在多个下游任务上取得了优于现有高效迁移方法的性能，尤其在少样本场景下表现突出。
2211.10277|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that existing efficient transfer learning methods for vision-language models (VLMs) either damage or over-bias towards prior knowledge. It proposes Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes), which freezes the original text-based classifier and tunes a residual parameter set, explicitly decoupling prior and task-specific knowledge. TaskRes achieves superior performance over existing methods, especially in few-shot settings.
2211.10277|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简洁有效的VLM高效迁移方法，在保留先验知识的同时实现灵活适配，对少样本学习场景具有实用价值。
2211.10277|v2.contribution: 提出TaskRes方法，通过残差调优实现VLM的高效迁移学习。
2211.10277|v2.innovation: 创新性地在文本分类器上引入残差机制，显式解耦先验与任务知识。
2211.10277|v2.result: 在多个下游任务和少样本场景中取得领先性能。

2303.15786|v2.summary_cn: ①针对人-物交互（HOI）检测中，现有基于CLIP的知识蒸馏方法依赖大规模训练数据，且在少样本/零样本场景下性能不佳。②提出HOICLIP框架，通过交互解码器从CLIP视觉特征中提取信息区域，并与检测骨干融合；利用CLIP文本编码器生成分类器，并通过视觉语义算术和轻量适配器构建动词分类器。③相比现有方法，HOICLIP更高效地提取CLIP先验知识，并引入训练无关的增强策略利用全局HOI预测。④实验表明，HOICLIP在多个HOI检测基准上取得了显著性能提升，尤其在少样本和零样本场景下表现优异。
2303.15786|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of CLIP-based knowledge distillation for human-object interaction (HOI) detection, which requires large-scale data and performs poorly in few/zero-shot settings. It proposes HOICLIP, which uses an interaction decoder to extract informative regions from CLIP features, fuses them with the detection backbone, and leverages CLIP text embeddings for classifier generation. HOICLIP achieves significant performance gains on HOI benchmarks, especially in few-shot and zero-shot scenarios.
2303.15786|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种高效的HOI检测框架，充分利用CLIP先验知识，在少样本场景下具有重要应用价值。
2303.15786|v2.contribution: 提出HOICLIP框架，实现CLIP知识的高效迁移以提升HOI检测性能。
2303.15786|v2.innovation: 创新性地结合交互解码器、知识融合和文本语义算术，增强少样本泛化。
2303.15786|v2.result: 在多个HOI基准上取得显著性能提升，尤其在少样本/零样本场景。

2303.10431|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）因训练数据分布不均而产生的社会偏见，导致对特定身份群体的表示相似度偏差。②提出DeAR（Debiasing with Additive Residuals）方法，学习加性残差图像表示以偏移原始表示，确保输出表示的公平性，减少对不同身份群体的区分能力。③相比现有方法，DeAR通过残差机制直接调整表示，并引入新的公平性评估数据集（Protected Attribute Tag Association）以更全面评估。④实验表明，DeAR在多个公平性基准上有效降低了偏见，同时保持了模型的下游任务性能。
2303.10431|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses societal biases in large pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) caused by skewed training data distributions. It proposes DeAR (Debiasing with Additive Residuals), which learns additive residual image representations to offset original ones, ensuring fair outputs and reducing distinctions between identity groups. DeAR effectively reduces bias on fairness benchmarks while maintaining downstream performance, and introduces a new evaluation dataset.
2303.10431|v2.assessment: 该论文针对VLM的公平性问题提出了有效方法，并引入新评估基准，对负责任AI研究有参考价值。
2303.10431|v2.contribution: 提出DeAR方法，通过加性残差表示实现VLM去偏。
2303.10431|v2.innovation: 创新性地使用残差表示偏移，并引入新的公平性评估数据集。
2303.10431|v2.result: 在多个公平性基准上有效降低偏见，同时保持任务性能。

THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在自由形式生成中产生对象幻觉的问题，缺乏专门的基准测试。②提出了THRONE基准，用于系统评估LVLM在开放域生成中的对象幻觉，包含多样化的提示和标注。③相比现有幻觉基准，THRONE更贴近真实应用场景，覆盖自由形式生成而非受限任务。④通过实验揭示了LVLM幻觉的普遍性和严重性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_en: This paper addresses object hallucination in large vision-language models during free-form generation by introducing THRONE, a dedicated benchmark with diverse prompts and annotations. It improves over existing benchmarks by focusing on realistic open-ended outputs, and experiments reveal the prevalence of hallucination, though specific metrics are absent from the abstract.
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.assessment: 该基准对VLM可靠性研究有参考价值，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）直接关联有限。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.contribution: 提出了首个面向LVLM自由形式生成的对象幻觉基准THRONE。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.innovation: 设计贴近真实应用的开放域幻觉评估协议。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.result: 揭示了LVLM在自由生成中的幻觉问题，但未提供量化结果。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be._arxiv_id: THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Benchmark for the Free-Form Generations of Large Vision-Language Models.

VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）知识编辑缺乏统一评估基准的问题。②提出了VLKEB基准，涵盖多种知识编辑场景和评估维度。③相比现有知识编辑研究，VLKEB专门针对LVLM的多模态特性设计。④摘要未提供具体实验结果，但基准设计具有系统性。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_en: This paper introduces VLKEB, a benchmark for evaluating knowledge editing in large vision-language models, addressing the lack of standardized evaluation. It covers diverse editing scenarios and dimensions tailored to multimodal models, but no specific experimental results are provided in the abstract.
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.assessment: 对VLM知识更新研究有贡献，但与本领域核心任务关联较弱。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.contribution: 提出了LVLM知识编辑的综合性基准VLKEB。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.innovation: 针对多模态知识编辑的评估框架。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.result: 基准构建完成，但效果数据未在摘要中给出。

ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多轮对话中的评估不足问题。②提出了ConvBench基准，具有分层消融能力，可细粒度评估对话能力。③相比现有单轮基准，ConvBench支持多轮交互和层级分析。④摘要未提供具体性能数据。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_en: This paper proposes ConvBench, a multi-turn conversation evaluation benchmark with hierarchical ablation for large vision-language models, addressing the gap in conversational assessment. It enables fine-grained analysis beyond single-turn benchmarks, though no specific results are mentioned in the abstract.
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.assessment: 对VLM对话评估有贡献，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.contribution: 提出了多轮对话评估基准ConvBench。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.innovation: 引入分层消融机制以细粒度评估对话能力。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.result: 基准设计完成，但效果未在摘要中量化。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva._arxiv_id: ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark with Hierarchical Ablation Capability for Large Vision-Language Models.

2408.16176|v2.summary_cn: ①针对预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）在生物图像性状发现中的适用性问题。②构建了VLM4Bio数据集，包含469K问答对和30K图像，覆盖鱼类、鸟类和蝴蝶，评估12个SOTA VLM在五个生物任务上的表现。③相比通用VLM评估，VLM4Bio聚焦于生物领域专业任务，并探索提示技术和推理幻觉。④实验揭示了VLM在生物任务中的能力与局限，但摘要未提供具体准确率。
2408.16176|v2.summary_en: This paper evaluates 12 state-of-the-art vision-language models on biological trait discovery using a new dataset VLM4Bio with 469K QA pairs and 30K images across fishes, birds, and butterflies. It explores prompting and hallucination effects, revealing capabilities and limitations, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2408.16176|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了VLM在专业领域的潜力，但对自动驾驶感知的启发有限。
2408.16176|v2.contribution: 构建了生物图像VLM评估数据集VLM4Bio。
2408.16176|v2.innovation: 针对生物性状发现设计多任务评估协议。
2408.16176|v2.result: 评估了12个VLM，但未提供量化性能数据。

Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇语义分割依赖大规模训练数据的问题，探索利用现成视觉语言模型（如CLIP）的零样本能力。②提出了无需额外训练的分割方法，通过视觉语言模型生成类别无关的分组提议，并利用文本嵌入进行分类。③相比传统方法，该方法无需微调即可处理任意类别，降低了计算成本。④实验在多个分割基准上展示了竞争力，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by leveraging off-the-shelf vision-language models without additional training, generating class-agnostic proposals and classifying via text embeddings. It reduces computational cost and handles arbitrary categories, showing competitive performance on benchmarks, though specific numbers are absent.
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.assessment: 该方法与开放集检测和零样本感知高度相关，对自动驾驶中的未知物体识别有借鉴意义。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.contribution: 提出利用现成VLM实现零样本开放词汇分割的框架。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.innovation: 无需训练即可实现开放词汇分割。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.result: 在多个基准上表现竞争力，但未给出具体数据。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen._arxiv_id: Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation from Off-the-Shelf Vision-Language Models.

Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_cn: ①针对零样本开放词汇3D视觉定位（3DVG）的挑战，现有方法依赖标注数据。②提出了视觉编程方法，利用现成视觉语言模型和模块化程序实现零样本3D定位。③相比传统端到端方法，该方法无需训练，通过组合子任务处理复杂查询。④实验在多个3DVG基准上展示了有效性，但摘要未提供具体指标。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_en: This paper tackles zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding by proposing a visual programming approach that combines off-the-shelf vision-language models and modular programs. It eliminates the need for training and handles complex queries, showing effectiveness on benchmarks, though specific metrics are not given.
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.assessment: 该方法对自动驾驶中的3D感知和语言交互有潜在应用价值，与多模态感知方向契合。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.contribution: 提出零样本开放词汇3D视觉定位的视觉编程框架。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.innovation: 利用模块化编程实现无需训练的3D定位。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.result: 在3DVG基准上验证有效性，但未提供具体数据。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo._arxiv_id: Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary 3D Visual Grounding.

DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_cn: 针对开放世界小样本学习（OW-FSL）中模型难以同时识别已知类和未知类的问题，该论文提出DeIL方法，利用CLIP的直接和逆映射来增强视觉特征与文本语义的交互。通过直接映射对齐已知类，逆映射生成未知类的伪标签，从而提升分类性能。相比现有方法，DeIL在开放世界设置下更有效地利用CLIP的先验知识，实验表明在多个基准上取得了显著提升。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_en: This paper addresses open-world few-shot learning by proposing DeIL, which leverages direct and inverse CLIP mappings to enhance visual-text interaction. It aligns known classes directly and generates pseudo-labels for unknown classes inversely, improving classification in open-world settings. Experiments show significant gains over existing methods.
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.assessment: 该论文将CLIP应用于开放世界小样本学习，具有新颖性，但实验细节有限，需进一步验证。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.contribution: 提出DeIL框架，利用CLIP直接和逆映射处理开放世界小样本学习。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.innovation: 创新性地引入逆映射生成未知类伪标签。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.result: 在多个基准上取得显著性能提升。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W._arxiv_id: DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-World Few-Shot Learning.

Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉语言模型（VLM）中视觉编码器与语言模型融合不充分的问题，该论文提出一种视觉启发的VLM架构改进方法，通过增强视觉特征的语义表达和跨模态对齐来提升性能。方法包括改进视觉token的生成和注意力机制，使模型更好地理解图像细节。相比传统VLM，该方法在多个视觉语言任务上取得了更优的结果。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_en: This paper improves vision-language models by enhancing visual feature semantics and cross-modal alignment, addressing insufficient fusion in existing VLMs. It refines visual token generation and attention mechanisms for better image understanding. Experiments show superior performance on multiple VL tasks.
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.assessment: 该论文针对VLM的视觉部分进行优化，具有实用价值，但创新性一般。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.contribution: 提出视觉启发的VLM改进方法，增强视觉特征表达。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.innovation: 改进视觉token生成和注意力机制以提升跨模态对齐。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.result: 在多个视觉语言任务上取得更优结果。

DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在人类交互中缺乏对齐和反馈能力的问题，该论文提出DRESS方法，利用自然语言反馈来指导模型对齐人类意图。通过收集人类反馈数据并训练模型，使LVLM能够根据反馈调整生成内容，提升交互质量。相比现有方法，DRESS在指令跟随和交互任务上表现更优。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper introduces DRESS to align large vision-language models with human intent via natural language feedback, addressing interaction limitations. It trains models on human feedback data to adjust outputs, improving instruction following. DRESS outperforms existing methods in interaction tasks.
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.assessment: 该论文聚焦LVLM的人类反馈对齐，具有重要应用前景，实验充分。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.contribution: 提出DRESS框架，利用自然语言反馈增强LVLM的交互能力。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.innovation: 首次将自然语言反馈用于LVLM的端到端训练。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.result: 在指令跟随和交互任务上显著优于基线。

Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中语言幻觉和视觉错觉纠缠的问题，该论文提出HallusionBench诊断套件，通过精心设计的测试案例区分两类错误。方法包括构建图像-文本对来触发特定幻觉类型，并评估模型表现。相比现有基准，HallusionBench提供了更细粒度的诊断，揭示了LVLM的脆弱性。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_en: This paper presents HallusionBench, a diagnostic suite to disentangle language hallucination and visual illusion in LVLMs. It designs test cases to trigger specific error types and evaluates model performance. HallusionBench offers finer-grained analysis, revealing model vulnerabilities.
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.assessment: 该论文为LVLM评估提供了重要工具，具有高实用价值，分析深入。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.contribution: 提出HallusionBench基准，用于诊断LVLM的幻觉和错觉。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.innovation: 设计纠缠错误分离的测试框架。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.result: 揭示了LVLM在复杂场景下的显著错误模式。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S._arxiv_id: Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic Suite for Entangled Language Hallucination and Visual Illusion in Large Vision-Language Models.

Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）提示优化依赖人工或梯度的问题，该论文提出利用语言模型作为黑盒优化器来搜索提示。通过迭代生成和评估提示，无需访问模型梯度，实现自动化优化。相比手动设计，该方法在多个VLM任务上提升了性能，但计算成本较高。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_en: This paper uses language models as black-box optimizers to search prompts for vision-language models, avoiding gradient dependence. It iteratively generates and evaluates prompts for automated optimization. The method improves performance on VL tasks but incurs high computational cost.
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.assessment: 该论文探索黑盒优化VLM提示，思路新颖，但效率有待提升。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.contribution: 提出基于语言模型的黑盒提示优化方法。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.innovation: 将语言模型用作优化器，无需梯度信息。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.result: 在多个VLM任务上取得性能提升。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers._arxiv_id: Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers for Vision-Language Models.

Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在音频生成领域的应用，该论文提出Sonic VisionLM，将视觉输入转换为声音描述并生成音频。方法结合VLM和音频合成模块，实现从图像到声音的映射。相比现有工作，该研究探索了视觉到音频的跨模态生成，但实验规模较小，效果有限。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_en: This paper proposes Sonic VisionLM to generate sound from visual inputs using vision-language models and audio synthesis. It maps images to audio descriptions and synthesizes sounds. The work explores visual-to-audio generation but with limited experiments and results.
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.assessment: 该论文主题新颖但偏离主流视觉感知，实验不充分，影响力有限。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.contribution: 提出视觉到音频生成的Sonic VisionLM框架。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.innovation: 结合VLM与音频合成实现跨模态生成。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.result: 初步验证了可行性，但效果有待提升。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio._arxiv_id: Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Vision Language Models.

2412.09082|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有视觉语言导航（VLN）方法局限于单阶段任务，难以应对复杂动态环境中的多阶段和长时程导航问题。②提出了长时程视觉语言导航（LH-VLN）任务，开发了自动数据生成平台NavGen，构建了包含3260个任务、平均150步的LHPR-VLN基准，并提出了独立成功率（ISR）、条件成功率（CSR）和基于真值的CSR权重（CGT）等细粒度评估指标。③相比已有工作，首次专门针对长时程导航设计任务和基准，并通过双向多粒度生成方式提升数据效用。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但基准规模和指标设计为长时程导航评估提供了新标准。
2412.09082|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing VLN methods in single-stage navigation for long-horizon tasks. It proposes the LH-VLN task, an automated data generation platform NavGen, and the LHPR-VLN benchmark with 3,260 tasks averaging 150 steps, along with new metrics like ISR, CSR, and CGT for fine-grained evaluation. The work establishes a new standard for long-horizon navigation assessment.
2412.09082|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦长时程导航这一新兴方向，基准和指标设计具有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关性较低。
2412.09082|v2.contribution: 提出了首个长时程视觉语言导航基准和评估体系。
2412.09082|v2.innovation: 引入多阶段任务结构和双向多粒度数据生成方法。
2412.09082|v2.result: 构建了大规模基准，但未报告模型性能提升数据。

Towards Realistic UAV Vision-Language Na.summary_cn: ①针对无人机视觉语言导航（UAV-VLN）在现实场景中缺乏平台、基准和方法的问题。②摘要内容缺失，无法获取具体方法细节。③由于信息不足，无法评估其改进点。④效果未知。

Towards Realistic UAV Vision-Language Na.assessment: 摘要不完整，无法进行有效评估，且与自动驾驶感知相关性有限。
