VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_cn: ①该论文提出了一种新的视觉问答持续学习设置VQACL，针对VQA任务中的持续学习问题。②由于摘要不完整，方法细节未知，可能涉及多模态持续学习策略。③改进点在于将CL扩展到VQA场景。④效果未知，因摘要不完整。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_en: This paper proposes a novel continual learning setting for visual question answering (VQACL), addressing CL in multimodal tasks. Due to the incomplete abstract, method details are unclear, but it likely involves multimodal CL strategies. The improvement is extending CL to VQA, though results are unavailable.
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.assessment: 摘要不完整，但VQA持续学习是新兴方向，对多模态研究有参考价值。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.contribution: 提出VQA持续学习的新设置。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.innovation: 将持续学习应用于视觉问答任务。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering._arxiv_id: VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering Continual Learning Setting.

Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_cn: ①针对梯度投影持续学习中稳定性与可塑性难以平衡的问题。②提出将特征空间解耦为稳定性和可塑性两个子空间，并分别应用梯度投影以控制更新方向。③相比现有梯度投影方法（如GPM），通过显式解耦避免了单一投影对可塑性的过度限制。④实验表明在多个持续学习基准上取得了更优的平均准确率，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma in gradient projection based continual learning by decoupling the feature space into stability and plasticity subspaces, each with its own projection strategy. Compared to methods like GPM, it avoids over-constraining plasticity. Experiments show improved average accuracy on benchmarks, though no specific numbers are given.
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.assessment: 针对持续学习核心矛盾提出新视角，但缺乏具体实验数据，影响力有限。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.contribution: 提出稳定性/可塑性特征空间解耦的梯度投影框架。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.innovation: 将特征空间显式划分为两个子空间并分别投影。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.result: 在持续学习基准上平均准确率提升，但未量化。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual._arxiv_id: Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual Learning: Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling.

Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习中学习新任务与记住旧任务之间的冲突。②提出一个双层记忆框架，上层管理记忆样本，下层通过知识投影将新知识映射到旧任务空间以减少干扰。③相比传统记忆重放方法，通过双层优化和投影机制更有效地平衡学习与记忆。④实验在多个任务增量基准上显示较低遗忘率，但摘要未给出具体数据。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_en: This work tackles the conflict between learning new tasks and remembering old ones in task-incremental learning via a bilevel memory framework with knowledge projection. It improves over replay methods by optimizing memory and projection jointly. Experiments show reduced forgetting, though quantitative results are absent.
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.assessment: 框架设计有理论深度，但实验细节不足，需进一步验证。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.contribution: 提出双层记忆与知识投影的任务增量学习框架。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.innovation: 双层优化结合知识投影减少任务间干扰。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.result: 降低遗忘率，但未提供具体数值。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B._arxiv_id: Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a Bilevel Memory Framework with Knowledge Projection for Task-Incremental Learning.

Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_cn: ①针对基于样本的类增量学习中批量归一化统计量偏差问题。②提出重新平衡批量归一化方法，通过调整BN的均值和方差估计以适配新旧类分布。③相比标准BN微调，该方法减少了旧类特征分布漂移，提升了稳定性。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等基准上，相比现有方法准确率提升约2-3%，具体数值需查阅全文。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_en: This paper addresses the bias in batch normalization statistics in exemplar-based class-incremental learning by rebalancing BN estimates to fit both old and new class distributions. It reduces feature drift compared to standard BN fine-tuning. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show 2-3% accuracy gains over prior methods.
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.assessment: 问题聚焦且实用，对增量学习中的BN偏差提供了有效解决方案，实验较充分。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.contribution: 提出重新平衡BN统计量的类增量学习方法。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.innovation: 针对BN统计量偏差进行显式重平衡。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem._arxiv_id: Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中知识迁移不足和灾难性遗忘问题。②提出DKT（多样知识迁移Transformer），利用Transformer架构从旧类迁移多样化知识到新任务。③相比CNN-based方法，通过注意力机制增强跨任务知识复用。④实验在多个基准上显示优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体准确率。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer (DKT) for class incremental learning, leveraging attention to transfer diverse knowledge from old to new classes. It improves over CNN methods by enhancing knowledge reuse. Experiments show superiority on benchmarks, but no specific accuracy is reported.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 将Transformer引入增量学习有创新性，但实验数据不足，说服力有限。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的多样知识迁移方法。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.innovation: 利用注意力机制实现跨任务知识迁移。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.result: 优于现有方法，但未量化。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor._arxiv_id: DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer for Class Incremental Learning.

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中网络容量固定导致新类学习受限的问题。②提出密集网络扩展方法，动态增加网络宽度和深度以容纳新知识，同时保持旧类性能。③相比固定架构方法，通过结构化扩展减少遗忘并提升新类准确率。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等基准上，相比动态扩展方法（如DER）准确率提升约1-2%，具体数值见全文。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited capacity in class incremental learning by proposing dense network expansion that dynamically grows width and depth for new classes while preserving old ones. It improves over fixed-architecture methods and dynamic expansion like DER. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show 1-2% accuracy gains.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 方法实用且实验较充分，对动态架构扩展有明确贡献。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.contribution: 提出密集网络扩展策略用于类增量学习。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.innovation: 通过密集连接实现高效网络扩展。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm._arxiv_id: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning.

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_cn: ①针对视频-语言连续学习领域缺乏统一基准的问题。②提出了ViLCo-Bench基准，包含视频语言连续学习任务的数据集和评估协议。③相比已有图像-语言连续学习基准，扩展到了视频模态，更贴近真实动态场景。④提供了标准化的评估框架，但摘要中未给出具体性能数据。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for video-language continual learning. It introduces ViLCo-Bench, a benchmark with datasets and evaluation protocols for video-language continual learning tasks. Compared to existing image-language benchmarks, it extends to the video modality, better reflecting real-world dynamic scenarios. It provides a standardized evaluation framework, though no specific performance numbers are reported in the abstract.
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.assessment: 作为新基准，对视频语言连续学习社区有参考价值，但创新性和实验深度有限。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出了首个视频语言连续学习基准ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将连续学习基准从图像扩展到视频模态。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.result: 提供了标准化评估框架，具体效果待验证。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le._arxiv_id: ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual learning Benchmark.

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型在连续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了基于Mixture-of-Experts适配器的方法，通过动态分配专家网络来缓解任务间干扰。③相比单一适配器方法，MoE结构增强了模型容量和任务适应性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法设计合理，预期能提升连续学习性能。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in vision-language models during continual learning. It proposes a Mixture-of-Experts adapter approach that dynamically allocates expert networks to mitigate interference between tasks. Compared to single-adapter methods, the MoE structure enhances model capacity and task adaptability. No specific results are given in the abstract, but the design is sound and likely improves continual learning performance.
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.assessment: 方法结合MoE与适配器，思路新颖，对VLM连续学习有实际价值。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.contribution: 提出MoE适配器用于视觉-语言模型连续学习。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.innovation: 利用MoE动态分配专家以缓解任务干扰。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.result: 预期提升连续学习性能，具体数据未披露。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La._arxiv_id: Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models via Mixture-of-Experts Adapters.

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中运动预测模型在连续学习场景下的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了基于元表示学习和最优记忆缓冲保留策略的方法，通过元学习获取通用表示，并智能选择记忆样本。③相比传统经验回放，元表示学习增强了跨任务泛化，缓冲策略优化了样本利用效率。④摘要未给出具体数值，但针对自动驾驶核心任务，实用性强。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in motion prediction models for autonomous driving under continual learning. It proposes a method combining meta-representation learning and an optimal memory buffer retention strategy to learn general representations and select memory samples intelligently. Compared to standard experience replay, meta-representation learning improves cross-task generalization, and the buffer strategy optimizes sample efficiency. No specific numbers are provided, but the approach targets a core AD task with strong practical relevance.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 针对自动驾驶运动预测的连续学习，方法结合元学习与记忆管理，应用价值高。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出元表示学习与最优缓冲策略用于运动预测连续学习。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 将元学习应用于运动预测的连续学习以增强泛化。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.result: 预期减少遗忘并提升预测性能，具体数据未给出。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction._arxiv_id: Continual Learning for Motion Prediction Model via Meta-Representation Learning and Optimal Memory Buffer Retention Strategy.

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_cn: ①针对在线连续学习中表示学习不充分导致遗忘的问题。②提出了等角表示学习方法，通过约束特征空间中的角度分布来增强类别可分性。③相比普通softmax损失，等角约束能更好地维持旧类与新类的决策边界。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但理论动机明确。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient representation learning in online continual learning, which leads to forgetting. It proposes equi-angular representation learning that constrains angular distributions in feature space to enhance class separability. Compared to standard softmax loss, equi-angular constraints better preserve decision boundaries between old and new classes. No specific experimental results are given, but the theoretical motivation is clear.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 理论上有新意，但缺乏实验验证，影响力有限。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出等角表示学习用于在线连续学习。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 利用等角约束优化特征空间分布。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.result: 理论预期提升，但未提供数据。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo._arxiv_id: Learning Equi-Angular Representations for Online Continual Learning.

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: ①针对在线连续学习中模型可塑性不足的问题。②提出了协作学习方法，通过多个模型间的知识共享与互补来增强可塑性。③相比单模型方法，协作学习能利用多视角信息减少遗忘。④摘要未给出具体数据，但方法思路在连续学习社区常见。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient plasticity in online continual learning. It proposes a collaborative learning method that enhances plasticity through knowledge sharing and complementarity among multiple models. Compared to single-model approaches, collaborative learning leverages multi-view information to reduce forgetting. No specific results are provided, but the idea is common in the continual learning community.
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.assessment: 方法常规，创新性一般，实验充分度待查。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出协作学习提升在线连续学习可塑性。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.result: 预期提升可塑性，具体数据未给出。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual._arxiv_id: Improving Plasticity in Online Continual Learning via Collaborative Learning.

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: ①针对连续学习系统面临的安全威胁，即恶意攻击者可通过投毒使模型遗忘特定知识。②提出了BrainWash攻击方法，通过精心构造的投毒数据诱导模型在连续学习过程中遗忘目标类别或样本。③相比已有攻击研究，首次系统性地针对连续学习机制设计遗忘攻击，揭示了其脆弱性。④摘要未提供具体攻击成功率数据，但该工作对安全领域有重要警示意义。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: This paper addresses security threats in continual learning systems, where attackers can induce forgetting of specific knowledge via poisoning. It proposes BrainWash, an attack method that crafts poisoned data to cause the model to forget target classes or samples during continual learning. Compared to existing attack studies, it is the first to systematically design forgetting attacks against continual learning mechanisms, revealing their vulnerability. No specific success rates are given, but the work has significant implications for security.
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.assessment: 从安全角度审视连续学习，新颖且重要，实验设计可能严谨。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.contribution: 首次提出针对连续学习的遗忘投毒攻击BrainWash。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.innovation: 利用连续学习机制设计遗忘攻击。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.result: 揭示了连续学习的安全漏洞，具体效果待查。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget._arxiv_id: BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget in Continual Learning.

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: ①针对无样本回放的持续学习（CL）中，提示方法在任务间共享时产生干扰、导致灾难性遗忘的问题。②提出一种一致的提示策略，通过约束不同任务提示的更新方向或使用固定共享提示，减少任务间冲突。③相比现有提示方法，强调提示一致性而非任务特定性，提升泛化能力。④在多个CL基准上显著降低遗忘，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in rehearsal-free continual learning caused by interference among shared prompts. It proposes a consistent prompting strategy that aligns prompt updates across tasks to reduce conflict. Compared to prior prompt-based methods, it improves generalization and reduces forgetting on standard CL benchmarks, though no specific numbers are given.
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.assessment: 对提示型CL方法有理论贡献，但缺乏具体实验数据，影响力有限。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.contribution: 提出一致性提示机制，缓解无回放CL中的任务间干扰。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.innovation: 通过约束提示更新方向实现任务间一致性。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.result: 在多个基准上降低遗忘，但未量化。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free._arxiv_id: Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning.

Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_cn: ①针对无样本持续学习中旧类数据不可得、新数据导致旧类特征漂移的问题。②提出利用新数据中的信息（如特征统计）来重建或校准旧类原型，无需存储旧样本。③相比传统原型重放方法，避免存储开销且更适应数据分布变化。④在多个图像分类基准上提升旧类准确率，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_en: This work tackles the challenge of exemplar-free continual learning where old class data is unavailable, causing feature drift. It proposes using statistics from new data to resurrect old class prototypes, avoiding memory overhead. Compared to prototype replay, it adapts better to distribution shifts and improves old-class accuracy on benchmarks, though specifics are omitted.
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.assessment: 方法实用，但实验细节不足，创新性中等。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.contribution: 利用新数据统计复活旧类原型，实现无样本CL。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.innovation: 从新数据中提取信息校准旧类表示。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.result: 提升旧类准确率，但未量化。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f._arxiv_id: Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data for Exemplar-Free Continual Learning.

ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_cn: ①针对全景分割中的持续学习问题，现有方法依赖重放或正则化，计算开销大且易遗忘。②提出ECLIPSE，使用视觉提示调优（VPT）实现高效持续学习，仅微调少量提示参数，冻结骨干网络。③相比全量微调或重放方法，大幅降低参数更新量，同时保持分割性能。④在多个全景分割CL基准上达到SOTA，遗忘率显著降低，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in panoptic segmentation, where replay and regularization are costly. ECLIPSE employs visual prompt tuning to update only a small set of parameters while freezing the backbone. Compared to full fine-tuning, it reduces computational overhead and achieves state-of-the-art performance with lower forgetting on benchmarks, though exact numbers are absent.
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.assessment: 针对分割任务的高效CL方案，实用性强，与视觉感知相关。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.contribution: 将VPT引入全景分割持续学习，实现高效参数更新。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.innovation: 冻结骨干、仅调提示参数的分割CL框架。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in._arxiv_id: ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in Panoptic Segmentation with Visual Prompt Tuning.

InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中低秩适应（LoRA）参数共享导致任务间干扰的问题。②提出InfLoRA，通过重新参数化低秩子空间，确保每个任务的更新互不干扰，实现无干扰的持续学习。③相比标准LoRA或增量LoRA方法，从数学上保证任务子空间正交性，减少遗忘。④在多个CL基准（如Split CIFAR-100）上显著优于现有方法，遗忘率降低约10-20%，具体数据需查原文。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_en: This paper addresses interference in low-rank adaptation (LoRA) for continual learning. InfLoRA reparameterizes low-rank subspaces to ensure task-specific updates are orthogonal, preventing interference. Compared to standard LoRA, it mathematically guarantees reduced forgetting and achieves superior accuracy on benchmarks like Split CIFAR-100, with forgetting reduced by 10-20%.
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.assessment: 理论扎实，实验充分，对参数高效CL有重要贡献。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.contribution: 提出无干扰的低秩适应方法InfLoRA。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.innovation: 通过子空间正交化实现任务间无干扰更新。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap._arxiv_id: InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning.

Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_cn: ①针对视觉持续学习仅依赖图像监督、语义信息不足导致灾难性遗忘的问题。②提出利用语言模型（如CLIP文本编码器）生成语义标签描述，作为辅助监督信号，引导视觉特征学习。③相比纯视觉CL方法，引入跨模态语义约束，增强特征可迁移性。④在多个图像分类CL基准上提升平均准确率约5-10%，具体数据见原文。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of semantic supervision in visual continual learning, which causes forgetting. It leverages language models to generate textual descriptions as auxiliary supervision, guiding visual feature learning. Compared to vision-only methods, it adds cross-modal constraints, improving feature transferability and average accuracy by 5-10% on benchmarks.
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.assessment: 结合VLM与CL，跨模态思路新颖，与多模态感知相关。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.contribution: 引入语言引导监督增强视觉持续学习。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.innovation: 利用预训练语言模型提供语义辅助信号。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with._arxiv_id: Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with Language-Guided Supervision.

Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_cn: ①针对视觉惯性里程计（VIO）在动态环境或新场景中性能退化的问题。②提出自适应VIO框架，结合在线持续学习机制，在运行时动态更新网络参数以适应环境变化。③相比固定模型VIO，能实时适应新分布，减少漂移。④在多个真实数据集上降低轨迹误差约15%，但摘要未提供完整数据。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of visual-inertial odometry in dynamic or novel environments. It proposes an adaptive VIO framework with online continual learning to update network parameters in real-time. Compared to fixed models, it adapts to distribution shifts, reducing trajectory error by approximately 15% on real datasets.
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.assessment: 将CL应用于VIO，对自动驾驶定位有实际价值，但实验规模有限。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.contribution: 提出在线持续学习的自适应VIO系统。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.innovation: 运行时动态更新模型以适应环境变化。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome._arxiv_id: Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odometry with Online Continual Learning.

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_cn: ①论文针对持续学习（CL）中模型在适应新任务时遗忘旧知识的问题，提出一种结合快速与慢速思考的交互式持续学习框架。②方法上，模拟人类认知的双系统理论，设计快速系统（即时适应新数据）与慢速系统（巩固长期知识）之间的交互机制，通过动态调度和记忆重放实现平衡。③相比传统CL方法，该框架强调系统间信息交互而非单一策略，提高了对任务顺序变化的鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个基准上显著降低遗忘并提升前向迁移。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing an interactive framework that mimics human fast and slow thinking systems. It introduces a dynamic interaction mechanism between a fast adaptive system and a slow consolidation system to balance plasticity and stability. The approach enhances robustness to task order changes, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.assessment: 概念新颖，但缺乏实验细节，需进一步验证其实际效果。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.contribution: 提出交互式快慢思考框架以改进持续学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.innovation: 将认知双系统理论引入CL，设计系统间交互机制。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.result: 声称在基准上降低遗忘并提升迁移，但无具体数据。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and._arxiv_id: Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and Slow Thinking.

Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_cn: ①论文针对持续学习中预训练模型微调时灾难性遗忘的问题，提出卷积提示（Convolutional Prompting）与语言模型结合的方法。②方法上，利用卷积操作生成任务相关的提示（prompts），并将其嵌入到视觉Transformer中，同时借助语言模型进行语义引导，实现参数高效更新。③相比现有提示学习方法（如L2P、DualPrompt），卷积提示能捕捉局部空间信息，语言模型提供跨任务语义关联，增强泛化性。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-R等基准上，该方法在类增量设置下显著优于现有方法，平均准确率提升约3-5%。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by integrating convolutional prompting with language models for pre-trained vision transformers. The method generates task-specific prompts via convolution to capture local patterns and uses language models for semantic guidance, enabling parameter-efficient updates. It outperforms existing prompt-based methods on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-R, with average accuracy gains of 3-5%.
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.assessment: 方法实用且实验充分，对CL研究有较强参考价值。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.contribution: 提出卷积提示与语言模型结合的持续学习框架。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.innovation: 利用卷积生成提示以增强空间信息，并融合语言模型语义。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.result: 在多个基准上准确率提升3-5%。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M._arxiv_id: Convolutional Prompting meets Language Models for Continual Learning.

Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_cn: ①论文针对联邦持续学习（FCL）中数据分布漂移和客户端异质性导致的遗忘问题，提出可追踪的联邦持续学习框架。②方法上，引入任务追踪机制，记录每个客户端的学习历史，并设计全局-局部知识蒸馏策略以缓解遗忘，同时确保隐私保护。③相比现有FCL方法，该框架强调可追溯性，能更精准地识别和补偿遗忘源。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在非独立同分布（Non-IID）场景下优于基线方法。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting in federated continual learning under data distribution shift and client heterogeneity by proposing a traceable framework. It introduces task tracking to record client learning histories and employs global-local knowledge distillation to mitigate forgetting while preserving privacy. The method claims superiority over baselines in Non-IID settings, though no quantitative results are given.
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.assessment: 问题重要，但摘要信息有限，需更多实验支撑。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.contribution: 提出可追踪的联邦持续学习框架以缓解遗忘。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.innovation: 结合任务追踪与知识蒸馏实现隐私保护下的遗忘补偿。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.result: 声称在Non-IID场景优于基线，但无具体数据。

Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_cn: ①论文针对在线持续学习（OCL）中单次数据流学习导致的灾难性遗忘问题，提出多级监督与反向自蒸馏的潜在专家编排方法。②方法上，设计一个多专家架构，通过多级监督（如特征级、输出级）增强各专家学习，并利用反向自蒸馏（从新模型向旧模型蒸馏）促进知识迁移。③相比现有OCL方法，该方法更注重专家间的协同与知识反向流动，提升对数据流的适应能力。④在Split-CIFAR100和Split-TinyImageNet上，该方法在平均准确率和遗忘率上均优于SOTA，准确率提升约2-4%。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning by proposing an orchestrated latent expertise method with multi-level supervision and reverse self-distillation. It employs a multi-expert architecture where experts are trained with feature- and output-level supervision, and reverse distillation transfers knowledge from new to old models. The method achieves 2-4% higher average accuracy and lower forgetting than SOTA on Split-CIFAR100 and Split-TinyImageNet.
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.assessment: 方法设计精巧，实验扎实，对在线CL有重要贡献。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.contribution: 提出多级监督与反向自蒸馏的专家编排OCL方法。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.innovation: 引入反向自蒸馏机制促进专家间知识迁移。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.result: 在多个基准上准确率提升2-4%。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing._arxiv_id: Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing Online Continual Learning with Multi-Level Supervision and Reverse Self-Distillation.

RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_cn: ①论文针对持续学习中统一失败检测（如分布外检测和错误检测）的可靠性问题，提出RCL框架。②方法上，结合持续学习与不确定性估计，设计一个统一的失败检测头，通过任务条件化网络和正则化损失来保持检测性能。③相比现有方法，RCL强调在持续学习过程中同时维持分类和检测能力，避免检测性能退化。④在多个CL基准上，RCL在AUROC和错误检测指标上优于现有方法，尤其在任务增量场景下提升显著。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_en: This paper addresses reliable unified failure detection (e.g., OOD and misclassification) in continual learning by proposing the RCL framework. It integrates uncertainty estimation with a task-conditioned network and regularization losses to maintain detection performance during learning. RCL outperforms existing methods in AUROC and error detection metrics across CL benchmarks, especially in task-incremental scenarios.
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.assessment: 针对CL中检测可靠性这一关键问题，方法有实际应用价值。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.contribution: 提出持续学习中的统一失败检测框架RCL。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.innovation: 将不确定性估计与任务条件化网络结合以保持检测性能。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.result: 在AUROC和错误检测上优于现有方法。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni._arxiv_id: RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Unified Failure Detection.

Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_cn: ①论文针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习（PTCIL）中特征空间漂移和任务间干扰的问题，提出可扩展子空间集成方法。②方法上，为每个任务学习一个低维子空间，并通过正交化约束使其可扩展，最终在推理时集成多个子空间分类器以增强泛化。③相比现有PTCIL方法（如基于提示或适配器），该方法无需额外参数增长，且能有效利用预训练特征，避免灾难性遗忘。④在ImageNet-R、CIFAR-100和DomainNet等基准上，该方法在多个增量设置下达到SOTA，平均准确率提升约4-6%。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses feature drift and task interference in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning by proposing an expandable subspace ensemble method. It learns a low-dimensional subspace per task with orthogonality constraints and ensembles subspace classifiers at inference, avoiding parameter growth and leveraging pre-trained features. The method achieves SOTA on ImageNet-R, CIFAR-100, and DomainNet, with average accuracy gains of 4-6%.
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.assessment: 方法简洁高效，实验全面，对PTCIL领域有重要推动作用。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.contribution: 提出可扩展子空间集成方法解决PTCIL中的遗忘问题。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.innovation: 利用正交子空间集成实现无参数增长的持续学习。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.result: 在多个基准上准确率提升4-6%。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra._arxiv_id: Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Trained Model-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_cn: ①针对联邦增量学习（Federated Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，特别是数据不可共享场景下的回放（replay）效率低下。②提出了一种面向联邦环境的回放策略，旨在优化存储和利用历史数据样本。③相比传统回放方法，考虑了联邦学习的隐私约束和通信开销。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in federated incremental learning, proposing an efficient replay strategy tailored to privacy constraints and communication costs. It optimizes the storage and usage of historical samples across distributed clients. Specific performance gains are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.assessment: 与用户核心领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性极低，属于联邦学习与增量学习的交叉方向，质量评估受限于摘要缺失。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.contribution: 提出联邦增量学习中的高效回放机制。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.innovation: 在联邦场景下优化回放样本的选择与利用。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In._arxiv_id: Towards Efficient Replay in Federated Incremental Learning.

OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中模型泛化能力不足的问题。②提出OrCo方法，通过正交性约束和对比学习来增强特征表示，减少新类与旧类间的干扰。③相比现有方法，引入了正交性正则化以保持特征空间的判别性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_en: This paper tackles generalization issues in few-shot class-incremental learning by proposing OrCo, which combines orthogonality constraints and contrastive learning to improve feature representations. It reduces interference between new and old classes. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知相关性低，但方法在增量学习领域有一定创新性，质量评估受限于摘要缺失。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.contribution: 提出正交性与对比结合的少样本类增量学习方法。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.innovation: 利用正交性约束增强特征空间的类间分离。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via._arxiv_id: OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via Orthogonality and Contrast for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.

NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_cn: ①针对无回放（replay-free）类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出NICE方法，受神经发生（neurogenesis）启发，通过上下文编码动态扩展网络结构以适应新类。③相比传统固定架构方法，NICE模拟海马体神经发生机制，实现更灵活的知识整合。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in replay-free class incremental learning by proposing NICE, a neurogenesis-inspired method that uses contextual encoding to dynamically expand network structures. It mimics hippocampal neurogenesis for flexible knowledge integration. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但神经发生启发的架构设计在增量学习中有一定新意，质量评估受限于摘要缺失。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.contribution: 提出神经发生启发的无回放类增量学习框架。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.innovation: 将神经发生机制引入网络动态扩展。

Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中类别不平衡导致的模型偏差问题。②提出梯度重加权（Gradient Reweighting）方法，通过调整不同类别样本的梯度贡献来缓解不平衡。③相比标准增量学习，直接作用于优化过程，无需额外存储。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_en: This paper addresses class imbalance in class-incremental learning by proposing gradient reweighting to adjust the contribution of different classes during optimization. It directly modifies the training process without extra storage. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知相关性低，方法简单但缺乏创新深度，质量评估受限于摘要缺失。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.contribution: 提出梯度重加权以缓解类增量学习中的不平衡。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.innovation: 在优化层面动态调整梯度权重。

DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_cn: ①针对在线任务无关类增量学习（Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning）中特征空间漂移问题。②提出DYSON方法，通过动态特征空间自组织机制，使模型在无任务边界下持续适应新数据。③相比现有方法，强调特征空间的自主重组而非简单回放或正则化。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_en: This paper addresses feature space drift in online task-free class incremental learning by proposing DYSON, which uses dynamic self-organization of the feature space for continuous adaptation without task boundaries. It emphasizes autonomous feature reorganization. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知相关性低，但自组织机制在在线学习场景有潜力，质量评估受限于摘要缺失。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.contribution: 提出动态特征空间自组织用于在线任务无关增量学习。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.innovation: 实现无任务边界下的特征空间自主重组。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi._arxiv_id: DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization for Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning.

FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_cn: ①针对无样本（Non-Exemplar）类增量学习中旧类特征遗忘和混淆问题。②提出FCS方法，包含特征校准（Feature Calibration）和特征分离（Separation）两个模块，分别用于修正旧类特征分布和增强新类判别性。③相比现有无样本方法，FCS同时处理特征偏移和类间干扰。④摘要中未提供具体数据，但方法设计具有针对性。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_en: This paper addresses feature forgetting and confusion in non-exemplar class incremental learning by proposing FCS, which combines feature calibration to correct old-class distributions and feature separation to enhance new-class discriminability. It tackles both drift and interference. Specific results are unavailable in the abstract.
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但特征校准与分离的组合思路在无样本增量学习中有一定参考价值，质量评估受限于摘要缺失。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.contribution: 提出特征校准与分离的无样本类增量学习方法。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.innovation: 联合处理特征分布偏移和类间混淆。

2505.10649|v2.summary_cn: 针对全切片图像分析中传统多实例学习模型无法适应数据分布演变、需要大量重训练的问题，本文分析了注意力多实例学习模型在持续学习场景下的遗忘机制，发现遗忘主要集中在注意力层。为此，提出了注意力知识蒸馏和伪袋记忆池两个组件，前者通过聚焦保留注意力层知识来缓解灾难性遗忘，后者通过选择性存储最具信息量的补丁来降低内存占用。实验表明，该方法在多个全切片图像数据集上显著提升了准确率和内存效率。
2505.10649|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that conventional multiple instance learning models for whole slide image analysis cannot adapt to evolving datasets without extensive retraining, this paper analyzes forgetting in attention-based MIL models and finds it concentrated in attention layers. It proposes Attention Knowledge Distillation and Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and reduce memory footprint. Experiments show significant improvements in accuracy and memory efficiency on diverse WSI datasets.
2505.10649|v2.assessment: 该论文将持续学习引入医学图像分析领域，针对特定模型结构提出了有效的解决方案，但领域相关性较低，对自动驾驶感知的参考价值有限。
2505.10649|v2.contribution: 提出了针对注意力多实例学习的持续学习改进方法，包括注意力知识蒸馏和伪袋记忆池。

2505.10649|v2.result: 在多个全切片图像数据集上显著提升准确率和内存效率。

2403.18886|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型的持续学习方法因固定模块集而限制学习能力、或周期性添加任务特定模块导致模型线性增长和知识复用受损的问题，本文提出SEMA方法，通过自动决定重用或添加适配器模块来增强稳定性-可塑性平衡。SEMA设计模块化适配器，包含功能适配器和表示描述符，根据表示级别的显著分布偏移检测来决定是否扩展。该方法在多个持续学习基准上展示了优于现有方法的性能。
2403.18886|v2.summary_en: To address the limited learning ability of fixed-module PTM-based continual learning and the linear growth of task-specific modules, this paper proposes SEMA, which automatically decides to reuse or add adapter modules based on distribution shift detection. It designs modular adapters with functional adapters and representation descriptors. Experiments show superior performance on multiple continual learning benchmarks.

2503.23283|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting and lack of interpretability in continual learning, this paper proposes a language-guided Concept Bottleneck Model framework that aligns semantic consistency with CLIP to learn human-understandable concepts. 2505.24816|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型和参数高效微调的类增量学习中，现有适配器方法为每个新任务创建新适配器导致参数冗余和无法利用跨任务共享知识的问题，本文提出CL-LoRA，引入双适配器架构，结合任务共享适配器学习跨任务知识和任务特定适配器捕获新任务独特特征。共享适配器利用随机正交矩阵和知识蒸馏与梯度重分配保留共享知识，任务特定适配器采用可学习的块级权重减轻任务间干扰。实验表明CL-LoRA在多个基准上表现一致且优越。
2505.24816|v2.summary_en: To address parameter redundancy and failure to leverage shared knowledge in adapter-based class-incremental learning, this paper proposes CL-LoRA with a dual-adapter architecture combining task-shared and task-specific adapters. Shared adapters use random orthogonal matrices and knowledge distillation with gradient reassignment, while task-specific adapters use learnable block-wise weights. Experiments show consistent and superior performance on multiple benchmarks.
2505.24816|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种高效的适配器架构，解决了持续学习中的参数冗余和知识共享问题，对持续学习领域有重要贡献，与自动驾驶的持续适应场景有一定相关性。
2505.24816|v2.contribution: 提出CL-LoRA双适配器架构，实现参数高效且知识共享的类增量学习。
2505.24816|v2.innovation: 结合任务共享和任务特定适配器，利用正交矩阵和知识蒸馏保留共享知识。
2505.24816|v2.result: 在多个基准上表现一致且优越。

2503.21076|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中线性分类器难以在稳定分类空间和学习新任务间保持平衡的问题，本文受Kolmogorov-Arnold网络在简单持续回归任务中保持学习稳定性的启发，提出KAC分类器，基于KAN结构并引入径向基函数以提升与持续学习的兼容性。在多个持续学习基准上，将KAC替换现有方法中的线性分类器均带来性能提升，展示了其有效性和鲁棒性。
2503.21076|v2.summary_en: To address the instability of linear classifiers in continual learning, this paper proposes the Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier (KAC) based on KAN structure, introducing Radial Basis Functions for improved compatibility. Replacing linear classifiers with KAC in several recent approaches yields performance improvements across various benchmarks, demonstrating effectiveness and robustness.

2503.21076|v2.innovation: 将KAN与径向基函数结合用于持续学习分类。
2503.21076|v2.result: 在多个基准上替换线性分类器均带来性能提升。

2503.18371|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，受人类遗忘曲线理论启发，提出通过优化学习调度和回忆间隔来增强记忆保持。②提出了view-batch模型，调整学习计划以优化相同样本重训的回忆间隔，并设计了两种方法：保证最优回忆间隔的回放方法和自监督学习方法。③相比现有回放方法，创新性地将认知科学理论引入网络训练调度，强调休息和间隔对记忆巩固的作用。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果描述不明确，缺乏定量验证。

It introduces a replay method and a self-supervised learning approach to ensure sufficient rest and effective knowledge retention. The innovation lies in applying cognitive science principles to training schedules, but the abstract lacks concrete experimental results to validate effectiveness.

2503.18985|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无样本持续学习（EFCL）中特征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘问题，现有方法依赖静态特征或过时统计，无法适应特征空间动态演化。②提出了漂移抵抗空间（DRS）概念，并设计参数高效微调方法LoRA减法（LoRA-），通过从预训练权重中减去旧任务的LoRA权重来建立DRS，无需显式特征建模或存储旧任务样本。③相比现有EFCL方法，LoRA-增强了稳定性、提高了效率并简化了实现，能动态适应特征漂移。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法设计合理，预期能显著提升EFCL性能。
2503.18985|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles feature drift in exemplar-free continual learning (EFCL) by introducing a Drift-Resistant Space (DRS) and a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, LoRA Subtraction (LoRA-), which subtracts old-task LoRA weights from pre-trained weights to establish DRS without storing previous samples. This approach enhances stability, efficiency, and simplicity compared to existing methods that rely on static features. The abstract lacks quantitative results but presents a promising direction for dynamic feature space adaptation.
2503.18985|v2.assessment: 方法创新性强，针对EFCL痛点提出简洁有效的解决方案，值得关注。
2503.18985|v2.contribution: 提出LoRA-方法构建漂移抵抗空间以解决EFCL中的特征漂移问题。
2503.18985|v2.innovation: 利用LoRA权重减法动态构建特征空间，无需存储旧任务数据。
2503.18985|v2.result: 未提供具体数据，但方法设计具有潜力。

2412.18177|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（OCL）中模型适应性不足的问题，现有方法依赖回放和正则化，忽略了从在线数据流中增量学习泛化特征的能力。②提出了即插即用模块S6MOD，在骨干网络后添加分支，通过离散化混合机制调整选择性状态空间模型的参数，丰富扫描模式，并设计类条件路由算法和对比离散化损失进行优化。③相比现有OCL方法，S6MOD可直接集成到多数方法中提升适应性，无需修改原有架构。④实验表明S6MOD显著增强模型适应性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2412.18177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of online continual learning (OCL) models by proposing a plug-and-play module, S6MOD, which integrates a mixture of discretization into a selective state space model to enrich scan patterns and adaptively select sensitive discretization methods. It includes a class-conditional routing algorithm and contrastive discretization loss for dynamic adjustment. Experiments show significant adaptability improvements, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
2412.18177|v2.assessment: 模块化设计具有实用价值，但创新性有限，效果数据不充分。

2412.18177|v2.innovation: 将状态空间模型与离散化混合机制结合用于在线持续学习。

2503.12053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（OCL）在高频数据流中实时学习且内存受限的问题，现有方法难以平衡效率和准确性。②提出了Ferret框架，采用细粒度流水线并行策略和迭代梯度补偿算法，实现低延迟处理，并通过自动模型分区和流水线规划适应不同内存预算。③相比现有OCL算法，Ferret在20个基准和5个集成算法上实现了高达3.7倍的内存开销降低，同时保持相同在线准确率。④实验表明Ferret在不同内存预算下均优于对比方法，展示了卓越的适应性和效率。
2503.12053|v2.summary_en: This paper presents Ferret, a framework for online continual learning under varying memory constraints, using fine-grained pipeline parallelism and iterative gradient compensation to handle high-frequency data with minimal latency. It automates model partitioning and pipeline planning to adapt to memory budgets, achieving up to 3.7x lower memory overhead for the same online accuracy across 20 benchmarks and 5 OCL algorithms. Ferret consistently outperforms competing methods, highlighting its adaptability and efficiency.
2503.12053|v2.assessment: 工程贡献显著，实验充分，对实际部署有重要价值。

2503.17677|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class-wise confusion in class-incremental learning caused by inadequate representation and feature overlap in prototype methods. It proposes CREATE, using lightweight auto-encoders to learn compact manifolds per class and a confusion-aware separation loss to ensure correct reconstruction and feature separation. This enhances representation stability and mitigates overlap. Experiments show superior performance on benchmarks.
2503.17677|v2.assessment: 针对原型方法的缺陷提出系统性解决方案，方法设计精巧，实验充分，对CIL领域有实质贡献。

2412.18219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无样本类增量学习（CIL）中推理时间与准确性之间的权衡问题。②提出ACMap框架，通过适配器合并（Adapter Merging）构建共享子空间，并采用质心原型映射（Centroid Prototype Mapping）保持高精度，同时引入早停策略提升可扩展性。③相比现有方法，ACMap在保持恒定推理时间的同时达到最先进准确性，解决了传统方法的效率瓶颈。④在五个基准数据集上，ACMap匹配最先进准确性，且推理时间与最快方法相当。
2412.18219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between inference time and accuracy in exemplar-free class-incremental learning. It proposes ACMap, which merges task-specific adapters into a single one for constant inference time, and uses centroid prototype mapping to maintain accuracy. An early stopping strategy enhances scalability. Experiments on five benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy with inference time comparable to the fastest methods.
2412.18219|v2.assessment: ACMap在效率和准确性之间取得良好平衡，实验充分，代码开源，具有实际应用价值。
2412.18219|v2.contribution: 提出ACMap框架，实现恒定推理时间下的高精度CIL。
2412.18219|v2.innovation: 适配器合并与质心原型映射结合。
2412.18219|v2.result: 在五个基准上匹配最先进准确性，推理时间最快。

Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_cn: ①针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习（CIL）中知识遗忘和利用不足问题。②提出知识记忆与反刍（Knowledge Memorization and Rumination）机制，通过记忆模块存储旧知识，并在学习新任务时反复回顾以巩固。③相比简单回放方法，该机制更结构化地整合知识。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个基准上提升性能。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge forgetting and underutilization in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning. It proposes knowledge memorization and rumination, storing old knowledge and revisiting it during new task learning. Compared to simple replay, it integrates knowledge more structurally. Experiments claim improvements on benchmarks, though specifics are absent.
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.assessment: 记忆与反刍概念有趣，但摘要缺乏细节，实验充分性待验证。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.contribution: 提出知识记忆与反刍机制。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.result: 在多个基准上提升性能。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo._arxiv_id: Knowledge Memorization and Rumination for Pre-trained Model-based Class-Incremental Learning.

2503.22163|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中模型置信度校准被忽视的问题，现有事后校准方法因需保留旧任务验证集而不适用于内存受限场景。②提出T-CIL，一种无需旧任务验证集的温度缩放方法，利用内存中经对抗扰动的旧类样本。③创新点在于根据特征距离调整扰动方向，使旧任务样本扰动强于新任务，并利用新任务验证集确定单一扰动幅度，从而适用于旧任务。④实验表明该方法能有效校准置信度，同时保持分类精度。
2503.22163|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked issue of confidence calibration in class-incremental learning, where post-hoc methods fail due to limited memory. T-CIL proposes a temperature scaling approach using adversarially perturbed exemplars without old-task validation sets, adjusting perturbation direction by feature distance. It achieves effective calibration while maintaining accuracy.
2503.22163|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦增量学习中的校准问题，具有实际应用价值，但方法依赖对抗扰动，泛化性需进一步验证。
2503.22163|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需旧任务验证集的类增量学习校准方法。
2503.22163|v2.innovation: 利用对抗扰动和特征距离实现跨任务温度缩放。
2503.22163|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升校准性能，同时保持精度。

2502.20032|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习对类别到达顺序敏感的问题，尤其是高相似类顺序变化导致性能下降。②通过理论分析证明增量阶段分组低相似类可提升鲁棒性，提出图驱动动态相似度分组方法，利用图着色算法动态划分类别组，每组训练独立子模型并构建元特征。③相比现有方法，首次从理论层面分析顺序敏感性并提供解决方案。④实验表明该方法在准确率和抗遗忘性上均达到最优。
2502.20032|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the class order sensitivity in CIL, proving that grouping low-similarity classes improves robustness. GDDSG uses graph coloring to dynamically partition classes into groups, training isolated sub-models with meta-features. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and anti-forgetting performance.
2502.20032|v2.assessment: 理论分析与方法设计结合紧密，对增量学习顺序鲁棒性研究有重要贡献。
2502.20032|v2.contribution: 首次从理论角度证明低相似分组提升顺序鲁棒性，并提出图驱动方法。
2502.20032|v2.innovation: 将图着色算法应用于动态类别分组。
2502.20032|v2.result: 在多个数据集上实现最优准确率和抗遗忘性。

2506.15720|v2.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习中模型更新导致遗忘和过拟合的问题，现有方法固定特征提取器限制了适应性。②提出三部分权重空间集成方法，在基类、前一模型和当前模型间插值，特别是分类头，协同维护知识。③创新点在于允许整个模型无缝更新，同时通过权重集成缓解遗忘。④实验表明该方法有效解决遗忘和过拟合，性能优于现有FSCIL方法。
2506.15720|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and overfitting in FSCIL by proposing Tri-WE, which interpolates base, previous, and current models in weight-space. It enables full model updates with few examples, improving adaptability. Experiments show superior performance over existing methods.
2506.15720|v2.assessment: 权重空间集成思路新颖，为少样本增量学习提供新视角。
2506.15720|v2.contribution: 提出三部分权重空间集成方法，实现少样本下全模型更新。
2506.15720|v2.innovation: 在权重空间插值多个模型以平衡知识保持和适应性。
2506.15720|v2.result: 在标准FSCIL基准上取得最优性能。

2409.14983|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无样本类增量学习中旧数据缺失加剧灾难性遗忘的问题。②提出动态任务特定适配器集成框架，包含任务特定适配器集成和补丁级模型对齐，通过补丁级蒸馏损失和特征重建保持一致性。③创新点在于利用补丁级适配器集成提升组合性，并设计双重机制维护决策边界。④实验表明该方法在NECIL场景下有效缓解遗忘。
2409.14983|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DIA for NECIL, integrating task-specific adapters with patch-level alignment to mitigate forgetting. It uses distillation and feature reconstruction to maintain consistency. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness in reducing catastrophic forgetting.
2409.14983|v2.assessment: 针对无样本增量学习提出实用方案，但方法复杂度较高，需更多实验验证。
2409.14983|v2.contribution: 提出动态适配器集成框架解决无样本增量学习遗忘问题。
2409.14983|v2.innovation: 补丁级适配器集成与特征重建结合。
2409.14983|v2.result: 在多个NECIL基准上提升性能。

SEC-Prompt: SEmantic Complementary Promp.summary_cn: ①论文摘要缺失，无法评估具体问题和方法。②标题暗示提出语义互补提示方法用于少样本类增量学习。③缺乏细节，无法判断创新点。④无实验结果。
SEC-Prompt: SEmantic Complementary Promp.summary_en: The abstract is missing, limiting assessment. The title suggests a semantic complementary prompting method for FSCIL, but details and results are unavailable.
SEC-Prompt: SEmantic Complementary Promp.assessment: 信息不足，无法进行有效评估。
SEC-Prompt: SEmantic Complementary Promp._arxiv_id: SEC-Prompt: SEmantic Complementary Prompting for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.

Low-Rank Adaptation in Multilinear Opera.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中的安全性和隐私问题，现有方法可能泄露敏感信息。②提出在多线性算子网络中使用低秩适配，实现安全保护的增量学习。③创新点在于结合低秩适配与多线性结构，减少参数更新同时保护数据。④实验表明方法在保持性能的同时增强安全性。
Low-Rank Adaptation in Multilinear Opera.summary_en: This paper addresses security in incremental learning by applying low-rank adaptation in multilinear operator networks. It reduces parameter updates while preserving data privacy. Experiments show maintained performance with enhanced security.
Low-Rank Adaptation in Multilinear Opera.assessment: 关注安全增量学习，方向有价值，但方法细节和对比需更充分。
Low-Rank Adaptation in Multilinear Opera.contribution: 提出安全保护的增量学习低秩适配方法。
Low-Rank Adaptation in Multilinear Opera.innovation: 低秩适配与多线性算子网络结合。
Low-Rank Adaptation in Multilinear Opera.result: 在安全性和性能间取得平衡。
Low-Rank Adaptation in Multilinear Opera._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Adaptation in Multilinear Operator Networks for Security-Preserving Incremental Learning.

2106.10456|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中教师模型生成的伪标签质量有限的问题，提出了一种基于教师-学生双模型框架的方法。该方法采用指数移动平均策略在线更新教师模型，使用大量区域提议和软伪标签作为学生训练目标，并引入轻量级检测特定数据集成以生成更可靠的伪标签。相比使用硬标签的STAC方法，教师模型通过软标签向学生传递更丰富的信息，在VOC07 val上达到53.04%的AP，比STAC高8.4%；在MS-COCO上，仅使用少量标注数据时也优于先前工作，并利用未标注数据在test-dev上达到53.8%的AP，比全监督ResNet-152级联R-CNN高3.1%。
2106.10456|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited quality of pseudo-labels in semi-supervised object detection by proposing a teacher-student framework with exponential moving average updates, soft pseudo-labels on abundant proposals, and a lightweight detection-specific data ensemble. It outperforms STAC by 8.4% AP on VOC07 val and achieves 53.8% AP on MS-COCO test-dev, surpassing fully supervised baselines with unlabeled data.
2106.10456|v2.assessment: 该论文在半监督目标检测领域提出了简单有效的改进策略，显著提升了性能，对依赖未标注数据的自动驾驶感知场景具有重要参考价值。
2106.10456|v2.contribution: 提出了一种利用软伪标签和在线教师更新的半监督目标检测方法，大幅提升了检测精度。
2106.10456|v2.innovation: 通过软标签和大量提议替代硬标签，结合轻量级数据集成，增强了教师模型的知识传递。
2106.10456|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得显著提升，VOC07 AP达53.04%，MS-COCO test-dev AP达53.8%。

2107.04384|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘的理论理解不足问题，在教师-学生框架下研究了任务相似性对遗忘和迁移的影响。通过扩展两层网络的教师-学生分析到多教师场景，每个教师代表不同任务，分离了特征和读出层的任务相似性。研究发现，当任务依赖相似特征时，中等任务相似性导致最大遗忘，但特征相似性并非唯一因素，读出层相似性也影响结果。该工作为持续学习中的任务干扰提供了理论洞见，但未提供具体性能数据。
2107.04384|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates catastrophic forgetting in continual learning using a teacher-student setup with multiple teachers to disentangle task similarity at feature and readout levels. It finds that intermediate feature similarity causes the most forgetting, but readout similarity also plays a role, offering theoretical insights into task interference.
2107.04384|v2.assessment: 该论文为持续学习中的遗忘机制提供了理论分析，但与应用场景关联较弱，对自动驾驶感知的实用性有限。
2107.04384|v2.contribution: 在多教师框架下揭示了任务相似性对持续学习遗忘和迁移的影响机制。
2107.04384|v2.innovation: 将教师-学生分析扩展到多任务场景，分离特征和读出层相似性。
2107.04384|v2.result: 提供了理论发现，但缺乏实验性能数据。

2110.12724|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中知识蒸馏难以平衡不同位置特征贡献的问题，提出了一种实例条件蒸馏框架，以提取对每个实例的分类和定位有益的知识。该方法引入可学习的条件解码模块，以目标实例为查询检索教师表示中的信息，并通过注意力机制衡量特征贡献，辅以定位-识别敏感的辅助任务。实验表明，该方法在多种设置下显著提升性能，例如将ResNet-50的RetinaNet从37.4提升到40.7 mAP（+3.3），甚至超过使用ResNet-101的教师模型（40.4 mAP）。
2110.12724|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an instance-conditional distillation framework for object detection, using a learnable decoding module to retrieve instance-specific knowledge from teacher representations via attention. It boosts RetinaNet with ResNet-50 from 37.4 to 40.7 mAP, surpassing the stronger teacher, demonstrating effectiveness across settings.
2110.12724|v2.assessment: 该论文针对检测蒸馏的难点提出了创新性条件蒸馏方法，性能提升显著，对模型压缩和高效感知有重要价值。
2110.12724|v2.contribution: 提出了实例条件蒸馏框架，有效提取检测中分类和定位相关的知识。
2110.12724|v2.innovation: 利用条件解码和注意力机制，实现实例级知识选择。
2110.12724|v2.result: 在多个检测器上取得显著提升，学生模型超越教师。

2203.14956|v2.summary_cn: 针对不同线束LiDAR导致的3D检测域差距问题，本文提出LiDAR蒸馏框架。方法通过下采样高线束点云生成低线束伪数据，并采用教师-学生框架蒸馏高线束信息，同时对齐源域与目标域的点云密度。在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI数据集上，使用三种不同检测器验证了有效性，显著提升了跨线束检测性能。
2203.14956|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the beam-induced domain gap in 3D object detection by proposing LiDAR Distillation, which aligns point cloud density and uses a teacher-student framework to distill rich information from high-beam data. Extensive experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and KITTI with three detectors demonstrate its effectiveness in improving cross-beam detection performance.
2203.14956|v2.assessment: 该工作针对实际部署中LiDAR线束变化带来的域偏移问题，提出实用且有效的蒸馏方案，对自动驾驶感知系统具有重要参考价值。
2203.14956|v2.contribution: 提出一种渐进式LiDAR蒸馏框架，有效弥合不同线束间的域差距。
2203.14956|v2.innovation: 通过密度对齐和教师-学生蒸馏，首次系统解决LiDAR线束引起的3D检测域偏移。
2203.14956|v2.result: 在多个数据集和检测器上显著提升跨线束3D检测精度。

2201.10207|v2.summary_cn: 针对语音预训练中的表示学习问题，本文提出SPIRAL方法，采用教师-学生框架学习扰动数据的去噪表示，并通过句内对比损失防止表示坍缩。该方法在语音基准上达到与wav2vec 2.0相当或更优的性能，同时显著降低训练成本（BASE模型80%、LARGE模型65%），并增强了噪声鲁棒性。
2201.10207|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SPIRAL, a self-supervised speech pre-training method using a teacher-student framework with perturbation-invariant representation learning and in-utterance contrastive loss. It achieves competitive or better performance than wav2vec 2.0 with 80% and 65% training cost reduction for BASE and LARGE models, respectively, while improving noise robustness.
2201.10207|v2.assessment: 该工作属于语音处理领域，与自动驾驶视觉研究相关性低，但方法设计有一定通用性。
2201.10207|v2.contribution: 提出一种高效的语音自监督预训练方法，降低训练成本并增强鲁棒性。
2201.10207|v2.innovation: 结合扰动不变学习和对比损失，在教师-学生框架中实现高效表示学习。
2201.10207|v2.result: 在语音任务上达到SOTA性能，训练成本大幅降低。

2205.15156|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测器计算开销大的问题，本文探索知识蒸馏以开发高效3D检测器，聚焦于pillar和voxel检测器。首先研究模型压缩和输入分辨率降低以获得精度-效率平衡的学生模型，然后构建基准评估2D KD方法在3D检测中的适用性，并提出改进的KD流程，包括增强logit KD和教师引导初始化。在Waymo数据集上，最佳模型达到65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH，超过教师模型且仅需44%的计算量。
2205.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper explores knowledge distillation for efficient 3D object detection, focusing on pillar- and voxel-based detectors. It constructs teacher-student pairs via model compression and resolution reduction, benchmarks existing KD methods, and proposes enhanced logit KD with teacher-guided initialization. On Waymo, the best model achieves 65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH, surpassing its teacher with only 44% computation.
2205.15156|v2.assessment: 该工作系统研究了3D检测中的知识蒸馏，提出有效改进方案，对高效自动驾驶感知模型设计具有重要指导意义。
2205.15156|v2.contribution: 构建3D检测KD基准并提出增强蒸馏方法，实现精度与效率的显著提升。
2205.15156|v2.innovation: 提出基于教师分类响应的关键位置logit蒸馏和权重继承初始化策略。
2205.15156|v2.result: 在Waymo上以44%计算量超越教师模型，达到65.75% mAPH。

2210.04208|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云分析中单模态表示学习的瓶颈，本文提出PointCMT跨模态训练策略，利用视图图像（渲染或投影的2D图像）增强3D点云表示。方法采用教师-学生框架，将跨模态学习建模为知识蒸馏问题，通过特征和分类器增强准则消除模态分布差异，避免负迁移。实验在多个数据集和骨干网络上验证了显著性能提升，且无需修改点云网络架构。
2210.04208|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces PointCMT, a cross-modal training strategy that leverages view images to enhance point cloud representation via a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework. It eliminates modality distribution discrepancy through feature and classifier enhancement criteria, improving point-only analysis without architecture modification. Experiments show significant gains across datasets and backbones.
2210.04208|v2.assessment: 该工作为点云分析提供了一种有效的跨模态增强思路，虽非直接针对自动驾驶，但对多模态感知有借鉴意义。
2210.04208|v2.contribution: 提出利用图像信息提升点云表示的跨模态蒸馏训练策略。
2210.04208|v2.innovation: 通过特征和分类器增强准则，有效避免跨模态负迁移。
2210.04208|v2.result: 在多个点云数据集上显著提升性能，无需改变推理架构。

2208.12262|v2.summary_cn: 针对对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）中缺乏局部语义表示学习的问题，本文提出MaskCLIP框架，将掩码自蒸馏与对比学习结合。核心思想是从完整图像蒸馏表示到掩码图像的预测表示，从而增强局部patch表示学习，并与文本相关表示形成互补。该方法在多个下游任务（如线性探测、微调）上取得了优于现有方法的结果。
2208.12262|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MaskCLIP, a framework that incorporates masked self-distillation into contrastive language-image pretraining to enhance local patch representation learning. By distilling representations from full images to masked ones, it complements text-related representation learning and achieves superior performance on various downstream tasks.
2208.12262|v2.assessment: 该工作为CLIP类模型补充了局部语义建模能力，对多模态感知和自监督学习有重要参考价值。
2208.12262|v2.contribution: 提出掩码自蒸馏机制，增强CLIP的局部表示学习。
2208.12262|v2.innovation: 将掩码图像建模与对比学习统一在自蒸馏框架下。
2208.12262|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。

2302.14250|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督增量语义分割（WILSS）中图像级标签缺乏定位信息且易遗忘旧类的问题，提出FMWISS框架。该方法利用预训练基础模型的互补知识进行共分割生成密集伪标签，并通过教师-学生架构和密集对比损失优化噪声伪掩码，同时引入基于记忆的复制-粘贴增强缓解灾难性遗忘。实验表明该方法在数据效率和新类分割性能上优于现有方法。
2302.14250|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation by proposing FMWISS, which leverages complementary foundation models for co-segmentation to generate pseudo labels, and employs a teacher-student architecture with dense contrastive loss to refine noisy masks. Memory-based copy-paste augmentation is introduced to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, achieving superior performance.
2302.14250|v2.assessment: 该工作有效结合基础模型与增量学习，为弱监督语义分割提供了新思路。
2302.14250|v2.contribution: 提出基于基础模型共分割的弱监督增量分割框架。
2302.14250|v2.innovation: 利用互补基础模型生成伪标签并配合对比学习优化。
2302.14250|v2.result: 在数据效率和新类性能上优于现有方法。

2311.13930|v2.summary_cn: 针对源域缺失目标检测（SFOD）中均值教师框架因单教师模型崩溃导致训练不稳定的问题，提出PETS方法。该方法引入静态教师、动态教师和学生模型的多教师框架，周期性交换静态教师与学生权重，并用学生移动平均更新动态教师，从而整合历史知识、减少误差累积。实验证明该方法在SFOD基准上显著提升检测性能。
2311.13930|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PETS, a multiple-teacher framework for source-free object detection, where a static teacher and a dynamic teacher guide the student model. By periodically exchanging weights between the static teacher and student, and updating the dynamic teacher via moving average, the method stabilizes training and improves detection performance on SFOD benchmarks.
2311.13930|v2.assessment: 该工作针对SFOD中教师模型不稳定问题提出有效解决方案，具有较强实用性。
2311.13930|v2.contribution: 提出周期性交换教师-学生的多教师框架，稳定SFOD训练。
2311.13930|v2.innovation: 通过静态与动态教师结合及周期交换机制减少误差累积。
2311.13930|v2.result: 在SFOD基准上显著提升检测精度。

2308.00398|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端自动驾驶中教师-学生范式下学生模型需从零学习规划头、且感知噪声和因果混淆导致规划学习困难的问题，提出DriveAdapter。该方法探索直接利用强教师模型进行规划，同时让学生模型专注于感知部分，打破感知与规划的耦合。实验表明该方法在闭环仿真中显著优于现有端到端方法。
2308.00398|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DriveAdapter to address the challenge in end-to-end autonomous driving where the student model must learn planning from scratch under the teacher-student paradigm. By directly leveraging the strong teacher for planning and letting the student focus on perception, it breaks the coupling barrier and achieves superior closed-loop performance.
2308.00398|v2.assessment: 该工作对端到端驾驶范式有重要革新，显著提升规划性能，值得高度关注。
2308.00398|v2.contribution: 提出解耦感知与规划的教师-学生适配方法，提升端到端驾驶性能。
2308.00398|v2.innovation: 直接复用教师模型进行规划，避免学生从零学习规划头。
2308.00398|v2.result: 在闭环仿真中显著优于现有方法。

2506.07087|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督伪装目标检测（UCOD）中伪标签噪声大和简单解码器难以捕获小目标语义特征的问题。②提出了基于教师-学生框架的UCOD-DPL方法，包含自适应伪标签模块（APM）、双分支对抗解码器（DBA）和Look-Twice机制。③APM动态结合固定策略和教师模型生成的伪标签，防止模型过拟合错误知识并保留自校正能力；DBA解码器增强特征学习。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称相比现有UCOD方法性能提升。
2506.07087|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issues of noisy pseudo-labels and inadequate decoders in unsupervised camouflaged object detection (UCOD). It proposes UCOD-DPL, a teacher-student framework with an Adaptive Pseudo-label Module (APM), a Dual-Branch Adversarial (DBA) decoder, and a Look-Twice mechanism to dynamically refine pseudo-labels and enhance semantic feature learning. The method improves performance over existing UCOD approaches, though specific quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
2506.07087|v2.assessment: 该论文针对UCOD中的伪标签噪声和模型容量不足问题提出了系统性的解决方案，对伪装目标检测领域有一定参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其效果。
2506.07087|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合动态伪标签学习和对抗解码器的无监督伪装目标检测框架。
2506.07087|v2.innovation: 通过自适应伪标签模块和双分支对抗解码器协同提升模型对噪声伪标签的鲁棒性和特征表达能力。
2506.07087|v2.result: 在UCOD任务上相比现有方法取得性能提升，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2507.21455|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模数据集训练成本高昂的问题，探索自监督数据集蒸馏以减少数据规模。②提出了通过参数化、预定义增强和近似技术来蒸馏图像及其自监督表示的方法，生成紧凑且具有跨架构泛化能力的蒸馏集。③创新点在于对图像和表示使用不同的低维基进行参数化，以更忠实紧凑地保留原始数据的关键特征。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但强调蒸馏集具有增强的跨架构泛化性。
2507.21455|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high training cost of large datasets by exploring self-supervised dataset distillation. It proposes techniques including parameterization via distinct low-dimensional bases, predefined augmentation, and approximation to distill images and their self-supervised representations into a compact set with enhanced cross-architecture generalizability. The method aims to preserve key characteristics of original data more faithfully, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2507.21455|v2.assessment: 该论文将数据集蒸馏扩展到自监督场景，提出了新颖的参数化方法，对高效训练和表示学习有潜在价值，但摘要中缺乏实验细节。
2507.21455|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督数据集蒸馏的新方法，通过参数化和近似技术生成紧凑且泛化的蒸馏集。
2507.21455|v2.innovation: 利用低维基参数化图像和表示，结合预定义增强和近似，提升蒸馏集的紧凑性和跨架构泛化能力。
2507.21455|v2.result: 蒸馏集具有增强的跨架构泛化性，但具体性能数据未在摘要中给出。

2410.11325|v2.summary_cn: ①针对知识蒸馏中教师-学生分布不匹配和低质量训练样本导致反馈不准确的问题。②提出了投机知识蒸馏（SKD），通过学生和教师模型协作生成高质量训练数据，学生提出token，教师根据自身分布替换排名不佳的token，从而自适应传递知识。③相比监督KD和on-policy KD，SKD结合了在线生成和分布对齐的优势，避免了静态数据集分布失配和低质量样本问题。④在翻译、摘要、数学和指令跟随等文本生成任务上进行了评估，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2410.11325|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the teacher-student distribution mismatch and low-quality training samples in knowledge distillation. It introduces Speculative Knowledge Distillation (SKD), where the student proposes tokens and the teacher replaces poorly ranked ones based on its distribution, enabling adaptive knowledge transfer and alignment with the student's inference-time distribution. SKD is evaluated on text generation tasks including translation, summarization, math, and instruction following, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2410.11325|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的投机式知识蒸馏方法，有效缓解了教师-学生差距，对生成任务中的模型压缩有重要价值，实验任务多样。
2410.11325|v2.contribution: 提出了投机知识蒸馏框架，通过学生提议和教师修正的协作机制生成高质量训练数据。
2410.11325|v2.innovation: 利用投机采样的思想，在训练中动态结合学生和教师分布，实现自适应知识蒸馏。
2410.11325|v2.result: 在多种文本生成任务上验证了有效性，但具体性能提升数据未在摘要中给出。

2403.09296|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在连续任务微调中出现的灾难性遗忘和零样本能力下降问题，提出了一种选择性双教师知识迁移框架。该方法利用最近微调的模型和原始预训练VLM作为双教师，通过无标签参考数据集上的特征差异进行选择性知识蒸馏，分别保留已学知识和零样本能力。相比现有持续学习方法，该框架在基准数据集上取得了更优的防遗忘和零样本保持效果。
2403.09296|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation in vision-language models during continual learning. It proposes a selective dual-teacher knowledge distillation framework using the fine-tuned and original pre-trained VLMs as teachers, with feature discrepancy-based selection on an unlabeled reference dataset. Extensive experiments show favorable performance against state-of-the-art continual learning methods.
2403.09296|v2.assessment: 该工作针对VLM持续学习中的关键挑战，提出新颖的双教师蒸馏机制，对多模态持续学习研究有重要参考价值。
2403.09296|v2.contribution: 提出选择性双教师知识迁移框架，同时缓解VLM的灾难性遗忘和零样本能力下降。
2403.09296|v2.innovation: 利用双教师特征差异实现选择性知识蒸馏，无需标注数据。
2403.09296|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上优于现有持续学习方法，有效保持零样本性能。

Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.summary_cn: 针对数据集蒸馏中数据冗余和效率低下的问题，提出了一种双层数据剪枝方法，从大规模数据中提取关键样本以优化蒸馏过程。该方法通过粗粒度筛选和细粒度选择两个层级，减少数据冗余并提升蒸馏效率。相比传统数据集蒸馏方法，该方法在保持性能的同时显著降低了计算成本。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.summary_en: This paper tackles data redundancy in dataset distillation by proposing a bi-level data pruning method to select critical samples from massive datasets. It combines coarse and fine-grained selection to improve distillation efficiency. The approach reduces computational cost while maintaining competitive performance.
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.assessment: 该研究为数据集蒸馏提供了高效的数据选择策略，对资源受限场景有实际意义。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.contribution: 提出双层数据剪枝框架，提升数据集蒸馏的效率和效果。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.innovation: 将数据剪枝与蒸馏结合，实现两级选择性采样。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.result: 在多个数据集上降低了计算开销，同时保持蒸馏性能。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level._arxiv_id: Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level Data Pruning Towards Efficient Dataset Distillation.

2407.14007|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D预训练中忽视样本间结构关系的问题，提出了多模态关系蒸馏（MRD）框架，将大型视觉语言模型（VLM）的知识蒸馏到3D骨干网络中。MRD同时捕获模态内和跨模态关系，生成更具判别性的3D形状表示。在零样本分类和跨模态检索任务上取得了新的最先进性能。
2407.14007|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Multi-modal Relation Distillation (MRD), a tri-modal pre-training framework that distills knowledge from VLMs into 3D backbones while capturing intra- and cross-modal relations. It produces more discriminative 3D representations, achieving state-of-the-art results on zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval.
2407.14007|v2.assessment: 该工作通过关系蒸馏增强了3D表示学习，对多模态3D理解领域具有显著贡献。
2407.14007|v2.contribution: 提出MRD框架，利用关系蒸馏提升3D形状表示的判别性。
2407.14007|v2.innovation: 同时建模模态内和跨模态关系，超越简单特征对齐。
2407.14007|v2.result: 在零样本分类和检索任务上达到新最先进性能。

2407.13362|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中3D文本配对数据稀缺的问题，提出了几何引导自蒸馏（GGSD）方法，从2D预训练模型中蒸馏知识到3D模型。该方法利用3D几何先验缓解2D模型的噪声，并通过自蒸馏进一步提升3D表示优势。实验表明，蒸馏后的3D学生模型性能显著超越2D教师模型。
2407.13362|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Geometry Guided Self-Distillation (GGSD) for open vocabulary 3D scene understanding, distilling knowledge from 2D models while leveraging 3D geometric priors to reduce noise. It further applies self-distillation to exploit 3D representation advantages, enabling the student model to surpass the 2D teacher.
2407.13362|v2.assessment: 该研究创新性地结合几何先验和自蒸馏，有效解决了3D开放词汇理解中的数据稀缺问题。
2407.13362|v2.contribution: 提出GGSD框架，通过几何引导蒸馏和自蒸馏提升3D开放词汇理解。
2407.13362|v2.innovation: 利用3D几何先验增强蒸馏过程，并引入自蒸馏超越教师模型。
2407.13362|v2.result: 3D学生模型性能显著优于2D教师模型，验证了方法的有效性。

2404.12386|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界实体分割依赖昂贵人工标注的问题，提出了自监督开放世界层次实体分割（SOHES）方法，无需人类标注。该方法通过自探索、自指导和自纠正三个阶段，利用预训练自监督表示生成伪标签并训练分割模型，同时捕获实体及其组成部分。仅使用原始图像训练，在自监督开放世界分割中取得了前所未有的性能。
2404.12386|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SOHES, a self-supervised approach for open-world hierarchical entity segmentation that eliminates human annotations. It uses self-exploration, self-instruction, and self-correction phases with pseudo-labels from feature clustering and mutual learning. The method achieves unprecedented performance using only raw images.
2404.12386|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了自监督分割的边界，实现了无需标注的层次实体理解，具有重要创新意义。
2404.12386|v2.contribution: 提出SOHES，实现完全自监督的开放世界层次实体分割。
2404.12386|v2.innovation: 通过三阶段自监督流程和教师-学生互学习，无需人工标注。
2404.12386|v2.result: 在自监督开放世界分割中达到前所未有的性能。

A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_cn: 针对知识蒸馏中教师模型质量对蒸馏效果的影响，提出了教师-学生协作知识蒸馏方法，强调优秀学习者能更好地教学。该方法通过学生反馈优化教师模型，实现协作式蒸馏。相比传统静态教师蒸馏，该方法提升了学生模型的性能。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_en: This paper addresses the impact of teacher quality in knowledge distillation by proposing a teacher-student collaborative framework where the student helps refine the teacher. This dynamic interaction improves distillation effectiveness compared to static teacher methods.
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.assessment: 该研究探索了动态师生协作机制，为知识蒸馏提供了新视角，但实验细节有限。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.contribution: 提出教师-学生协作蒸馏框架，通过学生反馈优化教师。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.innovation: 引入双向学习机制，打破传统单向蒸馏范式。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.result: 提升了学生模型性能，优于静态教师蒸馏方法。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher._arxiv_id: A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher-Student Collaborative Knowledge Distillation.

2306.15876|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督表示学习中对比学习（CL）和掩码图像建模（MIM）两种范式各自优缺点并存的问题，即CL擅长捕获全局模式和判别性特征，而MIM能引入局部和多样化的注意力，但现有方法难以同时获得判别性和多样性。②作者提出了一种简单有效的混合蒸馏策略（Hybrid Distillation），利用监督/对比学习教师和MIM教师共同指导学生模型，通过模仿MIM教师的token关系来缓解注意力坍塌，并蒸馏监督/CL教师的特征图以增强判别能力。③相比之前的特征蒸馏和掩码特征重建方法，该方法避免了非对称设计带来的判别性损失，同时有效结合了两种范式的优势。④实验表明，该方法在多个下游任务上取得了优于单一范式或简单组合的性能提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出，但验证了其有效性。
2306.15876|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of combining the strengths of contrastive learning (CL) and masked image modeling (MIM) in self-supervised representation learning, where CL excels at global discrimination and MIM provides local diversity. The authors propose a Hybrid Distillation strategy that jointly uses a supervised/CL teacher and an MIM teacher to guide the student, imitating token relations to prevent attention collapse and distilling feature maps for discriminability. This approach outperforms previous feature distillation and mask reconstruction methods by avoiding asymmetric design pitfalls, achieving improved performance across downstream tasks.
2306.15876|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简洁有效的混合蒸馏框架，为自监督学习中的范式融合提供了新思路，对视觉表示学习领域具有重要参考价值。
2306.15876|v2.contribution: 提出混合蒸馏策略，结合对比学习和掩码图像建模教师的优势，提升学生模型的判别性和多样性。
2306.15876|v2.innovation: 通过同时模仿MIM教师的token关系和蒸馏CL教师的特征图，避免了非对称设计导致的判别性损失。
2306.15876|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上验证了混合蒸馏的有效性，性能优于单一范式或简单组合方法。

2011.11858|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多目标跟踪（MOT）研究依赖目标先验知识、难以泛化到未见类别的问题，该论文构建了首个通用多目标跟踪（GMOT）基准数据集GMOT-40，包含40个精心标注的序列，均匀分布于10个目标类别，并采用两种跟踪协议评估算法特性。由于缺乏专用跟踪算法，作者设计了一系列基线GMOT算法，并对流行的MOT算法（经必要修改）和所提基线进行了全面评估。该工作填补了GMOT领域数据集的空白，为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。
2011.11858|v2.summary_en: Addressing the limitation that existing MOT methods rely on prior knowledge of targets and fail to generalize to unseen categories, this paper introduces GMOT-40, the first public benchmark for Generic Multiple Object Tracking, containing 40 carefully annotated sequences across 10 categories with two evaluation protocols. It also designs baseline GMOT algorithms and conducts thorough evaluations of adapted MOT methods, filling the dataset gap and providing a standardized platform for future research.
2011.11858|v2.assessment: 该论文为通用多目标跟踪这一被忽视的方向提供了首个基准数据集，具有重要的社区价值，尤其适合关注开放世界和泛化跟踪的研究者。
2011.11858|v2.contribution: 构建并发布了首个通用多目标跟踪基准数据集GMOT-40及基线算法。
2011.11858|v2.innovation: 首次系统定义并评测了无需目标先验的通用多目标跟踪任务。
2011.11858|v2.result: 提供了全面的基准评估结果，推动GMOT领域发展。
