2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中每个目标独立建模、缺乏场景内所有目标联合更新记忆能力的问题，该论文提出了一种新颖的多轨迹池化（multi-track pooling）模块，在极小空间开销下同时考虑所有轨迹进行记忆更新，并设计了适配该模块的在线难样本生成训练策略。通过结合这些创新，模型获得了强判别性的外观表示，支持贪心数据关联实现实时在线跟踪。在公开MOT数据集上达到了实时且最先进的性能。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: To address the issue of modeling each target in isolation and lacking joint memory updates across all targets, this paper proposes a novel multi-track pooling module that simultaneously considers all tracks during memory updating with minimal spatial overhead, along with a training strategy generating hard tracking episodes online. These innovations yield a strong discriminative appearance model, enabling greedy data association for real-time tracking, achieving state-of-the-art performance on public MOT datasets.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 该工作通过联合建模所有轨迹显著提升了外观判别力，在实时性和精度上均有突破，对MOT领域有重要参考价值。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出多轨迹池化模块和在线难样本训练策略，实现实时高精度MOT。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 首次在记忆更新中联合考虑所有轨迹，而非孤立建模。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公开MOT数据集上达到实时最先进性能。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: 针对RGB-D序列中多目标跟踪因视角变化、运动和遮挡导致的挑战，该论文提出联合推断物体完整几何形状并进行跟踪的方法。核心洞察是完整几何有助于跟踪，通过预测物体未见区域获得更多对应关系，从而在强外观变化下实现鲁棒跟踪。方法从RGB-D帧中检测物体，学习预测完整几何和到规范空间的稠密对应映射，进而推导6DoF姿态和帧间对应。在合成和真实数据上均达到最先进的动态物体跟踪性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: Addressing challenges in RGB-D multi-object tracking from changing viewpoints, motion, and occlusions, this paper proposes jointly inferring complete object geometry and tracking rigidly moving objects. The key insight is that complete geometry aids tracking by hallucinating unseen regions to obtain more correspondences. The method detects objects, predicts complete geometry and dense canonical correspondences, deriving 6DoF poses and inter-frame matches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real data.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将物体补全与跟踪结合，显著提升遮挡下的鲁棒性，对3D感知和跟踪研究具有启发意义。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出联合物体几何补全与跟踪的框架，利用完整形状增强对应关系。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 将物体补全作为跟踪的辅助信号，而非独立任务。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成和真实RGB-D数据上达到最先进动态跟踪性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联难以端到端学习的问题，该论文提出了一种基于提议的可学习框架，将MOT建模为在亲和图上的提议生成、提议评分和轨迹推断范式，类似于Faster RCNN的两阶段检测器。提议生成采用迭代图聚类降低计算成本，提议评分使用可训练的图卷积网络（GCN）学习结构模式并排序，轨迹推断通过去重叠策略保证约束。实验表明该方法在MOTA和IDF1指标上均有明显提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of end-to-end data association learning in MOT, this paper proposes a proposal-based learnable framework modeling MOT as proposal generation, scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, akin to Faster RCNN. It uses iterative graph clustering for efficient proposal generation, a trainable GCN for structural scoring, and a de-overlapping strategy for inference, achieving clear improvements in MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 该工作将检测中的提议范式引入MOT，结合GCN学习结构模式，为数据关联提供了新思路，具有较强创新性。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出基于提议和GCN的可学习MOT框架，实现端到端数据关联。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 借鉴两阶段检测器思想，用图聚类和GCN处理轨迹提议。
2103.07889|v2.result: 在MOTA和IDF1上均获得明显性能提升。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中位置预测和嵌入关联作为独立任务处理、缺乏相互增益的问题，该论文提出了一种统一模型，通过时间感知的目标注意力和干扰物注意力以及身份感知的记忆聚合模型实现两任务的协同。注意力模块使预测更聚焦目标、抑制干扰物，从而提取更可靠的嵌入用于关联；可靠嵌入又通过记忆聚合增强身份感知，强化注意力并抑制漂移。这种协同显著提升了对遮挡的鲁棒性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: Addressing the issue that position prediction and embedding association in online MOT are handled as independent tasks with little mutual benefit, this paper proposes a unified model with synergy via temporal-aware target and distractor attention, plus identity-aware memory aggregation. Attention improves prediction focus and embedding reliability, which in turn boosts identity-awareness and suppresses drifts, enhancing robustness to occlusions.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 该工作通过任务间协同机制有效结合预测与关联，显著提升遮挡鲁棒性，对在线MOT系统设计有重要借鉴意义。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出位置预测与嵌入关联的协同统一模型，利用注意力机制和记忆聚合实现互惠增强。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 引入双注意力模块和身份感知记忆聚合，实现任务间闭环反馈。
2104.00380|v2.result: 显著提升遮挡场景下的跟踪鲁棒性。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联忽略轨迹间和帧内检测的上下文信息、端到端方法缺乏优化分配优势、图优化方法特征提取与推理不一致的问题，提出了一种可学习的图匹配方法。该方法将轨迹与检测的关系建模为无向图，将关联问题转化为图匹配问题，并实现端到端优化。相比现有方法，它结合了深度特征学习与图划分优化，提升了关联的鲁棒性。实验表明在MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in multi-object tracking data association, including ignored contextual information, lack of optimization in end-to-end methods, and inconsistency in graph-based feature extraction. It proposes a learnable graph matching method that models tracklet-detection relations as a graph and solves association via graph matching with end-to-end optimization. This approach integrates deep feature learning with graph partitioning, improving association robustness and achieving competitive results on MOT benchmarks.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地融合图优化与深度特征学习，对MOT关联问题提供了新视角，值得关注。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出可学习图匹配框架，统一了特征学习与关联优化。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 将轨迹与检测建模为图匹配问题，实现端到端联合优化。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在MOT基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能。

Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中相似度学习效率低、难以处理密集场景的问题，提出了准密集相似度学习方法。该方法通过密集采样实例对并利用对比学习增强特征区分度，同时设计高效的匹配策略。相比传统稀疏关联方法，它充分利用了密集区域的信息，提升了跟踪的准确性。在MOT17、MOT20等基准上取得了当时的最优性能。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_en: This paper tackles inefficient similarity learning in multi-object tracking, especially in crowded scenes. It introduces quasi-dense similarity learning that densely samples instance pairs and employs contrastive learning to enhance feature discrimination, with an efficient matching strategy. Compared to sparse association methods, it leverages dense information, improving tracking accuracy and achieving state-of-the-art results on MOT17 and MOT20 benchmarks.
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.assessment: 该论文通过准密集学习显著提升了MOT性能，方法简洁有效，具有较高参考价值。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.contribution: 提出准密集相似度学习框架，增强实例特征区分度。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.innovation: 利用密集采样与对比学习优化相似度度量。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.result: 在多个MOT基准上达到最优性能。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult._arxiv_id: Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Multiple Object Tracking.

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中长期遮挡导致轨迹丢失的问题，提出了概率自回归运动模型来评分轨迹提议。该方法通过建模自然轨迹的分布，直接测量轨迹似然，既能关联新检测，也能通过采样修复丢失轨迹。相比仅依赖检测的联合方法，它充分利用了长期运动信息。在MOT16、MOT17和MOT20上超越了多数现有方法。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-term occlusion in multi-object tracking by introducing a probabilistic autoregressive motion model to score tracklet proposals. It learns the distribution of natural tracklets, enabling both detection association and tracklet inpainting via sampling. Unlike joint detection-tracking methods, it leverages long-term motion cues, outperforming state-of-the-art on MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将轨迹生成建模为概率过程，有效解决长期遮挡，具有重要应用价值。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率自回归运动模型用于轨迹评分与修复。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 通过学习轨迹分布实现似然评分和缺失轨迹采样。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在多个MOT数据集上取得领先性能。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中运动建模不足的问题，提出了基于区域的Siamese多目标跟踪网络SiamMOT。该网络包含运动模型，估计实例帧间移动以进行关联，并设计了隐式和显式两种运动建模变体。相比现有方法，它显著提升了跟踪能力，在MOT17、TAO-person和Caltech Roadside Pedestrians上超越最优。SiamMOT在HiEve数据集上也表现优异，且能以17 FPS处理720P视频。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper improves online multi-object tracking by introducing SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese network with a motion model for instance association. It explores implicit and explicit motion modeling variants, demonstrating the importance of motion cues. SiamMOT substantially outperforms state-of-the-art on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech datasets, and achieves 17 FPS on 720P videos.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: 该论文系统研究了运动建模在MOT中的作用，方法高效且性能优越，实用性强。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出SiamMOT框架，集成运动模型提升在线MOT性能。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 设计隐式和显式运动建模的Siamese跟踪器。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越最优，并保持实时速度。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频目标跟踪中时间上下文利用不足的问题，提出了基于Transformer的跟踪框架。该框架将编码器和解码器分为并行分支，编码器增强目标模板特征，解码器传播跟踪线索至当前帧。相比传统Siamese方法，它有效利用了帧间时间信息。结合简单Siamese匹配即可超越顶尖跟踪器，在多个基准上刷新纪录。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal context in video object tracking by proposing a transformer-based framework. It separates encoder and decoder into parallel branches, where the encoder reinforces template features and the decoder propagates tracking cues. This approach outperforms top trackers with simple Siamese matching and sets new records on benchmarks.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 该论文将Transformer创新应用于跟踪，展示了时间建模的潜力，但领域相关度略低。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出并行编码器-解码器Transformer用于时间上下文建模。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 分离Transformer分支以增强模板和传播线索。
2103.11681|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上达到最优性能。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 针对Siamese跟踪器固定模板难以适应目标外观变化的问题，提出了基于时空记忆网络的无模板跟踪框架STMTrack。该方法利用历史目标信息存储于记忆网络，引导跟踪器关注当前帧的显著区域，并通过像素级相似度计算生成精确边界框。相比模板更新方法，它无需复杂优化，能实时适应变化。在多个大规模基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of fixed templates in Siamese trackers by proposing STMTrack, a template-free framework based on space-time memory networks. It stores historical target information to guide attention and uses pixel-level similarity for accurate bounding boxes. Unlike template update methods, it avoids complex optimization and adapts in real-time, achieving competitive results on benchmarks.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: 该论文利用记忆网络实现无模板跟踪，创新性强，但相关度一般，性能验证有限。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出时空记忆网络驱动的无模板跟踪框架。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 利用历史信息存储与像素级匹配适应外观变化。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多人体关节3D姿态跟踪问题，旨在从视频中端到端地学习人体姿态与跟踪。②提出了TesseTrack，一种可学习的端到端框架，直接输出多人的3D姿态序列及身份关联。③相比传统分步方法（先检测再关联），该方法将姿态估计与跟踪联合优化，避免了误差累积。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在公开基准上达到先进水平。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking in videos, proposing an end-to-end learnable framework that jointly estimates poses and identities. Unlike traditional pipeline methods, it integrates pose estimation and tracking to reduce error accumulation. It claims state-of-the-art performance on public benchmarks, though no specific numbers are given in the abstract.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 与自动驾驶3D感知领域相关性较低，主要面向人体姿态，但端到端跟踪思路有一定参考价值。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出首个端到端可学习的多人关节3D姿态跟踪框架。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 将姿态估计与身份关联联合建模，实现端到端优化。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 在公开基准上达到先进水平，但缺乏具体量化数据。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: ①该论文针对类别级刚体和关节物体的6D姿态跟踪问题，输入为点云序列。②提出了CAPTRA方法，结合了逐点级和区域级特征，通过两阶段网络预测物体姿态变化。③相比实例级方法，CAPTRA能泛化到同一类别的新物体，且同时支持刚体和关节物体。④在NOCS和关节物体数据集上，CAPTRA显著优于基线方法，姿态精度提升明显。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This paper tackles category-level 6D pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds. CAPTRA uses a two-stage network with point-wise and region-wise features to predict pose changes, generalizing to unseen instances within a category. It outperforms baselines on NOCS and articulated object datasets with notable accuracy gains.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 与自动驾驶中物体姿态估计有一定关联，但主要面向室内物体，点云处理思路可借鉴。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出首个类别级刚体和关节物体点云姿态跟踪方法。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 结合逐点和区域特征，实现类别级泛化与关节物体支持。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 在多个数据集上显著优于基线，姿态精度提升。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云单目标跟踪中目标特征模糊和背景干扰的问题。②提出了Box-Aware Feature Enhancement模块，利用初始目标框信息增强搜索区域特征，并设计了一个轻量级关联头。③相比现有方法，该模块能更有效地利用框先验，提升特征判别力。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，该方法在多个类别上取得了领先的成功率和精度。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses feature ambiguity and background interference in single object tracking on point clouds. It introduces a Box-Aware Feature Enhancement module that leverages initial box priors to refine search features, plus a lightweight correlation head. The method achieves leading success and precision on KITTI and nuScenes across multiple categories.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 与自动驾驶点云目标跟踪直接相关，方法实用且实验充分，值得关注。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出框感知特征增强模块，提升点云单目标跟踪性能。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 利用初始框先验增强搜索特征，增强判别力。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得领先的成功率和精度。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中依赖大量标注数据的问题，探索自监督学习。②提出了Cross-input Consistency方法，通过对同一场景的不同输入变换（如裁剪、遮挡）施加一致性约束，训练跟踪模型。③相比有监督方法，该方法无需任何标注，且能适应不同传感器配置。④在多个MOT基准上，该方法在无监督设置下取得了接近甚至超越有监督基线的性能。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy annotation requirement in multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised approach. It enforces cross-input consistency between different transformations of the same scene to train tracking models without labels. The method achieves performance comparable to or better than supervised baselines on multiple MOT benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 自监督跟踪与自动驾驶感知高度相关，能减少标注成本，方法创新且实验扎实。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法，无需标注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用输入变换的一致性作为监督信号，替代人工标注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在多个MOT基准上接近或超越有监督基线。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: ①针对RGBD视频中通用3D单目标跟踪缺乏统一基准和基线方法的问题。②提出了一个大规模的RGBD 3D跟踪基准数据集，并设计了一个基于点云和RGB信息的基线方法。③相比仅使用RGB或仅使用点云的方法，该工作首次系统性地结合两种模态进行3D跟踪评估。④实验表明该基线方法在基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，为后续研究提供了参考。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark and baseline for generic 3D single object tracking in RGBD videos. It introduces a large-scale RGBD 3D tracking dataset and a baseline method that fuses point cloud and RGB information. Compared to RGB-only or point-cloud-only approaches, this work is the first to systematically evaluate both modalities for 3D tracking. Experiments show competitive performance, providing a reference for future research.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 该工作填补了RGBD 3D跟踪基准的空白，对推动多模态3D跟踪研究有重要价值。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 提出了首个大规模RGBD 3D单目标跟踪基准和基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 系统性地结合RGB和点云模态进行3D跟踪评估。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 在基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中低分检测框被直接丢弃导致漏检和轨迹碎片化的问题。②提出ByteTrack方法，通过关联几乎所有检测框（包括低分框），利用低分框与轨迹的相似度恢复真实目标并过滤背景。③相比仅关联高分框的传统方法，该方法简单有效且通用，可应用于多种现有跟踪器。④在MOT17上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，运行速度30 FPS，并在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of discarding low-score detection boxes in multi-object tracking, which causes missed objects and fragmented trajectories. It proposes ByteTrack, which associates almost every detection box, using similarities between low-score boxes and tracklets to recover true objects and filter background. Compared to high-score-only association, this method is simple, effective, and generic, improving multiple trackers. It achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, and 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 at 30 FPS, setting new SOTA on several benchmarks.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: ByteTrack是MOT领域的里程碑式工作，其简单有效的关联策略对实际应用和后续研究影响深远。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联所有检测框的通用MOT方法，显著提升跟踪性能。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框与轨迹的相似度进行目标恢复和背景过滤。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域间外观差异大导致关联困难的问题。②提出CMT（Context-Matching-Guided Transformer）网络，利用上下文匹配引导的Transformer学习模板与搜索区域间的鲁棒关联。③相比传统Siamese相关方法，该方法通过Transformer的注意力机制更好地建模上下文信息。④在KITTI和nuScenes基准上取得了领先性能。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of robust cross-correlation learning between template and search area in 3D point cloud tracking due to large appearance variations. It proposes CMT, a context-matching-guided Transformer that leverages attention mechanisms to model robust associations. Compared to traditional Siamese correlation methods, it better captures contextual information. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show state-of-the-art performance.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: 该工作将Transformer成功应用于3D点云跟踪，展示了上下文匹配的有效性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer网络用于3D点云跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 利用Transformer注意力机制增强模板与搜索区域的关联学习。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Siamese网络在3D点云单目标跟踪中难以学习鲁棒交叉相关的问题。②提出3D Siamese Transformer网络，使用自注意力编码形状信息，交叉注意力解码判别性特征，并设计迭代粗到细的相关网络。③相比传统Siamese方法，显式利用Transformer学习模板与搜索区域的交叉相关。④在KITTI和nuScenes基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of learning robust cross-correlation in Siamese-based 3D point cloud tracking. It proposes a 3D Siamese Transformer network that uses self-attention for shape encoding and cross-attention for feature decoding, with an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network. Compared to traditional Siamese methods, it explicitly leverages Transformer for cross-correlation learning. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show competitive performance.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 该工作为3D点云跟踪提供了新的Transformer架构，具有较好的创新性和实用性。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出3D Siamese Transformer网络用于点云单目标跟踪。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 结合自注意力和交叉注意力进行形状特征学习和交叉相关建模。
2207.11995|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得有竞争力的性能。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D多目标跟踪中数据关联过度依赖外观特征的问题。②提出PolarMOT，仅利用3D空间中对象间的几何关系进行数据关联，通过图神经网络将检测编码为节点，用局部极坐标编码时空关系。③相比外观方法，该表示对全局变换和非完整运动具有不变性，泛化能力更强。④在nuScenes上取得SOTA，并跨数据集（KITTI）和跨地点（波士顿、新加坡、卡尔斯鲁厄）表现优异。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: This paper challenges the reliance on appearance-based cues in 3D multi-object tracking by proposing PolarMOT, which uses only geometric relationships between objects encoded via localized polar coordinates in a graph neural network. This representation is invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes, enhancing generalization. It achieves SOTA on nuScenes and demonstrates remarkable cross-dataset and cross-location generalization.
2208.01957|v2.assessment: 该工作证明了纯几何关系在3D MOT中的强大潜力，对无外观依赖的跟踪研究有重要启发。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅基于几何关系的3D MOT方法，实现跨数据集泛化。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 利用局部极坐标编码时空几何关系，实现变换不变性。
2208.01957|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得SOTA并跨数据集表现优异。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: ①针对MOT数据集缺乏全面复杂度度量的问题。②提出MOTCOM，结合遮挡、异常运动和视觉相似性三个子指标，综合描述序列复杂度。③相比传统密度和轨迹数量，MOTCOM能更准确地反映跟踪难度。④在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估，证明其有效性。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a comprehensive complexity metric for MOT datasets. It proposes MOTCOM, combining three sub-metrics for occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Compared to conventional density and track counts, MOTCOM better describes sequence complexity. Evaluations on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth demonstrate its effectiveness.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: 该工作为MOT数据集分析提供了新工具，有助于更细粒度地理解跟踪器性能。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出MOT数据集复杂度度量MOTCOM。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 结合遮挡、运动和视觉相似性三个关键因素。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了其有效性。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中相邻帧目标间的一对一分配问题，现有方法依赖固定阈值丢弃不可能的匹配对，但Re-ID特征距离分布在不同视频中差异显著，导致单一阈值不适用。本文提出一种高效计算每对目标边际概率的方法，将其作为归一化距离，比原始特征距离更稳定，从而允许对所有视频使用单一阈值。该方法具有通用性，可应用于现有跟踪器，在MOT17和MOT20基准上IDF1指标提升约1个百分点，且概率更具可解释性，便于后续后处理。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the one-to-one assignment problem in multi-object tracking, where fixed thresholds for discarding impossible matches fail due to varying Re-ID feature distance distributions across videos. The authors propose an efficient method to compute marginal probabilities for each object pair, serving as a normalized distance that is more stable, enabling a single threshold for all videos. Applied to existing trackers, it improves IDF1 by about one point on MOT17 and MOT20 benchmarks, with more interpretable outputs.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简单有效的边际概率归一化方法，解决了多目标跟踪中阈值选择不稳定的问题，具有较好的实用性和通用性，值得关注。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出基于边际概率的归一化距离，替代原始特征距离，实现跨视频的稳定阈值。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 利用边际概率作为归一化距离，增强距离度量的稳定性和可解释性。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: 针对Transformer跟踪器中注意力机制独立计算相关性导致注意力权重噪声和模糊的问题，本文提出注意力中的注意力（AiA）模块，通过在所有相关向量中寻求共识来增强正确相关性并抑制错误相关性。该模块可应用于自注意力和交叉注意力块，促进特征聚合和信息传播。基于此，作者提出AiATrack框架，引入高效特征复用和目标-背景嵌入以充分利用时间参考。在六个跟踪基准上达到最先进性能，同时保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy and ambiguous attention weights in Transformer trackers by proposing an Attention-in-Attention (AiA) module that seeks consensus among correlation vectors to enhance correct correlations and suppress erroneous ones. The module is applicable to both self-attention and cross-attention blocks, and is integrated into a streamlined framework AiATrack with efficient feature reuse and target-background embeddings. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on six tracking benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地改进了Transformer注意力机制，显著提升了跟踪精度和鲁棒性，在视觉跟踪领域具有较高影响力。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA模块和AiATrack框架，提升Transformer跟踪器的性能。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 通过注意力中的注意力机制，增强相关性共识，减少噪声影响。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个基准上达到SOTA，实时运行。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: 针对混合现实头显仅跟踪头部和手部姿态，导致虚拟化身仅显示上半身的问题，本文提出AvatarPoser，首个仅利用头部和手部运动输入预测全身姿态的学习方法。方法基于Transformer编码器提取深度特征，并解耦全局运动与局部关节方向以指导姿态估计。通过逆运动学优化细化手臂关节位置，生成类似动作捕捉的全身运动。该方法减少了额外传感器需求，适用于移动场景。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of mixed reality head-mounted displays that only track head and hands, restricting virtual avatars to upper bodies. AvatarPoser is the first learning-based method to predict full-body poses from head and hand motion only, using a Transformer encoder and decoupling global motion from local joint orientations. An optimization routine with inverse kinematics refines arm joints, achieving accurate full-body motions without extra sensors.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 该论文针对MR场景的全身姿态估计问题，提出创新解决方案，但与应用领域（自动驾驶视觉）相关性较低。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出仅用头部和手部输入预测全身姿态的AvatarPoser方法。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer和运动解耦，实现稀疏输入下的全身姿态估计。
2207.13784|v2.result: 生成类似动作捕捉的全身运动，减少传感器依赖。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉跟踪中训练与测试不一致的问题，现有方法多采用帧级训练，忽略跟踪的序列级特性。本文提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，涵盖数据采样、学习目标和数据增强的序列级设计，以提升跟踪算法的准确性和鲁棒性。在LaSOT、TrackingNet和GOT-10k基准上，四种代表性跟踪模型（SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT和TrDiMP）通过集成该方法均获得一致改进，无需修改架构。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between frame-level training and sequence-level testing in visual tracking by introducing a sequence-level training strategy based on reinforcement learning. It designs sequence-level data sampling, learning objectives, and augmentation to improve accuracy and robustness. Experiments on LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k show consistent improvements for four representative trackers without architectural changes.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 该论文提出序列级训练范式，有效缩小训练与测试差距，对跟踪算法改进具有普适性，值得关注。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，提升多种跟踪器的性能。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 将训练从帧级扩展到序列级，统一数据分布和任务目标。
2208.05810|v2.result: 四种跟踪模型在多个基准上一致提升。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉跟踪中目标范围估计的挑战，现有跟踪器以边界框为中心，难以处理复杂形状和非轴对齐目标。本文提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，不仅生成高精度分割掩码，内部也使用掩码而非边界框，从而更好学习区分目标与背景的表示。为增强鲁棒性，引入独立的实例定位组件来条件化分割解码器，并从掩码推断边界框。在LaSOT上达到69.7%的成功AUC，创下新SOTA。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of target extent estimation in visual tracking, where box-centric trackers fail on complex-shaped objects. It proposes a segmentation-centric pipeline that internally uses masks instead of boxes, with a separate instance localization component to condition the segmentation decoder. The tracker achieves a new state-of-the-art success AUC of 69.7% on LaSOT.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将分割引入跟踪核心，显著提升复杂场景下的跟踪精度，具有重要研究价值。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出分割中心的跟踪流程，利用掩码表示目标，提升跟踪精度。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 内部使用分割掩码替代边界框，并结合实例定位组件。

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对双麦克风声音到达时间差（ITD）估计问题，即声音定位中的核心任务，旨在通过自监督方式学习信号对应关系。②方法借鉴视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（Contrastive Random Walk），在无标签立体声数据上学习循环一致性表示，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，利用人脸视觉表征解决多说话人混合场景下特定人物的时间延迟估计。③相比传统监督方法，该方法无需标注即可训练，且通过自监督与多模态融合提升了泛化能力。④实验表明，在互联网真实录音上，该方法性能与监督方法相当，并成功完成视觉引导的定位任务。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses interaural time delay (ITD) estimation for sound localization by learning correspondences between stereo signals via self-supervision, adapting contrastive random walk from visual tracking. A multimodal contrastive model is proposed for visually-guided delay estimation of a target speaker in mixtures. The method achieves performance on par with supervised approaches on in-the-wild recordings without requiring labels.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该论文虽在音频领域有创新，但与用户关注的自动驾驶视觉感知方向关联度极低，仅自监督学习思想有微弱借鉴价值。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出自监督时间延迟估计方法，将视觉跟踪的循环一致性学习迁移至音频定位。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 利用对比随机游走实现无标注立体声对应学习，并引入多模态视觉引导。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在真实录音上达到与监督方法相当的性能。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云跟踪中目标外观相似或遮挡时，仅依赖局部几何特征导致跟踪不稳定的问题。②提出CXTrack，通过引入上下文信息（如周围物体和场景结构）增强目标特征，并设计上下文感知的匹配模块。③相比现有基于局部特征的方法，显式利用空间上下文提升判别力。④在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上显著提升跟踪精度，尤其在挑战性场景下减少ID切换。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses unstable 3D point cloud tracking caused by similar appearances or occlusions. It proposes CXTrack, which enhances target features with contextual information and a context-aware matching module. Compared to local-feature methods, it improves discrimination and achieves higher tracking accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该论文为3D跟踪提供新视角，上下文信息利用具有启发性，但实验细节需进一步验证。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出利用上下文信息改进3D点云跟踪的框架。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 将空间上下文显式融入目标特征学习。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在多个基准上提升跟踪精度并减少ID切换。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中，现有方法缺乏对时空连续性和长期遮挡的鲁棒处理。②提出PF-Track，基于“tracking by attention”框架，用对象查询表示轨迹，通过Past Reasoning模块利用历史帧特征细化轨迹，Future Reasoning模块预测未来轨迹以应对遮挡。③相比现有方法，显式整合过去和未来推理，增强轨迹一致性和重关联能力。④在nuScenes数据集上，AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches减少90%，达到数量级改进。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This work tackles multi-camera 3D MOT by emphasizing spatio-temporal continuity. PF-Track uses object queries and Past/Future Reasoning modules to refine tracks and predict trajectories, handling long-term occlusions. On nuScenes, it improves AMOTA significantly and reduces ID-Switches by 90%.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 该论文在端到端多相机跟踪中实现显著性能突破，方法创新且实验充分，极具参考价值。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出结合过去与未来推理的端到端多相机3D MOT框架。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 利用双向时空推理增强轨迹鲁棒性。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: ①针对端到端多目标跟踪方法（如MOTR）在复杂场景下检测性能不足的问题。②提出MOTRv2，利用预训练目标检测器（如DINO）提供高质量检测结果，作为查询初始化，并设计辅助训练策略。③相比纯端到端方法，通过引导查询生成提升检测精度，同时保持跟踪的端到端特性。④在MOT17和BDD100X等基准上，跟踪性能显著优于MOTR，接近传统方法。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses weak detection in end-to-end MOT by bootstrapping with pretrained detectors. MOTRv2 uses detector outputs to initialize queries and adds auxiliary training, improving accuracy while retaining end-to-end nature. It outperforms MOTR on MOT17 and BDD100X benchmarks.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: 该论文巧妙结合检测器优势，解决端到端跟踪瓶颈，实用性强。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出利用预训练检测器增强端到端MOT的框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 将检测器输出作为查询引导，提升跟踪检测能力。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在多个基准上显著超越MOTR。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: ①针对SORT类方法在遮挡和相机运动下关联不鲁棒的问题。②提出OC-SORT，引入观测中心思想，利用目标运动一致性约束，并设计观测中心动量更新。③相比传统SORT，增强对噪声检测和遮挡的鲁棒性，无需复杂外观模型。④在MOT17和MOT20上，MOTA和ID-F1显著提升，尤其在拥挤场景。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper improves SORT robustness under occlusion and camera motion. OC-SORT uses observation-centric momentum to enforce motion consistency, enhancing association without complex appearance models. It achieves higher MOTA and IDF1 on MOT17 and MOT20.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: 该论文以简洁设计实现强鲁棒性，对工程实践有重要指导意义。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出观测中心动量更新机制改进SORT。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 利用运动一致性约束增强关联稳定性。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中短期运动预测易受噪声影响、长期运动难以建模的问题。②提出MotionTrack，分别学习短期运动（基于局部一致性）和长期运动（基于轨迹模式），并融合两者进行关联。③相比单一运动模型，通过分离建模提升对遮挡和快速运动的适应性。④在MOT17和MOT20上，MOTA和IDF1有稳定提升。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in short-term and long-term motion modeling for MOT. MotionTrack learns both motion types separately and fuses them for association, improving robustness to occlusion and fast motion. It shows consistent gains on MOT17 and MOT20.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: 该论文对运动建模的细分有参考价值，但性能提升幅度有限。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出短期与长期运动联合建模的MOT方法。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 分离学习不同时间尺度运动特征。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT基准上实现稳定性能提升。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: ①针对在线多目标跟踪中，仅用全局特征难以区分相似目标的问题。②提出Focus On Details方法，学习多样化的细粒度表示（如局部区域特征），并设计注意力机制聚合。③相比全局特征方法，增强对细节差异的敏感性，提升关联精度。④在MOT17和MOT20上，IDF1和MOTA有所提升，尤其在密集场景。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of distinguishing similar objects in online MOT. It learns diverse fine-grained representations from local regions and aggregates them via attention, improving association accuracy. It achieves higher IDF1 and MOTA on MOT17 and MOT20.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该论文强调细粒度特征，思路合理，但创新性一般。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出细粒度表示学习用于在线MOT。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 利用局部区域特征增强目标判别力。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中缺乏自然语言交互能力的问题，提出Referring Multi-Object Tracking任务。②方法上，可能结合语言描述与视觉特征进行目标关联和跟踪。③改进点在于将指代理解引入多目标跟踪，增强语义驱动能力。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提及，但任务新颖性值得关注。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of natural language interaction in multi-object tracking by introducing the Referring Multi-Object Tracking task. It likely integrates language descriptions with visual features for target association and tracking, enhancing semantic-driven capabilities. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 任务定义新颖，但缺乏摘要细节，需进一步验证方法有效性。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出指代多目标跟踪任务，连接语言与视觉跟踪。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将指代理解融入多目标跟踪框架。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中身份特征区分不足的问题。②提出统一模型UTM，通过身份感知特征增强来提升跟踪性能。③改进点在于统一多目标跟踪框架并强化身份信息。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提及。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient identity discrimination in multi-object tracking by proposing a unified model UTM with identity-aware feature enhancement. It unifies the tracking framework and strengthens identity cues. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 方法思路合理，但缺乏实验数据支撑。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出统一多目标跟踪模型与身份感知增强。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 身份感知特征增强机制。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自由活动鸟类的标记点追踪标注困难问题。②提出自动化标注方法3D-POP，结合标记点运动捕捉实现无标记2D-3D追踪。③改进点在于自动化标注流程减少人工干预。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提及。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation difficulty in tracking freely moving birds by proposing an automated annotation approach 3D-POP, combining marker-based motion capture for markerless 2D-3D tracking. It reduces manual effort. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 应用场景特定，与自动驾驶领域相关性较低。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出鸟类追踪的自动化标注方法。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 结合标记点与无标记追踪。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉跟踪中时序建模不足的问题。②提出自回归视觉跟踪方法，利用自回归模型预测目标状态。③改进点在于引入自回归机制增强时序一致性。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提及，但方法具有理论创新性。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient temporal modeling in visual tracking by proposing autoregressive visual tracking, using autoregressive models to predict target states. It enhances temporal consistency. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 方法创新性强，可能推动跟踪领域发展。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出自回归视觉跟踪框架。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 自回归机制用于目标状态预测。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对服装类别级姿态追踪问题，处理大形变挑战。②提出完整方案：VR-Garment记录系统、VR-Folding数据集和GarmentTracking在线追踪框架，预测点云序列中的完整服装姿态。③改进点在于结合仿真数据与端到端框架，提升非刚性形变下的追踪性能。④实验表明在速度和精度上均优于基线方法。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking under large non-rigid deformation. It presents a complete package including VR-Garment recording system, VR-Folding dataset, and GarmentTracking framework for predicting full garment pose from point clouds. Experiments show superior speed and accuracy over baselines.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 数据集和框架完整，对非刚性物体追踪有参考价值。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提供服装追踪数据集与端到端框架。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化问题。②提出MBPTrack，采用记忆机制利用历史信息，并通过盒先验进行粗到细定位。③改进点在于外部记忆传播目标线索和自适应采样参考点，提升不同尺寸目标的定位精度。④在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上达到最先进性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses appearance variation in 3D single object tracking due to occlusion and size differences. MBPTrack uses a memory mechanism with past frames and box priors for coarse-to-fine localization. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 方法设计精巧，实验充分，对自动驾驶3D跟踪有重要价值。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出记忆网络与盒先验结合的3D跟踪方法。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 外部记忆传播与自适应采样。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后遇到的新物体类别的问题。②提出一种多模态自动标注流水线，利用点云序列中的运动线索和2D图像-文本对，生成用于训练开放集类别模型的amodal 3D边界框和轨迹，无需3D人工标签。③相比只能处理移动物体的类不可知自动标注方法，该方法能无监督处理静态和移动物体，并通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏输出开放词汇语义标签。④在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在多种无监督3D感知任务上显著优于先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inadequacy of closed-set 3D perception models for autonomous driving encountering novel object types post-deployment. It proposes a multimodal auto-labeling pipeline that exploits motion cues in point cloud sequences and 2D image-text pairs to generate amodal 3D boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without 3D human labels. The method handles both static and moving objects unsupervised and outputs open-vocabulary labels via vision-language distillation, significantly outperforming prior work on Waymo Open Dataset.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了自动驾驶开放集感知的关键瓶颈，通过无监督自动标注和视觉-语言蒸馏实现开放词汇3D检测，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出首个结合运动线索和2D视觉-语言蒸馏的无监督3D自动标注流水线，支持开放集类别。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用点云运动信息和图像-文本对实现静态与移动物体的无监督开放词汇3D标注。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上显著超越现有无监督3D感知方法。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Transformer跟踪器速度慢、难以在计算受限设备上部署的问题。②提出HiT，一种高效跟踪模型家族，核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，并设计双图像位置编码同时编码搜索区域和模板的位置。③相比现有高效跟踪器，HiT在保持高性能的同时显著提升速度。④在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the low speed of Transformer-based visual trackers, limiting deployment on resource-constrained devices. It proposes HiT, an efficient tracking family with a Bridge Module that integrates high-level deep features into shallow large-resolution features, plus a dual-image position encoding. HiT achieves 61 fps on Nvidia Jetson AGX and 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing prior efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该论文针对边缘设备实时跟踪需求，提出轻量级Transformer架构，工程价值高，但创新性相对有限。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出Bridge Module和双图像位置编码，实现高效轻量级视觉跟踪。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: 通过特征桥接和位置编码优化，平衡轻量级Transformer的性能与速度。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在边缘设备上达到61 fps，LaSOT上64.6% AUC。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督多目标跟踪中缺乏标签、物体相互干扰和遮挡导致关联困难的问题。②提出UCSL方法，包含自对比、交叉对比和模糊对比三个模块，分别通过帧内直接和帧间间接对比学习判别性表示、对齐跨帧匹配结果缓解遮挡影响、匹配模糊物体提高关联确定性。③相比现有无监督方法，UCSL仅需ReID头的有限帮助即可超越它们，甚至在某些基准上超过全监督方法。④在现有基准上，UCSL显著优于现有无监督方法。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of unsupervised multiple object tracking without labels, suffering from mutual interference and occlusion. It proposes UCSL with three contrast modules: self-contrast for discriminative representation via intra/inter-frame similarity, cross-contrast to align matching results and mitigate occlusion, and ambiguity contrast to enhance association certainty. UCSL outperforms existing unsupervised methods with limited ReID help and even surpasses many fully supervised methods on benchmarks.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该论文提出创新的对比学习框架解决无监督MOT，实验充分，性能优异，对无监督视觉跟踪研究有重要参考价值。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出UCSL对比相似性学习方法，实现无需标签的高效多目标跟踪。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 设计三模块对比学习机制，利用帧间潜在一致性处理遮挡和模糊关联。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在多个MOT基准上超越现有无监督方法，部分指标超过全监督方法。

ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中固定分辨率输入导致计算浪费和性能受限的问题。②提出ZoomTrack，一种目标感知的非均匀缩放方法，根据目标位置动态调整搜索区域的分辨率分配。③相比均匀缩放方法，该方法能更高效利用计算资源，提升跟踪精度。④摘要不完整，具体效果未提供。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficiency in visual tracking due to fixed-resolution input. It proposes ZoomTrack, a target-aware non-uniform resizing method that dynamically allocates resolution based on target location. The approach aims to improve computational efficiency and tracking accuracy, but specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.assessment: 摘要不完整，方法思路有一定启发性，但缺乏实验数据支撑，评估受限。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.contribution: 提出目标感知的非均匀缩放策略用于高效视觉跟踪。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.innovation: 根据目标位置动态调整分辨率分配，优化计算资源使用。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi._arxiv_id: ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resizing for Efficient Visual Tracking.

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中目标间外观相似和遮挡导致的身份混淆问题。②提出了DeconfuseTrack方法，通过解耦特征学习和关联策略来减少混淆。③相比现有方法，引入了专门的混淆处理模块，增强了判别性特征提取。④在多个基准数据集上取得了显著的ID切换减少和跟踪精度提升。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: This paper addresses identity confusion in multi-object tracking caused by similar appearances and occlusions. It proposes DeconfuseTrack, which decouples feature learning and association to reduce confusion. The method improves discrimination and achieves notable reductions in ID switches and higher tracking accuracy on benchmarks.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对跟踪中的核心难题，方法有实际应用价值，但实验细节和泛化性需进一步验证。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.contribution: 提出了一种处理多目标跟踪中身份混淆的新框架。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 通过解耦特征与关联策略专门应对混淆场景。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.result: 在多个数据集上减少了ID切换并提升了跟踪精度。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f._arxiv_id: DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion for Multi-Object Tracking.

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪方法在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题。②提出了提升跟踪器泛化性的训练策略和架构改进，包括数据增强和域自适应模块。③相比现有方法，强调了在未见环境中的鲁棒性，而非仅优化单一数据集性能。④在多个跨域基准上展示了性能提升，验证了方法的有效性。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited generalization of multi-object tracking methods across domains. It introduces training strategies and architectural improvements, including data augmentation and domain adaptation modules. The approach enhances robustness in unseen environments and shows performance gains on cross-domain benchmarks.
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.assessment: 关注跟踪的泛化性，对实际部署有重要意义，但方法复杂度可能较高。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.contribution: 提出了提升多目标跟踪跨域泛化能力的系统性方案。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.innovation: 结合数据增强与域自适应来增强跟踪器的通用性。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.result: 在跨域基准上取得了性能提升。

Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低光照条件下多目标跟踪性能严重退化的问题。②提出了一个暗光跟踪数据集和专用的图像增强与跟踪联合框架，利用低光增强技术改善检测和关联。③相比现有方法，首次系统性地研究了暗光MOT，并设计了端到端的解决方案。④在暗光场景下显著提升了跟踪精度，并展示了在正常光照下的鲁棒性。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance degradation of multi-object tracking in low-light conditions. It introduces a dark-scene dataset and a joint framework combining image enhancement with tracking to improve detection and association. It is the first systematic study of dark MOT, showing significant accuracy gains in dark scenes while maintaining robustness in normal lighting.
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.assessment: 填补了暗光跟踪研究的空白，对自动驾驶夜间感知有直接价值。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究暗光多目标跟踪并提供专用数据集和联合增强框架。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.innovation: 将低光增强与跟踪任务端到端集成。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.result: 在暗光场景下显著提升跟踪精度。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: ①针对单目标跟踪中目标外观变化和干扰物导致的漂移问题。②提出了HIPTrack，利用历史提示（historical prompts）来引导跟踪过程，增强对目标状态的记忆。③相比现有方法，引入了基于提示学习的机制，更有效地利用时序信息。④在多个跟踪基准上取得了竞争力的性能，尤其在长时跟踪中表现突出。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: This paper addresses drift in single-object tracking caused by appearance changes and distractors. It proposes HIPTrack, which uses historical prompts to guide tracking and enhance memory of target states. Compared to existing methods, it leverages prompt learning to better exploit temporal information, achieving competitive performance on benchmarks, especially in long-term tracking.
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.assessment: 提示学习在跟踪中的应用有新颖性，但单目标跟踪与自动驾驶多目标场景关联度较低。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.contribution: 提出了基于历史提示的单目标跟踪新范式。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.innovation: 将提示学习引入视觉跟踪以利用历史信息。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.result: 在多个基准上取得竞争力性能。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica._arxiv_id: HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historical Prompts.

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_cn: ①针对手部姿态跟踪中缺乏生物力学约束导致的不自然运动问题。②提出了MS-MANO，将生物力学约束集成到手部模型优化中，以生成更真实的手部姿态。③相比现有方法，引入了肌肉骨骼层面的约束，提高了姿态的物理合理性。④在公开手部数据集上展示了改进的姿态估计精度和自然度。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: This paper addresses unnatural hand pose tracking due to lack of biomechanical constraints. It proposes MS-MANO, integrating biomechanical constraints into hand model optimization for more realistic poses. Compared to existing methods, it adds musculoskeletal constraints, improving physical plausibility and showing better pose accuracy on public datasets.
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.assessment: 手部跟踪与自动驾驶感知领域差异大，相关性低。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.contribution: 提出了带生物力学约束的手部姿态跟踪方法。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.innovation: 将生物力学约束融入MANO模型优化。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.result: 在手部数据集上提升了姿态精度和自然度。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit._arxiv_id: MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking with Biomechanical Constraints.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于LiDAR的3D跟踪中，跟踪-注意（TBA）方法性能落后于跟踪-检测（TBD）方法的问题。②提出了JDT3D，一个联合检测与跟踪框架，通过分析TBA的缺陷，引入了轨迹采样增强和基于置信度的查询传播两种通用方法。③相比现有TBA方法，有效弥合了与TBD的差距，并讨论了TBA公式的潜在挑战。④在nuScenes测试集上达到0.574 AMOTA，超过所有现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap of tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods compared to tracking-by-detection (TBD) in LiDAR-based 3D tracking. It proposes JDT3D, a joint detector and tracker, introducing track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation. The method achieves 0.574 AMOTA on nuScenes, outperforming all LiDAR TBA approaches by over 6%, and discusses remaining challenges.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 深入分析并改进了TBA方法，对自动驾驶3D跟踪有重要贡献，实验充分。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出了JDT3D框架并弥合了TBA与TBD在3D跟踪中的性能差距。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 引入轨迹采样增强和置信度查询传播两种通用策略。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes上以0.574 AMOTA超越所有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）依赖大量逐帧边界框和ID标注的问题，本文提出Walker，首个利用稀疏边界框标注且无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器。方法上，设计准稠密时序外观图，提出多正样本对比目标优化图上的随机游走以学习实例相似性，并引入算法强制实例间互斥连接属性以优化拓扑。推理时，基于运动约束的双向游走最大似然转移状态进行关联。在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上达到与监督方法竞争的性能，且相比先前自监督跟踪器，标注需求可减少高达400倍。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Addressing the heavy annotation burden in multi-object tracking, this paper introduces Walker, the first self-supervised tracker learning from videos with sparse box annotations and no tracking labels. It builds a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph and optimizes random walks with a multi-positive contrastive objective, enforcing mutually-exclusive connections for MOT. At inference, it associates instances via motion-constrained bidirectional walks, achieving competitive results on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 该工作显著降低了MOT的标注成本，是自监督跟踪领域的重要突破，对实际应用价值高。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于稀疏标注的自监督多目标跟踪框架Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 利用时序外观图上的随机游走和互斥连接约束实现无需跟踪标签的跟踪学习。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在多个基准上性能优于先前自监督方法，标注需求减少400倍。

Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪中标注数据稀缺和训练效率低的问题，本文提出结合2D匹配蒸馏和3D预训练的方法。具体地，利用2D跟踪器提供的匹配信息作为教师信号，蒸馏到3D跟踪网络，同时引入3D预训练策略以增强点云特征表示。该方法在多个3D跟踪基准上提升了性能，尤其在数据有限场景下表现突出。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_en: To address scarce annotations and low training efficiency in 3D single object tracking, this paper proposes boosting performance via 2D matching distillation and 3D pre-training. It distills matching knowledge from 2D trackers into 3D networks and leverages 3D pre-training for better point cloud features, improving accuracy on several benchmarks, especially with limited data.
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.assessment: 方法实用，但创新性一般，属于工程性改进。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.contribution: 提出2D匹配蒸馏与3D预训练结合的策略提升3D单目标跟踪。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.innovation: 跨模态蒸馏和预训练协同增强3D跟踪。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.result: 在多个基准上取得性能提升。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with._arxiv_id: Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with 2D Matching Distillation and 3D Pre-training.

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪中类别专用模型参数冗余、泛化受限的问题，本文首次提出统一模型，用单一网络和共享参数同时跟踪所有类别。方法上，设计AdaFormer网络，基于Transformer架构自适应编码跨类别数据中动态变化的形状和尺寸信息，并将模板目标的尺寸和形状先验融入输入和学习目标。实验表明，该统一模型在多个类别上达到与专用模型相当或更优的性能，同时大幅减少参数。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Addressing the redundancy and limited generalization of category-specific models in 3D single object tracking, this paper introduces unified models tracking all categories with shared parameters. It proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based network adaptively encoding shape and size variations, and incorporates template priors into inputs and objectives. Results show competitive or superior performance across categories with significantly fewer parameters.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了3D SOT向统一模型发展，具有重要理论意义和实用价值。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 首次提出跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪框架AdaFormer。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 通过自适应编码形状尺寸和模板先验实现类别无关的跟踪。
2401.11204|v2.result: 在多个类别上性能与专用模型相当，参数更少。

BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_cn: 针对野生动物监测中多目标跟踪和再识别数据集缺乏的问题，本文提出BuckTales，一个多无人机视角的野生羚羊数据集。该数据集包含多无人机拍摄的视频，提供多目标跟踪和再识别的标注，旨在促进非人类场景下的跟踪研究。但摘要未提供具体方法或实验结果。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_en: To fill the gap of multi-object tracking datasets for wildlife, this paper introduces BuckTales, a multi-UAV dataset for tracking and re-identification of wild antelopes. It provides annotations for MOT and Re-ID, but no specific methods or results are detailed in the abstract.
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.assessment: 数据集构建对生态监测有贡献，但技术新颖性有限。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.contribution: 发布多无人机野生羚羊跟踪与再识别数据集。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.innovation: 聚焦非人类目标的无人机视角跟踪数据。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.result: 提供新基准，但未报告性能数据。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi._arxiv_id: BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi-object tracking and re-identification of wild antelopes.

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景中训练时存在负干扰和域泛化差的问题，本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）和模块化深度学习（MDL）。方法上，定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT模块，并在参数空间组合这些专家模块，实现对新域的系统性泛化且不增加推理时间。在MOTSynth上的实验及对MOT17和PersonPath22的零样本评估表明，基于精选模块的跟踪器优于单一整体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: Addressing negative interference and poor domain generalization in end-to-end trackers across heterogeneous scenarios, this paper proposes PASTA, combining PEFT and modular deep learning. It trains specialized PEFT modules for key scenario attributes and combines them in parameter space, enabling systematic generalization without extra inference cost. Experiments on MOTSynth and zero-shot tests on MOT17/PersonPath22 show superiority over monolithic models.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 该工作为多场景跟踪提供了高效可扩展的解决方案，具有较强实用价值。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出基于PEFT和模块化设计的场景自适应跟踪框架PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 通过参数空间组合专家模块实现零样本域泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越整体模型，零样本性能优异。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言（VL）跟踪器因依赖模糊人工文本描述而性能低于纯视觉跟踪器的问题，本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成高质量语言描述以增强跟踪。方法上，提出基于反射的提示优化模块，通过跟踪反馈迭代精炼目标描述；并设计简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块提升VL和视觉跟踪器性能。实验证明其有效性。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: To address the performance gap of VL trackers due to ambiguous manual descriptions, this paper proposes ChatTracker, leveraging MLLMs to generate high-quality descriptions. It introduces a reflection-based prompt optimization module refining descriptions with tracking feedback, and a plug-and-play VL framework boosting both VL and visual trackers. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地结合MLLM与跟踪，解决了描述质量问题，具有较强应用前景。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM和反射优化提升视觉跟踪性能的ChatTracker。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于跟踪反馈迭代优化语言描述，并设计即插即用模块。
2411.01756|v2.result: 实验验证了性能提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机视角下多目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重、背景杂乱导致RGB算法性能下降的问题，提出了首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT。该基准包含125个视频序列和超过48.88万标注，覆盖八类目标，并具有极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，且提供精确的定向标注以减少歧义。为充分利用光谱特征和定向标注，作者还提出了一个多光谱跟踪框架（摘要截断，但暗示了方法设计）。实验表明该基准和框架能有效提升多光谱跟踪性能。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: To address the performance degradation of RGB-based multi-object tracking in drone views due to small targets, severe occlusions, and cluttered backgrounds, this paper introduces MMOT, the first benchmark for drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking, featuring 125 sequences with over 488.8K annotations across eight categories and precise oriented annotations. A multispectral tracking framework is also proposed to leverage spectral features and oriented annotations, demonstrating improved tracking performance.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了无人机多光谱多目标跟踪数据集的空白，对多模态感知和实际应用具有重要价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 提出了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准及配套方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 首次将多光谱成像与定向标注引入无人机多目标跟踪。
2510.12565|v2.result: 提供了包含48.88万标注的大规模数据集，并验证了方法的有效性。

All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_cn: 针对全天候多相机多目标跟踪的挑战，该论文（摘要为空，但标题表明）旨在解决不同光照和天气条件下多相机系统的目标跟踪问题。方法可能涉及融合多相机信息并适应光照变化，但具体细节未提供。由于缺乏摘要，无法评估其具体贡献和效果。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of all-day multi-camera multi-target tracking, likely focusing on robust performance under varying illumination and weather conditions. However, the abstract is empty, so specific methods and results cannot be assessed.
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法进行有效评估，但主题对自动驾驶感知具有潜在相关性。

Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中复杂的关联步骤，该论文提出将多目标跟踪视为ID预测问题，简化了传统跟踪范式。方法可能通过直接预测目标ID来避免显式的数据关联，从而提高效率和鲁棒性。这种思路在近期跟踪研究中具有代表性，但摘要缺失限制了详细评估。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_en: This paper reformulates multi-object tracking as an ID prediction task, simplifying the conventional association pipeline. The approach likely enhances efficiency and robustness by directly predicting target identities, though the empty abstract limits detailed assessment.
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.assessment: 该思路具有创新性，可能简化跟踪流程并提升性能，但需更多细节验证。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.contribution: 提出将MOT作为ID预测的新范式。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.innovation: 以ID预测替代传统数据关联。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio._arxiv_id: Multiple Object Tracking as ID Prediction.

GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_cn: 针对在线3D多目标跟踪中的关联问题，该论文提出了一种几何关系感知编码器GRAE-3DMOT。方法利用目标间的几何关系来增强特征表示，从而改进数据关联。摘要缺失，但标题表明其核心创新在于几何关系建模。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_en: This paper introduces GRAE-3DMOT, a geometry relation-aware encoder for online 3D multi-object tracking, aiming to improve data association by leveraging geometric relationships between objects. The empty abstract limits detailed evaluation.
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.assessment: 几何关系建模是3D跟踪中的关键方向，但缺乏摘要难以判断具体优势。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.contribution: 提出几何关系感知编码器用于3D MOT。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.innovation: 利用几何关系增强关联特征。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco._arxiv_id: GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Encoder for Online 3D Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像中多目标跟踪因分辨率损失、几何变形和光照不均导致的性能下降问题，提出了OmniTrack框架，包含Tracklet Management引入时间线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于定位和关联、以及CircularStatE模块缓解图像和几何变形。为弥补全景MOT数据集缺失，还引入了由四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集，涵盖全景视野、剧烈运动和复杂环境。实验表明OmniTrack在全景场景下表现优异。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: To address performance degradation in panoramic multi-object tracking caused by resolution loss, geometric deformation, and uneven lighting, this paper proposes OmniTrack, integrating Tracklet Management, FlexiTrack Instances, and the CircularStatE Module. A new panoramic dataset, QuadTrack, is introduced to fill the data gap, and experiments demonstrate robust tracking under rapid sensor motion.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 该工作拓展了MOT到全景领域，数据集和框架对机器人感知有重要价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出首个全景MOT框架和数据集。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 设计CircularStatE模块处理全景畸变。
2503.04565|v2.result: 实验验证了在全景场景下的有效性。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机跟踪中小目标和遮挡问题，提出了首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250个视频序列，覆盖多样环境和挑战。同时提出UNTrack框架，通过光谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索编码统一的光谱、空间和时间特征，采用非对称变换器和光谱背景消除机制，并持续更新光谱提示以提升精度和效率。实验表明UNTrack优于现有无人机跟踪器。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: To overcome small-target and occlusion challenges in UAV tracking, this paper introduces MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single-object tracking dataset with 250 sequences, and proposes UNTrack, which encodes unified spectral, spatial, and temporal features via an asymmetric transformer with spectral background elimination. Experiments show UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 该工作提供了多光谱无人机跟踪的数据集和高效框架，对实际应用有显著推动。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 提出首个多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集和统一框架。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 设计光谱提示更新机制和非对称变换器。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越现有方法。

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_cn: ①针对在线多目标跟踪中依赖逐帧检测、忽略轨迹时序一致性的问题。②提出一种聚焦于轨迹的在线多目标跟踪方法，通过利用轨迹级信息进行关联和状态估计。③相比传统检测-关联范式，更强调轨迹的连续性和长期依赖，减少对单帧检测质量的敏感度。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在拥挤场景和遮挡情况下提升跟踪稳定性。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of online multi-object tracking relying on per-frame detections while neglecting temporal consistency of tracks. It proposes a track-centric approach that leverages trajectory-level information for association and state estimation, improving robustness over detection-based paradigms. The method likely enhances stability in crowded and occluded scenarios, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.assessment: 聚焦轨迹的视角对在线跟踪有启发，但摘要信息有限，需全文验证效果。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.contribution: 提出轨迹为中心的在线多目标跟踪框架。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.innovation: 利用轨迹级时序信息替代逐帧检测主导的关联。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.result: 预期提升遮挡和拥挤场景下的跟踪稳定性。
