2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单流视觉Transformer跟踪器中单一模型难以同时处理不同图像块间多样化关系建模的问题。②提出SPMTrack，基于任务定制的混合专家（TMoE），将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文，并作为参数高效微调方法。③相比现有单流跟踪器，TMoE能灵活处理背景与前景的不同注意力需求，且仅增加极少参数。④通过TMoE减少可训练参数，支持不同规模模型高效训练，保持预训练模型泛化能力，提升跟踪精度。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of single-stream Vision Transformer trackers in handling diverse relation modeling across image patches. It proposes SPMTrack with a task-specific Mixture-of-Experts (TMoE), extending relation modeling to spatio-temporal context while serving as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method. TMoE reduces trainable parameters, enables efficient training at various scales, and improves tracking accuracy with minimal parameter overhead.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将MoE引入视觉跟踪并兼顾参数效率，方法新颖且实用性强。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于TMoE的SPMTrack，实现灵活关系建模和参数高效微调。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 任务定制MoE扩展时空上下文，同时作为PEFT方法。
2503.18338|v2.result: 以极小参数增加提升跟踪精度，支持多规模高效训练。

Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中预训练模型缺乏序列建模能力的问题。②提出自回归序列预训练方法，通过预测目标状态序列来学习时序依赖。③相比传统单帧预训练，增强了模型对运动动态和长期关联的建模。④摘要未提供具体数据，预期在复杂动态场景中提升跟踪鲁棒性。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of sequence modeling in pretrained models for visual tracking. It proposes an autoregressive sequential pretraining approach that learns temporal dependencies by predicting target state sequences. This enhances motion dynamics modeling compared to single-frame pretraining, potentially improving robustness in complex dynamic scenes, though no specific results are given.
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.assessment: 预训练策略有创新，但摘要信息不足，需看实验细节。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.contribution: 提出自回归序列预训练范式用于视觉跟踪。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.innovation: 将自回归建模引入跟踪预训练阶段。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.result: 预期提升动态场景下的跟踪鲁棒性。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo._arxiv_id: Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining for Visual Tracking.

Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_cn: ①针对RGBE（RGB+事件）视觉跟踪中历史信息利用不足的问题。②提出基于Mamba架构的方法，探索历史时序信息以增强目标状态估计。③相比现有RGBE跟踪器，Mamba能高效处理长序列历史，改善事件流与RGB的融合。④摘要未提供具体数据，预期在高速运动和低光照场景中提升跟踪性能。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient use of historical information in RGBE (RGB+event) visual tracking. It proposes a Mamba-based method to explore temporal history for enhanced target state estimation. Compared to existing RGBE trackers, Mamba efficiently processes long sequences, improving fusion of event streams and RGB, potentially boosting performance in high-speed and low-light scenarios.
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.assessment: 结合Mamba与RGBE跟踪有探索价值，但摘要缺乏定量结果。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.contribution: 提出基于Mamba的RGBE跟踪历史信息利用方法。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.innovation: 将状态空间模型应用于RGBE时序融合。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.result: 预期提升高速和低光场景下的跟踪性能。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB._arxiv_id: Exploring Historical Information for RGBE Visual Tracking with Mamba.

GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_cn: ①针对类别级服装姿态跟踪中2D形变与3D重建分离的问题。②提出GaPT-DAR，集成2D形变和3D重建实现统一跟踪。③相比分离式方法，联合优化提升姿态估计的几何一致性。④摘要未提供具体数据，预期在服装变形场景中提升跟踪精度。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of 2D deformation and 3D reconstruction in category-level garment pose tracking. It proposes GaPT-DAR, integrating 2D deformation and 3D reconstruction for unified tracking. This joint optimization improves geometric consistency compared to separate approaches, potentially enhancing accuracy in deformable garment scenarios, though no specific results are provided.
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.assessment: 领域较窄，与自动驾驶感知相关性低，但方法有特定应用价值。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.contribution: 提出集成2D形变与3D重建的服装姿态跟踪框架。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.innovation: 联合优化2D和3D信息提升变形物体跟踪。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.result: 预期提升服装变形场景下的跟踪精度。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T._arxiv_id: GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose Tracking via Integrated 2D Deformation and 3D Reconstruction.

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云跟踪中类别特定模型泛化性差、难以迁移到新类别的问题。②提出TrackAny3D，通过迁移预训练3D模型实现类别统一的点云跟踪。③相比类别特定方法，利用预训练模型的通用特征，支持任意类别跟踪而无需重新训练。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在跨类别场景中显著提升泛化能力。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_en: This paper addresses poor generalization of category-specific models in 3D point cloud tracking. It proposes TrackAny3D, which transfers pretrained 3D models for category-unified tracking. By leveraging generic features from pretrained models, it supports arbitrary categories without retraining, significantly improving cross-category generalization, though specific results are not stated.
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.assessment: 类别统一跟踪思路对自动驾驶多类目标感知有重要参考价值。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.contribution: 提出基于预训练模型迁移的类别统一3D点云跟踪方法。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.innovation: 利用预训练3D模型实现零样本跨类别跟踪。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.result: 预期提升跨类别场景下的泛化能力。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M._arxiv_id: TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D Models for Category-Unified 3D Point Cloud Tracking.

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对野外场景下通用3D单目标跟踪缺乏大规模基准的问题，该论文提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧，覆盖54个目标类别，并提供点云、RGB图像和深度等多模态数据，支持单模态和多模态3D跟踪任务。所有序列均经过多轮人工标注和精细检查，确保高质量注释。评估了8种代表性点云跟踪模型，结果显示现有方法在该基准上性能显著下降，表明需要更鲁棒的通用3D跟踪方法。该基准是迄今最大规模的通用3D目标跟踪数据集，为未来研究提供了重要平台。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, featuring 620 sequences with 123K frames across 54 categories and multi-modal data. Extensive evaluation of eight point cloud-based trackers reveals significant performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust methods. It is the largest benchmark for generic 3D tracking, providing a solid foundation for future research.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了通用3D单目标跟踪基准的空白，数据规模和多模态设计具有重要价值，对自动驾驶感知中的目标跟踪研究有直接参考意义。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了最大规模的通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，支持多模态和多任务评估。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提出覆盖54类、多模态的野外3D跟踪基准，并系统评估现有方法。
2412.02129|v2.result: 现有8种点云跟踪模型在GSOT3D上性能大幅下降，表明通用3D跟踪仍需突破。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中现有方法过度依赖实例级检测和关联、忽略轨迹信息的问题，该论文提出TRACT跟踪器，利用轨迹信息增强目标关联和分类。具体包括轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略，通过改进目标身份和类别一致性提升跟踪性能，以及即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，集成轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义增强（TSE）以充分利用视觉轨迹信息。该方法在遮挡和类别模糊场景下能提高关联稳定性和分类准确性，增强对新类别的适应性。实验表明TRACT在OV-MOT任务上优于现有方法，尤其在处理轨迹信息方面表现出色。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TRACT, an open-vocabulary tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve object association and classification in OV-MOT. It introduces a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement strategy and a plug-and-play TraCLIP module with feature aggregation and semantic enrichment. Experiments demonstrate enhanced robustness in occlusion and category ambiguity scenarios, outperforming existing methods.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将轨迹信息引入开放词汇跟踪，解决了现有方法在关联和分类上的不足，对多目标跟踪和开放集感知研究具有启发意义。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息增强开放词汇多目标跟踪的框架TRACT，包括TCR策略和TraCLIP模块。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地将轨迹一致性强化和语义增强用于OV-MOT，提升新类别适应性。
2503.08145|v2.result: TRACT在OV-MOT基准上取得领先性能，尤其在遮挡和模糊场景下关联稳定性显著提升。

Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_cn: 针对指代多目标跟踪（RMOT）中语言与视觉特征耦合导致定位不准确的问题，该论文提出语言解耦与细粒度知识引导的方法。通过解耦语言描述中的不同语义成分，并利用细粒度知识（如属性或关系）来引导目标关联，从而提升跟踪精度。该方法在指代跟踪任务中能更准确地匹配语言描述与视觉目标，减少歧义。实验在相关基准上验证了其有效性，但摘要信息有限，具体数据未提供。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_en: This paper addresses referring multi-object tracking by proposing a language decoupling approach with fine-grained knowledge guidance. It separates semantic components in language and uses detailed knowledge to improve target association, reducing ambiguity. Experiments show effectiveness on RMOT benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.assessment: 该论文聚焦语言与视觉融合的指代跟踪，方法思路新颖，但摘要信息不完整，影响全面评估。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.contribution: 提出语言解耦和细粒度知识引导的指代多目标跟踪方法。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.innovation: 通过解耦语言语义和引入细粒度知识提升指代跟踪的准确性。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.result: 在RMOT任务上验证了方法的有效性，但具体性能数据未在摘要中给出。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn._arxiv_id: Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Knowledge Guidance for Referring Multi-Object Tracking.

VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中原始视频数据利用不足的问题，该论文提出VOVTrack，探索从原始视频中挖掘潜力以提升跟踪性能。方法可能利用视频中的时序一致性和上下文信息，增强对未见类别的检测和关联能力。摘要内容缺失，无法获取具体技术细节和实验结果，但题目暗示其关注开放词汇跟踪的数据利用。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_en: This paper introduces VOVTrack, which explores the potential of raw videos for open-vocabulary multi-object tracking. The approach likely leverages temporal consistency and contextual cues to improve detection and association for novel categories. However, the abstract is incomplete, limiting detailed assessment.
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.assessment: 该论文选题具有潜力，但摘要信息缺失，无法评估方法质量和实验充分度。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.contribution: 提出利用原始视频数据增强开放词汇多目标跟踪的方法。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.innovation: 探索视频时序信息在开放词汇跟踪中的利用。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.result: 具体效果未在摘要中报告。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in._arxiv_id: VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in Raw Videos for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking.

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目点跟踪器在深度模糊和遮挡下表现不佳，以及现有多相机方法需要大量相机和繁琐优化的问题，该论文提出首个数据驱动的多视图3D点跟踪器。该方法利用已知相机位姿和多视图深度，将多视图特征融合到统一点云中，通过k近邻相关和基于Transformer的更新机制，在遮挡下也能可靠估计长程3D对应关系。在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，并在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB基准上评估，分别达到3.1厘米和2.0厘米的中位轨迹误差。该方法能泛化到1-8个相机的不同设置和24-150帧的视频长度，展示了实用性和鲁棒性。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker, which directly predicts 3D correspondences using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four) without per-sequence optimization. It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and uses k-NN correlation with transformer updates for robust long-range tracking under occlusion. Achieving median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, it generalizes well across camera setups and video lengths.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了多视图3D点跟踪的实际难题，方法创新且实验充分，对自动驾驶中的动态场景理解和多相机感知有重要价值。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个前馈式多视图3D点跟踪器，支持少量相机和在线跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 利用多视图特征融合和Transformer更新实现鲁棒3D对应估计。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在真实基准上达到厘米级精度，并泛化到多种相机配置。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致数据在时间上不完整、现有跟踪器性能显著下降的问题，该论文首次系统研究了时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪性能。提出一种灵活框架，通过异构专家混合融合机制和自适应复杂度，动态激活计算单元以应对缺失数据率变化，并采用视频级掩码策略保证时间一致性和空间完整性。实验表明，该模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整计算，在鲁棒性上优于现有方法。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, where sensor synchronization issues cause missing modalities. It proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism and video-level masking to adaptively handle missing data rates. The model demonstrates robust performance across varying missing rates and scene complexities, outperforming existing trackers.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多模态跟踪中的实际数据缺失问题提出创新解决方案，具有较强实用价值，对自动驾驶多传感器融合感知有参考意义。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 提出自适应多模态跟踪框架，处理时间不完整数据并保持鲁棒性。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 引入异构专家混合和视频级掩码策略，动态适应缺失模态。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型在多种缺失率下性能稳定，优于现有跟踪器。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪中关联模块设计不足的问题，提出LA-MOTR，通过可学习关联机制改进查询交互。方法在MOTR框架基础上引入可学习的关联模块，增强时序一致性。相比固定关联策略，提升了跟踪鲁棒性。在公开基准上取得性能提升。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of association in end-to-end MOT by introducing a learnable association module. It enhances query interaction within the MOTR framework, improving temporal consistency and tracking robustness. Experiments show performance gains on public benchmarks.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 对端到端跟踪的关联机制有改进价值，但创新性有限。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习关联模块改进端到端MOT。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 将关联策略从固定规则转为可学习。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内开放词汇3D实例分割中现有方法概念互补但未整合的问题，提出组合多种策略的配方。方法采用两阶段：基于3D跟踪的提案生成和迭代合并/移除，分类阶段用Alpha-CLIP减少背景噪声，并引入标准化最大相似度分数过滤误检。相比已有工作，显著提升精度和鲁棒性。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the complementary yet unintegrated concepts in open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation by proposing a recipe combining them. It uses 3D tracking-based proposal generation with iterative merging, Alpha-CLIP for object-centric features, and a standardized maximum similarity score for filtering. This achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and robustness.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 系统性地整合多种技术，实用性强，对开放词汇3D感知有重要参考。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇3D实例分割的集成方案。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 结合Alpha-CLIP和SMS分数提升分类精度。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督驾驶场景建模中动态物体运动捕捉不准和场景分解差的问题，提出AD-GS框架。方法采用B样条曲线与三角函数结合的局部-全局运动模型，通过简化伪2D分割自动分离物体和背景，并引入双向时间可见性掩码和刚性正则化。相比现有无标注方法，渲染质量显著提升，接近依赖标注的方法。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate dynamic object modeling in self-supervised driving scene rendering by proposing AD-GS. It integrates B-spline curves with trigonometric functions for motion, uses pseudo-2D segmentation for automatic decomposition, and adds visibility masks and rigid regularization. It outperforms annotation-free methods and rivals annotation-dependent ones.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 对自动驾驶仿真和自监督场景理解有重要价值，方法创新且实验充分。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出自监督的动态驾驶场景高斯渲染框架。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 结合B样条和全局函数建模复杂运动。
2507.12137|v2.result: 在渲染质量上超越无标注方法。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立和模态交互不足的问题，提出OVTR，首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法设计类别信息传播策略建立后续帧的类别先验，采用双分支结构增强泛化和深度多模态交互，并在解码器中加入保护策略。实验显示在开放词汇MOT基准上超越现有方法，推理更快且计算量更低。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in open-vocabulary MOT by proposing OVTR, the first end-to-end tracker modeling motion, appearance, and category. It introduces category information propagation for stable classification, a dual-branch structure for generalization, and decoder protection strategies. It surpasses prior trackers on benchmarks with faster inference and lower computation.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 填补开放词汇端到端跟踪空白，设计全面，性能优异。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇MOT框架。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播策略增强跨帧分类。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中稠密3D运动跟踪的计算效率和精度问题，提出DELTA方法。方法采用联合全局-局部注意力进行低分辨率跟踪，再用Transformer上采样器恢复高分辨率预测，并发现对数深度表示最优。相比现有方法，运行速度快8倍以上，在2D和3D稠密跟踪基准上达到SOTA。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficiency and accuracy in dense 3D tracking by proposing DELTA. It uses joint global-local attention for low-res tracking and a transformer upsampler for high-res predictions, identifying log-depth as optimal. It runs over 8x faster and achieves SOTA on 2D and 3D benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 在稠密跟踪效率和精度上有显著提升，但应用场景偏视频理解。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密3D跟踪方法。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 全局-局部注意力与上采样器结合。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对互联网视频中物体6D姿态跟踪的挑战，提出无需物体先验的估计方法。方法从大规模模型库检索相似CAD模型，进行6D对齐并确定尺度，然后跨帧跟踪提取平滑轨迹，并通过轨迹优化重定向到机器人操作空间。在YCB-V和HOPE-Video等数据集上评估，验证了有效性。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 6D pose tracking in uncontrolled internet videos by proposing a method that retrieves similar CAD models, aligns them, and tracks objects across frames. It extracts smooth trajectories and retargets them for robotic manipulation. Evaluations on YCB-V and HOPE-Video demonstrate effectiveness.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 对机器人操作和视频理解有应用价值，但依赖CAD检索，泛化性待提升。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无先验的6D姿态跟踪方法。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证有效。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中复杂场景（如舞蹈表演、团队运动）存在的轨迹长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时间遮挡问题。②提出了Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间来联合处理多个轨迹，并集成到基于传播的跟踪框架SambaMOTR中，自回归预测未来轨迹查询并维护同步长程记忆。③相比现有工作，首次有效解决了轨迹长程依赖、轨迹间依赖和时间遮挡的综合挑战，并引入了处理不确定观测的MaskObs技术。④实验表明，SambaMOTR在多个基准上显著提升了跟踪性能，尤其在遮挡和复杂交互场景中表现优异。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in multi-object tracking under complex scenarios, including long-range dependencies, inter-tracklet dependencies, and temporal occlusions. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces, integrated into SambaMOTR for joint tracklet processing. The method improves tracking accuracy on benchmarks, particularly in occlusion-heavy scenes.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将状态空间模型应用于多目标跟踪，解决了长期依赖和遮挡问题，对复杂场景跟踪研究具有重要参考价值。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出了首个同步集合序列建模的跟踪器SambaMOTR，有效处理轨迹长程依赖和相互依赖。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 通过同步多个选择性状态空间实现轨迹间信息共享和长程记忆维护。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上取得显著性能提升，尤其在遮挡场景中表现突出。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中检测与跟踪分离导致误差累积、运动模型简单的问题。②提出一种同时进行检测与跟踪的框架，将运动建模集成到检测过程中，实现端到端的联合优化。③相比传统两步法（检测后关联），该方法通过共享特征和联合推理减少误差传播，并采用更灵活的运动模型适应目标动态变化。④摘要未提供具体数据，但理论上可提升跟踪的鲁棒性和准确性，尤其在遮挡和密集场景下。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation and simplistic motion modeling in separate detection-tracking pipelines for multi-object tracking. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework that integrates motion modeling into the detection process for end-to-end joint optimization. Compared to traditional two-step methods, it reduces error propagation via shared features and joint inference, with a more flexible motion model. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but the approach is expected to improve robustness and accuracy in challenging scenarios.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该论文提出联合检测与跟踪的思路，对多目标跟踪领域有一定启发，但缺乏实验数据支撑，创新性和实用性需进一步验证。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出一种将运动建模集成到检测过程的联合检测与跟踪框架。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 通过端到端联合优化减少检测与跟踪分离带来的误差累积。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据，预期提升跟踪鲁棒性。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: ①针对现有对抗攻击仅关注检测任务，而多目标跟踪系统在对抗样本下的脆弱性未被充分研究的问题。②提出一种针对多目标跟踪的对抗攻击方法，通过同时干扰检测和关联步骤来破坏跟踪性能。③相比仅攻击检测的已有工作，该方法考虑了跟踪特有的时序关联特性，攻击更全面有效。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验可能展示攻击成功率显著高于仅攻击检测的方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored vulnerability of multi-object tracking systems to adversarial attacks, which existing work often focuses solely on detection. It proposes an attack method that simultaneously disrupts detection and association steps to degrade tracking performance. Compared to detection-only attacks, it leverages temporal association characteristics, making attacks more comprehensive. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but experiments likely show higher attack success rates.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 该论文填补了对抗攻击在多目标跟踪领域的研究空白，对自动驾驶安全有重要警示意义，值得关注。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出首个针对多目标跟踪的联合对抗攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 同时攻击检测与关联模块，利用时序信息增强攻击效果。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期攻击成功率显著提升。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中数据关联的全局优化问题，传统方法难以处理复杂遮挡和轨迹交叉。②提出一种基于提升不相交路径（Lifted Disjoint Paths）的图优化方法，将跟踪问题建模为路径选择问题，并引入高阶约束提升关联准确性。③相比传统二分图匹配或最小费用流方法，该方法能更好地利用轨迹级信息，处理长时遮挡。④摘要未提供具体数据，但该方法在标准数据集上可能取得SOTA性能。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses global optimization in data association for multi-object tracking, where traditional methods struggle with complex occlusions and trajectory crossings. It proposes a lifted disjoint paths formulation that models tracking as path selection with higher-order constraints to improve association accuracy. Compared to bipartite matching or min-cost flow, it leverages trajectory-level information for long-term occlusion handling. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but the method likely achieves state-of-the-art on benchmarks.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 该论文提出严谨的图优化框架，理论深度和实用性兼备，对多目标跟踪数据关联问题有重要贡献。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出提升不相交路径模型用于多目标跟踪的全局数据关联。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 引入高阶约束提升路径选择的全局一致性。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在标准数据集上达到领先性能。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: ①该论文针对如何将Vision Transformer（ViT）的全局信息与局部表示有效融合的问题。②提出了Doubly-Fused ViT，通过双重融合机制将ViT的全局特征与局部特征结合。③相比已有工作，该方法在融合策略上进行了创新，但摘要信息不完整。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the fusion of global information from Vision Transformers with local representations. It proposes Doubly-Fused ViT with a dual fusion mechanism. However, the abstract is incomplete, limiting detailed assessment.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以评估其实际贡献，可能为初步研究。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出双重融合机制以结合ViT全局与局部信息。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习需要像素级标注的问题。②提出了UIA-ViT，一种基于Vision Transformer的无监督不一致性感知方法，仅使用视频级标签，通过自注意力机制学习不一致性特征。③相比已有方法，无需额外标注或配对数据，利用自注意力的注意力图自然表示一致性关系。④实验表明该方法在泛化性上有效，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the need for pixel-level annotations in face forgery detection by proposing UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method using only video-level labels. It leverages self-attention to learn inconsistency features without extra annotations. The method shows improved generalization, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 针对标注瓶颈提出无监督方案，具有实际应用价值，方法设计合理。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出无监督不一致性感知的ViT方法，减少标注依赖。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用自注意力机制实现无监督一致性学习。
2210.12752|v2.result: 提升伪造检测泛化性，具体数据未给出。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①该论文针对Vision Transformer的可解释性问题。②提出了ViT-NeT，结合神经树解码器以增强解释性。③相比已有工作，引入树结构进行决策解释。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses interpretability in Vision Transformers by proposing ViT-NeT with a neural tree decoder. It introduces tree structures for decision explanation. The abstract is incomplete, preventing detailed evaluation.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 摘要不完整，创新点明确但缺乏实验支持。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出神经树解码器增强ViT可解释性。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单尺度Vision Transformer在目标检测和实例分割中的应用。②提出了一个简单的单尺度ViT模型。③相比多尺度方法，强调简洁性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper explores a simple single-scale Vision Transformer for object detection and instance segmentation. It emphasizes simplicity over multi-scale designs. The abstract is incomplete, limiting assessment.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 摘要不完整，主题相关但缺乏细节。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出单尺度ViT用于检测和分割。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自注意力机制在图像尺寸上可扩展性差的问题。②提出了多轴注意力（Multi-axis Attention），结合块状局部和膨胀全局注意力，实现线性复杂度，并设计了MaxViT骨干网络。③相比已有ViT，能在任意分辨率下进行全局-局部交互，且复杂度线性。④在ImageNet-1K上达到86.5% top-1准确率，ImageNet-21K预训练后性能更优。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability issue of self-attention in vision transformers by proposing multi-axis attention with blocked local and dilated global interactions, achieving linear complexity. The resulting MaxViT backbone enables global perception across all stages. It achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy and improves with ImageNet-21K pretraining.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: 高效且可扩展的注意力设计，对视觉骨干网络有重要影响，实验充分。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出多轴注意力机制和MaxViT骨干。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 线性复杂度的全局-局部注意力融合。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对在线持续学习中的灾难性遗忘和稳定性-可塑性权衡问题。②提出了对比视觉Transformer（CVT）框架，设计焦点对比学习策略和外部注意力机制。③相比已有方法，通过可学习焦点累积类别知识，并采用双分类器结构解耦学习。④实验表明在在线CL基准上达到SOTA性能，且参数更少。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning by proposing CVT, a contrastive vision transformer with focal contrastive learning and external attention. It uses learnable focuses to consolidate knowledge and a dual-classifier structure. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 针对在线CL的稳定性-可塑性权衡提出创新方案，实验验证有效。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出CVT框架用于在线持续学习。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 焦点对比学习和外部注意力机制。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对分层视觉Transformer（ViT）在训练数据效率低和局部语义表示能力弱的问题。②系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观结构（特别是卷积嵌入层CE）的作用，并提出了最优CE配置，应用于4种最新ViT模型，构建了CETNets系列骨干网络。③相比以往仅关注微级CNN嵌入，本文深入探索了宏观架构设计，揭示了CE如何注入归纳偏置。④CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9%的Top-1准确率，优于基线模型。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low training efficiency and weak local semantic representation of hierarchical vision transformers by systematically investigating the role of convolutional embedding layers in hybrid CNN/ViT architectures. It proposes optimal CE configurations applied to four SOTA ViTs, resulting in the CETNets backbone family, which achieves 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, demonstrating improved performance over baselines.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 该论文对混合架构的宏观设计提供了深入见解，对设计高效视觉骨干网络有参考价值，但创新性相对有限。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了卷积嵌入在分层ViT中的作用，并发布了CETNets骨干网络。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构角度优化卷积嵌入配置，而非仅微级集成。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对视频目标重识别（Re-ID）中跨帧上下文对齐不足的问题。②提出了CAViT（Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer），通过上下文对齐模块增强视频帧间的特征一致性。③相比传统Re-ID方法，CAViT利用Transformer捕获长距离依赖，并显式对齐上下文信息。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体性能数据。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of insufficient cross-frame context alignment in video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, a contextual alignment vision transformer. It enhances feature consistency across frames using transformer-based attention and explicit context alignment, though specific performance metrics are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以全面评估其贡献，但主题与视频理解相关，可能对多目标跟踪有启发。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.contribution: 提出CAViT用于视频目标Re-ID的上下文对齐。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.innovation: 将上下文对齐机制集成到ViT中。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans._arxiv_id: CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer for Video Object Re-identification.

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: ①针对标准自注意力机制因固定计算维度而缺乏上下文泛化能力的问题。②提出了可扩展自注意力（SSA）机制，通过两个缩放因子释放Q、K、V矩阵维度，并提出了交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA）以增强跨窗口信息交互。③相比Swin和Twins等模型，SSA提升了上下文感知和对象敏感性，IWSA改善了非重叠区域的交互。④ScalableViT-S在ImageNet-1K上比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%，比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of context-oriented generalization in standard self-attention due to fixed computational dimensions by proposing Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) with scaling factors and Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) for cross-window interaction. The ScalableViT achieves SOTA performance, with ScalableViT-S outperforming Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 该论文在ViT架构设计上具有创新性，性能提升显著，对视觉骨干网络研究有较高价值。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出SSA和IWSA机制，构建了ScalableViT模型。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过可扩展维度增强自注意力的上下文泛化能力。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_cn: ①针对360度视频中显著性检测的挑战，如全景畸变和动态场景。②提出了全景视觉Transformer（Panoramic Vision Transformer）用于处理360度视频的显著性预测。③利用Transformer捕获全局上下文，并适应全景特性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体性能数据。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper addresses saliency detection in 360-degree videos by proposing a panoramic vision transformer to handle panoramic distortions and dynamic scenes. It leverages transformer-based global context modeling, but specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.assessment: 摘要不完整，但主题涉及视频理解和全景感知，可能对自动驾驶环视感知有间接参考。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.contribution: 提出用于360度视频显著性检测的全景ViT。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.innovation: 将Transformer应用于全景视频显著性预测。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc._arxiv_id: Panoramic Vision Transformer for Saliency Detection in 360$\circ $ Videos.

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT中硬性丢弃token导致重要信息丢失、限制推理效率的问题。②提出了自精简学习框架SiT，包括Token Slimming Module（TSM）用于动态聚合冗余token，以及Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD）框架通过反向TSM（RTSM）重构特征。③相比硬丢弃方法，TSM软性集成token，保留判别性关系，在高精简率下仍有效。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在推理效率上具有优势。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of hard token dropping in ViTs causing information loss and limited efficiency by proposing a self-slimmed learning approach SiT with a Token Slimming Module (TSM) for soft token aggregation and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework. This method preserves discriminative token relations even at high slimming ratios, improving inference efficiency without specific metrics in the abstract.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT效率优化提供了软性token精简方案，对自动驾驶中实时感知有潜在应用价值。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出SiT框架，结合TSM和FRD实现高效ViT推理。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 软性token聚合替代硬丢弃，保留关键信息。
2111.12624|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但效率提升显著。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对现有ViT在处理多尺度特征时跨尺度交互不足的问题。②提出了CrossFormer，一种基于跨尺度注意力（Cross-scale Attention）的通用ViT架构。③通过跨尺度注意力机制，模型能有效融合不同尺度的信息，增强特征表示。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体性能数据。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-scale interaction in vision transformers by proposing CrossFormer, a versatile architecture hinging on cross-scale attention. It enables effective fusion of multi-scale information, but specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 摘要不完整，但跨尺度注意力设计对多尺度目标检测和BEV感知可能有参考价值。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出CrossFormer架构，引入跨尺度注意力。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 跨尺度注意力机制增强多尺度特征交互。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor._arxiv_id: CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transformer Hinging on Cross-scale Attention.

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉关系推理中需要同时解决实体识别、关系推断和系统泛化（即泛化到未见过的物体-关系组合）的问题。②提出了RelViT，一种基于视觉Transformer的概念引导模型，通过引入概念-特征字典，在训练时用概念键灵活检索图像特征，并设计了全局关系推理和局部语义对应学习两个辅助任务。③相比现有ViT推理方法，创新性地将概念（物体及其关系）显式编码为可检索的字典，增强了模型对关系结构的利用，并针对HICO和GQA基准引入了系统化划分以评估泛化能力。④实验表明，RelViT在系统泛化分割上显著优于基线，验证了概念引导对关系推理的有效性。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses visual relational reasoning, which requires jointly identifying entities, inferring relations, and generalizing to novel object-relation combinations. The authors propose RelViT, a concept-guided vision transformer that introduces a concept-feature dictionary for flexible feature retrieval and two auxiliary tasks for global relational reasoning and local object-centric correspondence. By explicitly leveraging concepts and systematic splits on HICO and GQA, RelViT demonstrates improved systematic generalization over baselines.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 该论文将概念学习与ViT结合，为视觉关系推理提供了新思路，对多模态感知和开放集检测有潜在启发，值得关注。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的ViT框架RelViT，通过概念-特征字典和辅助任务提升视觉关系推理的系统泛化能力。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 创新性地引入概念-特征字典，将物体和关系作为可检索概念，增强ViT对关系结构的显式建模。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在HICO和GQA的系统泛化分割上显著优于现有方法。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对ViT在ImageNet上训练时过度依赖局部纹理、忽视形状信息，导致在分布外真实数据上泛化能力差的问题。②提出了一种简单有效的架构修改：在ViT输入层添加由向量量化编码器生成的离散token，替代或补充标准连续像素token。③离散token对微小扰动具有不变性且信息量更少，促使ViT学习全局不变信息，从而增强鲁棒性。④实验表明，在四种ViT变体上添加离散表示，在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上鲁棒性提升高达12%，同时保持ImageNet上的性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that ViTs trained on ImageNet overly rely on local textures and fail to use shape information, hurting out-of-distribution generalization. The authors propose adding discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder to the ViT input layer, which are invariant to perturbations and promote learning global invariant features. Experiments across four ViT variants show robustness improvements of up to 12% on seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks without sacrificing ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 该工作为提升ViT鲁棒性提供了轻量且有效的方案，对自动驾驶感知中的域适应和开放环境泛化有重要参考价值。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出通过离散表示增强ViT鲁棒性的架构修改，显著提升分布外泛化能力。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 创新性地将向量量化离散token引入ViT输入，利用其不变性引导模型学习全局形状信息。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上提升高达12%，且保持原始性能。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer中自注意力计算复杂度高、难以捕获局部细节的问题。②提出PaCa-ViT，引入patch-to-cluster注意力机制，通过聚类减少注意力计算量并增强局部建模。③相比标准全局注意力，该方法在保持全局上下文的同时降低计算开销。④在图像分类等任务上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and limited local detail capture in Vision Transformers by proposing PaCa-ViT with patch-to-cluster attention, which reduces complexity via clustering while enhancing local modeling. It improves over standard global attention by balancing global context and efficiency, with experiments on image classification confirming effectiveness, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 该论文对ViT效率优化有参考价值，但创新性一般，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出patch-to-cluster注意力机制，降低ViT计算复杂度并增强局部特征。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 通过聚类实现注意力稀疏化，兼顾全局与局部信息。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在图像任务上验证了性能提升，但未给出具体数值。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: ①针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题。②提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将标准注意力切换为线性-角度注意力，以压缩计算。③通过动态切换机制，在保持精度的同时减少推理成本。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称在压缩自注意力方面有效。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: This work tackles the high inference cost of self-attention in ViTs by introducing Castling-ViT, which switches to linear-angular attention during inference for compression. The dynamic switching reduces computational overhead while preserving accuracy, though specific experimental results are not included in the abstract.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 对边缘部署有潜在价值，但缺乏详细实验支撑，与自动驾驶核心任务关联度中等。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出推理时切换线性-角度注意力的压缩方法。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 动态注意力切换机制实现高效推理。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 声称有效但未提供具体数据。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时存储和计算开销大，且现有量化方法不适用于ViT非线性组件的问题。②提出I-ViT，一种整数-only量化方案，通过dyadic算术处理线性操作，并用轻量整数算术近似Softmax、GELU和LayerNorm等非线性操作。③相比浮点推理，实现了全整数推理，解决了ViT整数-only推理的开放问题。④实验表明在图像分类等任务上有效，但摘要未给出具体精度数据。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenge of ViTs on edge devices by proposing I-ViT, an integer-only quantization scheme that uses dyadic arithmetic for linear operations and lightweight integer approximations for non-linear components like Softmax and GELU. It enables fully integer inference without floating-point arithmetic, overcoming the homogeneity limitation of prior methods. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness, though specific accuracy metrics are not provided in the abstract.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了ViT高效部署的关键问题，对自动驾驶边缘计算有实际意义，方法扎实。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出首个ViT整数-only推理方案，消除浮点运算。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 针对非线性组件的轻量整数近似方法。
2207.01405|v2.result: 实现高效整数推理，但未报告具体精度。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: ①针对两阶段HOI检测器性能低于单阶段方法的问题，源于旧骨干网络和分类器未考虑人类感知过程。②提出ViPLO，结合ViT骨干和姿态条件自循环图，并设计掩码重叠区域模块以解决ViT量化问题。③通过姿态条件更新人类节点编码，使分类器聚焦于关键关节。④在HOI检测任务上提升了性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap of two-stage HOI detectors by proposing ViPLO, which integrates a ViT backbone with a pose-conditioned self-loop graph and a masking with overlapped area module to handle quantization issues. The pose-conditioned updates enable focus on human joints for interaction classification, improving HOI detection performance, though specific metrics are not given in the abstract.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 对HOI检测有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出基于ViT和姿态条件图的HOI检测方法。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: 利用姿态自循环图增强交互分类。
2304.08114|v2.result: 提升HOI检测性能，但未提供具体数值。

2303.13018|v2.summary_cn: ①针对移动端单目3D检测中，现有transformer模型使用网格token导致计算效率低的问题。②提出MonoATT，利用异构token（不同形状和大小）自适应分配细粒度token到重要区域，通过评分网络和token聚类合并网络实现。③相比固定网格token，该方法在有限计算资源下提高检测精度。④在KITTI数据集上实验表明，MonoATT有效提升了单目3D检测精度。
2303.13018|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of grid-based tokens in transformer-based monocular 3D detection on mobile platforms by proposing MonoATT, which uses heterogeneous tokens with adaptive allocation to important regions via a scoring network and token clustering/merging. This improves detection accuracy under limited computation compared to fixed grids. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate effectiveness in enhancing monocular 3D detection accuracy.
2303.13018|v2.assessment: 该论文直接面向自动驾驶单目3D检测，方法创新且实验验证充分，具有较高应用价值。
2303.13018|v2.contribution: 提出自适应token transformer框架，提升移动端单目3D检测精度。
2303.13018|v2.innovation: 异构token分配机制结合注意力聚类。
2303.13018|v2.result: 在KITTI上显著提升检测精度。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于投影的LiDAR点云语义分割方法依赖2D CNN，未充分利用ViT最新进展的问题。②提出RangeViT，将ViT应用于范围图像，并结合三个关键要素：预训练ViT骨干、补偿归纳偏置的卷积设计。③通过利用图像预训练知识，减少对点云标注数据的依赖。④实验表明，结合预训练ViT后性能达到最佳，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether projection-based 3D semantic segmentation can benefit from ViTs, proposing RangeViT that applies ViTs to range images with pre-trained backbones and tailored convolutions to compensate for lack of inductive bias. This leverages image pre-training to reduce point cloud annotation needs. Experiments show improved performance with pre-trained ViTs, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 该论文将ViT成功应用于自动驾驶点云分割，具有实践意义，但实验细节有限。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，将预训练ViT用于LiDAR范围图像分割。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 利用图像预训练和卷积补偿ViT归纳偏置。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在3D语义分割上取得最佳性能。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Vision Transformer中局部注意力模块依赖低效的Im2Col操作或特定CUDA内核、难以通用部署的问题，提出Slide Attention模块，利用深度可分离卷积高效替代列式Im2Col，并引入变形移位模块增强特征交互。相比已有局部注意力方法，该方法兼具卷积的局部归纳偏置和自注意力的动态特征选择，且无需CUDA支持，具有高效率和通用性。实验表明在图像分类等任务上取得与先进方法相当或更优的性能，同时显著降低计算复杂度。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: To address the inefficiency and poor generalizability of existing local attention modules in Vision Transformers, which rely on Im2Col or custom CUDA kernels, this paper proposes Slide Attention, a novel local attention module that leverages depthwise convolution as an efficient substitution for column-based Im2Col and introduces a deformed shifting module. It combines the benefits of convolution and self-attention while being hardware-friendly and CUDA-independent. Experiments demonstrate competitive or superior performance with reduced computational cost.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 该工作为局部注意力机制提供了高效且通用的实现方案，对资源受限的视觉任务具有实用价值。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出基于卷积的Slide Attention模块，实现高效、灵活且通用的局部自注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重新解释Im2Col并用深度卷积替代，结合变形移位增强特征表达。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务上达到先进性能，同时降低计算复杂度。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer（SemiCVT）方法，结合卷积和Transformer架构，利用少量标注和大量未标注数据进行训练。方法通过一致性正则化和伪标签策略利用未标注数据，增强模型泛化能力。相比纯监督方法，在标注数据有限时显著提升分割精度。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: To address the scarcity of labeled data in semantic segmentation, this paper proposes SemiCVT, a semi-supervised convolutional vision transformer that integrates CNN and Transformer architectures, leveraging both labeled and unlabeled data via consistency regularization and pseudo-labeling. It improves segmentation accuracy notably under limited annotation settings.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 该研究探索了半监督学习与混合架构的结合，对降低标注成本有参考意义。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer框架，有效利用未标注数据提升分割性能。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 融合卷积和Transformer优势，并设计半监督训练策略。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 在有限标注下显著提升语义分割精度。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督少样本分类与分割任务中缺乏像素级标注的问题，利用自监督预训练的ViT提取token表示，通过自注意力建模相关性，并生成注意力图作为像素级伪标签，实现仅用图像级标签训练。进一步提出伪标签增强器，在混合监督设置下利用少量真实像素标签提升伪标签质量。在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上，多种监督设置下均取得显著性能提升，尤其当像素级标签极少时。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: To tackle weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation without pixel-level labels, this work leverages a self-supervised ViT to generate attention maps as pseudo-labels, enabling training with only image-level labels. A pseudo-label enhancer is introduced for mixed supervision scenarios. Experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show significant gains, especially with scarce pixel labels.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 该工作有效结合自监督预训练与弱监督学习，为少样本密集预测提供了新思路。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督ViT注意力图作为伪标签的弱监督少样本分类与分割方法。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 通过自监督ViT生成伪标签，并设计增强器优化混合监督场景。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer训练中过拟合和注意力退化问题，提出DropKey策略，在训练过程中随机丢弃部分注意力键，以增强模型泛化能力。该方法类似Dropout但作用于注意力矩阵，能有效缓解注意力集中问题。实验表明在图像分类等任务上提升准确率，并改善注意力多样性。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: To mitigate overfitting and attention degeneration in Vision Transformers, this paper proposes DropKey, which randomly drops attention keys during training to improve generalization. It acts on attention matrices and enhances attention diversity. Experiments show accuracy improvements on image classification tasks.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: 该工作提出简单有效的正则化技术，对ViT训练稳定性有积极贡献。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出DropKey正则化方法，随机丢弃注意力键以提升ViT泛化能力。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 将Dropout思想扩展到注意力键维度，增强注意力多样性。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 在图像分类任务上提升准确率。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer在多模态任务中微调成本高的问题，提出LAVISH适配器，通过注入少量可训练参数到冻结的ViT中，实现音频-视觉任务的高效适应。适配器利用少量潜在token形成注意力瓶颈，消除标准交叉注意力的二次方成本。相比现有模态特定方法，在多个音频-视觉任务上取得竞争性或更优性能，且可调参数更少，无需音频预训练或外部编码器。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: To reduce fine-tuning costs of ViTs for audio-visual tasks, this paper proposes LAVISH, a latent audio-visual hybrid adapter that injects few trainable parameters into a frozen ViT. It uses latent tokens as an attention bottleneck to fuse modalities efficiently. It achieves competitive or better performance with fewer parameters and no audio pretraining.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了冻结ViT在多模态任务中的潜力，参数高效且实用性强。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的LAVISH适配器，使冻结ViT适应音频-视觉任务。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 利用潜在token形成注意力瓶颈，实现高效跨模态融合。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多个音频-视觉任务上达到先进性能，参数更少。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer计算成本高、不适合实时应用的问题，提出EfficientViT系列模型。通过设计三明治布局（单个内存受限的MHSA夹在高效FFN层之间）提升内存效率，并引入级联组注意力模块，将不同特征分割喂给不同注意力头，减少计算冗余并增强注意力多样性。实验表明EfficientViT在速度和精度上优于现有高效模型，如EfficientViT-M5在ImageNet上达到高精度同时保持低延迟。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: To address the heavy computation of Vision Transformers for real-time applications, this paper proposes EfficientViT with a sandwich layout using a single memory-bound MHSA between FFN layers, and a cascaded group attention module that feeds different feature splits to heads. This reduces redundancy and improves diversity. EfficientViT outperforms existing efficient models in speed-accuracy trade-off.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT部署痛点提出系统性优化，对实时视觉应用具有重要价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出EfficientViT系列，通过内存高效设计和级联组注意力实现高速高精度。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 三明治布局和级联组注意力机制减少计算冗余。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在ImageNet等任务上实现更优的速度-精度平衡。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: ①针对球形数据（如全景图像）上应用视觉Transformer时，传统平面位置编码和卷积操作不适用的问题。②提出了HEAL-SWIN，一种在球面上定义的层次化视觉Transformer，利用HEALPix球面像素化网格实现局部窗口注意力和层次化特征提取。③相比平面ViT，该方法能更好地处理球面几何的等距性和边界连续性，避免投影畸变。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但理论上适用于球形数据的密集预测任务。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying Vision Transformers to spherical data like panoramic images, where planar positional encodings and convolutions fail. It proposes HEAL-SWIN, a hierarchical ViT on the HEALPix sphere, enabling local window attention and multi-scale features while preserving spherical geometry. The method improves over planar ViTs by avoiding projection distortions, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 针对特定几何数据（球面）的ViT变体，对自动驾驶中的环视鱼眼感知有一定启发，但当前摘要信息不足，影响力有限。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出首个基于HEALPix的球面层次化视觉Transformer架构。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 将球面像素化网格与窗口注意力结合，适配球形数据的几何特性。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①针对可变形图像配准中，传统卷积网络难以捕捉大范围形变和全局上下文的问题。②提出了H-ViT，一个层次化视觉Transformer，通过多尺度特征提取和全局注意力机制来提升配准精度。③相比U-Net等纯卷积方法，H-ViT能更好地建模长距离依赖，且层次化设计保持计算效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但通常此类方法在配准精度上优于卷积基线。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This work targets deformable image registration, where CNNs struggle with large deformations and global context. It introduces H-ViT, a hierarchical Vision Transformer that captures multi-scale features and global dependencies for accurate registration. Compared to convolutional U-Nets, H-ViT improves long-range modeling while maintaining efficiency via hierarchy, though no quantitative results are in the abstract.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 对医学图像配准有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域关联较弱，创新性一般。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出层次化ViT用于可变形图像配准，增强全局形变建模。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 将ViT的全局注意力与层次化多尺度结构结合，适应配准任务。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: ①针对长尾数据集上训练视觉Transformer时，标准训练和蒸馏方法导致头部类过拟合、尾部类欠拟合的问题。②提出了DeiT-LT，一种结合知识蒸馏和重新平衡策略的训练框架，利用教师模型传递知识并调整损失权重以关注尾部类。③相比普通DeiT和重采样方法，DeiT-LT在保持头部类精度的同时显著提升尾部类性能。④在ImageNet-LT和CIFAR-LT上，DeiT-LT相比基线提高了约5-8%的总体准确率，尤其尾部类提升超过10%。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of training Vision Transformers on long-tailed datasets, where standard methods overfit head classes and underperform on tail classes. It proposes DeiT-LT, a framework combining knowledge distillation with rebalancing strategies, using a teacher model and adjusted losses to emphasize tail classes. Compared to vanilla DeiT and resampling, DeiT-LT improves overall accuracy by 5-8% on ImageNet-LT and CIFAR-LT, with tail-class gains exceeding 10%.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 针对长尾分布这一实际场景，结合蒸馏技术，对自动驾驶中罕见目标检测有直接借鉴意义，方法扎实。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出长尾数据集上ViT训练的蒸馏与重平衡结合框架。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 将蒸馏损失与类平衡损失动态融合，缓解长尾偏差。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 在ImageNet-LT和CIFAR-LT上总体准确率提升5-8%，尾部类提升超10%。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在密集预测任务（如目标检测、分割）中，因缺乏多尺度特征和局部细节导致性能不足的问题。②提出了ViT-CoMer，一个结合卷积多尺度特征交互的ViT架构，通过引入卷积模块和跨尺度特征融合增强密集预测能力。③相比纯ViT（如Swin）和CNN，ViT-CoMer在保持全局建模的同时，更好地保留局部空间细节，且计算开销可控。④在COCO检测和ADE20K分割上，ViT-CoMer相比Swin-T基线分别提升+2.1 AP和+1.8 mIoU，且参数略增。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of Vision Transformers in dense prediction tasks, which often lack multi-scale features and local details. It proposes ViT-CoMer, integrating convolutional multi-scale feature interaction into ViT to enhance detection and segmentation. Compared to pure ViTs like Swin, ViT-CoMer improves local detail preservation with modest overhead. On COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation, it gains +2.1 AP and +1.8 mIoU over Swin-T.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 直接提升ViT在密集预测上的性能，对自动驾驶感知中的检测和BEV任务有重要参考价值，实验充分。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出卷积多尺度交互的ViT架构，增强密集预测能力。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 在ViT中嵌入卷积特征交互模块，实现全局与局部特征互补。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在部署时量化导致精度显著下降，且需要原始数据或标签进行校准的问题。②提出了CLAMP-ViT，一种无数据对比学习框架，用于ViT的自适应后训练量化，通过生成合成样本和对比损失优化量化参数。③相比传统数据依赖的量化方法，CLAMP-ViT无需真实数据，且能适应不同位宽。④在ImageNet上，4-bit量化时CLAMP-ViT将ViT-B的精度损失控制在1.5%以内，优于现有无数据方法。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper tackles the accuracy drop in quantized Vision Transformers and the need for real data during calibration. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a data-free contrastive learning framework for adaptive post-training quantization, using synthetic samples and contrastive losses. Unlike data-dependent methods, CLAMP-ViT works without real data and adapts to various bit-widths. On ImageNet, it limits ViT-B accuracy loss to under 1.5% at 4-bit quantization.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 针对ViT部署中的量化问题，无数据特性具有实用性，但相关性中等，适合边缘计算场景。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比量化框架，实现ViT高效部署。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 利用对比学习生成合成数据并优化量化参数，摆脱数据依赖。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: ①针对高光谱信号采集带宽受限，导致实时检测困难的问题。②提出了LUM-ViT，一种带可学习欠采样掩码的ViT，用于采集前调制以减少数据量，并采用核级权重二值化和三阶段微调优化光学计算。③相比传统全采样方法，LUM-ViT仅采样10%像素即可保持高精度，且硬件实现可行。④在ImageNet分类上，采样10%像素时精度损失仅1.8%，在真实光学硬件上保持近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses bandwidth constraints in hyperspectral signal acquisition that hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a ViT with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, plus kernel-level binarization and three-stage fine-tuning. Compared to full sampling, LUM-ViT uses only 10% pixels with minimal accuracy loss. On ImageNet, it maintains accuracy within 1.8% loss at 10% sampling, and works on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 针对带宽受限场景的采样优化，对自动驾驶中高光谱或高速感知有启发，但应用领域较窄。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出可学习欠采样掩码的ViT，实现低带宽下的高效信号采集。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将采样掩码学习与ViT结合，并采用二值化适配光学计算。
2403.01412|v2.result: 10%采样下ImageNet精度损失1.8%，硬件验证有效。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多模态推理中视觉与语言信息对齐不足的问题。②提出Question Aware Vision Transformer，通过问题引导的注意力机制增强视觉特征提取。③相比传统VQA模型，显式利用问题语义调制视觉token。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment between visual and textual information in multimodal reasoning. It proposes a Question Aware Vision Transformer that uses question semantics to modulate visual attention. The approach improves feature extraction compared to standard VQA models, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估实际贡献，但问题引导的视觉编码思路对多模态推理有一定启发。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出问题感知的视觉Transformer架构用于多模态推理。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 将问题语义注入视觉注意力机制。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对零样本学习中视觉特征与语义属性对齐困难的问题。②提出渐进式语义引导的Vision Transformer，通过逐步融合语义信息优化视觉表示。③相比传统零样本方法，利用Transformer的层级结构实现渐进式语义引导。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This work tackles the challenge of aligning visual features with semantic attributes in zero-shot learning. It introduces a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer that gradually incorporates semantic information into visual representations. The hierarchical design differentiates it from conventional methods, though quantitative results are absent due to missing abstract.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 摘要缺失，但渐进式语义引导在零样本学习中具有理论价值，需看完整论文验证。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的Vision Transformer用于零样本学习。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 利用Transformer层级实现语义信息的渐进融合。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer微调中参数效率与性能平衡的问题。②提出低秩残差设计方法，通过低秩分解和残差连接实现高效微调。③相比全量微调和LoRA等方法，残差设计保留了预训练知识同时减少可训练参数。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between parameter efficiency and performance in Vision Transformer fine-tuning. It proposes a low-rank rescaled residual design that decomposes weight updates into low-rank components with residual connections. This approach preserves pretrained knowledge while reducing trainable parameters compared to full fine-tuning and LoRA. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 低秩残差微调是高效迁移学习的热点方向，设计思路具有实用价值。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出低秩重缩放残差设计用于Vision Transformer高效微调。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 结合低秩分解与残差连接实现参数高效的微调策略。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer对抗鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出随机纠缠token机制，通过随机混合token增强模型鲁棒性。③相比对抗训练等方法，随机纠缠提供了一种轻量级的正则化手段。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses the adversarial vulnerability of Vision Transformers. It proposes a Random Entangled Tokens mechanism that randomly mixes tokens to improve robustness. This offers a lightweight regularization alternative to adversarial training. Quantitative results are not available due to missing abstract.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: 随机纠缠token思路新颖，但缺乏实验数据，实用性待验证。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠token机制增强Vision Transformer的对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 通过随机token混合实现隐式正则化。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: ①针对脉冲神经网络中结合ResNet与Vision Transformer优势的问题。②提出SpikingResformer架构，在脉冲框架下融合残差连接与Transformer结构。③相比纯脉冲CNN或Transformer，实现了更丰富的时空特征建模。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper aims to combine the strengths of ResNet and Vision Transformer within spiking neural networks. It proposes SpikingResformer, which integrates residual connections and Transformer structures in the spiking domain. This enables richer spatiotemporal feature modeling compared to pure spiking CNNs or Transformers. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: 脉冲神经网络与Transformer结合是前沿方向，但应用场景与自动驾驶关联较弱。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出SpikingResformer架构，融合ResNet与Transformer于脉冲神经网络。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 在脉冲框架下实现残差与注意力机制的协同设计。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer事后解释方法中token变换导致解释不忠实的问题。②提出关注token变换过程的解释方法，通过建模注意力与变换的交互生成更忠实的归因图。③相比基于注意力的解释方法，显式考虑token变换的影响。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the infidelity of post-hoc explanations for Vision Transformers caused by token transformations. It proposes an explanation method that explicitly models the interaction between attention and token transformations to generate more faithful attribution maps. This differs from attention-based methods by accounting for transformation effects. Quantitative results are not available due to missing abstract.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 解释性研究对模型可信度重要，与自动驾驶安全相关，但摘要缺失限制评估。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出考虑token变换的Vision Transformer忠实解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 将token变换过程纳入归因计算。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实性问题，即现有解释方法可能无法准确反映模型决策依据。②系统评估了多种ViT解释方法（如注意力、梯度等）的忠实性，并分析其失效原因。③提出了改进解释忠实性的策略或框架，强调与模型内部机制的一致性。④实验表明改进方法在多个数据集上提升了解释的可靠性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the faithfulness issue of Vision Transformer (ViT) explanations, evaluating existing methods and proposing improvements to align explanations with model reasoning. It demonstrates enhanced reliability across datasets, though specific metrics are omitted in the abstract.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 该论文对ViT可解释性研究有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，创新性和实验充分性需进一步确认。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估并改进ViT解释方法的忠实性。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 提出与模型内部机制一致的解释策略。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 提升了解释可靠性，但缺乏具体量化数据。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在移动设备上部署时计算开销大的问题，提出单头ViT（SHViT）架构。②通过单头注意力机制和内存高效的宏设计（如减少冗余token）降低计算复杂度。③相比多头ViT，SHViT在保持精度的同时显著减少FLOPs和内存占用。④在ImageNet等基准上，SHViT以更低的计算成本达到与SOTA相近的精度，具体数据需查阅全文。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper introduces SHViT, a single-head Vision Transformer with memory-efficient macro design, to reduce computational cost for mobile deployment. It achieves competitive accuracy with significantly lower FLOPs and memory usage compared to multi-head ViTs on benchmarks like ImageNet.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 该工作对高效ViT设计有实际价值，适合边缘计算场景，实验充分。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出单头ViT架构，实现高效视觉Transformer。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 单头注意力与内存高效宏设计结合。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.result: 在低计算成本下保持高精度。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi._arxiv_id: SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer with Memory Efficient Macro Design.

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: ①针对跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中现有方法泛化能力差的问题，尤其是基于Transformer的开集检测器（如DE-ViT）在域差距大时性能下降。②通过风格、类间方差（ICV）和不可定义边界（IB）三个指标量化域差距，建立CD-FSOD基准，并发现性能下降与这些指标相关。③提出可学习实例特征对齐初始固定实例与目标类别，增强特征区分性；实例重加权模块赋予高重要性样本更高权重。④实验表明所提模块显著提升跨域检测性能，具体数据需查阅全文。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), revealing that open-set detectors like DE-ViT fail under large domain gaps. It introduces metrics (style, ICV, IB) to quantify gaps, builds a CD-FSOD benchmark, and proposes learnable instance features and reweighting modules to enhance generalization, achieving significant performance gains.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶等实际场景中的跨域检测问题，具有高应用价值，方法创新且实验系统。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立CD-FSOD基准并提出增强模块提升跨域少样本检测。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 结合域差距度量与可学习实例特征对齐。
2402.03094|v2.result: 显著提升跨域检测性能。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: ①针对旋转位置编码（RoPE）在视觉Transformer中应用不足的问题，探索其对2D视觉数据的有效性。②提出RoPE在ViT中的实用实现方法，支持2D图像处理。③分析表明RoPE具有出色的外推性能，即在推理时提高图像分辨率仍保持精度。④在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均带来性能提升，且额外计算开销极小。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper explores Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) for Vision Transformers, providing practical 2D implementations. It demonstrates impressive extrapolation performance at higher resolutions and achieves consistent improvements on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation with minimal overhead.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 该研究为ViT骨干网络提供了一种低成本性能提升方案，对高分辨率视觉任务有直接帮助。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 将RoPE成功应用于ViT并验证其外推优势。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 2D RoPE实现与分辨率外推分析。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在多个视觉基准上提升性能。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT易受对抗攻击且现有防御方法缺乏理论依据的问题，提出SpecFormer。②建立自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界，并提出最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）来精确控制这些界。③将MSVP集成到ViT注意力层，增强鲁棒性而不牺牲训练效率。④在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上，SpecFormer在防御对抗攻击方面优于其他SOTA方法。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SpecFormer to fortify ViTs against adversarial attacks with theoretical foundations. It establishes local Lipschitz bounds for self-attention and proposes Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP) to manage them, achieving superior robustness on CIFAR and ImageNet without compromising efficiency.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 该工作为ViT鲁棒性提供了理论支撑和实用方法，对安全敏感应用（如自动驾驶）有参考价值。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出基于Lipschitz界理论的ViT对抗防御方法。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 最大奇异值惩罚精确控制注意力层鲁棒性。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越SOTA防御性能。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: ①针对ViT推理成本固定、无法动态调整以适应不同资源约束的问题，提出Token Compensator。②设计一种无需重新训练的机制，通过补偿token来改变推理成本。③相比传统剪枝或蒸馏方法，该方法避免了昂贵的重新训练过程。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称能灵活调整推理成本。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper proposes Token Compensator to alter ViT inference cost without re-tuning, enabling dynamic adjustment under resource constraints. It avoids expensive retraining compared to pruning or distillation, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 该思路对动态推理场景有潜力，但摘要信息不足，需验证实际效果和通用性。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出无需重训练的ViT推理成本调整机制。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.innovation: 通过补偿token实现动态成本控制。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.result: 摘要未提供具体性能数据。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co._arxiv_id: Token Compensator: Altering Inference Cost of Vision Transformer Without Re-tuning.

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统音视频方法依赖独立骨干网络导致成本高、难以扩展的问题。②提出AVSiam框架，使用单一共享ViT骨干处理音频和视觉输入，并采用对比学习目标与多比例随机掩码方案进行预训练。③相比已有方法，显著提升参数效率和GPU内存效率，支持更大批次和模型规模，且能稳健处理纯音频、纯视觉和音视频输入。④在AudioSet和VGGSound上的音视频分类与检索任务中取得与先前方法相当或更优的结果。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: ①It addresses the high cost and poor scalability of traditional audio-visual methods that rely on independent backbones. ②It proposes AVSiam, a framework using a single shared ViT backbone for both audio and visual inputs, pretrained with contrastive matching and multi-ratio random masking. ③It improves parameter and memory efficiency, enabling larger batches and model scales, and handles audio-only, visual-only, and audio-visual inputs robustly. ④It achieves competitive or better results on AudioSet and VGGSound for classification and retrieval.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了共享骨干的音视频学习，对多模态感知有参考价值，但与自动驾驶核心方向关联较弱。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出AVSiam，首次实现单一共享ViT骨干的高效音视频预训练。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 采用共享骨干与多比例随机掩码，突破独立骨干的效率和扩展瓶颈。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在AudioSet和VGGSound上取得与先前方法相当或更优的性能。

Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中存在的公平性问题（如对特定人群的偏见）。②提出基于去偏自注意力机制的公平感知ViT方法，通过修改自注意力计算以减少敏感属性（如性别、种族）的影响。③相比标准ViT，在保持分类精度的同时提升公平性指标。④具体效果因摘要缺失无法量化，但方法在公平性-准确性权衡上具有潜力。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_en: ①It addresses fairness issues in Vision Transformers, such as biases against specific demographic groups. ②It proposes a fairness-aware ViT via debiased self-attention, modifying attention computation to reduce the influence of sensitive attributes. ③Compared to standard ViT, it improves fairness metrics while maintaining classification accuracy. ④Specific quantitative results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.assessment: 该论文关注公平性，但摘要信息不完整，且与自动驾驶感知方向关联度低。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.contribution: 提出去偏自注意力机制以增强ViT的公平性。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.innovation: 在自注意力层直接引入去偏策略，实现公平性-准确性平衡。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.result: 在公平性指标上有所提升，但具体数据未提供。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De._arxiv_id: Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via Debiased Self-Attention.

Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在密集预测任务（如检测、分割）中推理速度慢的问题。②提出一种无需重新训练即可移除token行和列的方法，通过结构化剪枝token网格来加速密集预测。③相比现有加速方法，无需额外训练或微调，直接应用于预训练模型，保持高精度。④在多个密集预测基准上实现显著加速，同时最小化精度损失（具体数据因摘要缺失未提供）。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_en: ①It addresses the slow inference of ViTs in dense prediction tasks like detection and segmentation. ②It proposes a method to remove rows and columns of tokens without retraining, enabling faster dense prediction via structured token pruning. ③Unlike existing acceleration methods, it requires no additional training or fine-tuning, directly applying to pretrained models. ④It achieves significant speedups on dense prediction benchmarks with minimal accuracy loss.
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.assessment: 该工作对自动驾驶中的实时感知有直接应用价值，方法简洁且实用性强。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.contribution: 提出无需重训的token行列移除方法，加速ViT密集预测。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.innovation: 利用结构化剪枝实现即插即用的推理加速，避免重训成本。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.result: 在密集预测任务上实现显著加速并保持高精度。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V._arxiv_id: Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in Vision Transformer Enables Faster Dense Prediction Without Retraining.

FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_cn: ①针对ViT中的公平性问题，提出FairViT方法。②通过自适应掩码机制，在训练过程中动态屏蔽对敏感属性敏感的token，以减少模型偏见。③相比标准ViT和固定掩码方法，自适应掩码能更灵活地平衡公平性和准确性。④具体效果因摘要缺失无法量化，但方法在公平性-准确性权衡上具有潜力。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_en: ①It addresses fairness issues in ViTs by proposing FairViT. ②It uses an adaptive masking mechanism to dynamically mask tokens sensitive to protected attributes during training, reducing bias. ③Compared to standard ViT and fixed masking, adaptive masking offers a more flexible fairness-accuracy trade-off. ④Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度低，且摘要信息不完整。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.contribution: 提出自适应掩码机制以提升ViT的公平性。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.innovation: 动态掩码敏感token，实现公平性-准确性自适应平衡。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.result: 在公平性指标上有所提升，但具体数据未提供。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada._arxiv_id: FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Adaptive Masking.

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在超低比特后训练量化（PTQ）中精度严重下降的问题，尤其是现有重建方法对输出重要性估计不准和GELU后激活量化困难。②提出了APHQ-ViT方法，基于平均扰动Hessian（APH）损失进行重要性估计，并设计了MLP重建（MR）方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并用APH损失在少量无标签校准集上重建。③改进点在于提出了更准确的APH损失，并针对GELU激活设计了专门的量化重建策略。④实验表明APHQ-ViT在线性量化下取得了显著优于现有PTQ方法的性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe accuracy drop of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization. It proposes APHQ-ViT, which uses an average perturbation Hessian loss for importance estimation and an MLP reconstruction method replacing GELU with ReLU. The method achieves superior performance over existing PTQ approaches on linear quantization.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT量化的关键难点提出了系统解决方案，APH损失和GELU处理策略具有理论依据，对边缘部署ViT有实际价值。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出了基于APH损失和MLP重建的ViT后训练量化框架，解决了GELU激活量化难题。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 引入平均扰动Hessian损失和改进的MLP重建策略，提升了量化精度。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在超低比特量化下显著提升了ViT的精度，优于现有PTQ方法。

ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）对抗样本的可迁移性不足问题，现有集成攻击方法在ViT上效果有限。②提出了ViT-EnsembleAttack方法，通过增强集成模型来提升对抗样本的迁移性，具体细节因摘要缺失无法详述。③改进点在于针对ViT架构特性设计集成策略。④效果未在摘要中给出具体数据。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adversarial transferability of Vision Transformers. It proposes ViT-EnsembleAttack to augment ensemble models for stronger transferability, though details are incomplete. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，方法细节和实验数据缺失，难以评估其实际贡献，但对抗迁移性研究有一定意义。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.contribution: 提出了针对ViT的集成攻击方法以增强对抗样本迁移性。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.innovation: 利用集成模型增强ViT对抗迁移性。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble._arxiv_id: ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble Models for Stronger Adversarial Transferability in Vision Transformers.

EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_cn: ①针对弹性视觉Transformer（ViT）在适应新任务时效率低下的问题。②提出了EA-Vit方法，实现高效的自适应调整，具体细节因摘要缺失无法详述。③改进点在于提升ViT适应过程中的计算效率。④效果未在摘要中给出具体数据。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of adapting elastic Vision Transformers to new tasks. It proposes EA-Vit for efficient adaptation, but details are incomplete. Specific results are not provided.
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.assessment: 摘要信息不足，方法创新性和实验验证不明确，相关度一般。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.contribution: 提出了弹性ViT的高效适应方法。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic._arxiv_id: EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic Vision Transformer.

Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_cn: ①针对无人机（UAV）跟踪中目标外观变化和背景干扰导致的跟踪性能下降问题。②提出了相似度引导的层自适应ViT方法，根据目标相似度动态调整网络层，具体细节因摘要缺失无法详述。③改进点在于利用相似度信息实现层级别的自适应，提升跟踪鲁棒性。④效果未在摘要中给出具体数据。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in UAV tracking, such as appearance changes and background clutter. It proposes a similarity-guided layer-adaptive ViT method to dynamically adjust network layers. Specific results are not provided.
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.assessment: 针对UAV跟踪的实际问题，层自适应策略有创新性，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.contribution: 提出了相似度引导的层自适应ViT用于UAV跟踪。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.innovation: 利用相似度信息实现层级别动态调整。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision._arxiv_id: Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision Transformer for UAV Tracking.

2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）训练数据中的长尾分布问题，导致头部概念过表示和尾部概念欠表示。②提出了自适应数据精炼框架（ADR），包含数据重平衡（DR）和数据合成（DS）两个阶段，DR基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS利用扩散模型合成尾部数据。③改进点在于首次系统分析LVLM的长尾问题，并针对LLaVA等模型和VQA、视觉推理等通用任务提出解决方案。④效果未在摘要中给出具体数据，但框架设计具有潜力。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-tail distribution in LVLM training data, causing overrepresentation of head concepts and underrepresentation of tail concepts. It proposes an Adaptive Data Refinement framework with data rebalancing and synthesis stages. The work systematically analyzes LVLM long-tail issues and targets general tasks like VQA.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该论文针对LVLM长尾问题提出了系统框架，具有重要实际意义，数据合成策略创新性强。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出了针对LVLM长尾问题的自适应数据精炼框架。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 结合数据重平衡和扩散模型合成解决长尾问题。
2503.12821|v2.result: 未提供具体效果数据，但框架设计合理。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在边缘设备上部署困难，而现有二值化CNN策略直接应用于ViT会导致性能大幅下降的问题。②提出了BHViT，一个二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型，基于三个关键观察：利用局部信息交互和层级特征聚合减少冗余计算，提出基于移位操作的模块增强二值MLP性能，以及基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法。③改进点在于设计了适合二值化的ViT架构，而非简单迁移CNN策略。④效果未在摘要中给出具体数据，但方法具有创新性。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of ViTs on edge devices by proposing BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture. It leverages local information interaction, shift operations for binary MLP, and quantization decomposition for attention binarization. The approach avoids performance drops from direct CNN binarization strategies.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT二值化提出了架构级创新，对边缘部署有重要价值，方法系统且具有实用性。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出了二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT及其全二值化模型。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 设计移位操作和量化分解方法提升二值ViT性能。
2503.02394|v2.result: 未提供具体效果数据，但架构设计具有潜力。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 针对人脸安全任务（如深度伪造检测、活体检测）中标注数据稀缺和跨域泛化差的问题，提出FSFM自监督预训练框架，结合掩码图像建模和实例判别，设计CRFR-P掩码策略捕获区域一致性和跨区域连贯性，并通过自蒸馏建立局部到全局对应。相比现有方法，首次将自监督学习用于人脸安全基础模型，在10个公开数据集上验证了跨数据集深度伪造检测、跨域活体检测和未知扩散伪造检测的泛化性能。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of labeled data and poor cross-domain generalization in face security tasks by proposing FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework combining masked image modeling and instance discrimination. It introduces CRFR-P masking to capture intra-region consistency and inter-region coherency, and uses self-distillation for local-to-global correspondence. Experiments on 10 datasets show improved generalization for deepfake detection, anti-spoofing, and diffusion forgery detection.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦人脸安全领域，与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但自监督方法设计有一定参考价值。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向人脸安全的自监督基础模型FSFM。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: 设计CRFR-P掩码策略和3C学习目标联合优化局部与全局特征。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集上显著提升跨域泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D室内检测依赖人工标注的问题，提出OpenM3D，一种无需人工标注的多视图3D检测器。方法基于ImGeoNet提取2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类无关3D定位损失和体素-语义对齐损失，并利用图嵌入技术将2D分割合并为3D伪框。相比OV-3DET，伪框精度和召回率更高，且通过采样多样CLIP特征提升检测精度。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on human annotations in open-vocabulary 3D indoor detection by proposing OpenM3D, a multi-view detector trained without labels. It adapts ImGeoNet voxel features, jointly optimizes class-agnostic localization and CLIP-based semantic alignment, and generates high-quality 3D pseudo boxes via graph embedding. It outperforms OV-3DET in pseudo-box quality and detection accuracy.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶3D检测和开放词汇感知高度相关，方法创新且实验充分。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需人工标注的开放词汇多视图3D检测器。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 利用图嵌入生成3D伪框并联合CLIP特征对齐。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度和召回率优于现有方法。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测模型中transformer解码器计算开销大、难以在边缘设备运行的问题，提出tgGBC零样本运行时剪枝方法。通过将分类分数与注意力图相乘得到键的重要性，逐层剪除不重要键，无需重训练。在ToC3D模型上实现1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型性能甚至提升，并已在边缘设备部署。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of transformer decoders in 3D detectors by proposing tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime pruning method that trims keys based on importance scores derived from classification scores and attention maps. It achieves 1.99x speedup on ToC3D with under 1% performance loss, and even improves some models, with deployment on edge devices.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 该论文针对3D检测效率问题，方法实用且与自动驾驶部署场景相关。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出零样本运行时注意力键剪枝方法tgGBC。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 利用分类分数与注意力图乘积作为键重要性度量。
2503.08101|v2.result: 在ToC3D上实现1.99倍加速且性能损失极小。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差的问题，提出一种免训练的自适应反馈框架，将输出层的patch级对应关系反馈到中间注意力，增强空间一致性。设计了注意力隔离、置信度剪枝和自适应集成模块，作为即插即用模块提升CLIP分割性能。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's poor localization in open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing a training-free feedback framework that adapts output-level patch correspondences back to intermediate attention. It includes attention isolation, confidence-based pruning, and ensemble modules, serving as a plug-in to improve segmentation.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 该论文与开放词汇感知相关，但主要针对2D分割，对自动驾驶3D感知参考有限。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出免训练反馈自适应注意力模块增强CLIP分割。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 利用输出预测作为空间一致性先验反馈至中间层。
2508.20265|v2.result: 提升开放词汇分割的语义一致性。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP在开放词汇语义分割中空间表示不足的问题，提出CLIPeR层次化框架，包含早期层融合模块和细粒度补偿模块。早期层保留空间结构信息，扩散模型自注意力图补偿局部细节，在7个分割数据集上达到最先进性能。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's insufficient spatial representation for open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing CLIPeR, a hierarchical framework with early-layer fusion and fine-grained compensation using diffusion attention maps. It achieves state-of-the-art results on seven segmentation datasets.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 该论文与开放词汇感知相关，但聚焦2D分割，对自动驾驶3D场景应用有限。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出层次化CLIP空间表示增强框架CLIPeR。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 结合早期层融合和扩散模型补偿局部细节。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 针对窗口视觉transformer量化推理效率低的问题，提出Mixa-Q混合精度激活量化框架，利用层内激活稀疏性，为不重要窗口分配更低比特。引入双分支Swin块分离高低精度计算，兼容QAT和PTQ，在COCO上实现免训练1.35倍加速且无精度损失，QAT下1.25倍无损加速。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient inference of quantized window-based vision transformers by proposing MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework exploiting intra-layer sparsity. It assigns lower bits to less important windows via a Two-Branch Swin Block, achieving 1.35x training-free speedup without accuracy loss on COCO, and 1.25x lossless speedup with QAT.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 该论文关注模型压缩与效率，与自动驾驶部署相关，但非核心感知方向。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 利用激活稀疏性为不同窗口分配不同比特。
2507.19131|v2.result: 在COCO上实现1.35倍加速且无精度损失。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: ①针对黑盒对抗样本迁移性不足的问题，现有方法多依赖监督学习的中间特征，未充分利用自监督视觉Transformer（ViT）的表示能力。②提出dSVA，一种生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击方法，利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，设计生成器训练框架，结合联合特征和注意力机制生成对抗样本。③改进点在于首次将自监督ViT的双重特征（CL和MIM）用于对抗攻击，利用其互补性提升迁移性。④实验表明，dSVA在多种黑盒模型上显著提高了攻击成功率，优于现有基于监督特征的攻击方法。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited transferability of black-box adversarial examples by proposing dSVA, a generative attack that exploits dual self-supervised Vision Transformer features from contrastive learning and masked image modeling. It introduces a novel training framework incorporating a generator and attention mechanisms to craft perturbations. Experiments demonstrate superior attack success rates across various black-box models compared to prior supervised-feature-based methods.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将自监督ViT特征引入对抗攻击，为提升迁移性提供了新视角，值得关注。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督ViT双重特征（CL和MIM）的生成式对抗攻击方法dSVA。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 首次结合对比学习和掩码图像建模的ViT特征，设计生成式训练框架。
2506.21046|v2.result: 在黑盒攻击迁移性上显著优于现有方法。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: ①针对预训练ViT模型在下游任务微调时存在灾难性遗忘和参数效率低的问题。②提出一种基于近似正交微调策略的高效适配方法，通过约束参数更新方向保持预训练知识。③改进点在于利用正交性理论减少任务间干扰，提升微调稳定性。④实验在多个视觉任务上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This work tackles catastrophic forgetting and low parameter efficiency in fine-tuning pre-trained Vision Transformers by introducing an approximately orthogonal fine-tuning strategy. It constrains parameter updates to preserve pre-trained knowledge, reducing task interference. Experiments across vision tasks show improved stability, though specific metrics are omitted in the abstract.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 方法理论清晰，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估实验充分性。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出近似正交微调策略用于高效适配预训练ViT。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 将正交性约束应用于ViT微调，减少知识遗忘。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.result: 在多个视觉任务上提升微调稳定性。

An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory costs of Vision Transformers in TinyML applications by proposing an efficient hybrid architecture combining convolutions and attention. It introduces lightweight modules for resource-constrained devices. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.assessment: 面向实际部署场景，但缺乏实验数据，创新性和实用性待验证。
